translation: n. 潜力；可能性 | adj. 潜在的，可能的
definitionEn:
(1) n. the possibility that something will develop in a particular way, or have a particular effect
(2) n. a natural ability or quality that shows someone or something will be successful
(3) n. likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 潜在的，可能的（常作定语，修饰名词）
uncommonMeanings.example: A potential agent was sitting in the third row. 一位潜在的经纪人正坐在第三排。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【物理】电位，电势（不可数，学科术语）
uncommonMeanings.example: The device measures the electric potential across the cell. 该仪器测量电池两端的电位。

readingExamples: Most importantly, your time and effort at senior high school will open the door to your potential.

posExamples.sentence: The moment she stepped onto the stage, a hush fell over the audience — it was as if everyone sensed the raw potential radiating from this unknown girl. （读后续写·人物出场）
I am writing to express my sincere belief that with proper guidance, every student in our class has the potential to excel in the upcoming speech contest. （应用文·建议信）
Unbeknown to the young pianist, a potential agent was sitting in the third row, captivated by every note.

wordForms.other: 构词法·后缀：potent（有效的，强有力的）+ -ial→potential；名词与形容词同形，靠位置区分——冠词/物主代词后作名词(your potential)，名词前作定语(potential danger)。副词 potentially = possibly。注意："潜力"义不可数，不说 a potential/potentials。

idioms.example: It was not until Mr. Chen took him under his wing that Li Wei began to fulfil the potential that had lain dormant for so many years. （读后续写·师生关系）

collocations.phrase: have the potential for sth / to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】有……的潜力；有可能做某事（n. possibility that sth will develop）
collocations.example: The company certainly has the potential for growth. 那家公司当然有发展潜力。／The technology has the potential to change our transportation systems and our cities. 这项技术有可能改变我们的交通系统和城市。
Hard work will help you achieve / fulfil / realize your full potential. 努力将帮助你发挥全部潜力。

collocations.phrase: a potential candidate / threat / risk / benefit
collocations.translation: 【课件】潜在的人选／威胁／风险／益处（adj. likely to develop in the future）
collocations.example: For the first time she realized the potential threat of her situation. 她第一次意识到自己处境的潜在威胁。
The advertisement targets new ways of attracting potential customers. 这则广告着眼于吸引潜在客户的新途径。

collocations.translation: 【课件】潜在的危险／问题／副作用
collocations.example: The potential side effects of the drug are unknown. 这种药的潜在副作用尚不清楚。

collocations.phrase: open the door to your potential
collocations.translation: 开启你潜能的大门（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Your time and effort will open the door to your potential. 你付出的时间和努力将开启你潜能的大门。

collocations.translation: 实现／发挥某人的潜力（课文主题搭配）
collocations.example: Hard work helped her realize her full potential. 勤奋让她充分发挥了潜力。
The workshop helped her tap into a creative potential she never knew she possessed. 工作坊帮她发掘出自己从不知道的创作潜力。
The programme holds enormous potential for broadening students' horizons. 这个项目在开阔学生视野方面潜力巨大。
The small startup showed remarkable potential for growth. 这家小公司展现出惊人的成长潜力。

collocations.phrase: a potential candidate / threat / risk / benefit
collocations.translation: 潜在的人选 / 威胁 / 风险 / 益处
collocations.example: The researchers identified several potential benefits. 研究者发现了几项潜在益处。
A good campaign can attract many potential customers. 好的宣传能吸引许多潜在客户。
Parents should be aware of the potential dangers of too much screen time. 家长应注意长时间看屏幕的潜在危险。
Read the label to learn about potential side effects. 读标签了解潜在副作用。

synonyms.example: The young athlete showed great promise, and his coach whispered to a colleague, 'Mark my words — this boy will go far.' （读后续写·动作对话）
synonyms.usage: 侧重预示未来的积极信号，适用于续写中埋下伏笔

synonyms.example: I believe every participant has the capacity to contribute meaningfully to this volunteer project. （应用文·招募信）
synonyms.usage: 侧重内在能力和限度

advancedExpressions.expression: realize / fulfil / reach / tap into / unlock one's potential; live up to one's potential
advancedExpressions.example: Only through consistent effort can one truly unlock the potential that lies dormant within. 唯有持之以恒，才能真正释放沉睡于内心的潜能。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·比喻性未来结构（从课文open the door句长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: 主语 + will open the door to sth（正常语序、无倒装；以"打开大门"隐喻未来必然结果）
advancedExpressions.example: Your time and effort at senior high school will open the door to your potential. 你在高中付出的时间与努力，将为你的潜能打开大门。

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did sb. realize the potential within
advancedExpressions.example: Only then did she realize the potential within — a strength she had never known was there. （倒装+隐喻，续写结尾段升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: given the potential of ..., it is advisable that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Given the potential of this programme to transform our reading habits, it is highly advisable that every student participate actively. （倡议信结尾呼吁）

advancedExpressions.expression: the potential ... far outweighs ...
advancedExpressions.example: The potential benefits of AI-assisted learning far outweigh its perceived risks — provided that ethical safeguards are firmly in place.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It dawned on her, slowly at first and then all at once, that the potential she had spent years searching for in others had been quietly residing within herself all along — waiting, like a seed beneath winter soil, for the right moment to break through. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It dawned on sb. that...心理觉醒 + 比喻(seed beneath winter soil) + 副词节奏控制(slowly...then all at once)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is therefore my firm conviction that our school should establish a mentorship programme through which every student's unique potential can be identified, nurtured, and ultimately brought to full fruition. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that...正式主句 + through which定语从句 + 三动词递进(identified, nurtured, brought)

original_sentence: Most importantly, your time and effort at senior high school will open the door to your potential.

classPractice.question: The technology has the potential ____ (change) our transportation systems and our cities.
classPractice.note: 【课件】have the potential to do sth 有可能做某事；potential 后接不定式 to do。

classPractice.question: 用 potential 家族词填空：new ways of attracting ____ customers；the ____ side effects of the drug are unknown；it is important to identify ____ problems at the design stage.
classPractice.note: 【课件】potential 作形容词修饰名词：potential customers/side effects/problems，表"潜在的"。

classPractice.question: 在高中付出的努力将开启你潜能的大门。Your effort at senior high school will ____ ____ ____ ____ your potential.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块 open the door to sth，to 为介词后接名词 potential。

classPractice.question: With proper guidance, every student has the ____ (potent) to excel in the contest.
classPractice.note: have the potential to do 有潜力做某事；此处需名词形式，不可数。

classPractice.question: 用 potential 的适当形式填空：Read the label carefully to learn about the drug's ____ side effects. It could ____ save your life.
classPractice.note: 第一空作定语用形容词 potential；第二空修饰动词用副词 potentially（=possibly）。

translation: 迫不及待（做某事）；等不及
definitionEn:
(1) phr. used to say that someone is very excited about something and eager for it to happen
(2) phr. to be very eager or impatient to do something
readingExamples: I can't wait to describe to you what senior high school life is like.

posExamples.sentence: On the first day of school, Jenny could hardly sleep the night before — she simply couldn't wait to meet her new classmates and explore the campus that had appeared in her dreams all summer. （读后续写·心理描写）
I can't wait to show you around our city when you arrive next month. Looking forward to your visit! （应用文·书信结尾）

wordForms.other: 结构注记：can't/couldn't wait + to do（做某事）或 + for sth（等某事）；否定形式表"迫不及待"，实为反话正说——can't wait 字面"等不了"=非常想。同义表达：be dying to do / be itching to do / be eager to do / look forward to doing。注意 look forward to 的 to 是介词接 doing，而 can't wait to 的 to 接原形。

collocations.phrase: can't wait to do sth = can hardly wait to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】迫不及待地要去做某事
collocations.example: She couldn't wait to open the letter. = She could hardly wait to open the letter. 她迫不及待地想拆开那封信。

collocations.translation: 迫不及待做某事（课文原句结构：can't wait to describe）
collocations.example: I can't wait to describe to you what senior high school life is like. 我迫不及待想向你描述高中生活是什么样的。

collocations.phrase: can't wait to see / hear / meet...
collocations.translation: 等不及要见到/听到/见到……
collocations.example: I can't wait to see the look on her face. 我等不及想看她脸上的表情。

collocations.phrase: can hardly wait (for sth / to do sth)
collocations.translation: 几乎等不及（比 can't wait 语气更强）
collocations.example: The children could hardly wait for the bell to ring. 孩子们几乎等不及铃声响起。
Every senior said they couldn't wait for the exam to be over. 每个高三生都说等不及考试结束。

synonyms.translation: 极想做某事（口语，情感最强）
synonyms.example: He was dying to ask her to the prom. 他极想邀请她去舞会。
synonyms.usage: 非正式口语，语气最强；结构 be dying to do / be dying for sth。与 can't wait to do 近义可互换，但更夸张。

synonyms.example: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon. 我期待尽快收到你的回信。
synonyms.usage: 较正式，to 为介词，后接名词或动名词（doing），不接动词原形；can't wait 更口语、情感更强，to 后接动词原形。

synonyms.example: The volunteers were eager to contribute their time. 志愿者们渴望贡献时间。
synonyms.usage: 偏书面，be eager to do sth / be eager for sth，强调积极主动的态度与内心渴望。

synonyms.translation: 心痒难耐想做某事（口语）
synonyms.example: She was itching to tell him the news. 她心痒难耐地想告诉他这消息。
synonyms.usage: 口语化，比 can't wait 更有"按捺不住"的意味，多用于续写心理描写。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·can't help doing / can't help but do（课件关联辨析）
advancedExpressions.expression: can't help doing sth. / can't help but do sth（忍不住／不可避免做某事）VS can't help (to) do sth.（不能帮助做某事）
advancedExpressions.example: She couldn't help wondering what he was thinking. = She couldn't help but wonder what he was thinking. 她忍不住想知道他在想什么。／I can't help (to) organize the party — you'd better ask someone else. 我帮不了你筹办派对——你最好另找他人帮忙。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表急切期待，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: can't wait to do / be dying to do / be itching to do / be eager to do / look forward to doing / count down the days until
advancedExpressions.example: I can't wait to see you again — honestly, I've been counting down the days until your arrival. 我迫不及待想再见到你——说真的，我一直在倒数你到来的日子。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·宾语从句（从课文describe...what句长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: can't wait to describe/tell/show + sb + what/how...（间接引语作宾语，用陈述语序）
advancedExpressions.example: I can't wait to describe to you what senior high school life is like. 我迫不及待想告诉你高中生活是什么样。

advancedExpressions.expression: I am counting down the days until...
advancedExpressions.example: I am counting down the days until your arrival — the guest room is already prepared! （书信·表达热切期待）

advancedExpressions.expression: the anticipation was almost unbearable
advancedExpressions.example: The night before the competition, the anticipation was almost unbearable — she tossed and turned, her mind racing. （读后续写·赛前紧张心理）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I can't wait to see you.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The thought of seeing you again fills me with such excitement that the days ahead seem to stretch into an eternity of waiting. （书信·情感升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象名词作主语(The thought...) + such...that...结果状语从句 + 夸张(an eternity of waiting)

sentenceUpgrade.original: She couldn't wait to open the gift.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Her fingers trembled with barely contained anticipation as she reached for the ribbon — every second of delay felt like an exquisite torment. （读后续写·动作+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 具体动作描写(trembled, reached) + 抽象心理名词(anticipation, torment) + 破折号展开细节

original_sentence: I can't wait to describe to you what senior high school life is like.

classPractice.type: 语境应用·语法填空（课件）
classPractice.question: But something inside me was going to climb that mountain at all cost. I could hardly wait ____ (try) this adventure again.
classPractice.note: 【课件·语境应用】can hardly wait to do sth = can't wait to do sth 迫不及待地做某事；wait 后接不定式 to do。

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·关联辨析）
classPractice.question: She couldn't help ____ (wonder) what he was thinking.（用非谓语填空）
classPractice.note: 【课件】can't help doing sth 忍不住做某事，help 后接动名词；对照 can't help but do（后接原形）与 can't help (to) do（不能帮助做）。

classPractice.question: I can't wait ____ (describe) to you what senior high school life is like.
classPractice.note: 课文原句：can't wait to do sth，wait 后接动词不定式，不接动名词。

classPractice.question: I'm really looking forward to seeing you. （用 can't wait 改写，意思不变）I ____ ____ ____ ____ you.
classPractice.note: look forward to doing 与 can't wait to do 近义；注意后者 to 接原形 see，不是 seeing。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（can't wait to / look forward to）：In a formal letter you may write "I ____ hearing from you", but with a close friend you might say "I ____ see you!"
classPractice.answer: look forward to; can't wait to
classPractice.note: look forward to 较正式、接动名词 hearing；can't wait to 更口语、接原形 see。

translation: adj. 中学的（招收11或13岁以上学生）；级别高的；高级水平的；老年的 | n. 级别（或地位）较高者；较…年长的人；高水平运动员
definitionEn:
(1) adj. high in rank or status, or higher in rank than someone else
(2) adj. relating to or intended for older students, especially those at the later stage of secondary school
(3) adj. (of people) old; having reached the later years of life
(4) n. someone who is older or higher in rank than someone else; (AmE) a student in the final year of high school or college

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （美国）高中或大学的毕业班学生
uncommonMeanings.example: As a senior facing the college application season, Jason flipped through the yearbook late at night. 作为面临大学申请季的毕业班学生，Jason 深夜翻看着毕业纪念册。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 级别（或地位）较高者；较年长的人
uncommonMeanings.example: She was ten years my senior. 她比我年长十岁。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 高水平运动员（成年组选手）
uncommonMeanings.example: He now competes with the seniors rather than the juniors. 他现在与成年组而非青少年组选手同场竞技。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （置于同名父子中父亲的名字后）老…，大…（缩写 Sr.）
uncommonMeanings.example: The sign still read 'Thomas Baker, Senior'. 招牌上仍写着"老托马斯·贝克"。

readingExamples: Welcome to senior high school!

posExamples.sentence: On my first day at senior high school, I stood frozen at the gate, clutching my schedule so tightly that the paper crumpled, until a warm voice behind me said, 'Lost? Follow me.' （读后续写·开学第一天·紧张与善意）
I am writing to invite you, as a senior engineer with rich hands-on experience, to deliver a lecture on artificial intelligence to the members of our science club next Friday afternoon. （应用文·邀请信）

Respecting our seniors is not merely a matter of politeness; it is a recognition that their experience, accumulated over decades of trial and error, remains a precious resource for the younger generation. （议论文·尊老美德）
It is high time that more volunteers visited the local nursing home, for many senior citizens there long not for material comfort but for simple companionship and a patient listener. （议论文·老龄化社会）

wordForms.noun: seniority（资历；年长）；senior（较年长者/毕业班学生）
wordForms.other: 构词/易错注记：反义词 junior（junior high school 初中 vs senior high school 高中；be junior to sb 职位低于某人）。核心考点——be senior/junior to sb 用介词 to，绝不用 than。senior citizen = 老年人（委婉）；Sr.=老…（用于父名后）。名词 seniority 指"工龄/资历"。

idioms.translation: （幽默）一时健忘，老年失神的瞬间
idioms.example: Grandpa patted every pocket for the glasses that were perched on his own head, then chuckled, 'Forgive me — just having a senior moment.' （读后续写·祖孙温情·幽默细节）

collocations.translation: 高中（课文原句词块：Welcome to senior high school!）
collocations.example: Welcome to senior high school! 欢迎来到高中！

collocations.translation: 职位/资历高于某人；比某人年长（用 to，不用 than！）
collocations.example: Ms. Lin is senior to me in the department. 林女士在部门里资历比我高。
The bus offers free seats to senior citizens. 公交车为老年人提供免费座位。
Our club pays weekly visits to senior citizens nearby. 我们社团每周探访附近的老年人。

collocations.translation: 高级职位／高级官员／高管
collocations.example: Years of dedication earned her a senior position. 多年的投入让她赢得了高级职位。
The senior members coached the newcomers patiently. 资深成员耐心指导新人。

collocations.translation: 毕业年级那一年（高三／大四）
collocations.example: In his senior year, the exam loomed ever larger. 到了毕业年级，考试的压力越来越大。
She is my senior by ten years. 她比我大十岁。
Our proposal was received well by senior management. 我们的提议受到高层管理人员的好评。

synonyms.example: She is my elder sister; she is also senior to me at work. 她是我姐姐，工作上资历也比我高。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：elder 只指血亲/家庭中年长（elder brother），作定语常前置，不与 than 连用；senior 侧重级别/资历，且 be senior to sb 用介词 to（≠ than）。要说"比…年长"用 be senior to sb 或 be older than sb，不说 senior than。

synonyms.example: She wisely consulted her immediate superior. 她明智地请教了直属上级。
synonyms.usage: superior 强调等级上的"上级"，可作名词指"上司"，be superior to sb（也用 to），隐含权力关系；senior 兼指年长与资历深，语气更中性温和。

synonyms.example: An elderly gentleman gave up his seat. 一位上了年纪的先生让了座。
synonyms.usage: elderly 是描述老年人的委婉形容词，只指年龄，作定语；senior 表"老年的"多用于 senior citizen 等固定说法，另有"级别高、资深"义。

synonyms.example: The school offers advanced courses in programming. 学校开设高级编程课程。
synonyms.usage: advanced 指水平、阶段或技术"高级、领先"（advanced learners）；senior 指人的级别、资历或年龄，不形容技术水平。

advancedExpressions.expression: senior high school; senior citizen; senior management/position; be senior to sb; one's senior year; senior by X years
advancedExpressions.example: As a senior citizen, my grandfather is senior to everyone in our reading club by at least twenty years. 作为一位老人，我爷爷在读书会里比谁都至少年长二十岁。

advancedExpressions.expression: junior high school ↔ senior high school; be junior to sb ↔ be senior to sb（均用 to）
advancedExpressions.example: Whether you are junior or senior to your classmates, respect is a two-way street. 无论你比同学资历高还是低，尊重都是双向的。

advancedExpressions.expression: It was not until ... that sb. truly understood what it meant to be a senior student
advancedExpressions.example: It was not until I helped a tearful freshman find her classroom that I truly understood what it meant to be a senior student. （not until 强调句+破折号点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: As a senior ... with ... experience, you are undoubtedly the ideal person to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As a senior editor with over a decade of experience, you are undoubtedly the ideal person to judge our writing contest. （身份+资历恭维式开场）

advancedExpressions.expression: Whether junior or senior, ... share(s) the responsibility of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Whether junior or senior, every member of society shares the responsibility of caring for the environment. （whether 让步结构+拟人收束）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The senior students did not simply show us around; they walked beside us through every corridor of confusion, turning our nervous first week into a journey of belonging. （读后续写·校园互助）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not simply... 否定引出递进 + 抽象名词具体化(corridor of confusion) + turning 现在分词表结果，化叙述为画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: I am a senior high school student.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As a senior high school student standing at the crossroads between adolescence and adulthood, I am learning to shoulder responsibilities that once seemed far beyond me. （应用文·自我介绍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 介词短语开篇亮明身份 + crossroads 隐喻定位人生阶段 + that 定语从句体现成长弧线

original_sentence: Welcome to senior high school!

classPractice.question: Although Ms. Lin was ten years senior ____ me, she treated my suggestions seriously.
classPractice.note: 核心易错点：be senior to sb 用介词 to，绝不用 than。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（senior / junior）：In China, students go to ____ high school (grades 7-9) first and then ____ high school (grades 10-12).
classPractice.note: junior high 初中，senior high 高中，一对反义词。

classPractice.question: 把"我们社团每周探访附近的老年人"译成英语。（senior）
classPractice.answer: Our club pays weekly visits to senior citizens nearby. / Our club visits senior citizens in the neighbourhood every week.
classPractice.note: senior citizen(s) = 老年人，比 old people 更委婉得体。

definitionEn:
(1) n. a way or track that is built or made by people walking over the ground
(2) n. the direction or route along which someone or something moves
(3) n. a set of actions, especially ones that lead to a goal or result (a course of action)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】小径，小道（a track made deliberately or by many people walking）
uncommonMeanings.example: a path leading to the summer house 一条通往避暑别墅的小径

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（开出的）通道
uncommonMeanings.example: Police cleared a path through the protesters. 警察从抗议者中开辟出了一条通道。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】方向，路线，轨道
uncommonMeanings.example: The tornado destroyed everything in its path. 龙卷风摧毁了沿途的一切。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（有助于实现……的）道路，途径
uncommonMeanings.example: She saw a college degree as her path to success. 她认为大学学位是自己通往成功的途径。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）途径，道路，行动方针（抽象义，课文核心用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: Everyone must find their own path in life. 每个人都必须找到自己的人生道路。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （移动的）路线，轨迹，方向
uncommonMeanings.example: The hurricane changed its path overnight. 飓风一夜之间改变了路径。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （计算机）路径，文件或目录的位置标识
uncommonMeanings.example: Make sure the file path is correct before running the programme. 运行程序前确认文件路径正确。

readingExamples: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges: a new environment, new knowledge and new ways of thinking.

posExamples.sentence: She walked slowly down the winding path, fallen leaves crunching beneath her feet, each step taking her further from the noise of the city and closer to a silence she had not known she needed. （读后续写·环境描写+心理状态）
Choosing the right career path can be confusing, and I am writing to share a few thoughts that I hope will help you clarify your own direction. （应用文·建议信）

While technology has undoubtedly paved new paths for education, it is the human element — the teacher who inspires, the classmate who challenges — that ultimately determines whether a student walks that path with purpose or merely wanders along it without direction. （议论文·科技与教育）

wordForms.other: 构词/发音注记：单数 path /pɑːθ/，复数 paths 词尾清辅音 /θ/ 变浊 /ðz/（同类：mouth-mouths, bath-baths）。合成词 pathway、footpath、bike path。抽象搭配 the path to success / a career path；比喻常与 lead to、cross、carve out 连用。

idioms.translation: 与某人不期而遇；偶然相遇
idioms.example: Years later, when their paths crossed again in a crowded airport terminal, she realised that some connections are not broken by time — only buried, waiting for the right moment to resurface. （读后续写·重逢场景）
As the first person in her family to attend university, she was blazing a path that her younger siblings would one day follow with far fewer obstacles. （读后续写·励志成长）

idioms.translation: 最省力的途径，阻力最小的道路
idioms.example: It is tempting to take the path of least resistance — to copy others' answers, to stay silent when you should speak — but greatness, I firmly believe, lies in the other direction. （应用文·励志演讲）

idioms.idiom: (go / venture) off the beaten path / track
idioms.translation: 不走寻常路，另辟蹊径；在偏僻之处
idioms.example:
Most tourists flocked to the well-known spots, but she ventured off the beaten path and discovered a hidden waterfall that none of the guidebooks had mentioned — and it was there, in that unspoiled corner of the world, that she felt truly alive for the first time in years. （读后续写·探索与发现）
The café he had chosen for our interview was off the beaten track — tucked away in a narrow alley where the only sounds were the occasional bicycle bell and the murmur of an old man reading poetry aloud to no one in particular. （读后续写·场景设定）

idioms.translation: 走前人未走之路，独辟蹊径
idioms.example: I am writing to express my admiration for your decision to follow an untrodden path — choosing to study traditional handicrafts in an age obsessed with algorithms and apps takes a rare kind of courage, and I have no doubt that your journey, though lonely at times, will lead to something truly original. （应用文·鼓励信）

collocations.example: She saw a college degree as her path to success. 她认为大学学位是自己通往成功的途径。
If you believe you can make her happy, I won't stand in your way. 如果你相信你能使她幸福，我不会妨碍你的。

collocations.phrase: a path leading to ... / clear a path through ...
collocations.translation: 【课件】通往……的小径／从……中开辟出一条通道
collocations.example: a path leading to the summer house 通往避暑别墅的小径；Police cleared a path through the protesters. 警察从抗议者中开辟出一条通道。
The tornado destroyed everything in its path. 龙卷风摧毁了沿途的一切。

collocations.translation: 你面前的道路（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges. 你面前的道路通向一个充满挑战的世界。
Exploring different career paths through internships is valuable. 通过实习探索不同的职业道路很有价值。

collocations.phrase: set sb. on the path to ...
collocations.example: That conversation set me on the path to becoming a writer. 那次谈话使我走上了成为作家的道路。

collocations.translation: 引领某人走上某条道路
collocations.example: Curiosity led her down the path of scientific discovery. 好奇心引领她走上科学探索之路。
She chose to carve out her own path. 她选择开辟自己的道路。

collocations.translation: 蜿蜒的/陡峭的/崎岖的道路
collocations.example: The rocky path to the summit tested every muscle in his legs. 通往山顶的崎岖小路考验着他腿上的每一块肌肉。
She refused to let anyone stand in her path. 她不容任何人挡她的路。

synonyms.example: He traced with his finger the route through the forest. 他用手指描出穿过森林的路线。
synonyms.usage: route 强调从A到B的具体行经路线（bus route, escape route），多为规划好的；path 既有具体小路义，又有"人生途径"抽象义。

synonyms.example: They followed the narrow track through the woods. 他们沿着林间小径前行。
synonyms.usage: track 常指未经铺设、由踩踏形成的乡间小路，更有"人迹/足迹"意味（off the beaten track）；path 更中性通用。

synonyms.example: The wisest course is to address the misunderstanding directly. 最明智的做法是直接消除误会。
synonyms.usage: course 侧重抽象的行动方针或进程（course of action, the course of history）；path 既有具体又有抽象义，两者抽象义可换但 path 更有"选择/方向"色彩。

advancedExpressions.expression: the path to success; career path; cross sb's path; carve out a path; off the beaten path; set sb on the path to; stand in one's path
advancedExpressions.example: She chose to carve out her own path rather than follow the beaten track others had trodden. 她选择开辟自己的道路，而非追随他人踩出的老路。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·后置定语（从课文the path before you长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: 名词 + 介词短语/分词作后置定语（the path before you = 在你面前的道路）
advancedExpressions.example: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges. 你面前的这条路通向一个充满挑战的世界。（before you 后置修饰 path，full of challenges 后置修饰 world）

advancedExpressions.expression: Not until ... did sb. realise that the hardest path often leads to the most beautiful view.
advancedExpressions.example: Not until he reached the summit did he realise that the hardest path often leads to the most beautiful view. （倒装句+隐喻，续写结尾升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: What matters is not how fast you walk but that you stay on the right path.
advancedExpressions.example: What matters is not how fast you walk but that you stay on the right path. （主语从句+隐喻，建议信/演讲稿）

advancedExpressions.expression: It is those who dare to go off the beaten path that end up changing the world.
advancedExpressions.example: It is those who dare to go off the beaten path that end up changing the world. （强调句+隐喻，议论文观点论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She chose her own path in life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: While others marched obediently along the path that had been laid out for them — good grades, a safe university, a secure job — she paused at the crossroads, listened to a voice that was barely more than a whisper, and stepped onto a path that existed, until that moment, only in her imagination. And though the undergrowth was thick and the way uncertain, she walked it not with fear but with the quiet exhilaration of someone who had finally stopped living someone else's life and started living her own. （读后续写·人生抉择+内心独白）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: While对比从句 + 现在分词作状语(marched, paused, listened, stepped) + 隐喻(undergrowth/way uncertain) + 哲理收束(stopped living someone else's life and started living her own)

sentenceUpgrade.original: There are many paths to success.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Had anyone told me, when I was stumbling through my first year of senior high, that the path to success resembled not a highway but a river — meandering, unpredictable, sometimes rushing forward and sometimes pooling in quiet eddies where the most important learning took place — I might have worried less about falling behind and trusted more in the journey itself. （虚拟语气倒装+比喻+读后续写反思）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Had...虚拟倒装句 + 比喻(highway vs river) + 对比(rushing vs pooling) + 反思收束

original_sentence: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges: a new environment, new knowledge and new ways of thinking.

classPractice.question: 她认为大学学位是自己通往成功的途径。She saw a college degree as her ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 【课件】path to success 通往成功的途径，to 为介词接名词 success。

classPractice.question: 如果你相信你能使她幸福，我不会妨碍你的。（stand in one's way）
classPractice.answer: If you believe you can make her happy, I won't stand in your way.
classPractice.note: 【课件】stand in one's path / way 妨碍某人、挡某人的路。

classPractice.question: 你面前的道路通向一个充满挑战的世界。The ____ ____ you leads to a world full of challenges.
classPractice.note: 课文原句：the path before you，介词短语 before you 作 path 的后置定语。

classPractice.question: 用 path 的搭配填空：Exploring internships early can set you on the ____ ____ your dream career.
classPractice.note: set sb on the path to sth（走上通往……的道路），to 为介词接名词。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（path / route）：The bus takes the same ____ every day, but everyone must find their own ____ in life.
classPractice.note: 具体规划好的行车路线用 route；抽象的人生道路用 path。

definitionEn:
(1) v. to result in something; to cause a particular situation or event to happen
(2) v. to be the reason why something happens or exists
(3) v. to guide someone or something to a place or result

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （道路、门等）通向，通往（具体空间义）
uncommonMeanings.example: This narrow path leads to the beach. 这条小路通向海滩。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 导致，引起，造成（某结果，抽象因果义，课文用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: Too much stress can lead to health problems. 压力过大会导致健康问题。

readingExamples: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges, new knowledge and new ways of thinking.

posExamples.sentence: A single careless word, spoken in anger, led to a silence between them that stretched into weeks — and it was only when she saw the hurt still lingering in his eyes that she understood how much damage one moment could do. （读后续写·冲突与和解）
I believe that consistent practice rather than last-minute cramming will ultimately lead to better results, and I hope these suggestions prove helpful in your preparation. （应用文·建议信）

While technological progress has undoubtedly led to unprecedented convenience, it is worth questioning whether the path we have paved leads to genuine human connection or merely to a more efficient form of isolation. （议论文·科技与社会）

wordForms.other: 语法/易错注记：lead 过去式-过去分词 led-led（拼写 led，非 lead）。结构区分——lead to sth/doing（导致，to 是介词，后接名词或动名词）VS lead sb to do sth（促使某人做，to do 是不定式）。同义替换：result in / give rise to / bring about / contribute to。别名词化误用："导致"不说 lead sb doing。

collocations.translation: 【课件】导致，引起；（道路）通向（to 是介词，后接名词或动名词，不接动词原形）
collocations.example: A path leads to the yard. 有条小路通向庭院。／Eating too much sugar can lead to health problems. 食用过多的糖会引起健康问题。／His actions could lead to him losing his job. 他的行为会让他丢掉工作。

collocations.translation: 【课件】促使／使得某人做某事（这里 lead 后接不定式 to do）
collocations.example: What led him to kill his wife? 是什么原因让他杀了妻子？

collocations.phrase: What led you to this conclusion?
collocations.translation: 【课件】你是如何得出这个结论的？（lead sb to sth）
collocations.example: What led you to this conclusion? 你是如何得出这个结论的？

collocations.phrase: the path ... leads to a world of ...
collocations.translation: ……的道路通向……的世界（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges. 你面前的道路通向一个充满挑战的世界。
All the evidence leads to the conclusion that hard work matters most. 所有证据都得出勤奋最重要的结论。
A lack of communication often leads to misunderstandings. 缺乏沟通常常导致误会。

collocations.translation: 一件事引发另一件事；顺理成章
collocations.example: One thing led to another, and they became close friends. 事情就这么一步步发展，他们成了挚友。

She stood at the crossroads of her life, knowing that the path she chose would lead to a future she could only dimly imagine — and for the first time, that uncertainty felt less like fear and more like possibility. （读后续写·人生抉择）

Her persistent encouragement led to him finally picking up the violin again after ten years of silence — and the music that followed was the most beautiful apology either of them had ever heard. （读后续写·人物转变）
Over-reliance on AI tools may lead to students losing the very skills — critical thinking, deep reading, independent reasoning — that education is meant to cultivate. （议论文·科技与教育）

synonyms.example: Years of dedication resulted in a gold medal. 多年的投入换来一枚金牌。
synonyms.usage: result in 后接结果（=lead to），语气正式；对照 result from 表"由……引起"（后接原因）。二者宾语都是名词/动名词。

synonyms.translation: 引起，导致（多指抽象事物、问题）
synonyms.example: The new policy gave rise to heated debate. 新政策引发了激烈争论。
synonyms.usage: give rise to 是固定习语，后接名词，常用于导致问题、争议、现象等，比 lead to 更书面。

synonyms.example: Several factors contributed to his recovery. 多个因素促成了他的康复。
synonyms.usage: contribute to 强调是多个原因之一（不一定是唯一/直接原因），语气比 lead to 温和；to 为介词接名词/动名词。

synonyms.example: A small act of kindness brought about the change. 一个小小的善举带来了改变。
synonyms.usage: bring about 强调带来重大变化，宾语可置于 about 后或代词插中间（bring it about），常用于积极语境。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"导致"，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: lead to / result in / give rise to / bring about / contribute to / trigger / account for
advancedExpressions.example: Over-reliance on AI may lead to — or, more precisely, give rise to — the very loss of skills education aims to cultivate. 过度依赖人工智能可能导致（更确切说是引发）教育本应培养的能力恰恰丧失。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·主谓一致（从课文the path leads to长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: 单数主语 + leads to（第三人称单数动词加 -s）；paths + lead to
advancedExpressions.example: The path leads to a bright future; many paths lead to the same goal. 这条路通向光明的未来；条条大路通向同一目标。

advancedExpressions.expression: Little did sb. know that ... would lead to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Little did he know that a single decision would lead to an encounter that reshaped his life. （倒装句+因果链，续写悬念铺设）

advancedExpressions.expression: It is ... that leads to ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is not the hours you put in but the focus you bring that leads to genuine progress. （强调句，建议信核心观点）

advancedExpressions.expression: Not only does ... lead to A, but it also paves the way for B.
advancedExpressions.example: Not only does reading widely lead to a richer vocabulary, but it also paves the way for a more empathetic understanding of the world. （倒装+排比）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Had anyone told me, in those early mornings when the rest of the world was still asleep and my only company was the scratch of a pen against paper, that this quiet, unglamorous labour would one day lead to everything I had ever dreamed of, I might have laughed — but now, standing at the finish line of a race I once thought I could never run, I understand that every sunrise spent in solitude was not a sacrifice but a step. （读后续写·努力与回报）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Had...虚拟倒装 + 时间状语细节描写(the scratch of a pen against paper) + not...but...对比收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Small changes can lead to big improvements.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is often the smallest of changes — a decision to read one more page, to ask one more question, to stay five minutes longer — that leads to improvements so profound that, looking back, you can scarcely recognise the person you once were. （强调句+排比，应用文/演讲稿结尾）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is...that...强调句 + 三动作排比(read, ask, stay) + looking back分词状语 + scarcely recognise对比反差

original_sentence: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges, new knowledge and new ways of thinking.

classPractice.question: 食用过多的糖会引起健康问题。（lead to）
classPractice.answer: Eating too much sugar can lead to health problems.
classPractice.note: 【课件】lead to + 名词（health problems），to 是介词。

classPractice.question: His actions could lead to him ____ (lose) his job.
classPractice.note: 【课件】lead to 中 to 为介词，后接动名词；lead to sb doing sth 导致某人做某事。

classPractice.type: 翻译（课件·辨析 lead sb to do）
classPractice.question: 是什么原因让他杀了妻子？／你是如何得出这个结论的？
classPractice.answer: What led him to kill his wife? / What led you to this conclusion?
classPractice.note: 【课件】lead sb to do sth 促使某人做某事（to do 为不定式）；lead sb to sth 引导某人到某处/某结果。

classPractice.question: A lack of communication often ____ (lead) to misunderstandings between friends.
classPractice.note: 主语 a lack 为单数，谓语用第三人称单数 leads；lead to 后接名词 misunderstandings。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（lead to / lead ... to）：Her encouragement finally ____ him ____ pick up the violin again, and that decision ____ a lifelong passion.
classPractice.note: lead sb to do sth（促使某人做，to do 不定式）VS lead to sth（导致某结果，to 是介词接名词 a lifelong passion）。

classPractice.question: Over-reliance on phones can result in poor sleep. （用 lead to 改写）Over-reliance on phones can ____ ____ poor sleep.
classPractice.note: result in 与 lead to 同义，均表"导致"，后接名词 poor sleep。

definitionEn:
(1) n. a demanding task or situation that tests someone's abilities
(2) vt. to question whether something is true, right, or legal
(3) vt. to invite someone to compete or fight

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】质疑；挑战（对……提出异议）
uncommonMeanings.example: Children challenge their parents' authority far more nowadays than they did in the past. 如今子女对父母权威的质疑远远多于过去。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 质疑，对……提出异议（熟词僻义，考点）
uncommonMeanings.example: No one dared challenge the old professor's theory. 没有人敢质疑这位老教授的理论。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 向……发起挑战；邀（某人）比赛/较量
uncommonMeanings.example: She challenged him to a game of chess. 她邀他下一盘棋一决高下。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 考验，检验（能力/技能）
uncommonMeanings.example: The wilderness challenged every survival skill he possessed. 荒野考验着他所拥有的每一项生存技能。

readingExamples: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges: a new environment, new knowledge and new ways of thinking.

posExamples.sentence: The mountain loomed before them, its jagged peak disappearing into the mist — a challenge that would either break them or bind them together forever. （读后续写·场景设置）
I am writing to invite you to participate in our '24-Hour Innovation Challenge,' where teams will compete to design solutions for real-world problems. （应用文·邀请信）
No one dared challenge the old professor's theory — until a quiet girl in the back row raised her hand with data that would rewrite the textbook. （读后续写·高光时刻）
The wilderness challenged every survival skill he possessed, stripping away pretense until only his truest self remained. （读后续写·冒险/成长类）

wordForms.other: 构词/搭配注记：challenge 既是名词也是动词（同形）。名词搭配 face/meet/rise to/take on/pose a challenge；动词句型 challenge sb to do sth（激某人做）/ challenge sth（质疑某事）。派生 challenging=有挑战性的（a challenging task），challenger=挑战者。注意 -ing 形容词修饰"事"（challenging），描述人"感到"用被动难受则另择词。

idioms.example: When the lead actor fell ill hours before the performance, a shy understudy rose to the challenge and delivered a performance that brought the audience to their feet. （读后续写·临危受命）

collocations.phrase: face / take up / accept a challenge
collocations.example: Martins now faces the biggest challenge of his career. Martins 现在面临他事业上最大的挑战。

collocations.phrase: meet a challenge / rise to the challenge
collocations.example: They rose to the challenge of entertaining 80 schoolchildren for an afternoon. 他们迎难而上，接下了一下午招待80名学童的任务。

collocations.phrase: pose / represent / present a challenge to sb
collocations.translation: 【课件】对某人构成挑战／提出质疑
collocations.example: The strike represented a serious challenge to the government. 这场罢工对政府构成了严重挑战。

collocations.translation: 【课件】向某人挑战做某事（较量）
collocations.example: Mike challenged me to a game of chess. Mike 邀我下一盘棋一决高下。

collocations.translation: 【课件】激励／强烈要求某人做某事
collocations.example: She challenged the newspaper to prove its story. 她要求这家报纸证实报道的真实性。

collocations.translation: 一个充满挑战的世界（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges. 你面前的道路通向一个充满挑战的世界。

collocations.translation: 面对/迎接挑战（核心搭配）
collocations.example: We must face every challenge with courage. 我们必须勇敢面对每一个挑战。

collocations.translation: 勇敢迎接挑战，从容应对难关
collocations.example: When the lead actor fell ill, the understudy rose to the challenge. 主演病倒时，替补演员挺身应对了这一挑战。

collocations.translation: 激/邀某人做某事，向某人发起挑战
collocations.example: He challenged me to finish the race. 他激我跑完全程。
The language barrier posed a challenge to the exchange students. 语言障碍给交换生带来了挑战。
I have decided to take on the challenge of organizing the festival. 我决定接受组织这次节日活动的挑战。
Standing before the judges was a daunting challenge. 站在评委面前是令人生畏的挑战。

synonyms.example: She questioned the fairness of the rule. 她质疑这条规则是否公平。
synonyms.usage: 作"质疑"义时 challenge 语气更强、带公开对抗意味（challenge a theory/decision）；question 只表示提出疑问、心存怀疑，语气较缓。两者均及物。

synonyms.example: The three-day trek through the blizzard was an ordeal. 穿越暴风雪的三天跋涉是一场严峻考验。
synonyms.usage: ordeal 只作名词，强调痛苦而漫长的煎熬；challenge 中性偏积极，可指值得迎接的难题，还可作动词。

synonyms.example: Each hurdle she cleared became a stepping stone. 她跨过的每一道难关都成了垫脚石。
synonyms.usage: hurdle 比喻需要逐一跨越的具体障碍（clear/overcome a hurdle），可数；challenge 范围更广，可指整体性、抽象的挑战。

advancedExpressions.expression: face / meet / rise to / take on / pose / present / overcome a challenge; challenge sb to do; challenge a theory/decision
advancedExpressions.example: Instead of shrinking from the challenge, she chose to rise to it and, in doing so, challenged everyone's low expectations of her. 她没有从挑战面前退缩，而是选择迎难而上，并因此打破了所有人对她的低估。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"挑战/难关"，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: challenge / hurdle / obstacle / ordeal / trial / test / difficulty
advancedExpressions.example: Every hurdle, every ordeal, every seemingly impossible challenge became, in hindsight, a lesson in disguise. 每一道难关、每一场煎熬、每一个看似不可能的挑战，事后看来都是伪装的一课。

advancedExpressions.expression: what had once seemed an insurmountable challenge now appeared to be ...
advancedExpressions.example: What had once seemed an insurmountable challenge now appeared to be nothing more than a bend in the road. （前后对比+隐喻收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would like to challenge the notion that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would like to challenge the notion that volunteer work is merely a box to tick. （倡议信/演讲稿开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: the greatest challenge lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The greatest challenge of our time lies not in the scarcity of resources but in the poverty of imagination. （否定对比+抽象论证）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The challenge that stood before him was not one of strength or skill — it was the kind that gnaws at the soul in the quiet hours before dawn, whispering doubts that only the brave dare to silence. （读后续写·内心挣扎）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not...but...对比 + 拟人(gnaws at the soul, whispering doubts) + 时间意象(quiet hours before dawn)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is precisely through confronting challenges — not the comfortable, predictable sort, but those that shake us to our core — that we discover reserves of courage we never knew we possessed. （应用文·感悟类）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is...that...强调句 + 破折号插入否定递进 + discover reserves of courage名词短语

original_sentence: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges: a new environment, new knowledge and new ways of thinking.

classPractice.question: 如今子女对父母权威的质疑远远多于过去。（challenge vt.）
classPractice.answer: Children challenge their parents' authority far more nowadays than they did in the past.
classPractice.note: 【课件】challenge 作及物动词表"质疑"，宾语为 authority。

classPractice.question: 用介词或不定式填空：Mike challenged me ____ a game of chess（较量）；She challenged the newspaper ____ ____ (prove) its story（强烈要求）。
classPractice.note: 【课件】challenge sb to sth 向某人挑战（较量）；challenge sb to do sth 激励／强烈要求某人做某事。

classPractice.question: 他们迎难而上，接下了招待80名学童的任务。They ____ ____ ____ ____ of entertaining 80 schoolchildren.
classPractice.note: 【课件】rise to the challenge 迎接挑战、迎难而上，rise 过去式 rose。

classPractice.question: The path before you leads to a world full of ____ (challenge), but for those with a positive mind, opportunity lies in each one.
classPractice.note: a world full of + 复数名词 challenges（充满挑战的世界），课文原句搭配。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（challenge 的名词或动词义）：No one dared to ____ the professor's theory (质疑); yet the task itself remained a real ____ (难题).
classPractice.note: 第一空动词义"质疑"，第二空名词义"挑战/难题"，同形不同词性，靠句法判断。

classPractice.question: 主演病倒时，替补演员挺身迎接了挑战。When the lead actor fell ill, the understudy ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: rise to the challenge（迎难而上）为固定短语，rise 过去式 rose。

definitionEn:
(1) n. the process of using your mind to consider or reason about something
(2) n. a particular way of considering or approaching something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】思想，思考，思维（the process of thinking about sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: I have to do some quick thinking. 我得迅速思考一番。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】想法，见解（ideas or opinions about sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: To my way of thinking, we should try again. = In my opinion, we should try again. 依我看，我们应该再试一次。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 思维，思考（作"思维/想法"义时不可数，课文用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: The book changed my whole thinking on the subject. 这本书改变了我对这个问题的全部看法。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （某群体的）观点，看法，意见
uncommonMeanings.example: Current thinking favours smaller class sizes. 目前的主流看法倾向于小班教学。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 有思考能力的，理性的（作定语）
uncommonMeanings.example: She is a thinking person who never accepts conventional wisdom blindly. 她是个爱思考的人，从不盲目接受传统看法。

readingExamples: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges: a new environment, new knowledge and new ways of thinking.

posExamples.sentence: As he stood at the edge of the cliff, his thinking began to shift — perhaps this was not an ending, he mused, but the beginning of something he could not yet name. （读后续写·心理转折）
Through this exchange activity, I have not only improved my English but also gained exposure to different ways of thinking, which I believe is the most valuable takeaway. （应用文·活动总结）

wordForms.noun: thinking（思维，不可数）；thought（思想；想法，可数或不可数）；thinker（思想家）
wordForms.adjective: thoughtful（深思的；体贴的）；thought-provoking（发人深省的）；thinking（爱思考的）
wordForms.other: 构词/易错注记：think 加 -ing 构成动名词/名词 thinking，作"思维、思考"义时为不可数名词，不说 a thinking/thinkings。动词 think 过去式-过去分词 thought-thought。搭配 ways of thinking（思维方式）、critical/positive/wishful thinking。合成词 thought-provoking（发人深省的）。

idioms.example: To my way of thinking, the most valuable lesson this experience has taught us is that setbacks are simply detours, not dead ends. （应用文·观点表达）

collocations.translation: 【课件】迅速思考一番，急中生智
collocations.example: I have to do some quick thinking. 我得迅速思考一番。
He laughed and accused me of wishful thinking. 他笑着骂我是一厢情愿。
To my way of thinking, honesty always pays off. 依我看，诚实总有回报。

collocations.translation: 【课件】批判性／分析性／积极的思维
collocations.example: The debate club develops critical, analytical and positive thinking. 辩论社培养批判性、分析性和积极的思维。

collocations.translation: 新的思维方式（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges: a new environment, new knowledge and new ways of thinking. 你面前的道路通向一个充满挑战的世界：新的环境、新的知识和新的思维方式。
Travel opened her eyes to a completely new way of thinking. 旅行让她看到了一种全新的思维方式。
The debate club has sharpened my critical thinking. 辩论社锻炼了我的批判性思维。

collocations.translation: 积极的思维方式，正面思考
collocations.example: Positive thinking helped her get through the hardest days. 积极的心态帮她熬过了最艰难的日子。
Believing the problem will solve itself is mere wishful thinking. 认为问题会自行解决只是一厢情愿。
A profound shift in his thinking took place that night. 那一晚他的思维发生了深刻转变。

synonyms.example: What changed was not his circumstances but his mindset. 改变的不是他的处境，而是他的心态。
synonyms.usage: mindset 侧重相对固定的思维倾向/心态（a growth mindset），可数；thinking 作"思维"义时不可数，指思考过程或整体想法。

synonyms.example: Her reasoning was so sound that the judge nodded. 她的推理如此严密，评委频频点头。
synonyms.usage: reasoning 强调逻辑推理的过程与链条（不可数）；thinking 更宽泛，泛指思考活动或思想观点。

synonyms.example: A sudden thought struck her. 一个念头突然闪过她的脑海。
synonyms.usage: thought 作"具体念头"时可数（a thought, thoughts），作"思想体系"时不可数（modern thought）；thinking 作"思维方式/思考"不可数，且强调过程。

advancedExpressions.expression: ways of thinking; critical thinking; positive thinking; wishful thinking; a shift in one's thinking; to my way of thinking
advancedExpressions.example: To my way of thinking, cultivating critical thinking matters far more than mere positive thinking or comforting wishful thinking. 依我看，培养批判性思维远比单纯的积极思考或聊以自慰的一厢情愿重要得多。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-ing 动名词转名词（不可数）
advancedExpressions.expression: think→thinking（思维/思考，U）；对照可数的 thought（想法）
advancedExpressions.example: New ways of thinking often begin with a single unexpected thought. 新的思维方式往往始于一个意想不到的念头。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·of + doing 作后置定语（从课文ways of thinking长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: n. + of + doing（way of doing sth / means of doing sth）
advancedExpressions.example: Senior high opens the door to new ways of thinking and learning. 高中为你打开通往新思维、新学习方式的大门。

advancedExpressions.expression: a thought crept into one's mind
advancedExpressions.example: A thought crept into his mind — quiet at first, like a distant melody — that perhaps the answer had been there all along. （渐进式心理描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: a growing body of thinking suggests that ...
advancedExpressions.example: A growing body of thinking suggests that creativity should be at the heart of modern education. （引出主流观点）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is worth considering that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Before we finalize the plan, it is worth considering that a more inclusive approach may yield better participation from junior students. （提议/建议信）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He changed his way of thinking.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Something shifted inside him that night — imperceptible to anyone watching, yet seismic in its consequence. The thinking that had confined him for so long began to crack, and through the fissures, new light streamed in. （读后续写·隐喻式心理转变）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 隐喻(fissures/light streaming in) + 对比(imperceptible vs seismic) + 破折号补充说明

sentenceUpgrade.original: We need different ways of thinking.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What this project desperately needs — and what I humbly propose — is not more resources but a fundamental reorientation in our thinking: from 'this is how it has always been done' to 'what if we tried something entirely different?' （应用文·倡议/提案）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What...is...主语从句 + 破折号插入 + 对比引语(from...to...)

original_sentence: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges: a new environment, new knowledge and new ways of thinking.

classPractice.question: 我得迅速思考一番。（quick thinking）
classPractice.answer: I have to do some quick thinking.
classPractice.note: 【课件】do some quick thinking 迅速思考一番／急中生智。

classPractice.question: 用 thinking 的搭配填空：He accused me of ____ thinking（一厢情愿）；____ to my way of thinking, we should try again（依我看）。
classPractice.answer: wishful; To（句首 To my way of thinking）
classPractice.note: 【课件】wishful thinking 一厢情愿；To my way of thinking = In my opinion 依我看。

classPractice.question: Senior high school opens the door to new ways of ____ (think), new knowledge and a new environment.
classPractice.note: 课文原句：ways of thinking，介词 of 后用动名词/名词 thinking，此处作不可数名词"思维方式"。

classPractice.question: 用 thinking 的搭配填空：Just hoping the problem disappears is mere ____ thinking; what you really need is ____ thinking to analyse it.
classPractice.note: wishful thinking 一厢情愿；critical thinking 批判性思维，均为固定搭配。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（thinking / thought）：A sudden ____ struck her, and it slowly reshaped her whole ____ on life.
classPractice.note: "一个念头"可数用 thought；"整体思维/看法"不可数用 thinking。

translation: 积极乐观的；良好的，正面的
definitionEn:
(1) adj. thinking about what is good in a situation
(2) adj. feeling confident and hopeful
(3) adj. good or useful
(4) adj. expressing certainty or agreement

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 优势，优点
uncommonMeanings.example: As she looked back on the turbulent year, she chose to focus not on what she had lost but on the positives — the friendships forged in hardship, the wisdom gained through pain. （读后续写·反思收束）

readingExamples: However, for those of you with a positive mind, opportunity lies in each challenge.

posExamples.sentence: Her grandmother had always said, 'Find one positive thing in every dark day,' and it was this quiet practice that carried her through the hardest winter of her life. （读后续写·祖辈智慧传承）
The feedback from the exchange programme has been overwhelmingly positive, with participants reporting increased confidence and a deeper appreciation for cultural diversity. （应用文·活动汇报）

wordForms.noun: positive（n. 优点，优势）/ positivity（n. 积极性，正能量）
wordForms.adverb: positively（adv. 积极地；确实地，肯定地）
wordForms.other: 反义词：negative（消极的；否定的；阴性的）。构词：形容词 + -ly → positively，可表"简直，确实"加强语气（It was positively freezing. 简直冻死了）。名词 positive 常用复数 positives 表"优点、好的方面"。

idioms.example: As the rain poured through the leaking tent, she laughed and said, 'Let's look on the bright side — we won't need a shower tonight!' （读后续写·苦中作乐·对话）

collocations.example: You've got to be more positive about your work. 你必须更加积极地对待自己的工作。

collocations.phrase: a positive attitude to / towards sth
collocations.example: She's got a really positive attitude to / towards life. 她对生活抱有非常乐观的态度。

collocations.phrase: have a positive effect on sth
collocations.example: The rural environment has a positive effect on the children's health. 乡村环境对孩子们的健康有好处。
Women should be portrayed in a more positive light. 应该从更正面的角度来描绘女性。

collocations.translation: 【课件】积极的反应／回应／反馈（expressing support）
collocations.example: The proposal met with a very positive response. 这项提议得到了非常积极的回应。
There is positive proof that he was at the scene. 有确凿的证据表明他曾在现场。
Athletes who had tested positive for banned substances were disqualified. 药检呈阳性的运动员被取消资格。
A proton carries a positive charge. 质子带正电荷。
She responded positively to the new plan. 她对新计划反应积极。
For those of you with a positive mind, opportunity lies in each challenge. 对于心态积极的你们，机会就藏在每一个挑战里。
Try to be positive about the future. 试着对未来乐观一些。
I'm positive that I locked the door. 我确信我锁了门。
A positive attitude helps you learn faster. 积极的态度让你学得更快。
Even as the chemotherapy drained her body, she maintained a positive outlook that baffled her doctors and inspired everyone on the ward. （读后续写·疾病/励志）
I am convinced that your participation will have a lasting positive impact on the younger students, who look up to you as a role model. （应用文·邀请信）
It was the teacher's quiet positive reinforcement — a nod here, a word of encouragement there — that slowly coaxed the shy boy out of his shell. （读后续写·师生互动）

synonyms.example: She stayed optimistic about passing the exam. 她对通过考试保持乐观。
synonyms.usage: optimistic 侧重"对未来结果有信心、往好处想"，常搭 optimistic about sth；positive 语义更宽，既指"乐观积极"，也指"确信的、正面的、良好的"，还可作名词表"优点"。谈心态时二者常可换，但"检测呈阳性"只用 positive。

synonyms.example: I'm confident that we can win. 我确信我们能赢。
synonyms.usage: confident 强调"自信、有把握"，可 confident of/about/that；positive 表"确信"时更口语、语气更斩钉截铁（be positive that = 十分肯定，几乎不容置疑）。

synonyms.example: I would appreciate it if you could offer some constructive suggestions on how to improve the layout of our school newspaper. （应用文·请求信）
synonyms.usage: 强调有助益、能促成进步

advancedExpressions.expression: be positive about / be positive that / a positive mind / positive impact / positive attitude / on the positive side
advancedExpressions.example: With a positive mind and a positive attitude, she stayed positive about the result and was positive that hard work would pay off. 心态积极、态度积极，她对结果保持乐观，并确信努力终会有回报。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"确信"）
advancedExpressions.expression: be positive that = be certain / be sure / be convinced / have no doubt that
advancedExpressions.example: I'm positive that he'll come. = I'm certain / convinced that he'll come. 我确信他会来。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·反义前缀 vs 后缀
advancedExpressions.expression: positive ↔ negative（词根不同的反义对）；positive → positively（-ly 副词）→ positivity（-ity 名词）
advancedExpressions.example: Focus on the positives, not the negatives. 多看优点，别只盯着缺点。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. chose to see the positive in ...
advancedExpressions.example: Where others saw only wreckage, she chose to see the positive — a blank canvas upon which something new and beautiful could be built. （废墟vs画布的意象对比）

advancedExpressions.expression: I cannot stress enough the positive difference that ... can make
advancedExpressions.example: I cannot stress enough the positive difference that regular journaling can make — it sharpens thinking, clarifies emotions, and documents growth. （建议信·推荐方法）

advancedExpressions.expression: on the positive side, ...; on the other hand, ...
advancedExpressions.example: On the positive side, social media connects us across continents; on the other hand, it can foster comparison that erodes self-esteem.

sentenceUpgrade.original: Stay positive when things are hard.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It was not blind optimism that kept her going — it was a quiet, stubborn conviction, forged in the crucible of everything she had already survived, that even the longest night must eventually yield to dawn. （读后续写·深夜→黎明意象链）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It was not...it was...双重强调 + 后置定语(forged in...) + 暗喻(crucible/dawn)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: While skills and strategies certainly matter, I have come to believe that the single most transformative factor — in study, in work, and in life itself — is a positive attitude that refuses to be defined by circumstances. （应用文·感悟分享）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: While让步从句 + the single most...最高级强调 + 三重地点介词短语(in study, in work, in life)

original_sentence: However, for those of you with a positive mind, opportunity lies in each challenge.

classPractice.question: 你必须更加积极地对待自己的工作。（be positive about）
classPractice.answer: You've got to be more positive about your work.
classPractice.note: 【课件】be positive about sth 对……持积极／乐观态度。

classPractice.question: 她对生活抱有非常乐观的态度。（positive attitude to/towards）
classPractice.answer: She's got a really positive attitude to / towards life.
classPractice.note: 【课件】a positive attitude to / towards sth 对……的积极态度，介词用 to 或 towards。

classPractice.question: 乡村环境对孩子们的健康有好处。（have a positive effect on）
classPractice.answer: The rural environment has a positive effect on the children's health.
classPractice.note: 【课件】have a positive effect on sth 对……有积极影响／好处。

classPractice.question: For those of you with a ____ (积极的) mind, opportunity lies in each challenge.
classPractice.note: 课文原句搭配 a positive mind；此处作定语修饰 mind，用形容词原形。

classPractice.question: 我确信我把门锁了。I'm ____ ____ I locked the door.
classPractice.note: be positive that + 从句 表"确信"，that 引导表语从句，不可省成 be positive to do。

classPractice.question: She always stays ____ (positive / positively) about the future, and she smiled ____ (positive / positively) at the bad news.
classPractice.note: 系动词 stay 后接形容词 positive 作表语；修饰动词 smiled 用副词 positively。

definitionEn:
(1) n. a set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something
(2) n. a chance for advancement or progress
readingExamples: opportunity lies in each challenge. When you rise to the challenges, you will have the opportunity to acquire great knowledge and enjoy personal growth.

posExamples.sentence: The letter lay on the kitchen table, unopened — an opportunity that would alter the course of her life, though she did not yet know it as she poured her morning tea. （读后续写·伏笔悬念）
On behalf of the Student Union, I am delighted to announce an invaluable opportunity: a two-week cultural immersion programme in partnership with our sister school in London. （应用文·通知/公告）

wordForms.other: 拼写记忆：oppor-tun-ity，源自拉丁 ob portum（"朝向港口"，风向有利于入港 → 时机）。词尾 -ity 为名词后缀。作可数名词，泛指"机会"多用单数 an opportunity 或复数 opportunities，不加不定冠词的抽象用法较少。

idioms.example: She knew the window of opportunity was narrow — the train would leave in twenty minutes, and with it, her last chance to say what needed to be said. （读后续写·时间紧迫）
When the professor asked for a volunteer, Li Hua seized the opportunity — his hand shooting up before his brain had fully registered the question. （读后续写·动作先行）

collocations.phrase: have the opportunity to do sth
collocations.translation: 有机会做某事（课文原句）
collocations.example: You will have the opportunity to acquire great knowledge and enjoy personal growth. 你们将有机会获取知识、享受成长。
He seized the opportunity to speak. 他抓住机会发了言。

collocations.phrase: an opportunity to do / of doing sth
collocations.example: It's a good opportunity to make friends. 这是个交朋友的好机会。
The old artist saw in the orphan boy a golden opportunity — not for profit, but to pass on a craft that would otherwise die with him. （读后续写·传承主题）
Don't miss the opportunity to study abroad. 别错过出国学习的机会。
I would be grateful if you could reply at the earliest opportunity, as the registration deadline is fast approaching. （应用文·请求信）
When the invitation to perform at Carnegie Hall arrived, her mother wept — this was the once-in-a-lifetime opportunity they had sacrificed everything for. （读后续写·梦想成真）

synonyms.usage: 辨析核心：opportunity 指"有利的时机、良机"，往往需要主动争取、努力把握，语气正面且较正式；chance 更口语，既可指"机会"，也含"偶然、运气"成分（by chance 偶然）。因此"抓住有利时机"用 seize the opportunity 更贴切，谈"可能性/概率"则用 chance（a good chance of winning）。

synonyms.example: The prospect of studying abroad both thrilled and terrified her — a duality that she felt in the pit of her stomach every time she looked at the acceptance letter. （读后续写·矛盾心理）
synonyms.usage: 多用复数，侧重未来可能性，适合续写中制造期待与焦虑

synonyms.example: When the veteran player was injured, the young substitute saw his opening — and seized it with both hands. （读后续写·体育/竞技）
synonyms.usage: 侧重突然出现的时机，续写转机点

advancedExpressions.expression: have / take / seize / grasp / grab an opportunity；miss / lose an opportunity；an opportunity to do (of doing)；a golden / rare / once-in-a-lifetime opportunity；at the earliest opportunity；a window of opportunity
advancedExpressions.example: Seize every opportunity to grow; the door of a golden opportunity rarely knocks twice. 抓住每一次成长的机会——绝佳良机很少敲两次门。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"有机会做某事"）
advancedExpressions.expression: have the opportunity to do = have the chance to do = get a chance to do = be given the chance to do
advancedExpressions.example: You'll have the opportunity / chance to acquire knowledge here. 在这里你有机会获取知识。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·opportunity 的后接结构
advancedExpressions.expression: opportunity to do sth（首选）/ opportunity of doing sth / opportunity for sth；避免 opportunity + that 从句
advancedExpressions.example: This is a good opportunity to practise / of practising English. 这是练习英语的好机会。

advancedExpressions.expression: fate presented sb. with an opportunity that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Fate presented him with an opportunity that was as terrifying as it was irresistible — a chance to right the wrong that had haunted him for a decade. （命运的机遇，适合续写关键转折）

advancedExpressions.expression: this is a rare opportunity to ...
advancedExpressions.example: This is a rare opportunity to engage directly with leading scientists in the field, and I strongly encourage every member to attend. （通知/邀请信强调机会难得）

advancedExpressions.expression: every challenge carries within it the seed of opportunity
advancedExpressions.example: History repeatedly demonstrates that every crisis carries within it the seed of opportunity — if only we have the wisdom to recognize it and the courage to nurture it.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What lay before her was not merely a good opportunity — it was the kind of moment that comes once in a lifetime, the kind that separates the life you have from the life you could have, and she knew, with every fibre of her being, that she could not let it slip through her fingers. （读后续写·关键时刻抉择）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What...was...主语从句 + the kind that...重复递进 + 比喻(slip through her fingers) + with every fibre of her being强化决心

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Opportunities, I have learned, are rather like sunrises — if you wait too long, you miss them. It is with this conviction that I urge every student to seize the opportunities our school so generously provides. （应用文·演讲稿）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(like sunrises) + 格言式简洁句 + It is...that...强调句

original_sentence: opportunity lies in each challenge. When you rise to the challenges, you will have the opportunity to acquire great knowledge and enjoy personal growth.

definitionEn:
(1) phr. to exist or be found in something
(2) phr. to consist in or depend on something
readingExamples: opportunity lies in each challenge.

posExamples.sentence: She finally understood that happiness did not lie in the destination but in every small, imperfect step of the journey. （读后续写·主题升华）
The key to building a harmonious class community lies not in rigid rules but in mutual respect and genuine care for one another. （应用文·倡议/演讲）

wordForms.other: ★三组极易混淆的动词变化（高考高频）：① lie（躺；位于/在于，不及物）lie–lay–lain，现在分词 lying；② lie（说谎，不及物）lie–lied–lied，现在分词 lying；③ lay（放置；下蛋，及物）lay–laid–laid，现在分词 laying。口诀：躺过（lain）位于要努力想，谎言（lied）三态都规则，放置（laid）及物带宾语。lie in 表"在于"取①，故过去式为 lay in、完成式为 has lain in。
wordForms.irregular: lay - lain (位于) | lied - lied (说谎)

collocations.translation: 【课件】位于；在于（lie—lay—lain—lying 躺/位于 vi.，区别于 lie—lied—lied 说谎）
collocations.example: The town lies in a small wooded valley. 该镇坐落于一个林木茂盛的山谷中。

collocations.translation: 【课件】（责任/决定权）在于……，取决于……
collocations.example: Part of the blame / responsibility must lie with services. 服务方也一定要负一部分责任。

collocations.phrase: the problem / difficulty lies in doing sth
collocations.example: The problem / difficulty lies in (/with) providing sufficient evidence. 问题/困难在于要提供足够的证据。

collocations.phrase: the strength / advantage lies in the fact that ...
collocations.translation: 【课件】优点/长处在于……这一事实
collocations.example: The strength of the book lies in the fact that the material is from classroom experience. 这本书的优点在于它取材于课堂经验。

collocations.translation: 机会存在于每个挑战之中（课文原句）
collocations.example: For those with a positive mind, opportunity lies in each challenge. 对心态积极的人来说，机会就藏在每一个挑战里。
The secret lies in daily practice. 秘诀就在于每天练习。
Our team's strength lies not in any individual brilliance but in our collective willingness to support one another through every difficulty. （应用文·团队介绍）
After years of searching for answers in distant places, he discovered that the answer had lain in the simple wisdom of his grandfather all along. （读后续写·回归主题）
The magic of this old bookshop lay in its chaos — every stack of books a potential adventure, every dusty corner a secret waiting to be discovered. （读后续写·场景描写）

synonyms.example: True courage, the old soldier said, consists not in the absence of fear but in the decision that something else matters more. （读后续写·人物对话/哲理）
synonyms.usage: 正式，适用于哲理性表达和人物对话；consist in = lie in，后接抽象事物；注意 consist of 才是"由……组成"，勿混。

synonyms.example: The power to change your life, she realized, resides not in some distant future but in the choices you make this very moment. （读后续写·顿悟时刻）
synonyms.usage: 正式，强调归属于，适合结尾金句

synonyms.example: Beauty exists in the smallest details. 美存在于最微小的细节里。
synonyms.usage: exist in 更中性直白，强调"客观存在"；lie in 更常用于"（原因/关键/答案）在于"，突出所在之处。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·lie/lay/lied 三组辨析（课件重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: lie—lay—lain—lying（躺；位于/在于，vi.）｜lie—lied—lied—lying（说谎，vi.）｜lay—laid—laid—laying（放置；下蛋，vt.）。lie in / lie with 表"在于"取第一组，过去式 lay in，完成式 has lain in。
advancedExpressions.example: He lay in bed telling lies, so the police laid the report on the desk. 他躺在床上说谎，于是警察把报告放在了桌上。（三词同现，一眼看清区别）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·lie in / lie with 表"在于"（课件句型）
advancedExpressions.expression: 抽象主语 + lie in / lie with + 名词/doing / the fact that 从句：the problem lies in doing sth；the strength lies in the fact that ...
advancedExpressions.example: The problem lies in providing sufficient evidence; the strength lies in the fact that the material comes from real experience. 问题在于提供充分证据；长处则在于材料源自真实经验。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·lie三组辨析（从课文句长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文 opportunity lies in each challenge 中 lie 取"位于/在于"义（lie–lay–lain）；对照 lie–lied–lied（说谎）与 lay–laid–laid（放置，及物）
advancedExpressions.example: He lay in bed telling lies, so the police laid the report on the desk. 他躺在床上说谎，于是警察把报告放在了桌上。（三个词同现，一眼看清区别）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·lie in / lie 家族
advancedExpressions.expression: lie in（在于）= consist in = rest in；lie behind（隐藏在……背后）；lie ahead（在前方，即将到来）；lie down（躺下）
advancedExpressions.example: The real reason lay behind his silence, and greater challenges lay ahead. 真正的原因藏在他的沉默背后，更大的挑战还在前方。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"关键在于"）
advancedExpressions.expression: the key lies in ... = the key rests on ... = it all comes down to ... = what matters most is ...
advancedExpressions.example: Success lies in / comes down to persistence. 成功在于坚持。

advancedExpressions.expression: the true meaning of ... lay not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The true meaning of that journey, he understood at last, lay not in the summit he had failed to reach but in the person he had become along the way. （not...but...结构升华主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: the key to ... lies in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The key to a successful school event, as I have learned through trial and error, lies in meticulous planning coupled with the flexibility to embrace the unexpected. （经验分享类）

advancedExpressions.expression: the essence of ... lies in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The essence of true education lies not in the quantity of information transmitted but in the quality of curiosity it ignites.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What the years had taught him — what the failures and false starts and sleepless nights had etched into his bones — was that success lay not in a single stroke of brilliance but in the quiet accumulation of unglamorous, daily effort that no one applauds. （读后续写·人生感悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What...was that...主语从句 + 三名词递进(failures, false starts, sleepless nights) + etched into his bones具象化 + no one applauds对比反差

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I am firmly convinced that the solution to this dilemma lies not in any individual effort, however heroic, but in a spirit of cooperation that transcends personal interests — a spirit I believe our class has demonstrated time and again. （应用文·演讲稿/倡议）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: I am firmly convinced that...正式主句 + however heroic让步插入 + a spirit that...同位语递进

classPractice.question: 1) Tom got punished because he ____ to his parents yesterday. 2) He ____ in bed the whole night, awake, and in the morning he fell asleep. 3) Last night I ____ my mobile phone on the sofa, but it's now nowhere to be seen. 4) When the boy opened his eyes, he found himself ____ in a bed.

definitionEn: phr. to show the ability or strength to deal with a difficult situation or challenge successfully
readingExamples: When you rise to the challenges, you will have the opportunity to acquire great knowledge and enjoy personal growth.

posExamples.sentence: The boy everyone had underestimated rose to the occasion with a speech so moving that even the school janitor, who had heard a thousand speeches, stopped his cart in the hallway to listen. （读后续写·侧面烘托）
I am writing to express my confidence that our class will rise to this challenge and make the upcoming Charity Sale the most successful one our school has ever seen. （应用文·动员/鼓劲）

wordForms.other: rise 为不及物动词，变化 rise–rose–risen（现在分词 rising），主语自升，绝不加宾语。对照及物的 raise–raised–raised（举起/提高）和不及物的 arise–arose–arisen（出现）。记忆串：太阳 rise 起、我把手 raise 起、问题自己 arise 起。

idioms.translation: 随机应变，成功应对困难局面
idioms.example: When the power went out during the concert, the young violinist rose to the occasion, continuing to play by the light of a single candle held by a trembling stagehand — and the audience held its breath. （读后续写·画面感场景）

collocations.translation: 迎接挑战，成功应对挑战（课文原句）
collocations.example: When you rise to the challenges, you will have the opportunity to acquire great knowledge. 当你迎接挑战时，你便有机会获取知识。

collocations.translation: 迎接挑战，成功应对挑战
collocations.example: With her teammates depending on her and the clock ticking down, she rose to the challenge and sank the final shot that sealed their victory. （读后续写·体育竞技）

collocations.translation: 随机应变，从容应对困难局面
collocations.example: She rose to the occasion and gave a brilliant speech. 她从容应对，做了精彩演讲。
The whole hall rose to its feet and cheered. 全场起立欢呼。
Having risen to prominence through sheer determination, she never forgot the teacher who had first believed in her. （读后续写·人物弧光）

synonyms.translation: 举起，提高，抚养（及物动词）
synonyms.example: Please raise your hand if you agree. 同意的请举手。
synonyms.usage: ★核心辨析：rise（rise–rose–risen）不及物，主语自己"上升/升起/起立"，不能带宾语（The sun rises. 太阳升起）；raise（raise–raised–raised）及物，必须带宾语，表"举起、提高、筹集、抚养"（raise money / raise prices）。rise to the challenge 用不及物的 rise。

synonyms.example: Problems arose during the trip. 旅途中出现了问题。
synonyms.usage: arise（arise–arose–arisen）不及物，主语多为抽象事物（problem, question, chance, difficulty），表"（问题）产生、出现"；rise 主语多为具体事物或数量（sun, price, level）表"上升"。别与 arouse（及物，唤起某种情感）混淆。

synonyms.example: When no one else would take the lead, the quietest girl in the group stepped up — her voice steady, her hands still, her eyes blazing with a quiet fire no one had noticed before. （读后续写·人物蜕变）
synonyms.usage: 口语化，强调主动承担，续写中转折点描写

synonyms.example: For years, he had wondered if he could measure up to his father's legacy — and on that cold morning, with the mountain behind him and the sunrise ahead, he finally had his answer. （读后续写·父子主题）
synonyms.usage: 强调达到标准，适合自我证明类叙事

advancedExpressions.expression: rise to the challenge / occasion（应对挑战/临场发挥）；rise to one's feet（起立）；rise to prominence / fame / power（崛起）；rise up（起义，升起）；give rise to（引起，导致）
advancedExpressions.example: Difficulties give rise to growth only when we rise to the occasion. 只有当我们从容应对时，困难才会带来成长。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·rise / raise / arise 三词辨析（从课文 rise to the challenges 长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: rise（vi. 上升/起立）rise-rose-risen | raise（vt. 举起/提高）raise-raised-raised | arise（vi. 出现/发生）arise-arose-arisen
advancedExpressions.example: As problems arise, prices may rise, so the government raises subsidies. 问题一出现，物价可能上涨，于是政府提高补贴。（一句同现，语法区别一目了然）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"成功应对"）
advancedExpressions.expression: rise to the challenge = rise to the occasion = meet the challenge = live up to the challenge = be equal to the task
advancedExpressions.example: I'm confident our class will rise to / meet the challenge. 我相信我们班能迎接这个挑战。

advancedExpressions.expression: rise, phoenix-like, from the ashes of ...
advancedExpressions.example: From the ashes of her failed first attempt, she rose — phoenix-like — with a clarity of purpose that startled everyone who thought they knew her. （凤凰涅槃隐喻，强烈的视觉冲击）

advancedExpressions.expression: I have every confidence that ... will rise to meet ...

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The question was never whether they would face hardship — that was inevitable, written into the very fabric of life itself — but whether they would rise to meet it together or be pulled apart by its force. And in that moment, with the storm raging outside and the fire crackling within, they chose to rise. （读后续写·暴风雨场景）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The question was never whether...but whether...长句对比 + 环境烘托(storm/fire) + 短句收束(they chose to rise)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In that defining moment — when the easy path beckoned with its promises of comfort and the hard road offered nothing but uncertainty — he rose to the occasion, not with a grand gesture but with a quiet nod to himself that said, silently but irrevocably: I am ready. （读后续写·内心独白式抉择）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号插入对比(easy path vs hard road) + not...but...形式对比 + 无声独白(I am ready)制造情感冲击
