definitionEn: vt. to gain or obtain something, especially knowledge, a skill, or a possession, through one's own effort or experience
readingExamples: you will have the opportunity to acquire great knowledge and enjoy personal growth.

posExamples.sentence: In the months that followed, he acquired not just the language but the cadence of his grandmother's stories — the pauses, the laughter, the way her voice softened when she spoke of home. （读后续写·文化传承）
Through this internship, I have acquired practical skills that textbooks alone could never provide, and I am eager to share these insights with fellow students. （应用文·经验分享）

wordForms.adjective: acquired（adj. 后天习得的，非先天的，如 an acquired taste）/ acquirable（可获得的）
wordForms.other: 拼写易错：acquire 含不发音的 c（ac-quire），名词 acquisition 亦保留（ac-qui-si-tion）。词根 quire/quisit 表"寻求、获取"（比较 require, inquire）。搭配对象多为可积累之物（knowledge, skills, habits, a language, a reputation, a taste）。

idioms.translation: 逐渐喜欢上……（an acquired taste 后天养成的爱好）
idioms.example: I have recently acquired a taste for olives. 我最近渐渐喜欢上了橄榄。（课件原句）
The college acquired a reputation for very high standards. 这所学院赢得了标准极高的声誉。（课件原句）
She had acquired a taste for early mornings — the silence, the pale light, the feeling that the world belonged to her alone for a few precious hours. （读后续写·习惯/性格塑造）

collocations.phrase: acquire sth（by buying / being given it）
collocations.translation: 【课件】（通过购买/被给予而）获得、购得
collocations.example: The museum acquired valuable works of art / She acquired a new email address. 博物馆购得了珍贵的艺术品／她申请到一个新邮箱地址。

collocations.translation: 【课件】（凭努力/能力/行为而）获得、习得
collocations.example: It is a skill acquired through years of effort. 这是一项经多年努力才习得的技能。
The college acquired a reputation for very high standards. 这所学院赢得了标准极高的声誉。

collocations.translation: 【课件】逐渐喜欢上……（an acquired taste 后天养成的爱好）
collocations.example: I have recently acquired a taste for olives — it is truly an acquired taste. 我最近渐渐喜欢上了橄榄——这真是一种后天养成的口味。
I like your earrings — are they a recent acquisition? 我喜欢你这副耳环，是最近新买的吗？

collocations.translation: 获取渊博的知识（课文原句）
collocations.example: You will have the opportunity to acquire great knowledge and enjoy personal growth. 你们将有机会获取知识、享受个人成长。
You can acquire this skill through practice. 你可以通过练习掌握这项技能。
I would suggest that all new students acquire the habit of daily journaling — it is a small investment of time that yields extraordinary returns in self-awareness. （应用文·建议信）
Children acquire their first language naturally. 儿童自然而然地习得母语。
Over the course of her three years at the school, she acquired a reputation not for brilliance but for kindness — a currency, she would later learn, far more valuable. （读后续写·人物评价）

synonyms.translation: （通过努力/正当途径）获得，得到
synonyms.example: You must obtain a permit before entering. 进入前你必须取得许可证。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：obtain 较正式，泛指"设法得到（具体物品、许可、信息）"，强调获取的动作与途径；acquire 强调"逐渐地、经努力地获得"，常搭知识、技能、习惯、语言、名声等可积累之物（acquire knowledge/skills）；不说 acquire a ticket，而说 obtain/get a ticket。

synonyms.translation: 获得，增加（多为有益之物）
synonyms.example: She gained a lot of experience from the job. 她从这份工作中获得了很多经验。
synonyms.usage: gain 语气最通用，强调"获得有用/有益之物并有所增益"（gain experience/weight/confidence），常含"增长"意味；acquire 更书面，突出"经努力/长期积累而获得"，尤指知识技能。三者中 acquire 最正式，gain 最口语常见。

synonyms.example: After a decade of relentless practice, she finally attained the mastery she had dreamed of since childhood — not through talent, but through tenacity. （读后续写·实现目标）
synonyms.usage: 强调经过长期努力实现，续写中用于展现人物弧光

synonyms.example: The old gardener taught him to cultivate not just roses but patience — both, he said, required the same things: time, care, and the humility to accept that some blooms come later than others. （读后续写·隐喻式道理）
synonyms.usage: 强调有意识地培养，适合成长类续写

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·acquire 两大义项（课件辨析）
advancedExpressions.expression: acquire = ① obtain sth by buying / being given it（购得、被给予而获得，对象多为具体物）；② gain sth by efforts / ability / behavior（凭努力/能力习得，对象多为 knowledge, skills, a reputation, a taste 等可积累之物）
advancedExpressions.example: She acquired the painting at auction (义①), and over time acquired a reputation as a serious collector (义②). 她在拍卖会上购得那幅画，久而久之赢得了严肃收藏家的名声。

advancedExpressions.expression: acquire（vt.）→ acquisition（n. 获得/习得/获得物，[C/U]）；an acquired taste 后天养成的爱好；language acquisition 语言习得。词根 quire/quisit 表"寻求、获取"（比较 require, inquire, request）。
advancedExpressions.example: Language acquisition takes time; there is no shortcut. 语言习得需要时间，没有捷径。

advancedExpressions.expression: acquire knowledge / skills / a habit / a language / a reputation / a taste for sth；an acquired taste（后天养成的爱好）；language acquisition（语言习得）
advancedExpressions.example: The knowledge and skills you acquire now will open doors you cannot yet imagine. 你如今获取的知识与技能，将为你打开如今尚无法想象的大门。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"获取知识/技能"）
advancedExpressions.expression: acquire knowledge = gain knowledge = obtain knowledge = pick up (a skill) = develop (a skill)
advancedExpressions.example: You can acquire / gain / pick up a lot here. 在这里你能学到/获得很多。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·quire词根 + 名词后缀 -ition
advancedExpressions.expression: acquire → acquisition（-ition 名词）；同根 require（要求）→ requirement，inquire（询问）→ inquiry，请求 request
advancedExpressions.example: Language acquisition takes time; there is no shortcut. 语言习得需要时间，没有捷径。

advancedExpressions.expression: what sb. acquired went far beyond ...
advancedExpressions.example: What she acquired during that summer went far beyond a certificate or a line on her résumé — she gained an understanding of human resilience that no classroom could have imparted. （暑期经历收获主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: I have acquired a solid foundation in ... through ...
advancedExpressions.example: I have acquired a solid foundation in event organization through my two years of service on the Student Council, during which I coordinated five major school-wide activities. （自荐信/申请信）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ability to acquire ... is arguably more important than ...
advancedExpressions.example: In an era of rapid change, the ability to acquire new skills is arguably more important than any specific skill one currently possesses.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What she had acquired from those gruelling months of training was not merely a set of skills — it was a quiet, unshakeable confidence that settled into her bones like an old friend, whispering: you have done hard things before; you can do them again. （读后续写·内心蜕变）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What...was...主语从句 + not merely...破折号递进 + 拟人(like an old friend, whispering) + 内心独白收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: I have learned a lot from this activity.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The knowledge I have acquired through this activity extends far beyond the technical — it encompasses a deeper appreciation for teamwork, a sharper awareness of my own strengths and weaknesses, and a renewed commitment to the pursuit of excellence in all that I do. （应用文·活动总结/感悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: extends far beyond...引出一系列 + 三重宾语递进(deeper appreciation, sharper awareness, renewed commitment)

original_sentence: you will have the opportunity to acquire great knowledge and enjoy personal growth.

classPractice.question: You will have the opportunity to ____ (获取) great knowledge and enjoy personal growth.
classPractice.note: 课文原句 acquire great knowledge；不定式 to acquire 作 opportunity 的后置定语，动词用原形。

classPractice.question: It takes years to ____ (acquire / obtain) a foreign language, but only minutes to ____ (acquire / obtain) a visa at the counter.
classPractice.note: 习得语言强调长期积累用 acquire；在柜台"取得"签证这一具体物用 obtain。

classPractice.question: 语言习得需要时间。Language ____ (acquire 的名词形式) takes time.
classPractice.note: acquire → acquisition，名词后缀 -ition；注意保留 c 与 s 的拼写。

definitionEn:
(1) n. physical or mental energy that is exerted to achieve something
(2) n. a determined attempt to do something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 费力的尝试；成果，作品（常带修饰，指"努力做成的东西"）
uncommonMeanings.example: The cake was her first effort at baking, and though a little lopsided, it tasted of pure love. 那蛋糕是她第一次尝试烘焙的成果，虽有点歪，却满是爱意。

readingExamples: your time and effort at senior high school will open the door to your potential.

posExamples.sentence: Her mother never said 'I'm proud of you' — she showed it by the effort she poured into making dumplings at 5 a.m. every exam day, shaping each one with the same care she gave to everything she loved. （读后续写·细节描写·亲情）
I would like to extend my heartfelt gratitude to every volunteer whose tireless efforts transformed a simple idea into an event that touched the hearts of everyone present. （应用文·感谢信）

wordForms.noun: effort（n. 努力；可数，复数 efforts）
wordForms.adjective: effortless（adj. 毫不费力的，轻松的）
wordForms.adverb: effortlessly（adv. 轻松地，毫不费力地）
wordForms.other: 构词：effort + -less（无……的）→ effortless（毫不费力），再加 -ly → effortlessly。★可数与不可数皆可：表"努力"多不可数（put effort into），也可数指"一次努力/尝试"（make an effort，复数 make efforts）。搭配动词首选 make（make an effort），避免 do an effort。

idioms.example: The shopping mall spares no effort to attract more customers. 这家购物中心想尽办法吸引更多顾客。（课件原句）
I assure you that I will make every effort to ensure the smooth running of the English Corner and to create an environment where every participant feels valued. （应用文·承诺/自荐）
The young doctor spared no effort in treating the old woman — not because she was anyone important, but because he remembered his own grandmother, alone in a hospital far from home. （读后续写·共情动机）

collocations.phrase: make an effort to do sth
collocations.example: She made an effort to change the subject of the conversation. 她尽力想转移话题。

collocations.phrase: make every effort to do sth
collocations.example: We should make every effort to protect the environment. 我们应尽一切努力保护环境。

collocations.phrase: spare no effort to do / in doing sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】不遗余力，想尽办法做某事
collocations.example: The shopping mall spares no effort to attract more customers. 这家购物中心想尽办法吸引更多顾客。

collocations.phrase: in an effort to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】为了（试图）做某事（= in order to try to）
collocations.example: In an effort to save water, the school installed new taps. 为了节约用水，学校安装了新水龙头。

collocations.translation: 【课件】费劲地／轻松地、毫不费力地
collocations.example: Alex rose to his feet with a single effortless movement. 亚历克斯轻巧地一跃而起（毫不费力）。
Only with a joint effort can we finish the task on time. 只有通力合作，我们才能按时完成任务。（部分否定/only + 状语引起的倒装）

collocations.translation: 你的时间与努力（课文原句）
collocations.example: Your time and effort at senior high school will open the door to your potential. 你在高中付出的时间与努力，将为你打开通往潜能的大门。

collocations.phrase: make an effort / make efforts to do sth
collocations.example: He made an effort to smile. 他努力挤出了一丝微笑。
She put a lot of effort into the project. 她在这个项目上下了很大功夫。

It was through a concerted effort — the villagers forming a human chain, passing buckets from hand to hand — that the fire was finally brought under control. Meanwhile, the joint effort between the two rival schools to organize the charity run proved that cooperation could bridge even the deepest divides. （读后续写·集体行动场面）

collocations.phrase: with the least effort / without effort
collocations.translation: 毫不费力地，轻而易举地
collocations.example: While others struggled for hours over the equation, he solved it with the least effort, as if numbers danced to a rhythm only he could hear. （读后续写·人物特点刻画）
Was it worth the effort? As she watched the first seedlings push through the barren soil, she had her answer — sometimes the smallest green shoots carry the loudest message of hope. （读后续写·象征收束）
It took every ounce of will she possessed, but with an effort that left her trembling, she let go of the past and took the first step into the life that awaited her. （读后续写·放下执念）

synonyms.example: His scientific endeavours consumed him — he worked through nights, through holidays, through his own health — driven by a question that would not let him rest. （读后续写·执着追求）
synonyms.usage: 正式书面用语，强调持续认真的努力尝试，可作名词或动词（endeavour to do）；effort 更通用中性，日常与正式皆宜，常搭 make an effort。

synonyms.example: By the time he reached the summit, his muscles screamed with exertion, but the view that greeted him washed away every trace of pain. （读后续写·身体感受→精神升华）
synonyms.usage: 侧重体力上的付出与劳累，续写中用于描写艰苦历程；effort 兼指脑力与体力，范围更广，且可搭 in an effort to、make efforts。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·effort家族（课件系统梳理）
advancedExpressions.expression: make an effort to do｜make every effort to do｜spare no effort to do / in doing｜in an effort to do（= in order to try to）｜with effort（费劲）/ without effort（轻松）｜a joint / concerted effort（通力合作）｜put effort into (doing)｜be worth the effort
advancedExpressions.example: The mall spares no effort to attract customers, and only with a joint effort can the staff make every effort to serve them well. 商场想尽办法招徕顾客，唯有通力合作，员工才能尽全力服务好他们。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·only + 状语置于句首引起部分倒装（从课件例句长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: Only + 状语（介词短语/从句/副词）置于句首 → 主句部分倒装（助动词/情态动词提前）：Only with a joint effort can we ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only with a joint effort can we finish the task on time. 只有通力合作，我们才能按时完成任务。（对比不倒装 We can finish the task with a joint effort.）

advancedExpressions.expression: make an effort / make efforts to do；make every effort；spare no effort；put effort into；in an effort to do；be worth the effort；a concerted / joint effort；with little / great effort
advancedExpressions.example: Spare no effort now, make every effort to improve, and one day you'll see it was all worth the effort. 现在不遗余力，尽力提升，终有一天你会明白这一切都值得。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"努力做某事"）
advancedExpressions.expression: make an effort to do = make efforts to do = strive to do = endeavour to do = do one's best / utmost to do = go all out to do
advancedExpressions.example: She made every effort / strove / went all out to catch up. 她竭尽全力去追赶。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·effort 后接结构与可数性（从课文 time and effort 长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: make an effort to do sth（不定式，勿用 of doing）；put effort into (doing) sth（介词 into + 动名词）；不可数时零冠词（time and effort）
advancedExpressions.example: It takes time and effort to make an effort to change. 改变需要时间和努力，也需要去努力尝试。

advancedExpressions.expression: every ounce of effort had been worth it
advancedExpressions.example: As the audience rose to their feet, she knew — with a certainty that brought tears to her eyes — that every ounce of effort, every rejection, every moment of doubt had been worth it. （情感爆发点）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is thanks to your tireless efforts that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is thanks to your tireless efforts that this year's campus cultural festival exceeded all expectations. （感谢信/颁奖词）

advancedExpressions.expression: effort, rather than talent, is the true determinant of ...
advancedExpressions.example: A growing body of research suggests that sustained effort, rather than innate talent, is the true determinant of long-term achievement.

sentenceUpgrade.original: She put a lot of effort into it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What no one saw — what the applause and the certificates could never capture — were the nights she spent hunched over her desk while the world slept, the tears of frustration she wiped away before anyone could notice, and the quiet, relentless effort that turned a dream into a reality one agonizing step at a time. （读后续写·幕后付出）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What no one saw...主语从句制造反差 + 三重意象(the nights/she spent, the tears, the effort) + one...at a time节奏递进

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Please allow me to extend, on behalf of the entire organizing committee, our deepest appreciation for your efforts — efforts that went far beyond what any job description could have captured, efforts that turned obstacles into stepping stones and strangers into a team. （应用文·感谢信/闭幕词）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 重复efforts制造排比 + far beyond what...从句强化 + 对比(obstacles into stepping stones, strangers into a team)

original_sentence: your time and effort at senior high school will open the door to your potential.

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件搭配）
classPractice.question: 这家购物中心想尽办法吸引更多顾客。The shopping mall ____ ____ ____ to attract more customers.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；spare no effort (to do) "不遗余力/想尽办法"，effort 用单数不可数，主语第三人称单数用 spares。

translation: n. 进步，进展；前进，行进 | vt.&vi. 发展，进步
definitionEn:
(1) n. a forward movement or development, especially in knowledge or technology
(2) vt. to promote or help the progress of something
(3) vt. to move forward or make progress

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】预支/预付（款）；ask for an advance on one's salary 要求预支薪水
uncommonMeanings.example: She asked for an advance on her salary to cover the sudden medical bill. 她要求预支薪水以支付突如其来的医疗费。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 前进，行进（军队、人向前移动）
uncommonMeanings.example: The soldiers advanced towards the enemy lines under cover of darkness. 士兵们在夜色掩护下向敌方阵地前进。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 预支，预付（款）
uncommonMeanings.example: The publisher offered her a generous advance — enough to quit her waitressing job and finally give the novel the months of undivided attention it deserved. （读后续写·梦想启动契机）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 预先的，事先的（作定语，如 advance notice / advance booking）
uncommonMeanings.example: She had received no advance notice of his arrival — just a knock on the door and there he stood, ten years older and carrying the weight of a thousand untold stories in his eyes. （读后续写·久别重逢）

readingExamples: what medical advances you will make or what amazing technologies you will develop!

posExamples.sentence: Step by step, she advanced through the darkness — not sure where the path would lead but certain that standing still was no longer an option. （读后续写·未知前行）
The advances we have made in campus sustainability over the past year are a testament to what can be achieved when students, teachers, and administrators work hand in hand. （应用文·工作汇报）

wordForms.noun: advancement（进步，提升）; advance（进展，预付款）
wordForms.adjective: advanced（先进的，高级的）; advance（预先的，作定语）
wordForms.other: 构词法：ad-(向)+vance(< 拉丁 abante 之前)；固定短语 in advance 提前（不用 in front）；advance 作"进步/进展"义常用复数 advances（medical/technological advances）；辨析 advanced（先进的）vs advancing（前进中的）

idioms.example: She had rehearsed the speech a hundred times in advance, but when she stood before the sea of faces, every prepared word evaporated — and what emerged instead was something raw, honest, and infinitely more powerful. （读后续写·临场突破）

collocations.translation: 【课件】医学/技术/科学进步（n. 进步，作"进步/进展"常用复数；课文原句）
collocations.example: What medical advances you will make! Recent advances in genetics have raised moral questions. 你们将取得怎样的医学进步啊！基因学近来的进展引发了道德问题。
The new vaccine represents a major advance in the fight against the disease. 这种新疫苗是抗击该疾病的一大进步。
The airline suggests booking tickets 21 days in advance. 航空公司建议提前21天订票。
Their aircraft were in advance of those used by the US. 他们的飞机比美国使用的更为先进/超前。

collocations.translation: 【课件】advanced 作形容词：先进的、高级的
collocations.example: advanced learners of English; advanced technology; at her advanced age. 英语高级学习者；先进技术；她高龄之时。
Advance booking is strongly recommended. 强烈建议提前预订。

collocations.translation: 先进技术（advanced 作形容词"先进的/高级的"）
collocations.example: The clinic is equipped with advanced technology. 这家诊所配备了先进技术。
The small research team, working out of a converted garage, made advances in solar technology that would eventually attract the attention of the world. （读后续写·创业/科研故事）
With each faltering step she advanced towards the podium, the memories of those who had believed in her pushing her forward like an invisible wind at her back. （读后续写·颁奖/演讲）
While we celebrate the rapid technological advances of our era, I believe we must not lose sight of the human values that give these advances meaning. （应用文·演讲稿）

Equipped with advanced AI technology, the small rural clinic could now diagnose conditions that once required patients to travel hundreds of miles to the city — a quiet revolution arriving not with fanfare but with hope. （读后续写·科技改变生活）

Having completed the advanced course with distinction, she found herself not just with a certificate but with a newfound confidence — the kind that comes from knowing you have pushed beyond what you once believed was your limit. （应用文·自荐/个人陈述）

synonyms.example: Though the blizzard raged around them, they forged ahead — not because they were fearless, but because someone they loved was waiting on the other side of the mountain. （读后续写·爱驱动前行）
synonyms.usage: 比喻克服困难持续前进，续写中经典动力源

synonyms.example: Your son has made remarkable progress this term — not just academically, but in the quiet confidence with which he now raises his hand in class. （应用文·家校沟通）
synonyms.usage: 最通用，书面口语均可

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·advance 一词多义（课件系统梳理）
advancedExpressions.expression: advance 六大动词义（课件）：① 移动/推进（move sth forward）He advanced his queen. ② 促进/助益（help the progress）Such conduct is unlikely to advance your career. ③ 提出（present a claim/theory）Scientists have advanced a new theory. ④ 预付/借出（pay before due）The bank advanced me 2000 yuan. ⑤ 前进（come/go forward）Our troops have advanced two miles. ⑥ 提前（bring to an earlier date）The date of the meeting was advanced from 10 to 3 June.
advancedExpressions.example: The bank advanced him the money in advance so he could advance his research and advance a bold new theory. 银行提前把钱借给他，好让他推进研究、提出一个大胆的新理论。（多义串联）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in advance / in advance of 辨析（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: in advance = 预先、提前（副词性，单独用）；in advance of = 在……之前；超前于（介词性，后接宾语）。均不用 in front。
advancedExpressions.example: Please book 21 days in advance, for their design was years in advance of its time. 请提前21天预订，因为他们的设计超前于时代好几年。

advancedExpressions.expression: medical advances / in advance / advance booking / advanced technology / make advances in / advance towards
advancedExpressions.example: The medical advances made in advance of the epidemic, aided by advanced technology, allowed the team to advance towards a cure faster than anyone had dared hope. （一句串联名词/短语/形容词/动词四种用法）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·感叹句 what + n.（从课文句长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: what + (a/an) + adj. + n. + 主谓！
advancedExpressions.example: What medical advances you will make! 你们将取得怎样的医学进步啊！（课文用 what 引导感叹，medical advances 为复数不加 a；对比 What an amazing technology!）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. advanced not with speed but with certainty
advancedExpressions.example: She advanced through the fog not with speed but with certainty — the kind born of knowing exactly what, and who, she was fighting for. （速度vs信念对比，适合高潮段落）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would advise you to prepare in advance by ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would strongly advise you to prepare in advance by familiarizing yourself with the debate format and reading the background materials I have attached. （建议信·具体指导）

advancedExpressions.expression: genuine advance requires not merely ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: Genuine advance — in science, in society, in the soul — requires not merely intelligence but the moral courage to ask what should be done, not just what can be done.

sentenceUpgrade.original: He made progress step by step.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He advanced not in great leaps but in the slow, steady rhythm of someone who has learned that the only way through difficulty is through it — one step, then another, then another, until the distance you have covered surprises even yourself. （读后续写·坚持的力量）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not...but...对比 + 重复递进(one step, then another, then another) + until从句制造惊喜感

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not out of...but out of...双否定对比 + 双重for短语(respect for the opportunity, for the people)

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件例句）
classPractice.question: 他们的飞机比美国使用的更为先进/超前。Their aircraft were ____ ____ ____ those used by the US.
classPractice.note: 课件例句；in advance of "超前于、在……之前"，后接宾语；区别于单独使用的 in advance（预先）。

classPractice.type: 语境应用·单句填空（课件搭配）

classPractice.question: 你们将取得怎样的医学进步啊！What medical ____ you will make!
classPractice.note: 课文原句；advance 作"进步/进展"义可数，此处用复数 advances；what 引导感叹句

translation: 令人大为惊奇的，令人惊喜的
definitionEn:
(1) adj. very surprising, especially in a way that makes you feel pleasure or admiration
(2) adj. extremely good; wonderful
(3) adj. so unexpected or extraordinary that it is difficult to believe
readingExamples: Who knows what beautiful works of art you will create, what medical advances you will make or what amazing technologies you will develop!

posExamples.sentence: When the curtain finally rose, an amazing scene unfolded before us: hundreds of paper cranes, folded by the whole class in secret, drifted down like snow onto the brightly lit stage. （读后续写·惊喜场面·环境描写）
I am delighted to share the amazing news that our school orchestra has been invited to perform at the city concert hall, and I sincerely hope you can come and cheer for us. （应用文·分享喜讯的邮件）
It is amazing how a single act of kindness, small as a dropped coin, can set off ripples that travel far beyond anything the giver ever imagines. （议论文·善意的力量）

The old craftsman's hands, wrinkled yet perfectly steady, moved with amazing precision, carving lifelike petals out of a plain block of wood while we watched, hardly daring to breathe. （读后续写·匠人技艺·细节描写）

wordForms.adjective: amazing（令人惊奇的，修饰物）/ amazed（感到惊奇的，修饰人）
wordForms.other: 构词法：动词 amaze + -ing/-ed 变形容词，+ -ment 变名词 amazement；核心易错：-ing 修饰事物、-ed 修饰人；固定搭配 be amazed at/by sth, be amazed to do, be amazed that ..., to one's amazement 令某人惊讶的是

idioms.example: To my amazement, the shy girl who had barely spoken all term walked straight up to the microphone and delivered the most moving speech of the evening. （读后续写·人物反转）

collocations.translation: 了不起的技术（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: What amazing technologies you will develop! 你们将开发出怎样了不起的技术啊！（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 对……感到惊奇（-ed 修饰人）
collocations.example: We were all amazed at his progress. 我们都对他的进步感到惊奇。
I was amazed to see how much the town had changed. 我惊讶地看到这座小镇变化如此之大。
Volunteering at the sports meeting was an amazing experience that taught me more about teamwork than any textbook ever could. （应用文·活动感悟）
It is amazing how quickly the desert blooms after a single night of rain, as if life had been waiting patiently underground all along. （读后续写·自然描写·拟人）

collocations.translation: 绝对令人惊叹的（amazing 为强义形容词，用 absolutely 而非 very 修饰）
collocations.example: The view from the mountain top was absolutely amazing: a sea of clouds rolled beneath our feet, dyed gold by the rising sun. （读后续写·登山·景物描写）
Winning first prize in the national contest was an amazing achievement for a team that had been founded only six months before. （应用文·校园喜报）
The new library offers an amazing variety of resources, from ancient maps to virtual-reality science labs, catering to readers of every possible interest. （应用文·宣传稿）
Foreign visitors often find it amazing that a city so fiercely modern still preserves its centuries-old tea houses in quiet corners. （议论文·传统与现代）
The children watched in amazement as the paper dragon, lifted by a hundred pairs of hands, seemed to come alive above the festival crowd. （读后续写·节日场面）

synonyms.example: The amazed students stared at the amazing magic trick in silence. 惊奇的学生们默默地盯着那令人惊叹的魔术。
synonyms.usage: 核心辨析(-ing vs -ed)：amazing 修饰"令人惊奇的事物"（an amazing技术/景象），amazed 修饰"感到惊奇的人"（be amazed at sth）；口诀"物用-ing，人用-ed"；同类 interesting/interested, exciting/excited

synonyms.example: The results of the experiment were so astonishing that the professor repeated it three times before daring to publish them. （议论文·科学求证）
synonyms.usage: 程度比 amazing 更强，含"几乎难以置信"之意，且可用于中性或负面消息；amazing 多带赞叹色彩

synonyms.example: What is truly remarkable about her progress is that it was achieved not by talent alone but by two hundred early mornings. （议论文·勤奋主题）
synonyms.usage: 语气客观正式，议论文中替换 amazing 可提升文体档次；侧重"值得关注"而非情绪上的惊喜

synonyms.example: Standing on the glass bridge, we drank in the breathtaking scenery below, where a silver river threaded its way through folds of green. （读后续写·写景）
synonyms.usage: 专指美得让人屏住呼吸的景色、表演或速度，是续写写景的首选；不用于形容消息或成绩

synonyms.example: It seemed incredible that the tiny seed we had almost thrown away should grow into the tallest sunflower in the garden. （读后续写·意外之喜）
synonyms.usage: 口语色彩较浓，兼指"好得／怪得难以置信"，强调超出预期；amazing 更侧重引发赞叹

advancedExpressions.expression: amaze (v.) → amazing (物) / amazed (人) → amazement (n.) → amazingly (adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: To our amazement, the amazed audience watched as the amazing acrobat performed amazingly well. （一句串起动词派生的名词、-ed形容词、-ing形容词、副词）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·what 引导的感叹句（从课文句长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: What + (a/an) + adj. + n. + 主谓！
advancedExpressions.example: What amazing technologies you will develop! 你们将开发出怎样了不起的技术啊！（technologies 复数不加 a；对比单数 What an amazing technology!）

advancedExpressions.expression: Nothing could have prepared sb. for the amazing sight that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Nothing could have prepared me for the amazing sight that greeted us at the summit — a rainbow arched clean across the valley, as though the sky itself were celebrating our climb. （否定开篇制造悬念+拟人升华，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: What makes ... truly amazing is not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What makes this programme truly amazing is not its modern equipment but the patient volunteers who never give up on any learner. （主语从句+not...but 对比强调，推荐信亮点句）

advancedExpressions.expression: However amazing ... may seem, ...
advancedExpressions.example: However amazing artificial intelligence may seem, it remains a tool whose value ultimately depends on the wisdom of those who wield it. （however 让步从句先扬后抑，引出辩证主旨）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: So amazing was the performance that the entire audience rose to their feet before the last note had even faded, their applause rolling through the hall like thunder. （读后续写·场面描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: So...that 倒装强调 + before 时间从句制造节奏感 + 独立主格(their applause rolling) + 明喻(like thunder)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Equipped with amazing facilities ranging from a digital planetarium to a rooftop garden, our school provides fertile soil in which every student's interest can take root and flourish. （应用文·学校介绍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Equipped with 过去分词开头 + ranging from...to 列举展开 + 土壤/生根隐喻链(fertile soil, take root, flourish)收束

original_sentence: Who knows what beautiful works of art you will create, what medical advances you will make or what amazing technologies you will develop!

classPractice.question: The audience were ____ (amazing / amazed) at the ____ (amazing / amazed) performance.
classPractice.note: 核心考点：-ed 修饰人（观众感到惊奇），-ing 修饰物（表演令人惊奇）

classPractice.question: I was amazed ____ (see) how much progress you had made in just one month.
classPractice.note: be amazed to do sth 惊奇地做某事；此处不定式表原因

classPractice.question: 令我们惊讶的是，那个害羞的女孩赢得了一等奖。To our ____, the shy girl won first prize.
classPractice.note: to one's amazement 令某人惊讶的是；amaze 的名词形式 amazement

definitionEn:
(1) n. a feeling or belief that you can do something well or succeed at something
(2) n. the feeling that you can trust someone or something
(3) n. a feeling of certainty about something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 信任（对某人的信赖，常用 have confidence in sb / take sb into one's confidence）
uncommonMeanings.example: The manager placed complete confidence in her new assistant. 经理完全信任她的新助手。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 秘密，知心话（熟词僻义，常用 in confidence 私下地）
uncommonMeanings.example: In the dim light of the café, she took him into her confidence and shared the secret she had guarded for two decades — and in doing so, released a burden she had not realized she was carrying. （读后续写·秘密倾诉）

readingExamples: I have confidence in your ability to make a difference to your family, to your community and to our country.

posExamples.sentence: He walked onto the stage with a confidence that surprised even himself — not the loud, boastful kind, but the quiet certainty of someone who had prepared for this moment his entire life. （读后续写·高光时刻）
I am writing to express my full confidence that the proposed reading programme will ignite a genuine passion for literature among students. （应用文·建议信）

wordForms.noun: confidence（信心，信任）; confidant（知己，心腹）; self-confidence（自信）
wordForms.verb: confide（吐露，倾诉；confide in sb 向某人吐露心事）
wordForms.adjective: confident（自信的）; confidential（机密的，形近勿混）
wordForms.adverb: confidently（自信地）; confidentially（私下地，机密地）
wordForms.other: 构词法：con-(共同)+fid(信任，拉丁 fidere)+-ence；同根 fid 家族：faith 信念、fidelity 忠诚；核心搭配 have confidence in sb（信任）/ be confident of sth（有把握）；固定短语 in confidence 私下地。形近三兄弟：confidence(n.) / confident(adj.自信的) / confidential(adj.机密的)

idioms.example: The old professor called him aside after class and told him, in strictest confidence, that his essay was the finest he had read in forty years of teaching. （读后续写·师生私语）

collocations.translation: 对……有信心/信任（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I have confidence in your ability to make a difference. 我对你们有所作为的能力充满信心。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 对……有把握，确信……（形容词 confident 搭配）
collocations.example: She is confident of winning the contest. 她有把握赢得比赛。
Years of practice gave him great self-confidence on stage. 多年的练习让他在台上非常自信。

collocations.translation: 私下地，秘密地（confidence 作"秘密"义，熟词僻义）
collocations.example: He told me the news in confidence. 他私下里把这消息告诉了我。
With each small victory — a nod from the debate judge, a smile from the foreign exchange student — she slowly built the confidence that had been eroded by years of self-doubt. （读后续写·渐进成长）
His hesitation was not born of laziness but of a lack of confidence that ran so deep it had become indistinguishable from his personality. （读后续写·心理刻画）
I would encourage every participant to speak with confidence during the presentation — your ideas deserve to be heard, and your voice matters. （应用文·鼓励信）

synonyms.translation: 机密的，保密的（形近易混）
synonyms.example: These documents are highly confidential and must not be shared. 这些文件高度机密，不得外传。
synonyms.usage: 形近辨析：confidence 是名词"信心/信任/秘密"；confidential 是形容词"机密的"（confidential information/documents）；confident 是形容词"自信的"（be confident of/that）——三词勿混

synonyms.example: There was a self-assurance about her now — a quiet steadiness that had replaced the trembling girl who had walked through the school gates three years earlier. （读后续写·前后对比）
synonyms.usage: 强调内在的沉着稳重，适合人物弧光描写；与 confidence 近义但更书面

synonyms.example: When everyone else had written him off, his mother's faith in him never wavered — and it was this faith, he later realized, that had been the scaffolding upon which he rebuilt his life. （读后续写·亲情支撑）
synonyms.usage: 强调信任和信念，have faith in sb 相信/信赖某人（≈ have confidence in sb）；适合亲情/友情主题

advancedExpressions.expression: have confidence in sb / be confident of sth / build confidence / a lack of confidence / in confidence / self-confidence
advancedExpressions.example: Having built her self-confidence over the years, she now spoke with confidence and, in confidence, admitted she had once had a total lack of confidence. （一句串联名词、形容词、复合词及"秘密"义）

advancedExpressions.expression: confidence / confident / confidential / confide / confidant
advancedExpressions.example: She confided in her confidant with confidence, trusting that such confidential words would go no further. （动词 confide + 名词 confidant + confidence + 形容词 confidential 串讲同根词）

advancedExpressions.expression: a quiet confidence settled over sb.
advancedExpressions.example: A quiet confidence settled over her — not the kind that announces itself, but the kind that simply knows. And in that knowing, she found the strength to do what she had always feared. （心理描写，动静对比）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is with great confidence that I recommend ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is with great confidence that I recommend Li Hua for the exchange programme — his dedication, adaptability, and genuine curiosity make him an ideal candidate. （推荐信）

advancedExpressions.expression: confidence, unlike arrogance, is rooted in ...
advancedExpressions.example: Confidence, unlike arrogance, is rooted not in the belief that one is better than others but in the quiet knowledge that one has done the work, faced the fear, and emerged stronger on the other side.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Confidence did not arrive all at once — it crept in gradually, like dawn breaking over a landscape she had only ever seen in darkness. One day she spoke without rehearsing every word; another day she met her own eyes in the mirror and did not look away. And that, she realized, was what confidence truly was: not the absence of fear, but the quiet conviction that she was more than her doubts. （读后续写·渐进式心理成长）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人(crept in gradually) + 明喻(like dawn breaking) + 否定递进(not the absence of fear, but...) + 具体细节(one day...another day...)

sentenceUpgrade.original: I am confident I can do this.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I can state with unwavering confidence that my experience, combined with my genuine passion for this role, equips me to meet — and indeed exceed — the demands of this position. Should you entrust me with this responsibility, I assure you it will be discharged with the utmost dedication. （应用文·自荐信/申请信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: with unwavering confidence正式强调 + meet and indeed exceed递进 + Should you...虚拟语气表郑重承诺

original_sentence: I have confidence in your ability to make a difference to your family, to your community and to our country.

classPractice.question: 我对你们有所作为的能力充满信心。I have ____ ____ your ability to make a difference.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；固定搭配 have confidence in sb/sth 对……有信心/信任，介词用 in

classPractice.question: These reports contain ____ (confident / confidential) information that must be kept secret.
classPractice.note: 形近辨析：confidential 机密的；confident 自信的；confidence 信心（名词）

classPractice.question: She is quite ____ (confidence) of passing the exam after months of hard work.
classPractice.note: be confident of doing/that ... 有把握；此处需形容词 confident，不是名词 confidence

definitionEn:
(1) phr. to have a significant effect or influence on a person or situation
(2) phr. to bring about a meaningful change for the better
readingExamples: I have confidence in your ability to make a difference to your family, to your community and to our country.

posExamples.sentence: To the world, she was just one volunteer in a sea of many — but to the old woman whose garden she tended every Saturday, she made all the difference in the world. （读后续写·微小善举·宏大意义）
I am writing to urge every student to participate in the campus clean-up, because every pair of hands makes a difference — and collectively, we can transform our school environment. （应用文·倡议书）

wordForms.other: 短语结构 make + a + difference；核心搭配是介词 to（make a difference to sb/sth 对……有影响）；量词灵活替换：a / all the / no / a real / a big difference；主谓一致看主语（Every contribution makes a difference）；过去式 made a difference

idioms.example: A few kind words at the right time make all the difference. 在适当的时候说几句体贴的话效果迥然不同。（课件原句）

The rescue team arrived only five minutes earlier than expected — but those five minutes made all the difference between tragedy and a story the family would retell with grateful tears for decades. （读后续写·千钧一发）

collocations.phrase: make a big / some / no difference to sb/sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】对……有很大/一些/没有影响或作用（介词用 to）
collocations.example: One more person wouldn't make any difference to the arrangements. 多一个人对安排不会有影响。 A new coat of paint made a big difference to the room. 重新粉刷一遍让房间大不一样。

collocations.translation: 【课件】效果迥然不同，至关重要，起决定性作用
collocations.example: A few kind words at the right time make all the difference. 在适当的时候说几句体贴的话，效果迥然不同。

collocations.translation: 【课件】对某人没有影响，无所谓
collocations.example: Morning or afternoon. It makes no difference to me. 上午下午都行，我无所谓。

collocations.translation: 对……有影响/起作用（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: You can make a difference to your family and community. 你能对家庭和社区产生影响。（课文原句结构，to 引出对象）
It was not grand speeches or lofty promises that made a tangible difference in the village — it was the new well, the repaired school roof, the medicine cabinet that was finally stocked. （读后续写·务实行动）

synonyms.example: She had no idea, as she wrote that letter, what an impact it would have on the boy who received it — a boy who had been on the verge of giving up, until words from a stranger reminded him that he mattered. （读后续写·蝴蝶效应）
synonyms.usage: 中性词，可正面可负面，have an impact/effect/influence on sb/sth，介词均用 on；make a difference 侧重"起积极作用"，介词用 to

synonyms.example: Every vote matters. 每一票都很重要。
synonyms.usage: matter 多用于否定/疑问或作"起作用"讲，常单独或接 to sb（it matters to me）；make a difference 更强调"带来可见的改变"，且可搭 all/no/a real 等修饰

synonyms.example: The decision to move to this small town, which seemed so inconsequential at the time, would prove to be the most consequential choice of his life. （读后续写·伏笔）
synonyms.usage: 正式用语，强调后续影响深远，适合埋下主题伏笔；make a difference 更口语通用

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·make a difference 的量词与介词（课件重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: 量词灵活替换：make a big / some / no / all the / a real difference；核心介词恒用 to（make a difference to sb/sth），不用 for/on；主谓一致看主语（Every effort makes a difference）。
advancedExpressions.example: It makes no difference to me, but a kind word can make all the difference to someone who is struggling. 对我无所谓，但一句好话对正陷困境的人却可能至关重要。（no / all the 两极对比）

advancedExpressions.expression: make a difference to / make all the difference / make no difference / tell the difference between
advancedExpressions.example: Whether you help makes all the difference to those in need, though it may make no difference to your own comfort. （一句对比 all the / no difference 两种极端）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"有影响/起作用")
advancedExpressions.expression: make a difference to = have an impact/effect on = play a part in = count / matter
advancedExpressions.example: Even a single volunteer can make a difference to / have a real impact on / play a part in a struggling community. （三种表达可替换互换，用于"起作用"）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was the kind of moment that ... would make a difference for
advancedExpressions.example: It was the kind of moment that — though no one in the crowded auditorium noticed — would make a difference for the shy girl in the back row, who saw, for the first time, that someone like her could stand in the spotlight. （无人知晓的转折时刻）

advancedExpressions.expression: however small it may seem, every contribution makes a difference
advancedExpressions.example: However small it may seem — whether it is donating a book, sharing a skill, or simply showing up — every contribution makes a difference, and I sincerely hope you will be part of that difference. （倡议收尾·呼吁参与）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is not the scale of the action that makes a difference, but ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is not the scale of the action that makes a difference — a single spark can ignite a forest — but the sincerity and persistence with which it is carried out.

sentenceUpgrade.original: Small actions can make a difference.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The ripple had started with something impossibly small — a kind word to a stranger, a door held open, a note left on a desk. None of it seemed to matter at the time, yet each gesture rippled outward in ways she could not see: a bad day turned bearable, a lonely heart less alone, a life quietly rerouted towards hope. And that was the thing about making a difference — you rarely knew when you were doing it. （读后续写·涟漪效应收束）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 涟漪隐喻(ripple) + 三重细小行为递进 + 破折号解释 + 主题句收束(you rarely knew...)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Let there be no doubt: each and every one of us possesses the capacity to make a difference — not in some distant, abstract future, but here and now, through the choices we make, the voices we raise, and the hands we extend to those who need them. （应用文·集会演讲结语）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Let there be no doubt: 号召句式 + 三重介词短语递进(through the choices, the voices, the hands)

original_sentence: I have confidence in your ability to make a difference to your family, to your community and to our country.

classPractice.question: 在适当的时候说几句体贴的话，效果迥然不同。A few kind words at the right time make ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；make all the difference "至关重要、效果迥然不同"；固定用 all the。

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件例句）
classPractice.question: 上午下午都行，我无所谓。Morning or afternoon. It makes ____ difference ____ me.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；make no difference to sb "对某人没影响、无所谓"，介词用 to。

classPractice.question: 你能对你的家庭和社区产生影响。You can make a ____ ____ your family and community.
classPractice.note: 课文搭配 make a difference to sb/sth，介词用 to，不用 for/on

classPractice.question: Those extra five minutes made ____ (all / no) the difference and saved the boy's life.
classPractice.note: make all the difference 至关重要、起决定性作用；make no difference 则表"没影响"

classPractice.question: A good teacher can have a great impact on students. （用 make 改写）→ A good teacher can ____ ____ ____ ____ students.
classPractice.note: have an impact on ≈ make a difference to；注意 impact 用 on，difference 用 to

definitionEn: phr. to use or enjoy something as much as possible, especially an opportunity, a resource, or a situation that may not last long
readingExamples: To fully realize your potential, it is important for you to make the most of our school resources.

posExamples.sentence: With only three days left in the village, she made the most of every hour — recording her grandmother's stories, sketching the old courtyard, breathing in the scent of jasmine that would haunt her memory for years to come. （读后续写·告别·珍惜当下）
I would strongly advise all new students to make the most of the mentorship programme — it is a rare chance to learn directly from seniors who have walked the path you are about to tread. （应用文·建议信）

wordForms.other: 短语结构 make the most of + sth（最高级 most 前必须有 the）；辨析三兄弟：make the most of（把好条件用足）/ make the best of（坏条件下尽力）/ make full use of（充分利用，最中性）；of 后接名词或 what 从句（make the most of what you have）；过去式 made the most of

collocations.phrase: make the most of school resources
collocations.translation: 充分利用学校资源（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: It is important for you to make the most of our school resources. 你们充分利用学校资源很重要。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: make the most of an opportunity
collocations.example: You should make the most of every chance to practise English. 你应该充分利用每一次练习英语的机会。

collocations.phrase: make the most of the time
collocations.example: The old man knew his days were numbered, but instead of despair, he made the most of the time he had — teaching his grandson everything he knew about woodcarving, one patient lesson at a time. （读后续写·生死/传承主题）

collocations.phrase: make the most of what you have
collocations.example: She had no studio, no expensive equipment — just a borrowed camera and a fierce determination to make the most of what she had. And somehow, that was enough. （读后续写·创业/梦想类）

synonyms.translation: （在不利条件下）尽量利用，随遇而安
synonyms.example: The hotel was far from what they had hoped, but they decided to make the best of it and enjoy the trip anyway. 旅馆远不如预期，但他们决定随遇而安，尽情享受旅程。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：make the most of 指"把好条件用到极致"（中性偏积极）；make the best of (a bad job / it) 强调"在坏条件下尽力而为"，含无奈色彩；二者都接 of + 名词

synonyms.example: To prepare for the exam, she made full use of every online resource available. 为备考，她充分利用了每一份在线资源。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：make full use of ≈ make the most of，最中性通用，突出"充分"；结构 make full use of sth / make the most of sth 可互换；注意 use 此处为名词（/juːs/）

synonyms.example: The young entrepreneur capitalized on the sudden interest in traditional crafts, turning her grandmother's embroidery skills into a business that would revive the entire village. （读后续写·时代机遇）
synonyms.usage: 侧重从某事物中获取利益，适合商业/社会主题；比 make the most of 更书面、更强调"抓机遇获利"

synonyms.example: He had spent too many years putting things off, waiting for the 'right moment' that never arrived — but as he stood before the mountain at dawn, he decided it was time to seize the day. （读后续写·人生转折）
synonyms.usage: 经典文学表达，适合续写中的人生感悟和转折点

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"充分利用")
advancedExpressions.expression: make the most of = make full use of = take (full) advantage of = capitalize on = make the best of（坏条件下）
advancedExpressions.example: You should make the most of / make full use of / take full advantage of every learning resource the school offers. （前三者可直接替换，均表积极充分利用）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·it is important for sb to do（从课文句长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: it is + adj. + for sb + to do sth（形式主语 it + 逻辑主语 for sb）
advancedExpressions.example: It is important for you to make the most of our school resources. 你们充分利用学校资源很重要。（课文句型：it 作形式主语，真正主语是不定式，动作发出者用 for you）

advancedExpressions.expression: determined to make the most of every fleeting moment, sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Determined to make the most of every fleeting moment, she filled her remaining days with laughter, with stories, with the kind of presence that said — without words — I am here, and I am grateful. （珍惜当下，时间紧迫感）

advancedExpressions.expression: I cannot urge you strongly enough to make the most of ...
advancedExpressions.example: I cannot urge you strongly enough to make the most of this reading programme — it is, without exaggeration, the kind of opportunity that can redefine your relationship with books. （推荐信）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ability to make the most of limited resources is ...
advancedExpressions.example: The ability to make the most of limited resources — to extract value from constraint rather than be defeated by it — is perhaps the single most underrated determinant of success.

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should make the most of our time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Time, she had learned, was not a resource to be managed but a gift to be spent — lavishly, deliberately, on the people and pursuits that set the soul alight. And so she made the most of every hour, not by cramming it with tasks, but by filling it with presence: the unhurried conversation, the walk taken slowly, the sunset watched all the way to darkness. （读后续写·时间哲学）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not...but...对比(resource vs gift) + 副词节奏(lavishly, deliberately) + 三重具体意象(unhurried conversation, walk, sunset)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Make the most of this chance.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I would therefore urge every student to make the most of this chance — not merely to attend the workshops, but to immerse themselves fully: to ask the questions that feel too bold, to forge the friendships that might last a lifetime, and to leave with not just a certificate but a transformed perspective. （应用文·活动动员）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not merely to...but to...递进 + 三重不定式排比(to ask, to forge, to leave with)

original_sentence: To fully realize your potential, it is important for you to make the most of our school resources.

classPractice.question: 你们充分利用学校资源很重要。It is important for you to make the ____ of our school resources.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；make the most of sth 充分利用，most 前必须有 the

classPractice.question: The room was small and dark, but they decided to make the ____ (most / best) of a bad situation.
classPractice.note: 坏条件下尽力而为用 make the best of；把好条件用足才用 make the most of

classPractice.question: You should make full use of the library. （用 most 改写）→ You should make the ____ ____ the library.
classPractice.note: make full use of ≈ make the most of，均表"充分利用"

definitionEn:
(1) n. [usually plural] a supply of something valuable, such as land, water, minerals or money, that a country, organization or person can use
(2) n. something, such as books, equipment or online material, that provides information or help for learning and teaching
(3) n. [plural] personal qualities, such as courage, imagination and determination, that help you deal with difficult situations
(4) v. (chiefly BrE) to provide an organization or activity with the money, equipment or staff it needs

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （用于学习/教学的）资料，参考材料（如书籍、设备、网上材料）
uncommonMeanings.example: The teacher shared some useful online resources for exam revision. 老师分享了一些有用的在线备考资料。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （复数）应变的智谋与内在力量（个人品质，如勇气、想象力）
uncommonMeanings.example: Stranded on the mountainside with night closing in, Emma had nothing to rely on but her own inner resources — calm thinking, a pocketknife, and a stubborn refusal to panic. （读后续写·野外遇险·心理描写）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 为…提供资金（或设备、人员）（英式用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: The after-school reading corner, generously resourced by local businesses, has grown from a single bookshelf into a small library that children queue up to enter. （应用文·感谢信/社区报道）

readingExamples: To fully realize your potential, it is important for you to make the most of our school resources.

posExamples.sentence: The old fisherman taught me that the sea is a generous but limited resource, handing me one small fish and releasing the rest with a gentleness I would never forget. （读后续写·祖辈教诲·动作细节）
I would like to suggest that our library open its digital resources to all students at weekends, so that those without computers at home will not be left behind. （应用文·建议信）
Time, unlike money or minerals, is a resource that can never be recycled; how we spend our eighteenth year determines, in large part, who we become at eighty. （议论文·珍惜时间）

No civilization, however advanced its technology, can afford to squander the natural resources on which its very survival depends — a lesson written plainly in the ruins of ancient empires. （议论文·可持续发展）

wordForms.noun: resource（资源，常用复数 resources）; resourcefulness（足智多谋）
wordForms.adjective: resourceful（足智多谋的，善于随机应变的）
wordForms.other: 构词法：re-(再)+source(来源)→可再取用之物→资源；"资源"义几乎总用复数 resources（natural/human/school resources）；形义辨析 resource(资源) vs source(来源)——多一个 re-，勿混；派生形容词 resourceful 足智多谋（-ful 表"充满"）；固定搭配 be thrown back on one's own resources 被迫自力更生

idioms.idiom: be thrown back on one's own resources
idioms.translation: 只能依靠自己，被迫自力更生
idioms.example: With no signal and no map, the hikers were thrown back on their own resources, navigating by the sun and the moss on the north side of the trees. （读后续写·困境求生）

collocations.translation: 学校资源（课文原句词块；resource 作"资源"义常用复数）
collocations.example: Make the most of our school resources. 充分利用我们的学校资源。（课文原句）
We must protect our natural resources for future generations. 我们必须为子孙后代保护自然资源。
After graduation, my cousin joined the human resources department, where her daily job is to match the right people with the right posts. （应用文·人物介绍）
Precisely because our resources are limited, every drop of water saved in the school canteen is a quiet vote for the planet's future. （议论文·节约主题）

collocations.phrase: make full use of / make the most of resources
collocations.example: To prepare for the contest, she made full use of every resource available — past papers, online lectures, and even lunchtime chats with her teachers. （读后续写·备赛励志）
The two schools decided to pool their resources, sharing laboratories and libraries so that students on both campuses could benefit equally. （应用文·合作倡议）
Our seniors' life experience is a precious resource that no search engine can replace, which is why our club records their oral histories every weekend. （应用文·社团活动介绍）
The school website has uploaded abundant learning resources, including recorded lessons and interactive exercises, free for every student to download. （应用文·通知）
Turning off an idle screen may seem trivial, but a habit multiplied by a billion people conserves resources on a scale no single power plant can match. （议论文·环保论证）

synonyms.translation: 来源，出处；根源（形义易混）
synonyms.example: The sun is the ultimate source of energy for all life on Earth. 太阳是地球上一切生命能量的终极来源。
synonyms.usage: 形义辨析(高频易混)：source 指"来源/出处/根源"（a source of income/information；the source of the river 河的源头）；resource 指"可利用的资源/储备"（natural/human resources）。记忆：re-source "再取用"→资源；source 是水从哪来，resource 是能用的水。

synonyms.example: Her fluency in three languages proved a tremendous asset when the international guests arrived without an interpreter. （读后续写·关键时刻）
synonyms.usage: asset 强调"对人或组织构成优势的财富"，可以指人；resource 强调"可取用的储备"，一般不直接指人

synonyms.example: For many rural children, the scholarship is the only means by which the dream of college can ever be reached. （议论文·教育公平）
synonyms.usage: means 指达到目的的"途径、手段"，单复数同形（by means of）；resource 是被利用的"资源"本身

synonyms.example: The country keeps a strategic reserve of grain so that no natural disaster can shake the stability of its food supply. （议论文·粮食安全）
synonyms.usage: reserve 强调"特意留作备用"的储备量（石油储备、外汇储备）；resource 泛指一切可利用之物，不含"备用"之意

advancedExpressions.expression: natural / human / learning resources / limited resources / make the most of resources / inner resources / resourceful
advancedExpressions.example: A resourceful student makes the most of limited resources, drawing on both the school's learning resources and her own inner resources. （一句串联复数搭配、"内在智谋"义与派生形容词 resourceful）

advancedExpressions.expression: source（来源）+ re-（再）→ resource（可再取用之物=资源）；resource → resourceful（足智多谋的）
advancedExpressions.example: Water from that mountain source became the village's most precious resource, and only the most resourceful farmers made full use of it. （source 源头 → resource 资源 → resourceful 机智，三词一句辨清）

advancedExpressions.expression: Drawing on every resource within her/him, sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Drawing on every resource within her — her wits, her training, and the memory of her coach's calm voice — Lily steadied the boat and steered it toward the fading light of the shore. （现在分词开头+破折号三项列举，续写高潮段的蓄力句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: It is the shared duty of ... to make the most of ... resources while wasting none
advancedExpressions.example: It is the shared duty of every student to make the most of our school's resources while wasting none, for the library's true wealth lies not on its shelves but in our hands. （倡议书结尾·职责句+对比升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... is not merely a resource to be consumed, but a legacy to be preserved
advancedExpressions.example: Clean air is not merely a resource to be consumed, but a legacy to be preserved — borrowed, as the saying goes, from our children rather than inherited from our ancestors. （not merely...but 平行结构+化用谚语，论证收束）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should use school resources well.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Only by making the most of the resources around us — attentive teachers, well-stocked shelves and open-minded classmates — can we turn three short years of senior high into a lifetime's foundation. （应用文·演讲稿）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Only by...can 部分倒装 + 破折号三项列举具体化"资源" + 时间对比(three short years / a lifetime)制造格局感

sentenceUpgrade.original: She used her resources to solve the problem.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Refusing to admit defeat, she summoned every resource at her disposal, and piece by piece the seemingly unsolvable puzzle yielded to her quiet persistence. （读后续写·攻坚克难）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Refusing 现在分词表伴随心理 + at one's disposal 高级搭配 + 拟人(puzzle yielded) + piece by piece 副词控制节奏

original_sentence: To fully realize your potential, it is important for you to make the most of our school resources.

classPractice.question: 充分利用我们的学校资源很重要。It is important to make the most of our school ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；resource 作"资源"义几乎总用复数 resources

classPractice.question: The sun is the ultimate ____ (source / resource) of light and heat for the earth.
classPractice.note: 形义辨析：source 来源/出处（a source of ...）；resource 是可利用的资源（natural resources）

classPractice.question: Trapped in the cave, the ____ (resource) boy managed to signal for help using his phone's flashlight.
classPractice.note: 此处需形容词 resourceful 足智多谋的（-ful 后缀）；resource 是名词

definitionEn:
(1) phr. to make good use of an opportunity or available resource
(2) phr. (in a negative sense) to exploit someone's weakness or a situation unfairly for personal gain

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（中性）利用（机会、条件、资源），善加运用（课文义：take advantage of your classes）
uncommonMeanings.example: She took advantage of the free library to read everything she could reach. 她利用免费图书馆读遍了能拿到的一切书。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（贬义）利用某人，占某人的便宜（take advantage of sb.）
uncommonMeanings.example: She had never been able to say no — a kindness that others had learned, over the years, to take advantage of with a casual ruthlessness that chipped away at her spirit. （读后续写·人际关系·伤害）

readingExamples: Take advantage of your classes, learn from your teachers and classmates, and make use of our school facilities.

posExamples.sentence: She took full advantage of the silence that settled over the house after midnight — it was in these hours, with only the moon as her witness, that she wrote the novel she had dreamed of since childhood. （读后续写·追梦场景）
I would like to encourage every member to take advantage of the online learning platform — it offers courses from world-class institutions, entirely free of charge. （应用文·通知/公告）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（充分）利用（机会/资源），善加运用；也指占……的便宜
collocations.example: You should take full advantage of the free courses offered by the school. 你应充分利用学校提供的免费课程。
Young workers tend to be at an advantage when applying for jobs. 年轻工人在求职时往往处于有利地位。
It might be to his advantage to take a computer course of some kind. 上一门电脑课程也许对他有利。

collocations.phrase: have / gain an advantage over sb
collocations.translation: 【课件】比某人有优势，胜过某人
collocations.example: His diligence gives him an advantage over the other applicants, which means he has an advantage over his opponent. 他的勤奋使他胜过其他求职者，意味着他比对手更有优势。

collocations.translation: 充分利用你们的课程（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Take advantage of your classes, learn from your teachers and classmates, and make use of our school facilities. 要充分利用课程，向老师和同学学习，并利用好学校设施。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: make use of our school facilities
collocations.translation: 利用好学校设施（课文原句词块；同义替换 take advantage of）
collocations.example: Take advantage of your classes, learn from your teachers and classmates, and make use of our school facilities. 要充分利用课程，向老师和同学学习，并利用好学校设施。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: take advantage of the opportunity to do sth
collocations.translation: 抓住机会做某事（中性·利用机会）
collocations.example: Take advantage of the opportunity to ask questions after class. 要抓住机会在课后提问。
Don't let others take advantage of your kindness. 别让别人利用你的善良。

He took full advantage of the summer break — rising before the sun to train, poring over books by lamplight, determined to return in September as a version of himself that no one would recognize. （读后续写·自我蜕变）

While others panicked in the chaos, she kept her head and took advantage of the situation — identifying needs, organizing help, and quietly becoming the leader no one had expected her to be. （读后续写·危机中凸显品质）
He had taken unfair advantage of her trust — a betrayal that cut deeper than any lie, because it had been dressed in the costume of friendship. （读后续写·背叛主题）

Years of living abroad had given him an accent and a perspective that his peers could not match; he didn't flaunt it, but he quietly knew he had an advantage over every other candidate in the room. （读后续写·竞争/面试场景）

With her fluent French and intimate knowledge of the city, she found herself at an advantage during the international conference, smoothly navigating conversations that left her colleagues stumbling. （读后续写·人物能力展示）

The change in the schedule worked entirely to her advantage — the extra hour before the interview gave her time to compose herself, to rehearse the answers she had lain awake worrying about. （读后续写·机遇降临）

synonyms.example: She learned to harness the fear that had once paralysed her, transforming it into a fuel that propelled her forward when exhaustion threatened to pull her under. （读后续写·情绪转化）
synonyms.usage: harness sth 强调把某种力量/情绪驾驭并转化为积极推动力，及物直接跟宾语；take advantage of 侧重"抓住并善用机会或资源"

synonyms.translation: 利用，开发（资源/机会/弱点）
synonyms.example: He had exploited every loophole, every grey area, every silence where a question should have been asked — and when it all came crashing down, no one was surprised except him. （读后续写·反派/教训类）
synonyms.usage: exploit 可褒（exploit resources 开发资源）可贬（exploit people 剥削他人），须看语境；take advantage of 的贬义仅限"占人便宜"，用于资源/机会时为中性

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·advantage 家族搭配（课件系统梳理）
advancedExpressions.expression: take (full / unfair) advantage of sth/sb（利用/占便宜）｜at an advantage（处于有利地位）｜to one's advantage（对某人有利）｜have / gain an advantage over sb（胜过某人）｜give sb an advantage over sb（使某人胜过……）。固定短语中 advantage 用单数、不加 s。
advancedExpressions.example: Taking full advantage of every free lesson put him at an advantage and gave him an advantage over his classmates when exams came. 充分利用每一节免费课让他占得先机，考试时比同学更有优势。

advancedExpressions.expression: take (full/unfair) advantage of / have an advantage over sb / at an advantage / to one's advantage / gain an advantage
advancedExpressions.example: He took full advantage of every free lesson, and that edge gave him a real advantage over his classmates when exams came. 他充分利用每一节免费课，考试时这份优势让他明显强过同学。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（利用/善用资源，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: take advantage of / make use of / make the most of / capitalize on / put ... to good use / cash in on
advancedExpressions.example: Make the most of your senior high years — take advantage of the classes and make good use of every facility around you. 好好把握高中三年，充分利用课程，用好身边每一处设施。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·祈使句并列（课文句型）
advancedExpressions.expression: Take ..., learn ..., and make use of ...（动词原形并列的祈使句，发出建议/号召）
advancedExpressions.example: 课文：Take advantage of your classes, learn from your teachers and classmates, and make use of our school facilities. 三个动词原形并列，是校长致辞式号召句的典型骨架。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. resolved to take advantage of the second chance that ...
advancedExpressions.example: She resolved to take advantage of the second chance that fate had so unexpectedly placed before her — this time, there would be no hesitation, no retreat, no looking back. （命运转折·决心表达，三重否定递进）

advancedExpressions.expression: I encourage you to take advantage of this rare opportunity to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I warmly encourage you to take advantage of this rare opportunity to study under Professor Wang — his insights into Chinese literature are nothing short of transformative. （推荐/邀请信）

advancedExpressions.expression: while we take advantage of ..., we must guard against ...
advancedExpressions.example: While we rightly take advantage of technology to enhance learning, we must guard against the creeping assumption that every human interaction can be replaced by a screen.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The opportunity arrived without fanfare — a passing mention in a conversation, a name scribbled on a napkin — and she could have let it go, as she had let so many things go before. But something had shifted inside her. She took advantage of it with a ferocity that surprised her, pursuing every lead, knocking on doors that had always seemed too heavy, and building, piece by piece, the future that had once existed only in the quietest corner of her imagination. （读后续写·抓住机遇·从迟疑到果断）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 对比(could have let it go / but...) + 从迟疑到果断的心理弧光 + 具象化动作(pursuing, knocking, building) + 隐喻(too heavy doors)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I would be remiss if I did not urge you to take full advantage of the remarkable resources our school provides — from the state-of-the-art laboratory to the mentorship programme that pairs you with accomplished alumni, these are not merely facilities but stepping stones to a future you may not yet be able to envision. （应用文·迎新演讲/建议）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: I would be remiss if I did not...郑重引出 + from...to...举例 + not merely...but...递进 + stepping stones隐喻

original_sentence: Take advantage of your classes, learn from your teachers and classmates, and make use of our school facilities.

classPractice.type: 语境应用·用 advantage 相关短语的适当形式填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: As we all know, computers play a more and more important role nowadays. Young workers tend to be ____ (1) when applying for jobs. It might be ____ (2) to take a computer course of some kind. His diligence also ____ (3) the other applicants, which means that he ____ (4) his opponent. After being employed, he can ____ (5) his smartness and enthusiasm to impress others.
classPractice.answer: 1) at an advantage  2) to his advantage  3) gives him an advantage over  4) has an advantage over  5) take full advantage of
classPractice.note: 课件原题五空。1) be at an advantage 处于有利地位；2) be to one's advantage 对某人有利；3) give sb an advantage over 使某人胜过……（主语 diligence 第三人称单数用 gives）；4) have an advantage over 比……有优势（主语 he 用 has）；5) take full advantage of 充分利用。固定短语中 advantage 均用单数。

classPractice.question: 要充分利用课程，向老师和同学学习。____ ____ ____ your classes, and learn from your teachers and classmates.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块；take advantage of 后接机会/资源，此处为中性"善加利用"义，句首祈使句用动词原形

classPractice.question: Don't let dishonest sellers take ____ (advantage / advantages) of elderly shoppers.（占便宜）
classPractice.note: 固定短语 take advantage of 中 advantage 用单数不加s；take advantage of sb 为贬义"占某人便宜"

classPractice.question: We should make full use of the school library. → We should ____ ____ ____ ____ the school library.
classPractice.note: make full use of = take full advantage of，二者可互换表"充分利用"；注意 advantage 前可插 full

definitionEn:
(1) n. [usually plural] rooms, equipment or services that are provided for a particular purpose
(2) n. a place, especially a building, used for a particular activity or industry
(3) n. a natural ability to learn or do something easily and well
(4) n. an extra function or useful feature of a machine, system or service

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①天赋，才能（单数！a facility for sth = 学得又快又好的能力，高考爱考熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The new student showed a rare facility for languages, slipping between English and French so effortlessly that even the teacher paused mid-sentence to listen. （读后续写·天才同学·侧面烘托）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（机器、系统的）特殊功能，附加功能
uncommonMeanings.example: Thanks to the recording facility on her phone, the interview with the ninety-year-old veteran was preserved word for word for the school's oral history project. （应用文·社会实践报道）

readingExamples: Take advantage of your classes, learn from your teachers and classmates, and make use of our school facilities.

posExamples.sentence: The village school had no sports facilities to speak of — just a bare yard and a homemade wooden goal — yet the children's laughter there rang louder than in any stadium I had ever visited. （读后续写·乡村支教·对比描写）
I am writing to recommend our newly opened community centre, whose modern facilities, including a heated swimming pool and a well-equipped gym, are free to all residents over sixty. （应用文·推荐信）
First-class facilities alone do not make a first-class school; without devoted teachers and hungry minds, the shiniest laboratory is merely an expensive room with the lights left on. （议论文·教育本质）
Visitors are kindly reminded that the library's facilities, from self-service printers to group study rooms, may be booked in advance through the official app or at the front desk. （应用文·通知）

wordForms.noun: facility; facilitation（促进）; facilitator（促进者，引导者）
wordForms.adjective: facile（同源词：轻易的，肤浅的，含贬义）
wordForms.other: 小贴士：①"设施"义几乎总用复数 facilities（school/sports/public facilities）；单数 a facility 常表"天赋"(a facility for sth) 或"（系统的）功能"。②词根 facil-=easy（容易），故 facilitate=使容易→促进，facile=轻易的（贬）。③动词 facilitate 后直接跟宾语，不说 facilitate to do。

collocations.phrase: make use of our school facilities
collocations.translation: 利用好学校的设施（课文原句词块；设施义常用复数 facilities）
collocations.example: Take advantage of your classes, learn from your teachers and classmates, and make use of our school facilities. 要充分利用课程，向老师和同学学习，并利用好学校设施。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: have a facility for sth（单数·天赋）
collocations.translation: 在某方面有天赋/学得快（熟词僻义）
collocations.example: She has a facility for languages. 她有学语言的天赋。
The city plans to upgrade the sports facilities in every district park, giving joggers, dancers and basketball lovers alike a place to sweat. （应用文·新闻报道）
Treating public facilities with care is a quiet test of character that every citizen takes daily, whether or not anyone happens to be watching. （议论文·公民素养）
Mobile clinics now carry basic medical facilities into remote mountain villages, where a doctor's visit was once a once-a-year event. （应用文·医疗下乡报道）

collocations.translation: 现代化的／最先进的／一流的设施
collocations.example: Equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, the new science building allows students to conduct experiments that used to exist only in textbooks. （应用文·校园介绍）
The airport provides thoughtful facilities for passengers with disabilities, from step-free ramps to volunteer guides stationed at every corner. （应用文·服务介绍）
More companies are setting up childcare facilities in the workplace, an arrangement that eases young parents' minds and, in turn, boosts their efficiency. （议论文·职场与家庭）
Not everyone has a facility for numbers, but everyone can develop, through patient daily practice, a firm working friendship with them. （议论文·努力与天赋）

synonyms.example: The lab equipment must be checked and cleaned after each experiment, a rule our chemistry teacher enforces without a single exception. （应用文·规章说明）
synonyms.usage: equipment 指具体的器材装备，不可数名词，无复数；facilities 泛指成套的场地与配套服务，常用复数

synonyms.translation: 便利设施，生活福利设施
synonyms.example: The seaside town owes its popularity to its charming amenities: open-air cafés, free beach showers and a promenade lined with palm trees. （应用文·旅游介绍）
synonyms.usage: amenity 侧重让生活舒适愉快的配套（社区、酒店、城市宜居度），多用复数 amenities；facility 侧重实现某种功能的设施

synonyms.example: The concert venue was switched to the indoor stadium at the last minute because of the fast-approaching storm. （读后续写·突发变故）
synonyms.usage: venue 特指举办活动（比赛、演出、会议）的地点；facility 既可指场所，也可指其中的设备与服务

advancedExpressions.expression: make use of / provide / upgrade facilities；have a facility for sth（天赋）；facilitate sth（促进）；a facilitator（引导者）
advancedExpressions.example: The new lab not only provides first-class facilities but also facilitates hands-on learning. 新实验室不仅提供一流设施，还促进了动手学习。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（设施/设备，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: facilities / equipment / amenities / infrastructure / installations
advancedExpressions.example: The community centre boasts modern facilities and thoughtful amenities for every age group. 社区中心拥有现代化设施和面向各年龄段的贴心配套。

advancedExpressions.expression: facile（轻易的，肤浅的）/ facility（便利；设施；天赋）/ facilitate（使容易→促进）/ facilitator（引导者）
advancedExpressions.example: 词根 facil- 意为 easy；facilitate 字面"使变容易"，即"促进、使便利"，是应用文里"促进交流/合作"的高级替换。

advancedExpressions.expression: For all its humble facilities, ... was rich in ...
advancedExpressions.example: For all its humble facilities, the mountain classroom was rich in what no money could buy: a curiosity that lit up forty pairs of eyes every single morning. （for all 让步+冒号解释，物质与精神的反差描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: Boasting ... facilities, ... offers sb. an ideal place to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Boasting first-class facilities and a warm atmosphere, our English corner offers every learner an ideal place to open their mouths and their minds. （boasting 分词开头+一语双关(open mouths and minds)，宣传稿亮点句）

advancedExpressions.expression: Facilities may set the stage, but it is ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Facilities may set the stage, but it is the people on it — their passion, discipline and vision — that decide how the play of education unfolds. （舞台隐喻+强调句，硬件与人的辩证关系）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From the glass-walled library flooded with morning light to the standard track that circles a green field, our school's facilities quietly invite every student to stretch both body and mind. （应用文·校园介绍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: from...to 空间列举铺开画面 + 环境细节(flooded with morning light) + 拟人(facilities invite) + body and mind 对仗收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: The facilities in the village were poor.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The village boasted no facilities beyond a single dusty blackboard, yet within that bare-walled classroom I witnessed a hunger for knowledge that put the best-equipped city schools to shame. （读后续写·支教见闻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: boasted no... 反语强化贫瘠 + yet 转折设置反差 + 抽象名词具体化(a hunger for knowledge) + put...to shame 高级表达

original_sentence: Take advantage of your classes, learn from your teachers and classmates, and make use of our school facilities.

classPractice.question: The school has excellent sports ____ (facility), including a swimming pool and a gym.
classPractice.note: "设施"义几乎总用复数 facilities；此处泛指成套的体育设施

classPractice.question: She picked up the violin at four and showed a remarkable ____ for music.（facility / equipment）
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义：a facility for sth ="（做某事的）天赋"，用单数；equipment 指器材，与语境"天赋"不符

classPractice.question: The lab ____ must be cleaned after each experiment.（equipment / facilities，指具体不可数器材）
classPractice.note: equipment 指具体器材，不可数、无复数；facilities 泛指成套场地与配套服务，此处强调"器材"故用 equipment

translation: adj. 相等的；平等的；相当的 | n. 同等的人（物）| vt. 比得上
definitionEn:
(1) adj. the same in size, amount, value, number, level, etc.
(2) adj. having the same rights, status, or opportunities
(3) adj. linking v. to be the same as or amount to
(4) vt. to be as good as or reach the same standard as something else

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】相当的，能胜任的（be equal to sth = a.和……一样好 b.胜任=be up to）
uncommonMeanings.example: The architecture here is equal to any in the world. 这里的建筑与世界上任何建筑相媲美。／ Are you equal to this job? 你能胜任这份工作吗？（=be up to）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】同等的人（物）；匹敌者（treat sb as equals 一视同仁；be without equal / have no equal 出类拔萃；be the equal of 可与……抗衡）
uncommonMeanings.example: He treated his staff as equals. 他对员工一视同仁。／ The company proved to be the equal of its US rivals. 该公司可与其美国竞争对手抗衡。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①相等的，同样的（the same in size/amount/value；the same rights 平等的）
uncommonMeanings.example: Women demanded equal pay for equal work. 妇女要求同工同酬。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②等于；比得上，与……相当（Two plus two equals four.）
uncommonMeanings.example: No one can equal her in patience. 论耐心谁也比不上她。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③同等的人或事物；匹敌者
uncommonMeanings.example: In the world of ancient Chinese painting, this scroll had no equal — a fact that every museum director in the world understood the moment it was unveiled. （读后续写·无与伦比）

readingExamples: Of equal importance are good study habits, useful skills and a positive attitude.

posExamples.sentence: As they stood side by side on the starting line — the rich boy in his expensive shoes and the village girl in her worn-out sneakers — an unspoken understanding passed between them: on this track, at least, they were equals. （读后续写·平等主题·体育场景）
I am confident that my dedication, combined with the experience I have gained over the past two years, equals — if not surpasses — the requirements outlined in your announcement. （应用文·自荐信/申请信）

wordForms.verb: equalize（使平等，使相等）; equal（等于，比得上）
wordForms.other: inequality（不平等） / unequal（不平等的）；小贴士：①equal 作动词时过去式英式 equalled、美式 equaled。②be equal to sth 有"等于"和"胜任"两义，靠语境判断。③课文 Of equal importance are... 为"表语(介词短语)居首→完全倒装"，主语是复数 good study habits... 故用 are。

idioms.example: For the first time, he was speaking to his father on equal terms — not as a child seeking approval, but as one adult to another, each with his own hard-won wisdom. （读后续写·父子关系·成长标志）

collocations.phrase: be equal to sth【课件】（a.比得上，和……一样好 b.胜任，能应付=be up to）
collocations.translation: 【课件】① to be as good as sth 比得上，和……一样好；② to have the ability to deal with a problem/piece of work successfully 胜任，能应付（=be up to）
collocations.example: 【课件】The architecture here is equal to any in the world. 这里的建筑与世界上任何地方的建筑相媲美。／ Are you equal to this job? 你能胜任这项工作吗？

collocations.phrase: be equal in size / length / height【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】在大小/长度/高度上相等（=of equal size / value / importance）
collocations.example: 【课件】The two boxes are equal in size and weight. 这两个盒子大小和重量相等。（=of equal size）

collocations.phrase: All men are created equal.【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】人人生而平等（equal 作宾补，表"平等的"）
collocations.example: 【课件】All men are created equal. 人人生而平等。

collocations.phrase: treat sb as equals / as an equal【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】平等相待，一视同仁（n. 同等的人）
collocations.example: 【课件】He treated his staff as equals. 他对员工一视同仁。

collocations.phrase: be without equal / have no equal【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】出类拔萃，首屈一指，无人能及（n. 匹敌者）
collocations.example: 【课件】She is a musician without equal / who has no equal. 她是一位无与伦比的音乐家。

collocations.phrase: be the equal of sb / sth【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】可与……抗衡，比得上（n. 同等之物）
