collocations.example: 【课件】The company proved to be the equal of its US rivals. 事实证明该公司可与其美国竞争对手抗衡。

collocations.phrase: equal sth (vt. 与……相等；比得上)【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】vt. 与……相等；比得上（No amount of ... can equal ...）
collocations.example: 【课件】No amount of money can equal memories like that. 再多的金钱也比不上那样的记忆。

collocations.phrase: Of equal importance are ...（表语居首完全倒装）
collocations.translation: 同样重要的是……（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Of equal importance are good study habits, useful skills and a positive attitude. 同样重要的是良好的学习习惯、实用的技能和积极的态度。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 等于；胜任，能应付（be equal to the task 胜任这项任务）
collocations.example: I'm sure she is equal to the task. 我相信她能胜任这项任务。
The two boxes are equal in size and weight. 这两个盒子大小和重量相等。
The doctors warned that the surgery would test her to the limit — but she proved equal to it, emerging from the ordeal with a gratitude for life that she had never known before. （读后续写·疾病·康复）
I believe our club should operate on the principle of equal opportunity — every voice, regardless of seniority, deserves to be heard and respected. （应用文·倡议/演讲）
Her dedication to her students was without equal — a fact acknowledged not in speeches or awards, but in the tears that streamed down their faces the day she retired. （读后续写·师生情·侧面烘托）

synonyms.example: One kilometre is roughly equivalent to two thousand paces. 一公里大约相当于两千步。
synonyms.usage: 常作 be equivalent to sth，强调功能或价值上对等（可作 adj. 也可作 n.）；equal 更强调数量/地位上的"相等、平等"，也可作动词 equal sth

synonyms.example: No one could match her energy, her refusal to give up, her ability to find hope in situations where hope seemed the most irrational choice of all. （读后续写·人物赞颂）
synonyms.usage: match sb (in sth) 侧重在能力/品质上匹敌，及物直接跟宾语；equal 作"比得上"时同样及物 equal sb (in sth)，但更常用于数值"等于"

synonyms.translation: 完全相同的，一模一样的
synonyms.example: The twins wore identical uniforms. 这对双胞胎穿着一模一样的校服。
synonyms.usage: be identical to/with sth，强调"完全一致、毫无差别"；equal 强调"数量或地位上相等"，不等于"一模一样"（equal ≠ identical，可作议论文辨析亮点）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·完全倒装（表语/地点介词短语居首→主谓完全倒装，课文核心句式）
advancedExpressions.expression: ① 表语（介词短语/形容词）居首 + be + 主语：Of equal importance are ...（主语较长时用完全倒装使句子平衡）② 表地点的介词短语 + be/live/stand/lie + 主语（主语为名词）③ Here/There/Now/Then/Out/In/Up/Down/Away/Off + come/go/rush + 主语（谓语为表位移动词，主语为名词）④ There + be/live/fly/lie/stand/remain + 主语（表某地有某物）★注意：主语是代词则主谓不倒装；完全倒装时谓语单复数取决于后面的真实主语
advancedExpressions.example: 课文①：Of equal importance are good study habits, useful skills and a positive attitude. 同样重要的是良好的学习习惯、实用的技能和积极的态度。（主语较长，用完全倒装使句子更平衡；主语复数→谓语用 are）

advancedExpressions.type: 语境应用·完全倒装（课件原题）
advancedExpressions.expression: 地点介词短语居首 + be + 主语（名词）→ 完全倒装
advancedExpressions.example: 1. 教室里有四十名中国学生和两名老师。In the classroom are forty Chinese students and two teachers. 2. 在这张照片中，我周围都是那时在我生活中很重要的东西：汽车杂志和乐器。Around me in this picture are the things that were very important in my life at that time: car magazines and musical instruments.（谓语 are 与后置的真实主语 the things 一致）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·表语居首的完全倒装（课文句型）
advancedExpressions.expression: Of + 抽象名词 + be + 主语（Of equal importance are ... / Of great value is ...）
advancedExpressions.example: 课文：Of equal importance are good study habits, useful skills and a positive attitude. 当表语(介词短语)提到句首强调时，句子完全倒装，谓语与后置的真实主语一致（主语复数→are）。仿写：Of no less significance is a healthy body. 同样不可或缺的是健康的身体。

advancedExpressions.expression: be equal to sth（等于/胜任）/ on equal terms（平等地）/ equal opportunity（平等机会）/ without equal（无与伦比）/ treat sb as an equal（平等相待）
advancedExpressions.example: She was determined to compete on equal terms and prove herself equal to any challenge. 她决心平等竞争，证明自己能胜任任何挑战。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（相等/平等，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: be equal to / be equivalent to / be the same as / amount to / be on a par with / be on equal footing with
advancedExpressions.example: Their contributions were equal to, if not greater than, ours. 他们的贡献即便不比我们大，也与我们不相上下。

advancedExpressions.expression: for the first time, they met as equals
advancedExpressions.example: For the first time, they met as equals — the mentor who had once guided every step and the student who had finally found her own path, the two of them standing at the intersection where gratitude met pride and the student became the teacher's teacher. （师生/父子关系升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: I firmly believe that every student should be treated as an equal
advancedExpressions.example: I firmly believe that every student, regardless of academic standing, should be treated as an equal and given the respect they deserve — for a person's worth cannot be measured by a test score alone. （演讲稿·平等主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: equal does not mean identical; it means ...
advancedExpressions.example: Equal does not mean identical — a lesson that society has taken centuries to learn. It means that every person, in all their glorious difference, deserves the same shot at a dignified life.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In the eyes of the storm, she understood — with a clarity that only extreme circumstances can confer — that titles, wealth, and status were nothing more than costumes we wear. Strip them away, and we are all equal: fragile, fierce, and bound by the same desperate desire to be seen, to be loved, to matter. （读后续写·极端环境领悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 插入语(with a clarity that...) + 隐喻(nothing more than costumes) + Strip them away祈使句 + 三重不定式(to be seen, to be loved, to matter)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that the foundation of any healthy community — be it a classroom, a club, or an entire school — is the principle that every member is an equal, entitled to the same dignity, the same consideration, and the same opportunity to contribute. （应用文·集会演讲/倡议书）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that...正式主句 + be it...插入举例 + 三重the same...排比(dignity, consideration, opportunity)

original_sentence: Of equal importance are good study habits, useful skills and a positive attitude.

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件原题·完全倒装）
classPractice.question: 教室里有四十名中国学生和两名老师。In the classroom ____ (be) forty Chinese students and two teachers.
classPractice.note: 【课件】地点介词短语 In the classroom 居首→完全倒装；真实主语为复数 forty Chinese students and two teachers，故谓语用 are。

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件原题·完全倒装）
classPractice.question: 在这张照片中，我周围都是那时在我生活中很重要的东西：汽车杂志和乐器。Around me in this picture ____ the things that were very important in my life at that time: car magazines and musical instruments.
classPractice.note: 【课件】Around me（地点介词短语）居首→完全倒装；真实主语 the things 为复数，谓语用 are（数随后面的真实主语）。

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件·be equal to 胜任）
classPractice.question: 你能胜任这份工作吗？____ you ____ ____ this job?
classPractice.note: 【课件】be equal to sth ="胜任，能应付"（=be up to），介词用 to；亦可表"和……一样好"，如 The architecture here is equal to any in the world.

classPractice.question: Of equal ____ (important) ____ good study habits, useful skills and a positive attitude.（填形容词的名词形式与be动词）
classPractice.note: 课文原句；Of + 抽象名词提前→完全倒装，真实主语为复数 good study habits... 故谓语用 are

classPractice.question: 我相信他能胜任这份工作。I believe he is ____ ____ the job.
classPractice.note: be equal to sth ="胜任、能应付"，介词用 to 不用 for；be equal to 亦可表"等于"

classPractice.question: James is senior ____ me and more experienced ____ anyone else here.（填介词）
classPractice.note: senior/junior/superior/inferior + to（源自拉丁比较级，用 to 不用 than）；more experienced 是普通比较级，用 than。与 be equal to 一样，equal 的"胜任/等于"也接 to

definitionEn:
(1) n. the way you think or feel about someone or something, often shown in your behaviour
(2) n. (informal) confident, independent or aggressive behaviour that shows you do not care what others think
(3) n. (formal or literary) a position of the body

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①态度，看法，观点（课文义：a positive attitude；attitude to/towards sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her attitude to money changed after she started earning her own. 自己挣钱后，她对金钱的态度变了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（非正式）桀骜自信的个性，酷劲儿（a girl with attitude）
uncommonMeanings.example: With her leather jacket, fearless grin and second-hand electric guitar, the new transfer student was a girl with attitude, and the whole class sensed that school life was about to get interesting. （读后续写·人物出场·个性刻画）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（正式/文学）姿势，姿态（an attitude of prayer 祈祷的姿态）
uncommonMeanings.example: The marble statue stood in an attitude of prayer, hands folded and head bowed, as though it had been listening to the same silence for centuries. （读后续写·场景描写·静物传情）

readingExamples: Of equal importance are good study habits, useful skills and a positive attitude.

posExamples.sentence: What struck me most about Grandpa was his attitude towards setbacks: whenever a crop failed, he would simply tip back his straw hat, study the sky, and say, 'The land forgives those who try again.' （读后续写·祖辈智慧·语言描写）
I strongly recommend Li Hua for the exchange programme, for his positive attitude towards challenges has inspired everyone in our class to push beyond their comfort zones. （应用文·推荐信）

In the long run, it is attitude rather than aptitude that determines altitude; countless ordinary talents have out-flown gifted minds simply by refusing to quit when quitting seemed the only sensible choice. （议论文·态度决定高度）
Let us adopt a responsible attitude towards rubbish sorting, for the habit of one household, multiplied by millions, reshapes the face of a city and the future of a planet. （应用文·倡议书）

idioms.example: The new waiter was said to have an attitude problem, yet Mrs. Lee noticed that his rudeness melted away the moment anyone asked about his little daughter. （读后续写·误解与理解）

idioms.translation: 装腔作势，摆出某种姿态
idioms.example: Rather than striking an attitude of false modesty, the champion openly credited her rivals for pushing her to the very edge of her ability. （议论文·真诚品格）

collocations.translation: 积极的态度（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Of equal importance are good study habits, useful skills and a positive attitude. 同样重要的是良好的学习习惯、实用的技能和积极的态度。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 对某事的态度（介词用 to 或 towards）
collocations.example: What is your attitude towards online learning? 你对线上学习持什么态度？
A positive attitude towards failure, treating it as tuition rather than tragedy, is the invisible engine behind most success stories. （议论文·成败观）
Faced with the strangers' mockery, Tom adopted a calm attitude, bent down without a word, and went on picking up the scattered litter. （读后续写·以行动回应）
It took one sleepless night in the hospital corridor for Jack to change his attitude towards his 'nagging' mother forever. （读后续写·亲情觉醒）
Grandma's attitude towards life was written in her garden: whatever the winter took away, she calmly planted again in spring. （读后续写·人物象征）

collocations.translation: 漫不经心的／从容的态度
collocations.example: A casual attitude towards traffic rules costs lives; a moment's convenience at a red light may become a lifetime's regret. （议论文·规则意识）
The books we read in adolescence quietly shape our attitudes long after their plots have been forgotten. （议论文·阅读的意义）
How a tourist treats the smallest flower at a scenic spot reflects his attitude not only towards nature but towards everyone who comes after him. （议论文·文明旅游）
Instead of taking a wait-and-see attitude towards the new recycling scheme, our class volunteered to pilot it on the very first day. （应用文·活动报道）

synonyms.example: Studying abroad broadened her outlook, teaching her that there is more than one right way to live a meaningful life. （议论文·开阔视野）
synonyms.usage: outlook 指对世界、未来或人生的总体看法（outlook on life），介词用 on；attitude 可具体到对某人某事的态度，介词用 to/towards

synonyms.example: The professor's hands-on approach to teaching turns every lecture into a laboratory of living ideas. （应用文·课程介绍）
synonyms.usage: approach 强调做事的"方式方法"，落在行动层面，常作 approach to sth；attitude 强调内心的看法与情感倾向

synonyms.example: The school takes a firm stance against any form of bullying, promising that every report will be investigated within twenty-four hours. （应用文·校方声明）
synonyms.usage: stance 指就争议问题公开表明的正式立场（take a stance on/against），多用于机构、政策语境；attitude 更私人化、日常化

synonyms.example: Seen from the perspective of a first-time volunteer, even sorting donated books felt like an adventure worth writing home about. （读后续写·志愿初体验）
synonyms.usage: perspective 强调观察问题的角度，可随立足点转换（from the perspective of）；attitude 含情感与评价色彩，相对稳定

advancedExpressions.expression: attitude to/towards sth；adopt/take/change/adjust an attitude；a positive/negative/casual/wait-and-see attitude；have an attitude problem
advancedExpressions.example: It is attitude, not aptitude, that we can always change — and changing it is where growth begins. 我们随时能改变的是态度而非天资，成长正始于此。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（态度/看法，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: attitude towards / view on / stance on / outlook on / approach to / take on sth
advancedExpressions.example: Different generations often hold very different views on, and attitudes towards, hard work. 不同世代对努力常持很不相同的看法与态度。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·主语从句 + 强调（从课文"态度"话题延伸）
advancedExpressions.expression: What separates A from B is (not talent, but) attitude — 主语从句 what... + 破折号下定义
advancedExpressions.example: What separates those who finish from those who quit is rarely talent, but almost always attitude. 决定谁能坚持到底的，很少是天赋，几乎总是态度。

advancedExpressions.expression: It was ... that transformed sb.'s attitude from ... to ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was that rain-soaked afternoon, watching my father repair strangers' bicycles for free, that transformed my attitude from indifference to admiration. （强调句锁定关键场景+from...to 画出情感弧线，续写转折段）

advancedExpressions.expression: Let us approach ... with an attitude of ..., for ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us approach the ocean with an attitude of humility and gratitude, for every breath we take owes something to its silent blue depths. （let us 呼吁+for 补充理由，倡议书结尾句）

advancedExpressions.expression: What separates ... from ... is rarely talent, but almost always attitude
advancedExpressions.example: What separates those who finish the marathon from those who abandon it is rarely talent, but almost always attitude — the quiet decision, made a thousand times, to take one more step. （主语从句对比+破折号下定义，论证核心句）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He changed his attitude towards study.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Gone was the boy who dozed through classes; in his place sat a young man whose attitude towards study had been reshaped, stroke by stroke, by his mother's tired handwriting on those midnight notes. （读后续写·人物转变）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Gone was... 倒装开篇宣告旧我退场 + 今昔同框对比 + stroke by stroke 副词短语控制节奏 + 以物载情(midnight notes)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It cannot be overstated that a positive attitude functions as a compass in the fog of adversity: it does not remove the obstacles ahead, but it keeps every traveller pointed toward the dawn. （议论文·态度主题）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It cannot be overstated that 强调句式 + compass/fog/dawn 一以贯之的隐喻链 + not...but 让步式对比深化论点

original_sentence: Of equal importance are good study habits, useful skills and a positive attitude.

classPractice.question: A positive attitude ____ (towards) study matters as much as good habits.（填介词）
classPractice.note: attitude to/towards sth，两个介词都可用；课文即用 a positive attitude 强调态度的重要

classPractice.question: 同样重要的是良好的学习习惯、实用的技能和积极的态度。Of equal importance are good study habits, useful skills and a ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；a positive attitude 积极的态度，为高频写作词块

classPractice.question: 面对嘲笑，她仍对生活保持乐观的态度。(keep, attitude, towards)
classPractice.answer: Faced with mockery, she still kept an optimistic attitude towards life. / She still maintained a positive attitude towards life in the face of mockery.
classPractice.note: 考 attitude towards life 与 keep/maintain an attitude 搭配；faced with 作状语开头

definitionEn:
(1) n. something you hope to achieve in the future; an aim or purpose
(2) n. (in football, hockey, etc.) the frame, often with a net, into which players try to send the ball in order to score
(3) n. a point that is scored when the ball goes into the goal

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①目标，目的（an aim or purpose；课文义：set clear goals）
uncommonMeanings.example: Set yourself a clear goal and break it into small steps. 给自己定个明确目标，再拆成小步骤。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（足球等的）球门；进球得分（score a goal 进一球）
uncommonMeanings.example: The goalkeeper dived and just tipped the ball over the goal. 守门员飞身把球从球门上方托了出去。

readingExamples: Carefully plan your study, set clear goals and balance your schoolwork with other activities.

posExamples.sentence: Taped above Amy's desk was a photo of the wheelchair marathon champion, and beneath it, in bold red ink, her goal for the year: 'Finish the race — however slowly.' （读后续写·励志·细节特写）
To help every member set a realistic goal for the coming term, our English club will hold a goal-planning workshop in Room 302 at 4 p.m. this Friday. （应用文·通知）
A goal without a plan is merely a wish; it is the daily, unglamorous steps — reviewed notes, early alarms, refused temptations — that turn wishing into achieving. （议论文·目标与行动）
With thirty seconds left on the clock, Leo curled the ball past the diving goalkeeper — the winning goal that sent the whole stand surging to its feet like a released spring. （读后续写·体育高潮·比喻）

wordForms.other: goalkeeper（守门员）; goalpost（门柱）; goal-setting（目标设定）

idioms.translation: 打进乌龙球；（喻）弄巧成拙，害了自己
idioms.example: By copying his best friend's essay word for word, Mike scored a spectacular own goal: the teacher had marked that very essay only the day before. （读后续写·教训·幽默反转）

idioms.translation: （喻）中途改变规则或标准，使人难以达标
idioms.example: Employees complain that the company keeps moving the goalposts: no sooner is one sales target met than a higher one silently appears. （议论文·公平规则）

collocations.translation: 设定明确的目标（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Carefully plan your study, set clear goals and balance your schoolwork with other activities. 精心规划学习，设定明确目标，并平衡好功课与其他活动。（课文原句）
At the start of each month, she sets one small, measurable goal, believing that stairs are climbed step by step rather than in a single desperate leap. （议论文·方法论）
The moment the research team achieved their goal after six hundred failed experiments, the lab erupted — not with cheers, but with quiet, exhausted tears. （读后续写·科研坚持）
Those who pursue their goals with patience learn to treat every setback as a signpost rather than a stop sign. （议论文·挫折观）
Balancing long-term goals with short-term rewards keeps motivation alive: dream of the mountain top, but celebrate each camp along the way. （议论文·自我管理）
The ultimate goal of education is not to fill a bucket but to light a fire, as the old saying wisely reminds every teacher and parent. （议论文·教育目的）
Our volunteer team has been working towards one simple goal: that no elderly neighbour should eat dinner alone on festival nights. （应用文·社团介绍）
Seconds after coming on as a substitute, the youngest player scored a stunning goal, proving that chances belong to those who stay ready. （读后续写·体育励志）
When asked about his goal in life, the street cleaner smiled and said, 'To make one street shine — isn't that enough for one man?' （读后续写·平凡人物·对话）

synonyms.example: The aim of this survey is to find out how much time senior high students actually spend on sleep, exercise and screens each day. （应用文·调查报告）
synonyms.usage: aim 较口语化、较泛，指行动的意图或目的，可作动词 aim to do / aim at sth；goal 更强调明确、需长期努力才能到达的终点

synonyms.example: Our first objective is to raise five thousand yuan for the mountain-area library before the end of May. （应用文·活动方案）
synonyms.usage: objective 正式，多指计划/工作中可量化、可核查的具体目标，常见于应用文提案；goal 可大可小、可长可短

synonyms.example: The factory hit its yearly production target two months ahead of schedule, thanks to a string of small but clever innovations. （议论文·创新例证）
synonyms.usage: target 强调量化指标（sales/production target）或被瞄准的对象，常与具体数字连用 hit/miss a target；goal 未必量化

synonyms.translation: 目的，意图（做某事的原因）
synonyms.example: The purpose of the meeting is to decide who will lead the charity sale. 这次会议的目的是决定由谁负责义卖。
synonyms.usage: purpose 侧重"做某事背后的原因/意图"（for the purpose of doing），偏抽象动机；goal 是"想达到的具体终点"，更可视、可衡量

synonyms.example: Nursing a secret ambition to become a pilot, the farm boy saved every coin for flying magazines and spent cloudless afternoons watching planes. （读后续写·少年梦想·细节）
synonyms.usage: ambition 指长远宏大的人生抱负，情感色彩强烈，常与 nurse/cherish 连用；goal 可大可小，更中性

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（目标/目的，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: goal / aim / objective / target / purpose / ambition / aspiration
advancedExpressions.example: Set a clear goal, break it into weekly targets, and never lose sight of your ultimate aim. 定下明确目标，拆成每周指标，切勿忘记你的终极目的。

advancedExpressions.expression: set / achieve / reach / attain / pursue / work towards a goal；a long-term / short-term / ultimate goal；score a goal（进球）
advancedExpressions.example: She set a long-term goal, worked towards it day by day, and finally reached it. 她定下长远目标，日复一日为之努力，终于实现。

advancedExpressions.expression: goalkeeper（守门员）/ goalpost（门柱）/ goal-setting（目标设定）/ goal line（球门线）
advancedExpressions.example: Effective goal-setting turns a vague wish into a clear plan. 有效的目标设定能把模糊的愿望变成清晰的计划。

advancedExpressions.expression: With the goal firmly anchored in sb.'s heart, ...
advancedExpressions.example: With that goal firmly anchored in her heart, no ridicule could shake her and no failure could sink her; she simply adjusted her sails and read on. （with 复合结构+船锚/风帆隐喻贯穿，续写励志段）

advancedExpressions.expression: With the goal of doing ..., we will ...
advancedExpressions.example: With the goal of making our campus greener, we will plant fifty trees along the playground and set up a paper-recycling corner in every classroom. （with the goal of 目的状语开篇，活动方案的骨架句）

advancedExpressions.expression: A goal, however ambitious, remains ... unless ...
advancedExpressions.example: A goal, however ambitious, remains ink on paper unless it is broken down into daily actions and defended against daily distractions. （however 插入让步+隐喻(ink on paper)，论证目标与执行的关系）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I set a goal and worked hard to achieve it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Having nailed my goal to the wall — 'Top ten in the grade' — I traded weekend games for vocabulary lists, and when the results came out that winter, the trembling finger I ran down the list stopped at number nine. （读后续写·奋斗与收获）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Having done 完成式分词开头 + 目标具体化为引语细节 + traded A for B 表取舍 + 结尾特写(trembling finger)以画面代抒情

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is widely acknowledged that clear goals act as lighthouses in the sea of adolescence, without which even the most talented students may drift with the current and wake to find their harbour far behind. （议论文·目标主题）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is widely acknowledged that 权威式开头 + lighthouse/sea/harbour 一致的航海隐喻链 + without which 非限定性定语从句承接推进

original_sentence: Carefully plan your study, set clear goals and balance your schoolwork with other activities.

classPractice.question: 精心规划学习，设定明确目标。Carefully plan your study and ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块；set a goal / set goals 设定目标，为最核心搭配

classPractice.question: The factory hit its yearly production ____ two months early.（goal / target，强调可量化指标）
classPractice.note: target 强调可量化的指标，常与数字连用（production/sales target）；goal 未必量化，此处填 target 更贴切

classPractice.question: In the last minute, the striker scored a wonderful ____ and won the match.（goal / aim）
classPractice.note: score a goal 进球，goal 兼有"球门/进球"义；aim 无"进球"义，且不与 score 搭配

translation: vt. 同等重视；（使）保持平衡；权衡重要性 | n. 均衡，平衡；平衡能力
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to give equal importance to different things
(2) vt. to keep or put something in a steady position so that it does not fall
(3) n. a situation in which different elements are equal or in the correct proportions
(4) n. the ability to remain steady

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】同等重视，兼顾（give equal importance to two contrasting things）；相抵，抵消（be balanced by）；比较、权衡（balance A against B）；立稳、使保持平衡（balance on / balance sth on sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: She tries to balance home life and career. 她力图兼顾家庭生活和事业。／ Job losses were balanced by job increases in the service sector. 职位的减少因服务业就业机会的增加而得到了弥补。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】余额，结欠（bank balance；the balance of $500 结欠的 500 美元）——熟词僻义，高考爱考
uncommonMeanings.example: The balance of $500 must be paid within 2 days. 500 美元的余款必须在两天内付清。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（使）平衡；同等重视，权衡（课文义：balance A with B）
uncommonMeanings.example: She learned to balance study with rest. 她学会了在学习与休息之间取得平衡。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②均衡，平衡（状态）；平衡能力（keep one's balance）
uncommonMeanings.example: A good life is a matter of balance. 美好的生活在于平衡。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③余额，结欠（bank balance；熟词僻义，高考爱考）
uncommonMeanings.example: She checked the balance on her bank card, and the numbers on the screen — so small, yet so significant — determined whether she would eat that week. （读后续写·经济窘迫·细节描写）

readingExamples: Carefully plan your study, set clear goals and balance your schoolwork with other activities.

posExamples.sentence: She balanced the tray on one hand — a skill honed over countless shifts at her mother's diner — while scribbling calculus formulas on a napkin with the other. （读后续写·艰辛求学·画面感）
I am writing to propose that our school strike a better balance between exam preparation and holistic development — for education, at its core, should nourish the soul as much as the mind. （应用文·建议信）

On balance, the failures that had once seemed like endings revealed themselves as pivot points — every closed door had been, in truth, an open window she was too young to see until she grew tall enough in spirit to look through. （读后续写·成长感悟·倒叙收束）

The outcome of the student council election hung in the balance until the very last vote was counted — and in that suspended breath of time, everyone in the auditorium understood that history is not merely something you read about, but something you make, one raised hand at a time. （读后续写·学生会选举·悬念蓄势）

The joy of winning the national prize was balanced by the ache of knowing her grandmother, who had taught her to love words before she could even write them, was no longer there to see it. That bittersweet equilibrium — triumph and loss, celebration and mourning — was, she realized, the very texture of being alive. （读后续写·深情感悟·悲喜交加）

It is my considered opinion that, on balance, the benefits of implementing a peer-mentoring programme far outweigh the logistical challenges — for the bonds formed between senior and junior students extend well beyond academic support and into the very fabric of school culture. （应用文·提案/建议信）

wordForms.adjective: balanced（平衡的，均衡的）; unbalanced（不平衡的）; imbalanced（失衡的）
wordForms.other: unbalanced（不平衡的） / imbalance（失衡）；小贴士：①balance 可作 v. 也可作 n.，同形。②否定前缀 im-（在 b/m/p 前用 im-）：imbalance 失衡。③a balanced diet 均衡饮食（过去分词作定语）。④固定连接语 on balance ="总的来说"，句首用，逗号隔开。

idioms.idiom: strike a balance (between A and B)
idioms.example: Between chasing his Olympic dream and caring for his ailing mother, the young athlete struck a balance that would have broken most people — training at dawn, nursing by day, studying by lamplight. （读后续写·责任与梦想）

collocations.translation: 【课件】比较；权衡……的重要性（把 A 与 B 相权衡）
collocations.example: 【课件】You have to balance the cost against the benefits. 你得权衡成本与收益。

collocations.phrase: balance (vt.) 同等重视两件相对的事物【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】give equal importance to two contrasting things 同等重视，兼顾
collocations.example: 【课件】She tries to balance home life and career. 她力图兼顾家庭生活和事业。

collocations.phrase: be balanced by sth（相抵，抵消）【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】to be equal in importance/amount/value to sth with the opposite effect 相抵，抵消
collocations.example: 【课件】Job losses in manufacturing were balanced by job increases in the service sector. 制造业职位的减少因服务业就业机会的增加而得到了弥补。

collocations.phrase: balance on one leg / balance sth on sth【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】立稳；使保持平衡（放在……上面而不倒）
collocations.example: 【课件】She balanced on one leg like a dancer. 她像舞者一样单腿立稳。／ He balanced the television on a pile of books. 他把电视稳稳地架在一摞书上。

collocations.translation: 【课件】保持／失去平衡（keep 亦含"保持镇静"，lose 亦含"慌乱"）
collocations.example: 【课件】He slipped on the ice but managed to keep his balance. 他在冰上滑了一下，但设法稳住了身子。

collocations.phrase: keep a balance between ... and ...【课件】
collocations.example: 【课件】We should keep a balance between work and rest. 我们应在工作与休息之间保持均衡。

collocations.translation: 【课件】总的说来，权衡之后（句首连接语，后接逗号）
collocations.example: 【课件】On balance, the plan brings more benefits than drawbacks. 总的说来，这个计划利大于弊。
【课件】The sudden push threw him off balance. 突然一推使他失去了平衡。

collocations.phrase: bank balance / the balance（余额；结欠）【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】n. 银行余额；（应付的）结欠、余款
collocations.example: 【课件】The balance of $500 must be paid within 2 days. 500 美元的余款必须在两天内付清。

collocations.phrase: balance your schoolwork with other activities
collocations.translation: 平衡功课与其他活动（课文原句词块；balance A with B）
collocations.example: Carefully plan your study, set clear goals and balance your schoolwork with other activities. 精心规划学习，设定明确目标，并平衡好功课与其他活动。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: strike a balance (between A and B)
collocations.example: We must strike a balance between work and rest. 我们必须在工作与休息之间找到平衡。
A balanced diet and enough sleep keep the mind sharp. 均衡饮食和充足睡眠能让头脑清醒。
The tightrope walker had spent a lifetime learning to maintain a balance between discipline and freedom — one step too rigid and you fall; one step too loose and you fall just the same. （读后续写·隐喻人生哲理）
The ecosystem of the ancient forest existed in a delicate balance — one the developers, with their blueprints and bulldozers, threatened to destroy forever. （读后续写·环境主题·冲突铺垫）

collocations.translation: 使某人失去平衡；使某人措手不及
collocations.example: The question threw her off balance — not because it was difficult, but because it was the very question she had spent three years running from, and now here it stood, wearing the face of a kindly old professor who had no idea he had just dismantled every wall she had built. （读后续写·心理冲击·真相时刻）

As the rescue team worked through the night, his fate hung in the balance — and somewhere in the darkness, a mother who had not slept in forty-eight hours whispered prayers she had not said since childhood. （读后续写·悬念制造·救援场景）

If her fierce independence occasionally bordered on stubbornness, it was balanced by a generosity so quiet and so complete that those who received it often didn't realize they had until long after. That was the thing about her — every sharp edge had its corresponding softness, every fault its redeeming grace. （读后续写·人物性格描写·优点互补）

collocations.translation: 保持／失去平衡（身体平衡义）
collocations.example: He slipped on the ice but managed to keep his balance. 他在冰上滑了一下，但设法稳住了身子。

collocations.translation: 银行余额，存款结余（熟词僻义·n.余额）
collocations.example: She checked her bank balance before buying the ticket. 买票前她查了查银行余额。

As the words she had dreaded for months finally reached her ears, she lost her balance — not physically, but in that deeper sense where the ground you have stood on for years suddenly tilts and everything you thought was certain slides away. （读后续写·心理崩溃）

On balance, the decision to move to the smaller city had brought more joy than regret — fewer neon lights, perhaps, but infinitely more stars. And in that quieter darkness, she rediscovered the person she had been before ambition had gotten the better of contentment. （读后续写·人生取舍·感悟收束）

synonyms.example: It took months after the accident for her to regain her equilibrium — not just the physical kind, but the deeper equilibrium of a soul that has stared into the abyss and chosen, against all odds, to step back. （读后续写·灾后重建）
synonyms.usage: 正式用语，可指物理平衡也可指心理平静，常作 regain/lose one's equilibrium；balance 更通用、更口语，且兼有"余额"义

synonyms.example: In her grandmother's garden, there was a harmony that transcended mere aesthetics — every plant had a purpose, every corner told a story, and in tending it, she found the peace that had eluded her in the city. （读后续写·人与自然和解）
synonyms.usage: harmony 强调多方"和谐共存、协调一致"，常作 in harmony with；balance 强调"势均力敌、比例适当"的均衡状态

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·balance A against B（权衡）与 balance A with B（兼顾）辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】balance A against B = 把 A 与 B 相权衡、比较重要性；balance A with B = 使 A 与 B 平衡、兼顾（课文 balance your schoolwork with other activities）；be balanced by sth = 相抵、抵消
advancedExpressions.example: 【课件】balance A against B：You have to balance the risks against the benefits. 你得权衡风险与收益。／ balance A with B：balance your schoolwork with other activities 平衡功课与其他活动。

advancedExpressions.expression: balance A with/against B；keep/lose/regain one's balance；strike a balance between；on balance（总之）；hang in the balance（悬而未决）；throw sb off balance（使措手不及）
advancedExpressions.example: On balance, learning to strike a balance between study and rest matters more than any single exam. 总的来说，学会在学习与休息间取得平衡，比任何一次考试都更重要。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（平衡/权衡，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: balance / strike a balance / keep equilibrium / weigh A against B / find the right proportion between
advancedExpressions.example: A wise student weighs ambition against health and finds the right proportion between the two. 明智的学生权衡雄心与健康，在二者间找到恰当的比例。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·前缀 im-（否定，用于 b/m/p 前）
advancedExpressions.expression: balance → imbalance（失衡）/ balanced → unbalanced, imbalanced（不平衡的）
advancedExpressions.example: 否定前缀 in- 在 b/m/p 前同化为 im-：imbalance, impossible, immoral；故"失衡"是 imbalance 而非 inbalance。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. learned to balance ... with ...
advancedExpressions.example: Over the years, he had learned to balance ambition with contentment — to chase his dreams with one hand while holding onto gratitude with the other, and in that tension, he found not conflict but a strange and beautiful peace. （对比式收束，双手意象）

advancedExpressions.expression: I believe a balance must be struck between ... and ...
advancedExpressions.example: I believe a balance must be struck between preserving tradition and embracing innovation — for a school that forgets its roots is unmoored, but one that refuses to evolve is destined to wither. （正式提案句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: the key lies in balancing the competing demands of ...
advancedExpressions.example: The key to educational reform lies not in choosing between rigour and creativity but in balancing the competing demands of both — a task far harder than any extreme position, yet infinitely more rewarding.

sentenceUpgrade.original: We need to balance work and life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The art of living, she was beginning to understand, was the art of balance — not the sterile equilibrium of scales that never tip, but the dynamic, living balance of a dancer who leans into the music, risks the fall, and in that very risking, discovers the grace that holds her upright. And so she learned to work with passion, rest without guilt, and love without reserve — not perfectly, but wholly. （读后续写·舞蹈隐喻·人生哲理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 双重否定递进(not sterile equilibrium... but dynamic) + 舞蹈隐喻(leans into the music, risks the fall) + 三重动词收束(work, rest, love) + not...but...结尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should balance study and activities.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I would therefore propose that our school adopt a more balanced approach to scheduling — one that allocates not merely time for study and recreation in equal measure, but that recognizes these two pursuits not as competitors for our hours but as partners in our growth. For a mind that never plays is as impoverished as one that never studies. （应用文·提案/倡议书）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: one that...同位语递进 + not merely...but...双重递进 + 对称格言句收束

original_sentence: Carefully plan your study, set clear goals and balance your schoolwork with other activities.

classPractice.type: 完成句子（课件·balance A against B 权衡）
classPractice.question: 做决定前，你必须权衡利弊。Before making a decision, you must ____ the advantages ____ the disadvantages.
classPractice.note: 【课件】balance A against B ="权衡、比较 A 与 B 的重要性"，介词用 against；注意与 balance A with B（兼顾、使平衡）区别。

classPractice.type: 完成句子（课件·同等重视/兼顾）
classPractice.question: 她力图兼顾家庭生活和事业。She tries to ____ home life ____ career.
classPractice.note: 【课件】balance vt. 同等重视两件相对的事物；此处 balance home life and career 兼顾家庭与事业（亦可 balance A with B）。

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·熟词僻义 n. 余额/结欠）
classPractice.question: The ____ (balance) of $500 must be paid within two days.
classPractice.note: 【课件】balance 熟词僻义作名词="余额、结欠"（bank balance 银行余额）；此处 the balance of $500 指结欠的 500 美元。

classPractice.question: 设定明确目标，平衡好功课与其他活动。Set clear goals and ____ your schoolwork ____ other activities.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块；balance A with B ="使A与B平衡"，此处 balance 作动词，介词用 with

classPractice.question: ____ ____, the plan brings more benefits than drawbacks.（总的来说）
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义连接语 on balance ="总的来说、权衡之后"，常置于句首，后接逗号，与 all in all 近义

classPractice.question: A ____ (balance) diet, together with regular exercise, keeps us healthy.
classPractice.note: a balanced diet 均衡饮食，balanced 为过去分词作定语表"被均衡安排的"；此处主语 diet 用单数谓语 keeps

definitionEn:
(1) vt. to make something better in quality, standard or value than it was before
(2) vi. to become better; to reach a higher standard or level
(3) vi. (of a sick person or a bad situation) to get better; to recover gradually
(4) vt. to increase the value of land or property by farming, building, etc.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （病情、健康状况）好转
uncommonMeanings.example: For three sleepless nights Grandma's condition showed no sign of improving, but at dawn on the fourth day she opened her eyes and, ever so faintly, smiled. （读后续写·亲情守护·病榻转机）

readingExamples: As a senior high school student, you must make efforts to improve your communication and problem-solving skills.

posExamples.sentence: Determined to improve his spoken English before the exchange programme, Li Hua stood in front of the mirror every morning, reciting speeches until his voice cracked and the winter sky turned pale. （读后续写·励志成长）
I am writing to suggest that our library extend its opening hours, a measure that would greatly improve study conditions for students preparing for the college entrance examination. （应用文·建议信）
Statistics released by our school indicate that students' physical fitness has improved remarkably since the daily running programme was introduced last autumn. （议论文·体育锻炼）
Rome was not built in a day; likewise, a language learner's fluency improves not through occasional bursts of effort but through steady, deliberate daily practice. （议论文·学习方法）

wordForms.other: 构词法：im-（in-的变体，加在 b/m/p 前）+ prove。名词 improvement 为可数/不可数两用：a great improvement（具体的改进之处，可数）、show improvement（进步，不可数）。易错点：介词 improve on/upon sth（改进某物）、improvement in/on sth（某方面的改善），别与 improve sth 直接及物混淆。

idioms.translation: 越陈越好，随岁月而愈佳
idioms.example: Like fine wine, their friendship improved with age, growing richer with every shared hardship and every quiet evening of conversation. （读后续写·友情升华）

collocations.phrase: make efforts to improve your ... skills
collocations.translation: 努力提高你的……技能（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: As a senior high school student, you must make efforts to improve your communication and problem-solving skills. 作为高中生，你必须努力提高沟通和解决问题的能力。
She kept trying to improve on her first draft. 她不断改进初稿。
There has been a big improvement in his spoken English. 他的口语有了很大提高。
Your essay is good, but there is room for improvement. 你的作文不错，但仍有改进空间。
Joining the debate club is an effective way to improve your critical thinking skills as well as your confidence in public speaking. （应用文·招募启事）
Planting more trees along the streets would considerably improve the quality of the air we breathe every day. （应用文·倡议书）

collocations.translation: 极大地 / 显著地改善
collocations.example: The new online platform has significantly improved communication between teachers and parents, which benefits students in the long run. （议论文·科技与教育）
Making a to-do list every evening can improve your efficiency the next day, leaving you more time for hobbies and rest. （应用文·建议信）
A sincere apology, delivered face to face, did more to improve his relationship with his father than a hundred unsent text messages ever could. （读后续写·亲情和解）
Her grades steadily improved over the term, each small victory quietly rebuilding the confidence that failure had once stolen from her. （读后续写·逆袭成长）

synonyms.translation: 增强，提升（价值、品质、形象）
synonyms.example: Volunteering will greatly enhance your sense of responsibility. 志愿服务会大大增强你的责任感。
synonyms.usage: enhance 更正式，指提升已有的良好品质、价值、形象，宾语多为抽象名词（value / image / reputation）；improve 泛指使变好，宾语可以是任何有待改进之物

synonyms.example: The activity aims to promote friendship between the two schools. 该活动旨在促进两校友谊。
synonyms.usage: promote sth 强调'推动、促成'某事发展（cooperation / development / health），也表'晋升'（be promoted to）；improve 强调把已有事物的质量或水平变得更好，二者宾语侧重不同

synonyms.example: Regular class discussions strengthen the bond between students and help create a harmonious learning atmosphere. （议论文·班级建设）
synonyms.usage: strengthen 强调使更牢固、更强大，宾语常为关系、体质、信心等；improve 强调质量或水平的普遍提高

synonyms.example: The young writer spent months refining every paragraph of her story until each sentence rang clear as a bell. （读后续写·匠心打磨）
synonyms.usage: refine 指在已较好的基础上精雕细琢、去粗取精，多用于技艺、方法、文字；improve 不含'精细打磨'的意味

advancedExpressions.expression: improve on/upon sth（改进、超越）· room for improvement（改进余地）· make/show improvement（取得进步）· see a marked improvement in（在……有明显改善）
advancedExpressions.example: There is still room for improvement, but we have already seen a marked improvement in air quality. 仍有改进余地，但空气质量已有明显改善。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表'提高/改善'可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: improve / enhance / boost / promote / raise / lift / better（可视语境替换'使变好'的动词）
advancedExpressions.example: Regular reading can improve / enhance / boost your vocabulary. 经常阅读能提高你的词汇量。

advancedExpressions.expression: with each ..., sb. improved little by little, until ...
advancedExpressions.example: With each stumble and each humiliating fall, her skating improved little by little, until one frosty morning she glided across the ice as if she had been born on it. （重复结构渲染过程+until引出质变，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would appreciate it if measures could be taken to improve ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would appreciate it if effective measures could be taken to improve the food quality in our school canteen, as a balanced diet is essential to our health. （建议信礼貌句式+原因补充）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is not ... but ... that truly improves ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is not the amount of time spent at the desk but the quality of focused effort that truly improves academic performance. （强调句否定转折，直击论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He worked hard to improve his English.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Night after night, long after his roommates had drifted off to sleep, he huddled beneath a dim lamp with a worn dictionary, determined to improve his English one stubborn word at a time. （读后续写·环境+动作描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Night after night 时间重复营造毅力感 + long after 时间状语从句 + huddled/worn/dim 细节描写 + one stubborn word at a time 量词短语收尾显画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should improve our study methods.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Only by constantly reflecting on and adjusting our study methods can we improve them to the point where effort is translated into genuine progress rather than mere exhaustion. （议论文·方法论）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Only by...倒装句式 + to the point where 程度状语从句 + rather than 对比结构强化论证

original_sentence: As a senior high school student, you must make efforts to improve your communication and problem-solving skills.

classPractice.question: You must make efforts to ____ (improve) your communication skills before the interview.
classPractice.note: make efforts to do sth 结构，to 后接动词原形；照应课文原句 make efforts to improve。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（improve / enhance / promote）：The exchange programme is designed to ____ friendship between the two countries.
classPractice.note: 宾语为 friendship（关系的推动、促成），用 promote；enhance 多接品质/价值，improve 泛指使变好但不如 promote 贴'促进关系'之义。

classPractice.question: 尽管她的第一幅画获了奖，她整个夏天都在设法改进它。Although her first painting won the prize, she spent the whole summer trying to ____ ____ ____ (改进它).
classPractice.note: 考固定搭配 improve on/upon sth（在原有基础上做得更好），注意介词 on/upon 不可省。

classPractice.question: Your composition shows great ____ (improve), but there is still room for it.
classPractice.note: 空前 great、后有介词短语，需名词 improvement；room for improvement 为固定搭配'改进的余地'。

definitionEn:
(1) phr. used when mentioning the final person or thing in a list, to emphasize that they are just as important as the others
(2) phr. a discourse marker that signals the last point of a speech or piece of writing while keeping the audience's attention
readingExamples: Last but not least, always look on the bright side and never lose hope, even in difficult situations.

posExamples.sentence: Last but not least, I would like to extend my heartfelt thanks to the volunteers whose quiet dedication made this charity sale such a resounding success. （应用文·感谢信/演讲稿）
Last but not least, remember to bring your student ID card on the day of the visit, for no one will be admitted to the museum without it. （应用文·通知）
Last but not least, perseverance matters more than talent, for countless examples prove that it is the determined, not merely the gifted, who reach the summit of success. （议论文·结尾论点）

collocations.phrase: last but not least, always look on the bright side
collocations.translation: 最后但同样重要的是，永远要看到光明的一面（课文原句）
collocations.example: Last but not least, always look on the bright side and never lose hope, even in difficult situations. 最后但同样重要的是，永远要看到光明的一面，即使身处困境也绝不失去希望。

collocations.phrase: last but not least, I would like to ...
collocations.translation: 最后但同样重要的是，我想……（演讲/书信收尾套路）
collocations.example: Last but not least, I would like to thank all the volunteers. 最后但同样重要的是，我要感谢所有志愿者。

collocations.phrase: first ... second ... last but not least ...
collocations.translation: 首先……其次……最后但同样重要的是……（列举框架）
collocations.example: First, set a realistic goal; second, break it into daily tasks; last but not least, reward yourself for every small step forward. （应用文·建议信）

collocations.phrase: last but not least, it should be noted that ...
collocations.translation: 最后但同样重要的是，应当指出……
collocations.example: Last but not least, it should be noted that a healthy body is the foundation on which all academic achievement is built. （议论文·收束要点）

synonyms.example: Finally, please confirm your attendance by Friday. 最后，请在周五前确认出席。
synonyms.usage: finally 仅表列举顺序的'最后'，居句首常加逗号，不含'同样重要'的强调；last but not least 特意提醒读者最后一点绝非最不重要，修辞感更强

synonyms.example: Lastly, keep in mind that safety always comes first. 最后，请记住安全永远第一。
synonyms.usage: lastly 是中性的列举结尾副词，语气平实；与 firstly / secondly 成序列使用；last but not least 更有感染力，是应用文加分表达

synonyms.example: Above all, never give up on your dream. 最重要的是，永远不要放弃你的梦想。
synonyms.usage: above all 强调'在所有之中最重要的一点'（重要性排序），不一定放在列举末尾；last but not least 强调'位置在最后但依然重要'（顺序+重要性），两者侧重点不同

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·结尾衔接（列举末项可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: last but not least / finally / lastly / in the end / above all / to conclude / to sum up（收尾衔接词，视语气强弱替换）
advancedExpressions.example: Last but not least — or, if you prefer, finally — remember to enjoy the journey itself. 最后但同样重要的是——或者说，最后一点——别忘了享受旅程本身。

advancedExpressions.expression: last but not least, may I take this opportunity to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Last but not least, may I take this opportunity to wish every one of you a fruitful and colourful senior high school life. （情态倒装致辞句式，演讲稿典范收尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: last but not least, it would be advisable to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Last but not least, it would be advisable to set aside ten minutes each day for reflection, a habit that pays off handsomely in the long run. （委婉建议句式+习语点睛）

advancedExpressions.expression: last but not least, ... — perhaps the most vital point of all
advancedExpressions.example: Last but not least, learn to embrace failure — perhaps the most vital point of all, for every setback carries within it the seed of future success. （破折号补语强化收尾，升华论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Last but not least, we should protect the environment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Last but not least, safeguarding the environment is not a burden we reluctantly shoulder but a responsibility we proudly embrace, for the earth we save today is the home our children will inherit tomorrow. （议论文·结尾升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not ... but ... 对比结构 + for 引出理由 + today/tomorrow 时间对照营造格局感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Last but not least, thank you for your help.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Last but not least, please accept my sincerest gratitude for your generous help, without which the entire programme would have remained nothing but a dream on paper. （应用文·感谢信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: please accept my sincerest gratitude 正式致谢句式 + without which 非限制性定语从句含虚拟语气 + nothing but a dream on paper 形象化收尾

translation: 全面发展的；面面俱到的
definitionEn:
(1) adj. having a variety of experiences, skills, and abilities
(2) adj. fully developed in all aspects
(3) adj. having a personality that is fully developed in all aspects through a wide range of experiences
readingExamples: In time you will find yourself growing into a well-rounded individual.

posExamples.sentence: The scholarship committee was not looking for perfect test scores alone — they sought well-rounded individuals, and in the boy who played the erhu, captained the basketball team, and volunteered at the animal shelter every weekend, they found exactly what they had been searching for. （读后续写·申请/录取场景）

I am writing to recommend Li Hua for the summer programme, as I have rarely encountered a student as well-rounded — academically gifted, artistically talented, and above all, genuinely kind. （应用文·推荐信）

wordForms.other: 构词法·合成形容词（well- + 过去分词）：well- 表'好地'加过去分词构成一组合成形容词——well-known（著名的）、well-behaved（举止得体的）、well-informed（消息灵通的）、well-educated（受过良好教育的）、well-organized（有条理的）、well-known。书写要点：作定语放名词前时用连字符（a well-known writer）；作表语时英式常保留连字符、美式可不用（He is well known）。近义 all-round 亦常见连字符。

collocations.translation: 成长为一个全面发展的人（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In time you will find yourself growing into a well-rounded individual. 假以时日，你会发现自己正成长为一个全面发展的人。
The school offers a well-rounded education. 这所学校提供全面发展的教育。
He was, by any measure, a well-rounded person — a scientist who wrote poetry, an athlete who painted watercolours, a leader who was never too busy to listen. （读后续写·人物侧写）
The exchange year gave her a well-rounded experience that no classroom could replicate. （读后续写·文化沉浸）

synonyms.example: She is an all-round student who excels in both study and sports. 她是个品学兼优的全能学生。
synonyms.usage: all-round 作定语，常搭 all-round development / ability / student，英式英语更常用；well-rounded 侧重'各方面均衡发展'的人或教育，两者常可互换但搭配习惯略异

synonyms.example: The versatile actor can sing, dance and even direct. 这位多才多艺的演员能唱能跳还能导演。
synonyms.usage: versatile 强调'一人身兼多种技能、能胜任多种工作'，可作表语和定语；well-rounded 强调'素质全面均衡'，不只指技能多，还含品格、修养的全面

synonyms.example: The report gives a comprehensive analysis of the problem. 该报告对问题作了全面分析。
synonyms.usage: comprehensive 修饰事物（analysis / plan / survey），指'内容涵盖面广、无遗漏'；well-rounded 主要修饰人或教育经历，指'各方面均衡发展'，两者宾语类别不同不可乱换

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·well-家族（合成形容词一组）
advancedExpressions.expression: well-rounded / well-known / well-behaved / well-informed / well-educated / well-organized（well- + 过去分词，作定语加连字符）
advancedExpressions.example: A well-informed and well-behaved student naturally grows into a well-rounded individual. 一个见多识广、举止得体的学生自然会成长为全面发展的人。

advancedExpressions.expression: what made sb. well-rounded was not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What made her well-rounded was not the trophies on her shelf or the certificates in her drawer — it was the genuine delight she took in everything she did. （not...but...揭示本质）

advancedExpressions.expression: I consider myself a well-rounded candidate who ...
advancedExpressions.example: I consider myself a well-rounded candidate who brings not only a solid academic record but also leadership experience, artistic sensibility, and a demonstrated commitment to community service. （正式自荐）

advancedExpressions.expression: the goal of education should be to cultivate well-rounded individuals capable of ...
advancedExpressions.example: The goal of education should be to cultivate well-rounded individuals capable not merely of passing examinations but of asking the questions that examinations never pose.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To call her a well-rounded student would be to miss the point — as if her gifts were merely geometric, distributed evenly like spokes on a wheel. The truth was richer, stranger: she was a person in whom seemingly incompatible passions coexisted — a mathematician who wept at poetry, a sprinter who moved through museums as if through cathedrals, a child of the digital age who found her deepest peace in the hush of ancient libraries. （读后续写·颠覆刻板印象·人物深度刻画）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 先否定再展开(To call her...would be to miss) + 比喻(wheel spokes) + 三重身份排比(mathematician, sprinter, child of digital age) + 矛盾修辞(incompatible passions coexisted)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What we seek — and what our programme is designed to nurture — are not students who merely excel in every subject but well-rounded individuals who understand that true excellence is measured not by the breadth of one's résumé but by the depth of one's engagement with the world. （应用文·招生/选拔公告）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What we seek...主语从句 + not...but...双重对比 + breadth vs depth 对称修辞

classPractice.note: 修饰人且强调'各方面均衡发展'用 well-rounded；comprehensive 修饰事物（如 analysis / plan），不用于形容学生本身。

translation: n. 个人 | adj. 单独的，个别的
definitionEn:
(1) n. a single human being as distinct from a group
(2) n. considered separately rather than as part of a group
(3) adj. connected with one person
(4) adj. designed for one person

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①单独的，个别的，各自的（=separate）
uncommonMeanings.example: The teacher gave each student individual attention. 老师给了每个学生单独的关注。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②独特的，与众不同的，有个人风格的（=distinctive）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her individual style made her impossible to categorise. 她独特的风格让人无法归类。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（区别于团体的）个人，个体
uncommonMeanings.example: The rights of the individual must be protected. 个人的权利必须得到保护。

readingExamples: In time you will find yourself growing into a well-rounded individual.

posExamples.sentence: In the sea of identical uniforms, she was just another student — but the journal hidden beneath her mattress told a different story: the story of an individual wrestling with questions too large for her small town, too profound for casual conversation. （读后续写·个性觉醒）
I would like to request an individual consultation to discuss my career plan, as I believe such matters benefit from focused, one-on-one attention. （应用文·请求信）

wordForms.other: 构词法：individ(不可分的) + -ual（形容词/名词后缀）。词族：individuality（个性）、individually（逐个地，单独地）、individualism（个人主义）、individualist（个人主义者）。易错：individual 既是形容词又是名词，做名词可数（an individual / individuals）；副词 individually 常与 collectively（集体地）对照。

collocations.translation: 成长为一个全面发展的人（课文原句词块，individual 作名词'人/个体'）
collocations.example: In time you will find yourself growing into a well-rounded individual. 假以时日，你会发现自己正成长为一个全面发展的人。
Every individual matters in a team. 团队中每个人都很重要。

collocations.translation: 个体需求 / 个体差异
collocations.example: Good teachers pay attention to the individual needs of each student. 好老师会关注每个学生的个体需求。
The disaster taught them that individual responsibility was not a burden to be avoided but a power to be embraced. （读后续写·灾难→觉醒）

synonyms.example: She is a kind person. 她是个善良的人。
synonyms.usage: person 是最普通的'人'，泛指；individual 作名词时强调'区别于群体的单独一个人、个体'，语体更正式，常与 group / collective 对照（the individual and society）——'尊重每一个人'宜用 respect every individual

synonyms.example: There was something distinctive about the way she told stories. 她讲故事的方式有种独特的味道。
synonyms.usage: distinctive 只作形容词，强调'与众不同、可资辨识'；individual 作此义时同样表'独特'，但更侧重'带有个人印记的'（individual style / taste），二者常可换用

synonyms.example: Each snowflake is unique. 每一片雪花都独一无二。
synonyms.usage: unique 强调'世上唯一、无可替代'，语气最重，前不可加 very（可用 truly / quite）；individual 表'独特'语气较轻，指'各自不同、有个性'，达不到 unique 的'绝无仅有'

advancedExpressions.expression: each / every individual（每一个人）· individual differences / needs（个体差异/需求）· as an individual（作为个体）· individually（逐个地）· respect the individual（尊重个体）
advancedExpressions.example: Teaching should respect individual differences and treat every individual as unique. 教学应尊重个体差异，把每个人都当作独特的个体。

advancedExpressions.expression: it was then that sb. realized: being an individual meant ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was then that she realized: being an individual meant not standing apart from the crowd but standing so firmly in your own truth that the crowd could not help but make room. （个性≠孤立，独立=自信）

advancedExpressions.expression: the contribution of every individual, however modest, is ...
advancedExpressions.example: The contribution of every individual, however modest it may appear, is a thread in the fabric of our community — and a fabric is only as strong as the sum of its threads. （鼓励参与·隐喻）

advancedExpressions.expression: the tension between the individual and the collective is ...
advancedExpressions.example: The tension between the individual and the collective is not a problem to be solved but a creative tension to be managed.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She had spent years trying to be what others expected — the dutiful daughter, the agreeable friend, the invisible student in the back row. But the world, she slowly came to understand, does not need copies; it needs originals. And an original, by definition, must be an individual — with all the messiness and risk and terrifying freedom that entails. It was the scariest thought she had ever had. And it was also, she suspected, the truest. （读后续写·从从众到个性的觉醒）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 三重身份递进(dutiful daughter, agreeable friend, invisible student) + 对比(copies vs originals) + 短句强调(scariest...truest)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I would therefore urge every member of this community to recognize that behind every face, every name, every seat in this hall, there is an individual — with a story you have not heard, a struggle you have not witnessed, and a dream that deserves, at the very least, your respect. （应用文·演讲/倡议）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 三重every...排比 + 三重a...you have not...递进 + at the very least委婉强调

classPractice.note: 修饰动词 dealt，需副词 individually（逐个地，分别地），常与 collectively 相对。

classPractice.note: 第一空 individual 作名词'个体'；第二空 individual 作形容词'个别的/各自的'——一词两性，考察其名词与形容词双重词性。

translation: 品质，性格；特点；人物，角色；文字
definitionEn:
(1) n. the particular combination of qualities that makes someone a particular type of person
(2) n. the mental and moral qualities distinctive to an individual
(3) n. a person in a story, film, or play
(4) n. the quality of being interesting or unusual

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①品质，性格，品格（=personality/moral qualities）
uncommonMeanings.example: Honesty is an important part of her character. 诚实是她品格的重要部分。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（书、电影、戏剧中的）人物，角色（the main character 主人公）
uncommonMeanings.example: My favourite character in the novel is the loyal old servant. 小说里我最喜欢的角色是那位忠心的老仆人。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（书写或印刷的）文字，符号（a Chinese character 一个汉字）
uncommonMeanings.example: Each Chinese character carries its own history. 每个汉字都承载着自己的历史。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④特色，特点，风貌（使事物有趣或与众不同的品质）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old town has a lot of character. 这座老城很有特色。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑤毅力，勇气（困境中表现出的坚强品质）
uncommonMeanings.example: It was in the months of rehabilitation that his true character emerged. 正是在康复的那些月份里，他真正的坚强品格显现出来。

readingExamples: You need to make a continuous effort to train your mind and develop your character.

posExamples.sentence: The fire had taken their home, their photographs, their grandmother's wedding dress — everything that could burn — but it could not touch their character, forged over generations like iron tempered in flame. （读后续写·灾难重建·品格力量）
I am writing to recommend Zhang Wei for the leadership position — his character, tested over three years of service to our class, speaks louder than any résumé ever could. （应用文·推荐信）

wordForms.noun: characteristic（特征，特点，n.）· character（品格；角色；文字）
wordForms.verb: characterize / characterise（描述……的特征；以……为特点）
wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：character（n.品格/角色/文字）→ characteristic（n.特征 / adj.典型的）→ characterize（v.描述特征）→ characteristically（adv.）。注意：characteristic 既是名词'特征'又是形容词'典型的'，一词两性；be characteristic of sb/sth = 是……的典型特征。词根 charact-（刻痕、印记，源于希腊语'刻在心上的印记'→引申为品格）。搭配熟记：in character（符合性格）/ out of character（反常，不符合平日性格）。

idioms.example: When she refused the easy way out — when she chose the harder, kinder, slower path — no one who knew her was surprised. It was entirely in character. （读后续写·一致性塑造可信人物）

When the boy who never spoke raised his hand in class that day, it was so out of character that the teacher paused mid-sentence, the chalk frozen in her fingers, sensing that something momentous was about to happen. （读后续写·转折铺垫）

collocations.phrase: train your mind and develop your character
collocations.translation: 训练你的头脑、培养你的品格（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: You need to make a continuous effort to train your mind and develop your character. 你需要持续努力，训练头脑、培养品格。
It takes years to learn thousands of Chinese characters. 学会几千个汉字要花好几年。
Who is the main character in this novel? 这部小说的主人公是谁？
The old carpenter believed that working with wood built a person's character. （读后续写·手艺与品格）
The championship game, tied with seconds remaining, was more than a test of skill — it was a test of character. （读后续写·体育竞技·精神升华）
In the end, what the hiring manager remembered was that every referee had used the same phrase: a person of good character. （应用文·面试感悟）

synonyms.example: She has a warm and outgoing personality. 她性格温暖外向。
synonyms.usage: personality 侧重'个性、性格特征'（外向、内向等社交层面），偏中性描述；character 侧重'道德品质、人格'（诚实、坚韧等价值层面），常含道德评价——'品格好'用 good character，不用 good personality

synonyms.example: A man of such integrity, he did the right thing even when no one was watching. 他为人正直，即使无人注视也做对的事。
synonyms.usage: integrity 是不可数名词，专指'道德上的正直、诚信'，是 character 的一个核心组成部分；character 含义更广，可指整体品格、性格乃至角色、文字

synonyms.example: Her artistic temperament made her difficult to live with. 她艺术家般的性情让人难以相处。
synonyms.usage: temperament 侧重'天生的气质、情绪倾向'（易怒、沉静等），带先天色彩；character 更多指后天塑造、可培养的品格（develop one's character），二者一先天一后天

advancedExpressions.expression: develop / build one's character（培养品格）· in character（符合性格）· out of character（反常）· a test of character（品格考验）· a Chinese character（汉字）· the main character（主人公）
advancedExpressions.example: His outburst was so out of character that everyone fell silent. 他突然发火太反常了，大家都沉默了。

advancedExpressions.expression: adversity does not build character; it reveals it
advancedExpressions.example: The old woman had always said that adversity does not build character — it reveals it, stripping away every pretence until what remains is the unvarnished truth of who a person really is. （格言式主题句，适合续写转折点）

advancedExpressions.expression: I can speak to his / her character with absolute confidence
advancedExpressions.example: Having supervised Li Hua for three years, I can speak to her character with absolute confidence — she is that rarest of students in whom talent and humility coexist. （推荐信·强力背书）

advancedExpressions.expression: education should aim at the formation of character, not merely ...
advancedExpressions.example: Education, at its noblest, should aim at the formation of character, not merely the accumulation of credentials — for what use is a brilliant mind housed in a hollow soul?

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Character, he came to understand, was not something you were born with — it was something you built, choice by painstaking choice, in the small unobserved moments that no one applauded: the lie you almost told but didn't, the shortcut you almost took but refused, the apology that stuck in your throat but was offered anyway. And it was in these moments, not in the grand stages of life, that a person truly became who they were. （读后续写·品格的形成·日常细节）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: choice by painstaking choice递进 + 三重具体场景(the lie, the shortcut, the apology) + not...but...对比收束

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not as...but as...层递比喻(footnote vs page) + For...条件限定 + building on sand圣经隐喻收束

classPractice.note: 涉及诚实、责任感等道德品质，用 character（品格）；personality 偏'个性/性格类型'，无'道德评价'色彩，此处不合。

classPractice.question: Patience and honesty are ____ (character) of a good leader.
classPractice.note: be characteristic of sb/sth = 是……的典型特征；此处需名词/形容词 characteristic（作表语，是……的特征）。

definitionEn:
(1) adj. having the job or duty of dealing with something so that it is your fault if something goes wrong
(2) adj. being the cause of something
(3) adj. able to be trusted to do what is right or to do the things that are expected

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】① be responsible for（对……负责/是……原因）② be held responsible for（被追究责任）③ be responsible to sb（对某人负责/听命）；反义 irresponsible 不负责任的
uncommonMeanings.example: The airline is legally responsible for the safety of its passengers. 航空公司对乘客的安全负有法律责任。／ The Council of Ministers is responsible to the Assembly. 内阁须向议会负责。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（对……）需承担责任的，应受责备的，是……的起因
uncommonMeanings.example: The investigation concluded that no single person was responsible for the collapse. 调查断定坍塌不是任何单独一个人的过错。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②可靠的，可信赖的，负责任的（值得托付的品质）
uncommonMeanings.example: We need a responsible person to look after the children. 我们需要一个可靠的人来照看孩子。

readingExamples: yet you alone are responsible for realizing your great potential.

posExamples.sentence: When the storm hit and the adults were nowhere to be found, the sixteen-year-old became responsible for four younger siblings — and in those harrowing hours, fear and love fused into a courage she did not know she possessed. （读后续写·突发危机·责任降临）

As the newly elected president of the Student Union, I am keenly aware that I am responsible not only for organizing events but for being a voice that represents every student in this school. （应用文·就职演说）

wordForms.adjective: responsible（负责的）· irresponsible（不负责任的）
wordForms.adverb: responsibly（负责地）· irresponsibly（不负责任地）
wordForms.other: 构词法：respond(回应) → response(回应,n.) → responsible(能回应/负责的,adj.) → responsibility(责任,n.) → responsibly(负责地,adv.)；反义前缀 ir-（在 r 前）构成 irresponsible / irresponsibly。易错拼写：responsib-le / responsib-ility 词干带 b；名词 responsibility 可数（have responsibilities 承担多项职责）也可不可数（a sense of responsibility）。搭配定式：be responsible for (doing) sth（对……负责）、be responsible to sb（对某人负责）、take/bear responsibility for（承担责任）。

idioms.example: The village held no one person responsible for the fire — it was, they agreed, an act of nature — but in its aftermath, they held everyone responsible for the rebuilding, and in that shared burden they found a unity they had not known in decades. （读后续写·集体责任·重建）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……负责；有……的责任（for 后接名词或动名词）
collocations.example: 【课件】The airline is legally responsible for the safety of its passengers. 航空公司对乘客的安全负有法律责任。

collocations.phrase: be held responsible for sth【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】被认为应对……负责，被追究……的责任
collocations.example: 【课件】He is mentally ill and cannot be held responsible for his actions. 他有精神病，不能对自己的行为负责。

collocations.translation: 【课件】对某人负责（向某人汇报、听命）
collocations.example: 【课件】The Council of Ministers is responsible to the Assembly. 内阁须向议会负责。

collocations.phrase: take / claim / escape / avoid responsibility (for)【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】承担／声称对……负责／逃避／回避责任（responsibility n. 责任、职责）
collocations.example: 【课件】Nobody has claimed responsibility for the bombing. 没有人声称对爆炸事件负责。／ I don't feel ready to take on new responsibilities. 我不愿意承担新的责任。

collocations.phrase: a sense of responsibility (to / towards sb)【课件】
collocations.example: 【课件】Every citizen should have a sense of responsibility towards society. 每个公民都应对社会有责任感。

collocations.translation: 【课件】不负责任的（前缀 ir- 加在 r 前构成否定）
collocations.example: 【课件】It was irresponsible of him to leave the children alone. 他把孩子单独留下，太不负责任了。

collocations.phrase: be responsible for realizing your potential
collocations.translation: 对实现你的潜能负责（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Yet you alone are responsible for realizing your great potential. 然而唯有你自己要对实现你的巨大潜能负责。
I believe that fostering responsible citizens is the highest calling of education. （应用文·教育理念·演讲稿）
When her father fell ill, she shouldered responsibility for the family business. 父亲病倒后，她挑起了家族生意的重担。

He had spent the first seventeen years of his life perfecting the art of escaping responsibility — slipping out of commitments like water through fingers, leaving others to clean up messes he was too clever to claim. But the one thing he could never escape was the hollow feeling that followed him into every room, the quiet knowledge that a life without responsibility was, in the end, a life without weight, without consequence, without meaning. （读后续写·逃避→觉醒·人物弧光）
He is responsible for cleaning the classroom this week. 这周他负责打扫教室。

collocations.translation: 对某人负责（向某人汇报、听命）
collocations.example: As monitor, you are responsible to the head teacher. 作为班长，你要对班主任负责。
It was a sense of responsibility so deeply ingrained that she treated every task with the same meticulous care. （读后续写·品格决定高度）

synonyms.example: Leaders should be held accountable for their decisions. 领导者应为自己的决定负责。
synonyms.usage: accountable 较正式，强调'有义务对结果作出解释、承担后果'，句法用 be accountable to sb（向某人负责）/ for sth（对某事负责），常见 hold sb accountable；responsible 更通用，日常与正式皆可

synonyms.example: She is the most dependable friend I have ever had. 她是我交过的最可靠的朋友。
synonyms.usage: dependable 侧重'可依赖、靠得住'（人始终如一、不掉链子），作表语和定语；responsible 表'可靠'义时也可换用，但 responsible 还含'负有职责'之义，语义更宽

synonyms.example: A reliable classmate always keeps his word. 可靠的同学总是信守诺言。
synonyms.usage: reliable 强调'可信赖、结果可预期'，人和物皆可修饰（a reliable car / source）；responsible 主要修饰人，强调'负有责任、尽职'，不用于修饰机器、来源等无生命之物

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·be responsible for 与 be responsible to 辨析（课件重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】be responsible for sth ="对某事负责/是……原因"（for 接名词/动名词）；be responsible to sb ="对某人负责、向某人汇报听命"（to 接人）；be held responsible for ="被追究……的责任"；名词 responsibility 搭配 take/claim/escape/avoid responsibility for
advancedExpressions.example: 【课件】As monitor, you are responsible to the head teacher (对班主任负责) and responsible for the class discipline (为班级纪律负责). 介词 to 与 for 不可混用。

advancedExpressions.expression: be responsible for (doing) sth（对……负责）· be responsible to sb（对某人负责）· take / bear / shoulder responsibility for（承担责任）· a sense of responsibility（责任感）· hold sb responsible for（要某人负责）· act responsibly（负责任地行事）
advancedExpressions.example: As a responsible student, you must take responsibility for your own learning and act responsibly at all times. 作为负责任的学生，你必须对自己的学习负责，并时刻负责任地行事。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·主语 alone are responsible（同位强调+主谓一致）
advancedExpressions.expression: sb alone + be + responsible for ...（'唯有某人对……负责'，alone 作后置定语强调）
advancedExpressions.example: You alone are responsible for realizing your great potential. 唯有你自己要对实现你的巨大潜能负责。（alone 紧跟主语后置，强调'只有你'，谓语仍与 you 一致用 are）

advancedExpressions.expression: for the first time, sb. understood what it meant to be responsible for ...
advancedExpressions.example: For the first time, she understood what it meant to be responsible for another human being — not as a burden to be carried but as a gift that expanded the boundaries of who she was. （从负担到礼物的认知转变）

advancedExpressions.expression: I take full responsibility for ... and I assure you that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I take full responsibility for the oversight in the event scheduling and I assure you that measures have been put in place to prevent a recurrence. （正式道歉/承诺信）

advancedExpressions.expression: with great freedom comes great responsibility
advancedExpressions.example: With great freedom comes great responsibility — a truth so ancient it has become a cliché, yet so profound that each generation must rediscover it anew, often at great cost.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Responsibility had not been a choice for him — it had been thrust upon him by circumstances that would have crushed a weaker spirit. But somewhere along the way, in the endless cycle of caring for his younger sister, working the night shift, and somehow finding time for homework, responsibility had transformed from a chain into a compass. It no longer merely bound him; it directed him. And in that subtle alchemy of the soul, the boy who had been forced to grow up too fast became the man others would one day lean on. （读后续写·链→罗盘隐喻·成长史诗）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 对比递进(had not been a choice / had been thrust) + 意象转化(chain→compass) + alchemy of the soul灵魂炼金术隐喻 + 人物弧光收束(the boy who...became the man...)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If there is one message I wish to leave with you today, it is this: responsibility is not a cage that limits our freedom — it is the foundation upon which all meaningful freedom is built. To be responsible is to be answerable, yes, but it is also to be empowered. For when we take ownership of our choices, we become the authors of our lives rather than characters swept along by a plot we never chose. （应用文·演讲结语/议论文论点）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not...but...转折(cage vs foundation) + yes, but...让步递进 + authors vs characters对比隐喻

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·be held responsible for）
classPractice.question: He is mentally ill and cannot be held responsible ____ his actions.
classPractice.note: 【课件】be held responsible for sth ="被追究……的责任"，介词用 for；照应课件原句。

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·be responsible to sb）
classPractice.question: The Council of Ministers is responsible ____ the Assembly.（对……负责/听命）
classPractice.note: 【课件】be responsible to sb ="对某人负责、向某人汇报听命"，介词用 to；与 be responsible for sth（对某事负责）区分，是高考高频考点。

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·claim responsibility for）
classPractice.question: Nobody has claimed ____ (responsible) for the bombing.
classPractice.note: 【课件】claim responsibility for ="声称对……负责"，空处需名词 responsibility（形容词 responsible 转名词，词干带 b）。

classPractice.question: It was ____ (responsible) of him to leave the young children alone at home.（填反义形容词）
classPractice.note: 【课件】否定前缀 ir-（用于 r 前）+ responsible → irresponsible 不负责任的；It is + adj. + of sb to do 结构。

classPractice.question: Yet you alone are responsible ____ realizing your great potential.
classPractice.note: be responsible for (doing) sth 固定搭配'对……负责'，for 后接动名词 realizing；直接照应课文原句。
