classPractice.question: A true leader is willing to take full ____ (responsible) for the team's mistakes.
classPractice.note: take responsibility for 为固定搭配'承担……的责任'，空处需名词 responsibility（形容词 responsible 转名词，词干带 b）。

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（responsibly / responsible）：We should encourage teenagers to behave ____ both online and offline.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 behave 需副词 responsibly（负责任地）；responsible 是形容词，不能修饰动词。

definitionEn:
(1) adv. in front of someone or something; further forward in space
(2) adv. in or into the future; at a later time (the years ahead)
(3) adv. earlier than planned or expected; in advance
(4) adv. making more progress than someone else; winning or leading in a competition

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①在前面，向前（空间上更靠前）
uncommonMeanings.example: The path ahead twisted into the misty forest. 前方的小路蜿蜒进入雾蒙蒙的森林。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②在将来，今后（时间上，the years ahead 未来的岁月）
uncommonMeanings.example: Great opportunities lie ahead of us. 巨大的机遇就在我们前方。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③提前，先于预定时间（ahead of schedule）
uncommonMeanings.example: The bridge was completed three months ahead of schedule. 大桥提前三个月竣工。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④（比赛、竞争中）领先，占先
uncommonMeanings.example: With two minutes left, our team was still one goal ahead. 还剩两分钟，我们队仍领先一球。

readingExamples: I've been told that schoolwork will present more of a challenge in the years ahead, and that the teachers will hold us to higher standards.

posExamples.sentence: The path ahead twisted into the misty pine forest, and though her legs trembled, she tightened the straps of her backpack and pressed on. （读后续写·徒步冒险·环境+动作）
In the years ahead, our reading club plans to invite well-known writers to campus, so I sincerely encourage you to sign up and seize this precious opportunity. （应用文·招募启事）
Admittedly, countless difficulties lie ahead on the road to carbon neutrality, yet history proves that human wisdom always rises to meet the challenges of its age. （议论文·环保主题）
Those who plan ahead and prepare thoroughly are seldom caught off guard when opportunity knocks at the door. （议论文·规划人生）

wordForms.other: 构词法·合成词：a-（词头，古英语 on 的弱化，表状态/方向）+ head（头）→ ahead'向着头的方向'→'在前、向前'。ahead 是副词，无对应名词/动词形式；表'……之前/领先于'时须接介词 of 构成 ahead of（ahead of schedule / ahead of us / ahead of others）。特殊用法：ahead 可作后置定语修饰名词（the years ahead 未来的岁月、the road ahead 前方的路），置于所修饰名词之后。同类 a- 方向副词：aboard、ashore、aside、apart。

idioms.example: In his letters home, Uncle Ming always wrote that the only honest way to get ahead was to work harder than anyone else and complain less than everyone else. （读后续写·家书励志）

idioms.translation: 超越时代的，有超前思想的
idioms.example: Dismissed as a dreamer in her own day, the scientist was in fact decades ahead of her time, and the world eventually caught up with her vision. （议论文·创新人物论据）
No matter how carefully the little brother hid the chocolate, his sister was always one step ahead of him, giggling behind the curtain with the prize in hand. （读后续写·童趣手足）

idioms.translation: 开始进行；（口语）请便，去做吧
idioms.example: "Go ahead, take the stage," Ms. Lin whispered, giving my shoulder a gentle squeeze that somehow steadied my shaking knees. （读后续写·师生鼓励·对话描写）

collocations.translation: 在未来的岁月里（课文原句词块，ahead 作后置定语）
collocations.example: Schoolwork will present more of a challenge in the years ahead. 在未来的岁月里，学业会带来更多挑战。

collocations.translation: 提前，早于计划/预定时间
collocations.example: The project was finished ahead of schedule. 这个项目提前完成了。
She was far ahead of her classmates in maths. 她数学远远领先于同学。

collocations.translation: 开始进行；（口语）请便，去做吧
collocations.example: "Go ahead, take the stage," Ms. Lin whispered. “去吧，上台，”林老师轻声说。
The only honest way to get ahead is to work harder than anyone else. 出人头地唯一诚实的办法就是比谁都努力。

collocations.translation: 前方的道路，未来的历程（ahead 后置定语）
collocations.example: The road ahead may be paved with setbacks, but every stumble teaches us a lesson. 前方的道路或许布满挫折，但每一次跌倒都给我们上一课。
Those who plan ahead are seldom caught off guard. 未雨绸缪的人很少措手不及。
Whatever challenges lie ahead, unity will carry us through. 无论前方有何挑战，团结都将带我们渡过难关。

synonyms.example: Please register in advance through the school website. 请提前通过学校网站报名。
synonyms.usage: in advance 只表'提前于某时间点'，是中性介词短语，多置于句末；ahead 除'提前'外还能表空间在前、竞争领先，且 ahead of schedule 比 in advance 更具体点明'早于计划'

synonyms.example: The young runner inched forward, step by painful step. 年轻的跑者一步步艰难前挪。
synonyms.usage: forward 强调'朝前的方向或动作本身'（move / step forward）；ahead 强调'所处位置在前方或进度领先'，如 the path ahead（前方的路）不能换成 the path forward

synonyms.example: Had she checked the ingredients beforehand, the disaster could have been avoided. 若她事先检查了配料，这场灾难本可避免。
synonyms.usage: beforehand 是副词，指'在事情发生之前'，多修饰准备类动作，置于句末；不用于空间'在前方'或比赛'领先'之义，与 ahead 分工不同

advancedExpressions.expression: ahead of schedule / time（提前）· ahead of sb（领先于某人）· go ahead（开始；请便）· get ahead（出人头地）· go ahead with sth（着手进行）· press / forge ahead（奋力推进）· lie ahead（在前方等待）· the road ahead（前方之路）
advancedExpressions.example: Though difficulties lie ahead, we will forge ahead and stay one step ahead of the rest. 尽管前方困难重重，我们仍会奋力前行，始终领先他人一步。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·ahead 作后置定语（从课文句长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: 名词 + ahead（'前方的/未来的……'，ahead 后置修饰名词）
advancedExpressions.example: Schoolwork will present more of a challenge in the years ahead. 在未来的岁月里，学业会带来更多挑战。（ahead 置于 the years 之后作后置定语，等于 the years that lie ahead；同理 the road ahead / the challenges ahead）

advancedExpressions.expression: whatever lay ahead, sb. knew (that) ...
advancedExpressions.example: Whatever lay ahead, she knew that the courage kindled on that stormy night would light her way for years to come. （让步状语+隐喻，续写结尾升华定式）

advancedExpressions.expression: with ... ahead of us, let us ...
advancedExpressions.example: With three challenging yet promising years ahead of us, let us set sail together and turn every obstacle into a stepping stone. （介词短语开路+let us 呼吁+暗喻，演讲结尾感染力句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: though obstacles lie ahead, ... will ultimately ...
advancedExpressions.example: Though formidable obstacles lie ahead on the path of technological innovation, the wheels of progress will ultimately roll over them, as they always have. （让步从句+比喻论证，先抑后扬）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There were many difficulties ahead, but he didn't give up.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Though the trail ahead vanished into darkness and his water bottle held barely a mouthful, something stubborn in his chest refused to whisper the word 'quit'. （读后续写·心理+环境）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: though 让步从句 + vanished into darkness 环境渲染 + barely a mouthful 细节量化困境 + something stubborn in his chest 内心具象化，避免直白的 didn't give up

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should prepare for the future ahead.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Only those who take the trouble to prepare today can stand unshaken when the storms of the years ahead finally arrive. （议论文·未雨绸缪）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: only those who...主语从句限定 + today/years ahead 时间对照 + storms 隐喻未来挑战 + stand unshaken 结果具象化

original_sentence: I've been told that schoolwork will present more of a challenge in the years ahead, and that the teachers will hold us to higher standards.

classPractice.question: 有人告诉我，未来的岁月里学业会更具挑战性。I've been told that schoolwork will present more of a challenge in the years ____.
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句，ahead 作后置定语修饰 the years，表'未来的岁月'；置于名词之后是本词的高频难点。

classPractice.question: To everyone's astonishment, the new library was completed three months ahead ____ schedule.
classPractice.note: ahead of schedule 为固定搭配'提前，早于计划'，ahead 表'先于'义须接介词 of。

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（ahead / forward / in advance）：With only two minutes left, our team was still one goal ____ and the fans were on their feet.

classPractice.note: go ahead 口语中表'请便、你去做吧'，用于答应对方请求；与'着手进行'义相通。

translation: adj.（学校）为11或13岁以下儿童设立的；地位（或级别）低的；青少年的 | n. 职位较低者；青少年运动员
definitionEn:
(1) adj. connected with education for young people, usually below the age of 11 or 13 (junior high school, junior school)
(2) adj. having a lower rank or position in an organization or profession
(3) adj. relating to young people below a particular age, especially in sport
(4) n. a person with a lower rank or less experience; a young athlete competing at a lower age level

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （美国高中或大学的）三年级学生
uncommonMeanings.example: As a junior at the state university, Emma was already juggling two research projects, a part-time job and a stubborn dream of medical school. （读后续写·留学生活·奋斗群像）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 比某人年幼者（be sb's junior / be ... years sb's junior 比某人小……岁）
uncommonMeanings.example: Though the new coach was ten years his junior, the veteran player listened to every piece of advice with genuine respect, for wisdom, he believed, wears no age. （读后续写·体育·谦逊品格）

readingExamples: This is all quite new and different from my life at junior high school, but I'm sure I'll rise to all these challenges.

posExamples.sentence: Standing at the gate of my junior high school for the last time, I ran my fingers along the rusty railing, letting three years of laughter and tears flood back all at once. （读后续写·毕业离别·细节动作）
Our school will hold an orientation day for junior students next Friday, during which senior volunteers will show them around the campus and answer their questions. （应用文·通知）
In a healthy workplace, seniors should pass on their experience generously while juniors bring in fresh perspectives; it is this two-way exchange that keeps an organization alive. （议论文·代际合作）
At only fifteen, the tennis junior stunned the audience by defeating the defending champion, proving that age is merely a number on the scoreboard of ambition. （读后续写·体育黑马）

wordForms.other: 反义词 senior（年长的；高年级的；级别高的）——junior/senior 成对记忆。构词提示：junior 源自拉丁 junior（'较年轻的'），与 juvenile（青少年的）同源。搭配定式：be junior/senior to sb 用介词 to 不用 than；名词短语 junior high school（初中）／ senior high school（高中）。美国学制中 junior 特指高中/大学'三年级学生'，senior 指'四年级/毕业班学生'。

collocations.translation: 在初中（阶段）【课文原句词块】

The habits I formed at junior high school — keeping a diary and reading before bed — have quietly shaped the person I am today. （应用文·经验分享）
Volunteers from our class will visit the local junior school every Thursday to read picture books with the children. （应用文·活动介绍）

collocations.translation: 初级职员，资历较浅的员工
collocations.example: A wise manager values the voices of junior staff, for those closest to the ground often see the cracks first. （议论文·管理与倾听）

collocations.translation: 初级合伙人 / 住院医生 / 下级军官
collocations.example: The junior doctor stayed by the old man's bedside through the night, checking his pulse every hour with textbook care and un-textbook tenderness. （读后续写·医者仁心）

collocations.translation: 职位（或级别）低于某人（用 to，不用 than）
collocations.example: Although he was junior to everyone else on the committee, his proposal won unanimous approval. 尽管他在委员会里资历最浅，他的提案却获得一致通过。

collocations.translation: 青少年队 / 青少年锦标赛
collocations.example: Winning the national junior championship did not go to her head; the next morning she was back on the court before sunrise, as always. （读后续写·体育·胜不骄）
My cousin, two years my junior, taught me how to skateboard with the patience of a saint and the mischief of an imp. （读后续写·亲情童趣）

synonyms.translation: 年长的；高年级的；级别高的（junior 的反义词）
synonyms.example: A senior student showed the juniors around the campus on the first day. 一名高年级学生在第一天带低年级新生参观校园。
synonyms.usage: senior 与 junior 一对反义：均可作 adj.（senior/junior high 高中/初中）与 n.（前辈/晚辈）；表'比某人级别高/低'时都接介词 to 不接 than——be senior to sb（级别高于某人）／ be junior to sb（级别低于某人）；表年龄差用 be ... years sb's senior/junior（比某人大/小……岁）

synonyms.example: A true leader never looks down upon his subordinates; instead, he rolls up his sleeves and works beside them. （议论文·领导力）
synonyms.usage: subordinate 强调隶属关系中的'下级'，正式且略带层级色彩；junior 侧重资历浅、级别低或年纪轻，语气更中性温和

synonyms.example: The young volunteers, sleeves rolled up and faces glowing, turned the shabby community garden into a riot of colour within a single weekend. （读后续写·志愿服务）
synonyms.usage: young 仅描述年龄小；junior 在描述年龄时通常隐含'相对更年幼/低年级'的比较意味，如 junior members 指资历浅或年龄小的成员

synonyms.example: Inexperienced as she was, the new teacher won over the naughtiest class in the school with nothing but sincerity and homemade cookies. （读后续写·新手教师）
synonyms.usage: inexperienced 直指经验不足，可能含轻微贬义；junior 描述职位或资历，本身不评价能力高低

advancedExpressions.expression: junior ↔ senior（初中/高中、晚辈/前辈、级别低/高、比某人小/大……岁）
advancedExpressions.example: As a junior, she looked up to the seniors; two years their junior, she never dreamed she would one day be senior to them all. 作为低年级生她仰望学长；比他们小两岁的她从没想过有朝一日会成为他们所有人的上级。（一句串起 junior/senior 全部对应义，凸显 be junior to / senior to 用 to）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... who had once ... at junior high school now ...
advancedExpressions.example: The shy boy who had once hidden in the last row at junior high school now strode to the centre of the stage, microphone steady in his hand. （定语从句浓缩前史+now转折，一句完成人物弧光）

advancedExpressions.expression: on behalf of ..., I would like to extend a warm welcome to our junior schoolmates
advancedExpressions.example: On behalf of the Students' Union, I would like to extend a warm welcome to our junior schoolmates and assure them that a helping hand is never far away. （代表句式+extend a warm welcome 致辞套路，迎新演讲开篇）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as juniors learn from seniors, so ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as juniors learn from seniors on the sports field, so emerging economies can draw lessons from developed ones — not by copying blindly, but by adapting wisely. （just as...so...类比句式+not...but...修正，论证有层次）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Life in senior high school is different from junior high school.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: compared with 对比开路 + resemble a wider river 河流比喻 + 三个形容词递进(swifter, deeper, demanding) + of us all 收尾扩大共鸣

sentenceUpgrade.original: Junior students should respect senior students, and senior students should help junior students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is in the mutual exchange — juniors offering fresh enthusiasm, seniors offering seasoned guidance — that a school community finds its truest harmony. （议论文·校园文化）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: it is...that 强调句 + 破折号内对称结构(juniors offering.../seniors offering...) + truest harmony 抽象名词升华

definitionEn:
(1) adv. towards a place or position that is in front
(2) adv. towards the future; onward in time (from this day forward)
(3) adv. towards a better state; making progress (a big step forward)
(4) adv. to an earlier time or date (bring the meeting forward)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 转发（邮件、信件）；转寄
uncommonMeanings.example: Please forward this email to any classmates who missed yesterday's meeting, so that no one is left out of the preparations. （应用文·通知·邮件场景）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （足球、篮球等的）前锋
uncommonMeanings.example: The young forward weaved past two defenders, and for one breathless second the entire stadium seemed to hold a single heartbeat before the ball kissed the net. （读后续写·赛场高光时刻）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 冒失的，唐突的；过于大胆的
uncommonMeanings.example: "I hope it's not too forward of me to ask," the new student said shyly, "but could I join your study group?" （读后续写·社交对话·礼貌试探）

readingExamples: In fact, I'm looking forward to being more independent and responsible for my own learning.

posExamples.sentence: Gathering every ounce of courage, Amy stepped forward, raised her trembling hand, and volunteered to be the first speaker at the English festival. （读后续写·勇气突破·动作链）
We warmly welcome suggestions from all students, and anyone with creative ideas for the campus art week is encouraged to come forward before this Friday. （应用文·征集启事）
A nation moves forward not on the wheels of luck but on the rails of education, which is precisely why investment in schools deserves top priority. （议论文·教育强国）
From this day forward, I promised myself, no alarm clock would ever be snoozed, and no homework would ever meet a midnight deadline again. （读后续写·自我觉醒·幽默决心）

wordForms.other: 构词法·合成与派生：forward-looking（有远见的，着眼未来的）＝ forward + look + -ing；反义方向词 backward(s)（向后）。副词 forward（美式常用）与 forwards（英式亦可）通用。熟词生义提示：forward 除'向前'外，可作及物动词'转发（邮件/信件）'——forward an email to sb，高考熟词考点。短语动词家族：put forward（提出）、come forward（挺身而出）、bring forward（提前）、carry forward（发扬）、look forward to（期待）。

idioms.translation: 全力以赴；展现最佳状态
idioms.example: Interview day arrived at last, and determined to put her best foot forward, Lucy ironed her shirt twice and rehearsed her self-introduction until it flowed like a song. （读后续写·面试准备·细节刻画）
I am looking forward to your early reply, and I sincerely hope my suggestions will be taken into consideration. （应用文·建议信结尾）
At the class meeting, Wang Fang put forward a proposal that we set up a book-sharing corner, which was greeted with warm applause. （应用文·班会报道）

idioms.translation: 挺身而出；主动站出来（提供帮助或信息）
idioms.example: Just when the old man's cries seemed to dissolve into the indifferent crowd, a girl in a school uniform came forward and knelt beside him without a second's hesitation. （读后续写·见义勇为·对比烘托）
Owing to the approaching typhoon, the sports meeting has been brought forward to this Wednesday; please adjust your schedules accordingly. （应用文·通知）
It falls to our generation to carry forward the spirit of craftsmanship, polishing every detail of our work as the old masters once did. （议论文·工匠精神）
Fast forward ten years, and the boy who once failed every maths test was standing at the front of a classroom, chalk in hand, teaching the subject he had feared most. （读后续写·时间跳跃·命运反转）

collocations.translation: 盼望，期待（做）某事【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: I'm looking forward to being more independent and responsible for my own learning. 事实上，我很期待在学习上更加独立、更能对自己负责。
At the meeting she put forward a bold plan. 会上她提出了一个大胆的计划。

collocations.translation: 从那天起（表时间'今后、往后'）
collocations.example: From that day forward, he never gave up again. 从那天起，他再也没有放弃过。

collocations.translation: 把邮件转发给某人（forward 作动词，熟词生义）
collocations.example: Please forward this email to the new students. 请把这封邮件转发给新生们。

collocations.translation: 一大进步；向前迈出的一步
collocations.example: The new recycling system is a significant step forward in our school's journey towards a greener campus. （应用文·倡议书）

collocations.translation: 前进；（事业、进程）向前发展
collocations.example: However dark the night, time moves forward all the same — and so, the old fisherman said, must we. （读后续写·哲理点题）
The judges leaned forward in their seats, pens frozen mid-air, as the girl's voice rose from a whisper to a soaring note. （读后续写·舞台高光·旁观者反应）
Despite the shortage of funds, the volunteers pressed forward with the library project, believing every donated book was a brick in a child's future. （读后续写/报道·公益坚持）

collocations.translation: 前进的方向；解决问题的出路
collocations.example: Cooperation, rather than confrontation, is the only sensible way forward when tackling global challenges such as climate change. （议论文·国际合作）

collocations.translation: 前瞻性规划 / 超前思维
collocations.example: Thanks to careful forward planning, the charity sale ran like clockwork from the opening speech to the final auction. （应用文·活动总结）
She paced backwards and forwards outside the examination hall, her admission ticket growing damp in her clenched palm. （读后续写·考前焦虑·动作+细节）
Kindly forward the attached schedule to the exchange students so that they can prepare for next week's cultural tour. （应用文·邮件）

synonyms.example: The travellers rested briefly at the mountain hut, then continued their onward journey through the thinning air. （读后续写·登山旅程）
synonyms.usage: onward 更书面化，强调'继续向目的地行进'，常见于 onward journey、from ... onward；forward 使用范围更广，兼含空间、时间、进步义

synonyms.example: She fixed her eyes on the runner ahead, matching him stride for stride until the final bend. （读后续写·赛跑追逐）
synonyms.usage: ahead 侧重'位置在前方'或'进度领先'；forward 侧重'朝前的方向或动作'，如 step forward 强调迈步的动作本身

synonyms.example: Science advances one question at a time, and every 'failed' experiment quietly redraws the boundary of human knowledge. （议论文·科学精神）
synonyms.usage: advance 是动词/名词，指有目标、有组织的推进（军队、科技、事业）；forward 主要作副词表方向，二者词性和搭配不同

advancedExpressions.expression: put forward（提出）/ come forward（挺身而出）/ bring forward（提前）/ carry forward（发扬）/ look forward to（期待）/ from that day forward（从那天起）/ fast forward（快进）
advancedExpressions.example: She came forward to put forward a plan, we carried it forward, and from that day forward the club never looked back. 她挺身而出提出一个方案，我们把它发扬光大，从那天起社团再没回头。（一句串联 come/put/carry forward + from that day forward，集中记忆同词根短语）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. took a deep breath and stepped forward, ...
advancedExpressions.example: He took a deep breath and stepped forward, the apology he had rehearsed a hundred times finally finding its voice. （深呼吸+迈步动作组合表下定决心，独立主格收尾，续写关键转折的万能句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am looking forward to ... and would be grateful if ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am looking forward to your favourable reply and would be grateful if you could inform me of your decision at your earliest convenience. （期待+感激双重礼貌句式，书信标准收尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as ... cannot ... without moving forward, neither can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a bicycle cannot keep its balance without moving forward, neither can a society maintain its vitality without continuous reform. （类比+neither倒装，具象事物论证抽象道理）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He walked forward and helped the old lady.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Without a moment's hesitation, he threaded his way forward through the murmuring crowd, steadied the old lady's arm, and picked up the scattered oranges one by one. （读后续写·助人场景）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: without a moment's hesitation 果断感 + threaded his way 动词升级显画面 + murmuring crowd 环境音衬托 + 三动作连贯(threaded, steadied, picked up) + one by one 细节收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our school has moved forward in many ways.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In the past three years, our school has taken remarkable strides forward — from a smart library to a student-run radio station — each new facility bearing witness to its forward-looking philosophy. （应用文·校园介绍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: take strides forward 替换 move forward + 破折号举例具体化 + 独立主格 bearing witness to 收尾 + forward-looking 同根词呼应

definitionEn:

readingExamples: In fact, I'm looking forward to being more independent and responsible for my own learning.

posExamples.sentence: All winter Grandpa looked forward to the spring fair, marking off the days on the kitchen calendar with a red pencil worn down to a stub. （读后续写·亲情期盼·细节描写）

Psychologists point out that people who have something to look forward to — a trip, a reunion, even a good book — tend to weather daily stress far better than those who do not. （议论文·心理健康）
Having looked forward to this hiking trip for months, the whole class burst into cheers when the bus finally rolled through the misty mountain gate. （读后续写·集体出游·情绪释放）

collocations.phrase: look forward to being more independent

collocations.translation: 期待做某事（to 为介词，接动名词）

collocations.phrase: look forward to hearing from you

collocations.phrase: look forward to your reply / response

synonyms.example: We expect the number of participants to double this year, so an extra hall has been reserved just in case. （应用文·筹备说明）

synonyms.example: The long-anticipated concert did not disappoint: the moment the lights dimmed, a wave of excitement swept through the crowd. （读后续写·万众期待）

advancedExpressions.expression: look forward to / can't wait to do / be eager for / be dying to do / count the days until / be keen to

advancedExpressions.expression: I look forward to ... and remain at your disposal should ...

advancedExpressions.expression: it was ... that sb. had been looking forward to for ...

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: would be greatly appreciated 被动礼貌句式 + the opportunity of doing 名词化表达 + in person 收尾显诚意，双句叠加提升正式度

original_sentence: In fact, I'm looking forward to being more independent and responsible for my own learning.

classPractice.question: I'm looking forward to ____ (be) more independent and responsible for my own learning.
classPractice.note: 课文原句考点：look forward to 的 to 是介词，后接动名词 being，不可用原形 be。

classPractice.question: I can't wait to see you at the ceremony. → I ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ you at the ceremony. （用 look forward）
classPractice.note: can't wait to do 换成 look forward to doing 时，see 须变动名词 seeing，因为 to 是介词；常用现在进行时表强烈期待。

classPractice.question: We ____ (expect / look forward to) meeting our new teacher, and everyone is excited. 我们期待见到新老师，大家都很兴奋。
classPractice.note: expect 只是中性'预计'，不含喜悦；由'everyone is excited'可知需带憧憬色彩，故用 look forward to（后接动名词 meeting）。

translation: 自主的，有主见的；自立的
definitionEn:
(1) adj. confident and free to do things without needing help from other people
(2) adj. not connected with or controlled by something else
(3) adj. having one's own income

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （国家）独立的，自主的
uncommonMeanings.example: The small nation had fought for seventy-three years to become independent, and on the day the treaty was signed, children who had known nothing but war heard the word "peace" spoken aloud for the first time — and did not know whether to laugh or weep. （读后续写·历史时刻·独立）

readingExamples: I'm looking forward to being more independent and responsible for my own learning.

posExamples.sentence: The moment she boarded the train to an unfamiliar city with nothing but a single suitcase and a heart full of equal parts terror and hope, she became — truly, irreversibly — independent, and the world, though no less dangerous, felt infinitely larger and more wondrous than it had the day before. （读后续写·离家独立·成长）
I consider myself an independent thinker — someone who does not simply absorb opinions but examines them, questions them, and, when necessary, respectfully disagrees. （应用文·自我介绍/观点表达）

wordForms.adjective: independent（独立的）／ dependent（依赖的，反义）
wordForms.other: 构词法·前缀 in-（否定）+ dependent（依赖的）= independent（不依赖的→独立的）。词族全家桶：depend v.（依靠）→ dependence n.（依赖）→ dependent adj.（依赖的）→ dependent n.（受抚养者）；加否定前缀 in- 即得 independence n. / independent adj. / independently adv.。介词定式：depend on / be dependent on（依赖）↔ be independent of（独立于）——记住'依赖用 on，独立用 of'。

idioms.example: His happiness, he came to realize, could not be independent of the people he loved — and that, far from being a weakness, was the very thing that made happiness worth pursuing in the first place. （读后续写·人生感悟）

collocations.phrase: be independent and responsible for one's own learning
collocations.translation: 在学习上独立、能对自己负责【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: I'm looking forward to being more independent and responsible for my own learning. 我很期待在学习上更加独立、更能对自己负责。

collocations.translation: 不依赖……，独立于……（介词用 of）
collocations.example: As adults, we should be financially independent of our parents. 成年后，我们在经济上应独立于父母。
The teacher did not want students who merely memorized the textbook; she wanted independent thinkers who could look at a fact and ask, 'But what if the opposite is also true?' （读后续写·教育理念）

By the age of twenty, working two jobs while attending night school, she had become financially independent — not wealthy, not comfortable, but free in a way that no one who had always been provided for could fully appreciate. （读后续写·奋斗人物）

The two researchers, working on opposite sides of the world and entirely independent of each other, arrived at the same conclusion within the same week — a coincidence so improbable that it felt, to both of them, like the universe was insisting on a truth. （读后续写·科学发现·命运感）

synonyms.translation: 依赖的，依靠的（independent 的反义词）
synonyms.example: A child is dependent on its parents, but a teenager longs to be independent of them. 孩子依赖父母，青少年却渴望脱离父母而独立。
synonyms.usage: 反义辨析：dependent on sb/sth（依赖）↔ independent of sb/sth（独立于）；注意介词不同——dependent 接 on，independent 接 of。动词 depend on sb/sth（依靠）与之同族。

synonyms.example: Having been self-reliant since the age of nine — cooking her own meals, waking herself for school, managing a household while her mother worked double shifts — she found group projects a strange and not entirely welcome exercise in trusting others. （读后续写·过早独立）
synonyms.usage: 强调不依赖他人的实际能力，适合读后续写人物刻画

synonyms.example: The school committee voted to make each grade more autonomous in its decision-making, trusting that students, when given real responsibility, would rise to meet it. （应用文·学校改革报道）
synonyms.usage: 更多用于机构、组织自治的formal语境

advancedExpressions.expression: depend on → be dependent on ↔ be independent of → independence / independently
advancedExpressions.example: Whether you succeed depends on effort, not luck; once you stop being dependent on others and become independent of them, true independence begins. 成功与否取决于努力而非运气；一旦你不再依赖他人、独立于他们，真正的独立才开始。（一句串起 depend on / dependent on / independent of / independence，凸显 on 与 of 的介词对立）

advancedExpressions.expression: independence was not something sb. was given; it was something sb. had to take
advancedExpressions.example: Independence was not something she was given — it was something she had to take, wresting it from the grip of circumstance with hands that bled and a spirit that refused to break. （抗争式独立的震撼描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: I firmly believe that ... is essential to becoming an independent and well-rounded individual
advancedExpressions.example: I firmly believe that learning to manage one's own time and finances is essential to becoming an independent and well-rounded individual, and I would urge the school to offer more practical life-skills courses. （建议信）

advancedExpressions.expression: true independence lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: True independence lies not in isolation from others but in the strength to engage with the world on one's own terms — to belong without being owned, to connect without being defined.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Independence had not announced itself with trumpets; it had crept in quietly, in the small things — the first meal she cooked that did not taste of her mother's recipes, the first decision she made without calling home for advice, the first morning she woke up in a city where no one knew her name and felt, not loneliness, but the quiet thrill of being the sole author of the day ahead. （读后续写·独立悄然而至·细节铺陈）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人(independence had not announced) + 排比the first...三连 + sole author of the day隐喻

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The mark of an educated mind, I would argue, is not the ability to recite the thoughts of others but the courage to think independently — to stand at the edge of all that is known and ask, with genuine curiosity and not a little defiance, 'What lies beyond?' For it is in that question, asked by every generation anew, that progress begins. （应用文·演讲·独立思辨）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not...but...对比(defining negative) + stand at the edge空间隐喻 + 修辞问句 + For...因果升华

original_sentence: I'm looking forward to being more independent and responsible for my own learning.

classPractice.question: I'm looking forward to being more ____ (depend) and responsible for my own learning.
classPractice.note: 课文原句考点：be 后接形容词作表语，depend 加否定前缀 in- 与形容词后缀 -ent 变 independent。

classPractice.question: After graduation, she hopes to be financially independent ____ her parents.
classPractice.note: be independent of sb'独立于/不依赖某人'固定用 of；与 be dependent on / depend on 的 on 形成对比。

classPractice.question: 我们应该学会独立思考，而不是一味依赖老师。（用 independently 和 depend on）
classPractice.answer: We should learn to think independently rather than always depending on our teachers. / ... instead of always depending on our teachers.
classPractice.note: 副词 independently 修饰 think；'依赖'用 depend on；rather than / instead of 后接动名词 depending 保持结构一致。

translation: n. 焦点，重点 | vt.&vi. 集中
definitionEn:
(1) n. the thing or person that people are most interested in
(2) n. the act of giving special attention to one particular thing
(3) vt. to give attention, effort, etc. to one particular subject rather than another

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 焦点，重点，中心（人们最关注的人或事）
uncommonMeanings.example: The environment has become the focus of public debate. 环境已成为公众讨论的焦点。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （光、声、镜头等的）焦点；对焦状态
uncommonMeanings.example: As the last rays of sunset hit the old lighthouse mirror, the beam came into perfect focus. （读后续写·环境描写·光影）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （把注意力、精力等）集中于（focus (sth) on）
uncommonMeanings.example: He focused all his attention on the flickering candle flame, letting the noise of the storm outside fade into a distant murmur. （读后续写·专注冥想·内心镇定）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （使）（镜头、眼睛）对焦，调焦
uncommonMeanings.example: She focused the camera on the smiling child before pressing the shutter. 她把镜头对准微笑的孩子，然后按下快门。

readingExamples: Setting goals gives you a focus in life.

posExamples.sentence: The focus of the discussion shifted suddenly when a quiet girl in the back row raised her hand and asked a question so penetrating that the entire room fell silent — and the silence was not the absence of thought but the deepest kind of thinking. （读后续写·课堂瞬间）

He focused all his attention on the flickering candle flame, letting the noise of the storm outside fade into a distant murmur until there was nothing in the universe but the tiny tongue of light and the steady rhythm of his own breath. （读后续写·专注冥想·内心镇定）
In order to produce a truly original piece of research, I learned to focus on the gaps in existing knowledge rather than retreading well-worn ground. （应用文·学习心得/研究反思）

wordForms.adjective: focused（专注的）／ focal（焦点的，如 focal point 焦点）
wordForms.other: 拼写与单复数特例：动词第三人称/过去式可拼 focuses/focused/focusing（单 s）或 focusses/focussed/focussing（双 s），美式多用单 s，考试写单 s 最稳。名词复数有两形：foci /ˈfəʊsaɪ/（拉丁复数，多用于科技）与 focuses（常规复数）。搭配定式：focus on sth（专注于），介词用 on；in focus / out of focus（清晰/模糊）为熟词生义。

idioms.example: It wasn't until years later that the memory of that single afternoon — the way her father had looked at her before he left, the unspoken apology in his eyes — was brought into sharp focus, and she finally understood that some goodbyes are acts of love. （读后续写·回忆清晰·理解）

The photograph was out of focus, a blur of colors and half-remembered shapes, yet somehow it captured the feeling of that summer more truthfully than any sharp image could have — because memory itself, she realized, is always slightly out of focus. （读后续写·摄影与记忆·诗意模糊）

collocations.translation: ……的焦点/重点（在于……）【课件】n. 焦点；重点
collocations.example: The focus of recent research has been on environmental issues. 近来研究的重点一直是环境问题。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 使……成为焦点/清晰地凸显出来【课件】
collocations.example: The incident brought the problem of violence in schools into (sharp) focus. 这一事件使校园暴力问题凸显了出来。（课件原句）
The children's faces are badly out of focus in the photograph. 照片里孩子们的脸严重失焦、模糊不清。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 持续关注……，把重心保持在……上【课件】
collocations.example: We shall keep our focus on the needs of customers. 我们将继续关注顾客的需要。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: （更多地）集中于……（v. 集中在……，介词 on/upon）【课件】
collocations.example: He needs to focus more on/upon his career. 他需要把更多精力放在事业上。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: focus one's eyes / attention on sth
collocations.translation: 把目光/注意力集中于……【课件】
collocations.example: He focused his blue eyes on her. 他把蓝色的眼睛盯向她。/ If you focus your attention on your work, you will finish it on time. 如果你把注意力集中到工作上，你会按时完成它。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 保持对某事的专注【课件】
collocations.example: Keep focused on your goal, and don't let small setbacks distract you. 保持对目标的专注，别让小挫折分散你的注意力。（课件短语 keep focused on sth）

collocations.phrase: give sb a focus in life
collocations.translation: 给某人的生活一个重心/目标【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: Setting goals gives you a focus in life. 设定目标给你的生活一个重心。

collocations.translation: 集中于，专注于（focus 作动词的核心搭配，介词用 on）
collocations.example: You should focus on one goal at a time. 你应该一次专注于一个目标。
The photo is out of focus, so his face looks blurry. 这张照片没对好焦，所以他的脸看起来模糊。

collocations.translation: 关注的焦点，众人瞩目的中心
collocations.example: The new student quickly became the focus of attention in class. 那名新生很快成了班上关注的焦点。

collocations.translation: 专注于……的（作表语，focused 形容词化）
collocations.example: She stayed calm and focused on the task ahead. 她保持冷静，专注于眼前的任务。
The main focus of the charity event was not fundraising — though that was important — but raising awareness about a cause that had been ignored for far too long. （应用文·活动策划/报道）

She focused her mind on the task with an intensity that bordered on obsession — not because she loved the work, but because it was the only thing that drowned out the voice in her head telling her she was not enough. （读后续写·用工作麻痹自我）

The teacher, sensing the tension in the room, shifted the focus to a story from her own adolescence — a clumsy confession of failure that, by its very awkwardness, disarmed the conflict and reminded everyone that they were, after all, human. （读后续写·教师智慧）

synonyms.example: He concentrated on the sound of the rain — each drop a tiny percussion against the windowpane — until the chaos in his mind quieted to a rhythm he could follow. （读后续写·雨声镇静·感官描写）
synonyms.usage: 最常用动词，强调排除干扰、全神贯注

synonyms.example: The entire community's hopes centered on this one harvest — if it failed, there would be no second chance, no safety net, only a long winter and hard choices. （读后续写·丰收悬念）
synonyms.usage: 强调围绕一个核心展开，可用于集体关注场景

advancedExpressions.expression: focus on（专注于）/ the focus of attention（关注焦点）/ in focus ↔ out of focus（清晰↔模糊）/ bring sth into focus（使清晰、成为焦点）/ be focused on（专注于……的）
advancedExpressions.example: When she finally focused on her goal, the blurred future came into focus and she herself became the focus of attention. 当她终于专注于目标，模糊的未来变得清晰，而她自己也成了众人瞩目的焦点。（一句连用 focus on / come into focus / focus of attention，串起动词、熟词生义与名词义）

advancedExpressions.expression: the world narrowed to a single point — ...
advancedExpressions.example: The world narrowed to a single point — the needle in her hand, the thread, the fabric, the breath that she held and released with each stitch — and in that narrowing, the grief that had threatened to consume her became, for a brief and blessed moment, bearable. （专注作为治愈的方式）

advancedExpressions.expression: my primary focus will be on ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the newly appointed head of the organizing committee, my primary focus will be on improving communication between departments — because no great event, I have learned, is built by isolated effort. （就职/工作计划）

advancedExpressions.expression: in an age of distraction, the ability to focus deeply is ...
advancedExpressions.example: In an age of distraction, where every notification demands our attention and every platform competes for our gaze, the ability to focus deeply on a single task is not merely a skill — it is a form of resistance, a quiet rebellion against the forces that would fragment our minds.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The library had emptied hours ago, the last footsteps fading down the marble corridor like the echo of a forgotten promise. But he remained — bent over a single page, his focus so absolute that the janitor, when he came to turn off the lights, paused at the door, reluctant to break a concentration that had taken on the quality of prayer. Some people study to pass exams; he studied as if the answers to questions he had not yet learned to ask were hidden somewhere between the lines. （读后续写·极致专注·神圣化描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 环境反衬(热闹退去→孤独专注) + 明喻(taken on the quality of prayer) + 对比some people...he studied as if...

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should focus on what's important.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In a world that will try to convince you that everything is urgent — every email, every notification, every trending topic — the greatest intellectual discipline you can cultivate is the courage to focus. To focus is to choose, and to choose is to declare, with the full force of your attention, that some things matter more than others. This is not merely a study skill; it is a philosophy of life — and those who master it will, I promise you, achieve not just more, but better. （应用文·演讲·注意力哲学）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 条件铺垫(In a world that...) + 短句递进(To focus is to choose, and to choose is to declare) + 观点拔高(not merely...it is...)

original_sentence: Setting goals gives you a focus in life.

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 如果你把注意力集中到工作上，你会按时完成它的。If you ____ your attention ____ your work, you will finish it on time.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；focus one's attention on sth 把注意力集中于……，介词固定用 on。

classPractice.question: Setting goals gives you a ____ in life, so you know what to work towards.
classPractice.note: 课文原句：a focus in life'生活的重心/目标'，此处 focus 作可数名词，前有冠词 a。

classPractice.question: To do well in the exam, you'd better ____ ____ one subject at a time instead of trying to learn everything at once. 要考好，你最好一次专注于一门学科。
classPractice.note: focus on sth'专注于'，介词固定用 on；近义 concentrate on。

classPractice.question: The old photo is ____ (in focus / out of focus), so the faces are too blurry to recognize. 这张旧照片没对好焦，脸模糊得认不出。
classPractice.note: 熟词生义：out of focus'（图像）模糊/失焦'，in focus 才是'清晰'；由'blurry'可判定为失焦。

definitionEn:
(1) n. a small individual fact or item
(2) n. the small features or facts of something that you only notice when you look carefully

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 琐事，枝节（常用复数details）
uncommonMeanings.example: He was brilliant with grand visions — he could sketch the future on a napkin — but the small details of execution, the logistics and the spreadsheets and the follow-up emails, bored him to the point of paralysis. （读后续写·人物性格弱点）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 详述，详细说明
uncommonMeanings.example: The letter detailed every grievance she had carried for twenty years — not with anger, but with the surgical precision of someone who had replayed each wound so many times that the emotion had been worn smooth, leaving only the cold, hard shape of the facts. （读后续写·迟来的清算·冷静叙事）

readingExamples: To realize your goals, you need to have a good plan, manage your time well and pay attention to details.

posExamples.sentence: It was a small detail — a slight tremor in her voice when she said his name — but to anyone who had known her for more than a season, it was enough to reveal the earthquake happening beneath the calm surface of her words. （读后续写·人物微妙情绪·细节暴露）
My proposal outlines every detail of the event — from the seating arrangement to the contingency plan for rain — so that nothing is left to chance on the day itself. （应用文·活动策划书·严谨）

wordForms.other: 构词与搭配小贴士：detail 既作名词也作及物动词（detail the points 详述要点）；形容词 detailed（详细的），如 a detailed plan。介词短语固定形式：in detail（详细地，用单数）；go into detail 或 go into details（细说，单复数皆可）；表'很多细节'时名词用复数 details。'注意细节'两种说法都对：pay attention to details（课文用复数）与 attention to detail（惯用单数）。

idioms.example: She did not go into details about what had happened that night — not because she wanted to hide anything, but because some experiences resist language the way water resists being held in a fist. （读后续写·不可言说之痛）

He recounted the events in such excruciating detail that the room grew quiet — not with boredom, but with the uncomfortable recognition that they were hearing something that should perhaps have remained unspoken, something too raw and too honest for a Tuesday afternoon. （读后续写·坦诚叙事·震撼）

collocations.translation: 注意细节【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: You need to have a good plan, manage your time well and pay attention to details. 你需要有好的计划、管理好时间，并注意细节。

collocations.translation: 详细地（作状语，detail 用单数不加冠词）
collocations.example: Please explain your plan in detail. 请详细说明你的计划。
There's no time now to go into details. 现在没时间细说了。

collocations.translation: 注重细节（此处 detail 常用单数）
collocations.example: Her attention to detail was legendary — she could spot a misplaced comma from across the room. （读后续写·人物专业特质）

They argued for hours about minor details — the color of the banner, the font size on the program — while the major issue sat in the corner of the room like an elephant that everyone had agreed not to name. （读后续写·本末倒置·讽刺）
Before signing the contract, I would strongly recommend that you check the details — particularly the clauses in fine print, which are often where the most consequential terms are buried. （应用文·建议/提醒）

synonyms.example: The officer asked for the particulars of the incident, and as she spoke — describing the man's coat, the sound of his footsteps, the exact shade of the sky at that hour — she realized that trauma had sharpened her memory into something almost unbearable in its precision. （读后续写·事件回忆·创伤细节）
synonyms.usage: 较formal，常用于法律、报告等正式语境

synonyms.example: The vision was inspiring, the speech was moving — but when someone finally asked for the specifics, the room realized that behind the grand rhetoric there was no plan, only hope. （读后续写·空想与现实）
synonyms.usage: 强调具体而非抽象的内容，适用于计划、方案讨论

advancedExpressions.expression: pay attention to detail(s)（注重细节）/ in detail（详细地）/ go into detail(s)（细说）/ a detailed plan（详细的计划）/ down to the last detail（连最后一个细节都……）
advancedExpressions.example: She explained the plan in detail, going into every step, for she believed a truly detailed plan should account for everything down to the last detail. 她详细讲解了方案，逐步细说，因为她相信真正详尽的计划应把一切细节都考虑到。（一句连用 in detail / go into / detailed / down to the last detail，形成 detail 短语群）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was in the smallest detail that the truth revealed itself
advancedExpressions.example: It was in the smallest detail that the truth revealed itself — not in the forged signature on the document but in the way the ink had bled slightly at the corner of the letter 'g', a bleed that betrayed a hand that had hesitated for just a fraction of a second. （侦探/悬疑式细节描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: for the sake of completeness, I would like to detail the following points
advancedExpressions.example: For the sake of completeness, I would like to detail the following points regarding the revised schedule — points that may seem minor in isolation but, taken together, paint a fuller picture of the challenges we face. （正式报告/说明信）

advancedExpressions.expression: greatness, I would argue, lives not in grand gestures but in the details few people bother to notice
advancedExpressions.example: Greatness, I would argue, lives not in grand gestures but in the details few people bother to notice — the teacher who remembers every student's name, the surgeon who checks the equipment one more time than protocol requires, the writer who labors over a single sentence until it sings.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She had the kind of eye that noticed everything — not in a way that felt invasive but in a way that made people feel seen. She noticed the way her grandmother's hands trembled only when she thought no one was looking; she noticed that her friend's laugh was a half-beat too fast when the topic turned to home; she noticed that the new boy in class always saved the last bite of his lunch, wrapping it in a napkin as if it might need to last. （读后续写·细节观察·人物同理心）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not...but...转折定语 + 排比三she noticed + 细节收束(wrapping in a napkin)将具体与情感相连

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Let me leave you with this thought: the difference between mediocrity and excellence is not talent — it is detail. Talent will get you in the room, but it is the thousand tiny decisions you make after that — the extra draft, the double-check, the care that no one will ever see but everyone will feel — that determines whether you stay. So attend to the details, not because they are small, but because, in the end, they are the only things that are not. （应用文·演讲结语·细节哲学）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not talent — it is detail对比突转 + the thousand tiny decisions数字夸张 + they are the only things that are not悖论式收束

original_sentence: To realize your goals, you need to have a good plan, manage your time well and pay attention to details.

classPractice.question: To realize your goals, you need to have a good plan, manage your time well and ____ ____ ____ ____ (注意细节).
classPractice.note: 课文原句搭配 pay attention to details；attention 后介词固定用 to（此处 to 为介词），details 用复数。

classPractice.question: The teacher explained the grammar point ____ detail so that everyone could understand.
classPractice.note: in detail'详细地'为固定短语，detail 用单数不加冠词；表'详细地'不能用 in details。

classPractice.question: He gave us a very ____ (detail) plan, listing every step and every deadline.
classPractice.note: 此处修饰名词 plan 需用形容词 detailed'详细的'，由 detail 加后缀 -ed 构成。

definitionEn: phr. because of something that has happened
readingExamples: As a result of your action, your dream will come true and hopefully you will live a happy life.

posExamples.sentence: As a result of the storm, the bridge was washed out, the road was impassable, and the village — cut off from the world it had always depended on — was forced to discover resources within itself that it never knew it possessed. （读后续写·自然灾害·因祸得福）

As a result of the student council's tireless efforts, the school has agreed to install water fountains on every floor — a change that may seem small but will, I believe, make our daily lives significantly more convenient. （应用文·成果汇报）

collocations.phrase: as a result of + 名词（= because of）
collocations.translation: 由于……（其后接名词/名词短语，= because of）【课件·result 短语】
collocations.example: As a result of your action, your dream will come true and hopefully you will live a happy life. 由于你的行动，你的梦想会实现，希望你也会过上幸福的生活。/ He lost his job as a result of one big mistake. 他因一个大错误而丢了工作。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 结果是，因此……（连接副词，后接完整句子）【课件·result 短语】
collocations.example: He made one big mistake, and as a result he lost his job. 他犯了一个大错误，因此失去了工作。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 导致，造成（某种结果）【课件·result 短语】
collocations.example: His carelessness resulted in his failure. 他的粗心导致了他的失败。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 由……造成，起因于【课件·result 短语】
collocations.example: Sickness often results from lack of sleep. 生病通常是由缺乏睡眠引起的。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: as a result of your action
collocations.translation: 由于你的行动【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: As a result of your action, your dream will come true and hopefully you will live a happy life. 由于你的行动，你的梦想会实现，希望你也会过上幸福的生活。
As a direct result of her intervention, the two warring factions agreed to sit at the same table. （读后续写·调解成功·艰难和解）

collocations.translation: 因此，结果……（句中独立使用，后不接名词而接句子）
collocations.example: She had never been taught to ask for help. As a result, she carried burdens that were never hers to carry alone. （读后续写·逞强积累·崩溃）
The accident resulted in a profound change in the way the school approached safety. （读后续写·教训与反思）
Her remarkable resilience resulted not from natural temperament but from years of being tested. （读后续写·人物背景揭示）

synonyms.translation: 由于，因为（后接名词/名词短语）
synonyms.example: The flight was delayed due to heavy fog. 由于浓雾，航班延误了。
synonyms.usage: 较formal，后接名词/名词短语；传统语法主张 due to 用于 be 动词之后作表语（The delay was due to fog），现代英语中句首用法也日益普遍。与 as a result of 可互换。

synonyms.example: Owing to the storm, the sports meeting was put off. 由于暴风雨，运动会被推迟了。
synonyms.usage: 正式，多用于句首，后接名词；与 due to 意义相近但传统上更常单独作状语，句首用 owing to 比 due to 更受语法保守派认可。

synonyms.translation: 因为，由于（后接名词/动名词，最常用）
synonyms.example: We stayed indoors because of the rain. 因为下雨，我们待在室内。
synonyms.usage: 最口语、最常用；后接名词、代词或动名词。与 as a result of 相比语气更中性直接，正式度略低。注意 because 后接句子，because of 后接名词短语，不可混用。

synonyms.translation: 多亏，由于（多用于积极结果，也可反讽）
synonyms.example: Thanks to everyone's efforts, the show was a great success. 多亏大家的努力，演出大获成功。
synonyms.usage: 后接名词；通常引出'好'的原因，含感激色彩；也可反讽表'都怪……'。与其他表原因短语的中性/负面语气形成对照。

synonyms.example: The match was postponed on account of rain. 比赛因雨延期。
synonyms.usage: 较正式偏书面，后接名词，也可用于非正式书信；与 owing to / due to 语气相近。

advancedExpressions.expression: As a result, ...（结果是/因此，后接句子）· result in sth（导致）· result from sth（由……造成）· as a result of sth = because of sth（由于，后接名词）
advancedExpressions.example: His carelessness resulted in his failure, and as a result he lost his job — but the failure itself resulted from years of overconfidence. 他的粗心导致了失败，因此丢了工作——而失败本身则源于多年的自负。（一句串起 result in / as a result / result from，辨析：result in 后接'结果'，result from 后接'原因'；as a result 后接句子，as a result of 后接名词）

advancedExpressions.expression: as a result of / due to / owing to / because of / thanks to / on account of / as a consequence of + 名词（均'由于……'，后接名词或动名词，不接句子）
advancedExpressions.example: As a result of / Owing to / Due to / Because of / On account of the heavy rain, the outdoor concert was called off. 由于大雨，露天音乐会被取消了。（同一句替换六种'表原因'短语，全部后接名词短语 the heavy rain）

advancedExpressions.type: 辨析对·as a result of ↔ as a result
advancedExpressions.expression: as a result of + 名词（作介词短语，'由于……'）↔ as a result（作连接副词，'因此'，其后接完整句子，前常有句号或分号）
advancedExpressions.example: As a result of the storm, the road was blocked; as a result, we had to turn back. 由于暴风雨，道路被堵；因此我们只好折返。（前者 of 后接名词 the storm，后者 as a result 后直接接句子——高考高频易混点）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·因果关系推进
advancedExpressions.expression: as a result of ..., ... found / discovered / realized ...
advancedExpressions.example: As a result of his months in solitude — months that had begun as punishment and slowly transformed into something closer to a gift — he discovered that the voice he had been so desperate to hear from others was, and had always been, inside himself. （因果关系→内在成长）

advancedExpressions.expression: as a result of the above-mentioned factors, ...
advancedExpressions.example: As a result of the above-mentioned factors — increased enrollment, outdated facilities, and a shortage of qualified staff — I would respectfully urge the board to reconsider the timeline for the proposed renovations. （正式建议/报告）

advancedExpressions.expression: as a natural result of ..., ... inevitably ...
advancedExpressions.example: As a natural result of decades of prioritizing test scores over genuine curiosity, students have inevitably learned to ask not 'What is true?' but 'What will be on the exam?' — and that, perhaps, is the most damning indictment of our education system.

sentenceUpgrade.original: As a result of the accident, he changed.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As a result of the accident — that single, irreversible instant when metal met metal and the world as he knew it came apart — he did not merely change; he was remade. The careless boy who had treated life as an infinite resource was gone, and in his place stood someone who understood, with the terrible clarity that only comes through loss, that every ordinary Tuesday is a gift you did nothing to earn and can do nothing to keep. （读后续写·事故后的蜕变·生与死的领悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 插入补充(that single, irreversible instant) + 破折号强调 + not merely change; was remade递进 + boy vs someone人物对比 + every ordinary Tuesday is a gift哲理句

sentenceUpgrade.original: As a result of hard work, we succeeded.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As a result of countless hours of work that no one saw — the early mornings and late nights, the drafts that were discarded, the ideas that failed so spectacularly that they deserved their own memorial — we did not merely succeed; we became, in the process, the kind of people who could succeed, and that, I would argue, was the real victory, the one that no trophy could capture and no ceremony could honor. （应用文·获奖感言/反思）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 插入补充(that no one saw) + 排比the...三层 + did not merely succeed; we became层递 + the real victory收束对比(trophy vs character)

original_sentence: As a result of your action, your dream will come true and hopefully you will live a happy life.

classPractice.type: 语境应用·用 result 短语填空（课件）
classPractice.question: 1) 他的粗心导致了他的失败。His carelessness ____ his failure.  2) 他犯了一个大错误，因此失去了工作。He made one big mistake, and ____ ____ ____ he lost his job.  3) 生病通常是由缺乏睡眠引起的。Sickness often ____ lack of sleep.
classPractice.answer: 1) resulted in  2) as a result  3) results from
classPractice.note: 课件语境应用原题。result in 后接'结果'(failure)；as a result 后接句子表'因此'；result from 后接'原因'(lack of sleep)。三者切勿混：in→结果、from→原因、as a result→句子。

classPractice.question: As a result ____ your action, your dream will come true and you will live a happy life.
classPractice.note: 课文原句：as a result of + 名词'由于……'，介词固定 of；不可漏 of 变成 as a result（那样后面须接句子）。

classPractice.question: It rained heavily all day. ____ ____ ____ (As a result / As a result of), the football match was cancelled. 大雨下了一整天。因此比赛被取消了。
classPractice.note: 此处后接完整句子且句意为'因此'，用连接副词 As a result；若要用 as a result of 则须改为 As a result of the heavy rain, ...（后接名词）。

classPractice.question: The train was late because of the snow. → The train was late ____ ____ ____ ____ the snow. （用 as ... of 结构）
classPractice.note: because of 与 as a result of 均后接名词短语 the snow，表原因可互换；注意结构完整为 as a result of，不能只写 as a result。

translation: 指点，实用的提示；尖端；小费
definitionEn:
(1) n. a small but useful piece of practical advice
(2) n. the thin pointed end of something
(3) n. a small amount of extra money that you give to somebody who has provided a service

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（物体的）尖端，末端（the tip of one's finger 指尖；the tip of the tongue 舌尖）
uncommonMeanings.example: She stood on the tips of her toes to reach the top shelf. 她踮起脚尖去够最上层的架子。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②小费（给服务人员的额外报酬，leave/give a tip）
uncommonMeanings.example: He left a generous tip for the waiter. 他给服务员留了一大笔小费。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③给（服务人员）小费
uncommonMeanings.example: In some countries you are expected to tip the taxi driver. 在有些国家人们通常要给出租车司机小费。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 垃圾倾倒场（英式英语）
uncommonMeanings.example: The vacant lot had become an unofficial tip — a graveyard of broken furniture and abandoned appliances — but to the children who played there after school, it was a kingdom of rusting treasures and endless possibility. （读后续写·贫民区童年·废土中的诗意）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使倾斜；倾倒
uncommonMeanings.example: He tipped his chair back until it balanced on two legs — the precarious equilibrium of a boy who had never quite learned to sit still, who seemed always on the verge of either falling or flying. （读后续写·人物性格·不安分）

readingExamples: The tips below may help you.

posExamples.sentence: She offered me a tip that her grandmother had given her — 'When you don't know what to do, do the next right thing' — and in the years that followed, through crises large and small, those seven words proved to be a lantern in more darknesses than she would ever know. （读后续写·智慧传承·一句话的力量）

The tip of the iceberg was all anyone could see — a small disagreement about the event schedule — but beneath the surface, invisible and immense, were years of accumulated resentment that would take far more than a revised calendar to address. （读后续写·冰山隐喻·深层矛盾/应用文·分析报告）

He left a tip that was far too generous for the modest meal he had eaten — but the waitress had smiled at him on a day when he had forgotten how to smile at himself, and some kindnesses, he believed, could not be measured in percentages. （读后续写·陌生人的善意·小费中的温情）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：tip 一词多义（提示/窍门、尖端、小费、使倾斜），语境定义。tipping point（临界点，引爆点）。作"给小费"义时可作动词：tip the waiter；作"提示"义常用复数 tips（课文：The tips below may help you）。

idioms.idiom: on the tip of one's tongue
idioms.translation: 话到嘴边（一时想不起来）
idioms.example: The name was on the tip of her tongue — she could feel its shape, its rhythm, the way it had once fit so naturally into conversation — but the harder she reached for it, the further it receded, like a face dissolving in a dream upon waking. （读后续写·记忆的捉弄·细腻心理）

The budget discrepancy was, as the accountant put it, merely the tip of the iceberg — and when they finally looked beneath the surface, the full scale of the mismanagement was enough to make the boardroom fall into a silence that was deeper and more damning than any accusation could have been. （读后续写/应用文·调查揭露·真相）

collocations.translation: 下面的这些提示/窍门（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The tips below may help you. 下面这些提示或许能帮到你。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: give sb. a tip / a useful tip
collocations.translation: 给某人一个（有用的）建议、窍门
collocations.example: My teacher gave me a useful tip on note-taking. 老师给了我一个记笔记的实用窍门。

collocations.translation: 关于（做）某事的提示、技巧
collocations.example: Here are some tips on learning English well. 这里有几条学好英语的建议。

collocations.translation: 冰山一角（表象下另有大问题）
collocations.example: This complaint is just the tip of the iceberg. 这次投诉只是冰山一角。

The handbook was full of practical tips on public speaking — but the most useful one, she discovered, was scribbled by hand in the margin in faded blue ink: 'Remember that the audience wants you to succeed. They are not your judges; they are your guests.' （读后续写·书中发现旧笔记·智慧传承）

Before the interview, her mentor gave her a tip so simple it seemed almost absurd: 'Listen more than you speak, and when you do speak, make it count.' She followed it, and the job was hers. （应用文·经验分享·简洁有力）

collocations.translation: 暗中通知某人，向某人通风报信
collocations.example: Someone had tipped her off about the surprise party — but she played along beautifully, gasping at exactly the right moment, her performance so convincing that even the organizers felt a flutter of pride. （读后续写·善意配合·温馨）

collocations.translation: 关于（做）某事的建议/技巧
collocations.example: The senior students compiled a booklet of tips on surviving the first year of high school — advice ranging from which cafeteria line moved fastest to how to ask for help without feeling small. （应用文·经验分享/读后续写·传承）

collocations.translation: 给某人/针对某事的建议
collocations.example: Before the expedition, the guide handed each of them a card with three tips for the journey: 'Stay together. Trust your instincts. And when the mountain seems too big, look down at your feet — because the only step that matters is the next one.' （读后续写·启程·哲理建议）

synonyms.example: She dropped hints about her birthday for two weeks — casual remarks, strategic sighs, the careful placement of a catalog open to the very page — but the hints landed on deaf ears, and when the day arrived with no fanfare, her disappointment was a quiet, private thing that she folded and tucked away like a letter never sent. （读后续写·期待落空·细腻失望）
synonyms.usage: hint 指间接、微妙的"暗示"，让对方自己领会（drop a hint 给暗示；a hint of 一丝）；tip 是直接给出的"实用建议、窍门"。二者别混：a useful tip 实用窍门 ≠ a subtle hint 微妙暗示。

synonyms.example: The coach pulled her aside after practice and gave her a few pointers — small adjustments to her form, barely perceptible to an observer — but in the next match, those tiny changes unlocked a power she had not known her body possessed. （读后续写·体育竞技·指点改变）
synonyms.usage: pointer 较口语，多指教练/前辈就技巧给的具体小建议（give sb. a few pointers）；与 tip 近义，但 tip 使用范围更广，也可指小费、尖端等义。

advancedExpressions.expression: give sb. a tip / tips on doing sth. / tip sb. off / the tip of the iceberg / on the tip of one's tongue / tipping point
advancedExpressions.example: The senior gave us tips on managing time, tipped us off about the tricky teachers, and reminded us that a bad first month is just the tip of the iceberg — the real growth comes later. 学长给我们时间管理的窍门，偷偷透露哪些老师难对付，还提醒我们头一个月不顺只是冰山一角——真正的成长在后头。

advancedExpressions.expression: tip = 提示/窍门 (n.) → 尖端 (n.) → 小费 (n./v.) → 使倾斜 (v.)
advancedExpressions.example: 同一个 tip，靠语境区分：study tips 学习窍门；the tip of a pen 笔尖；a big tip 一大笔小费；tip the boat 使船倾斜。

advancedExpressions.expression: the best tip sb. ever received was ...
advancedExpressions.example: The best tip she ever received came from a stranger on a bus — an old woman who, noticing the tears she was trying to hide, leaned over and whispered, 'Darling, whatever it is, it will look different in the morning.' And it did. Not better, not solved — but different, and that difference, however small, was a crack through which light could enter. （陌生人智慧→黎明再看待→光之裂缝）

advancedExpressions.expression: if I could offer just one tip to ..., it would be this: ...
advancedExpressions.example: If I could offer just one tip to students about to begin their high school journey, it would be this: learn to say no. Not to opportunities — but to the pressure to do everything, be everything, please everyone. The path to excellence is paved not with additions but with the courage to subtract. （演讲/建议信·减法哲学）

advancedExpressions.expression: at the tipping point where ... becomes / transforms into ...
advancedExpressions.example: We stand, I believe, at a tipping point where convenience threatens to become dependence, where the tools designed to connect us are quietly severing the connections that matter most.

sentenceUpgrade.original: She gave me a useful tip.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She gave me a tip that, at the time, seemed too small to matter — a casual observation thrown over her shoulder as she walked out the door: 'People will forget what you said and what you did, but they will never forget how you made them feel.' I was sixteen, too young to understand that some advice is not meant to be understood immediately but to lie dormant in the soil of experience, waiting for the rain of circumstance to make it bloom. Years later, standing at the podium to deliver a eulogy I was not ready to give, I finally understood — and the tip that had lain silent for a decade became, in that moment, the only thing holding me upright. （读后续写·迟来的理解·智慧生根发芽）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 引述名人名言风格 + 种子隐喻(lie dormant in the soil of experience) + 时间跨度(16岁→多年后) + 结尾呼应(too small to matter → the only thing holding me upright)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Here are some tips for studying.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I will not insult your intelligence with the usual tips — 'find a quiet place,' 'take regular breaks,' 'review your notes' — tips so generic they apply equally to studying for an exam and training a goldfish. Instead, let me offer one piece of advice that has served me better than all the conventional wisdom combined: study as if you will one day have to teach what you are learning. Because when you learn to teach, you stop memorizing and start understanding; you stop collecting facts and start building frameworks; and, most importantly, you stop being a passive consumer of knowledge and become an active participant in the conversation that is education. （应用文·演讲·颠覆常规建议）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 否定先行(insult your intelligence with the usual tips) + 排比递进(you stop...and start...三次) + 教育=对话隐喻(conversation that is education)

original_sentence: The tips below may help you.

classPractice.question: 下面这些提示或许能帮到你。The ____ below ____ help you.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；作"提示、窍门"义常用复数 tips；may 表"或许、可能"。

classPractice.question: Could you give me a few ____ (tip) on how to improve my spoken English?
classPractice.note: tips on (doing) sth. 关于（做）某事的建议；此处用复数。

classPractice.question: This small complaint is just the ____ (tip / hint) of the iceberg; the real problems run much deeper.
classPractice.note: 固定短语 the tip of the iceberg 冰山一角；hint 指"暗示"，不能用于该短语。

translation: vt. 以…为基础（依据）| n. 根据；基底；总部，大本营
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to use an idea, a fact, a situation, etc. as the point from which something can be developed
(2) n. the lowest part of something
(3) n. a place where people in the armed forces live and work
(4) n. the people, activities, etc. from which somebody/something gets most of their support and income

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①以……为基础，把……建立在……上（base sth. on/upon sth.；常用被动 be based on）
uncommonMeanings.example: The report is based on data collected over ten years. 这份报告基于十年间收集的数据。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②底部，底座；根基（the base of the mountain 山脚）
uncommonMeanings.example: A vase stood on a marble base. 花瓶立在一个大理石底座上。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （军事）基地
uncommonMeanings.example: The old military base had been abandoned for forty years, its barracks overgrown with wild roses and its parade ground colonized by a family of deer who seemed, in their quiet dignity, to be conducting drills of their own. （读后续写·废弃基地·自然回收·诗意对比）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （支持、收入等的）来源，基础
uncommonMeanings.example: His grandmother's kitchen had always been the family's base — the one room where everyone eventually gravitated, drawn by the smell of something baking and the promise of a listening ear. （读后续写·家庭核心·温暖）

readingExamples: Instead, you should set goals based on your abilities and skills.

posExamples.sentence: She based her entire strategy on a single assumption — that people, when given the chance, would rather be kind than cruel — and though her peers called her naive, the results proved that optimism, when backed by careful planning, is not naivety but the most radical form of courage. （读后续写·信念胜利·乐观主义）

The base of the mountain was shrouded in mist when they began their ascent, and they climbed through clouds for two hours before breaking through into a world of crystal-clear air and a sky so blue it hurt to look at — as if they had climbed not through weather but into a different season entirely. （读后续写·登山·环境描写）

Our club has established a solid base of volunteers over the past three years — people who return not because they have to but because they have found, in service, something they did not even know they were looking for. （应用文·社团报告/总结）

wordForms.noun: basis（基本原则，基础，复数 bases /ˈbeɪsiːz/）
wordForms.adjective: basic（基本的，基础的） / based（以……为基础的）
wordForms.other: 小贴士：词族 base(n./v.) → basis(n. 基础/根据) → basic(adj.) → basically(adv.) → basement(地下室)。注意 base 的复数 bases /ˈbeɪsɪz/ 与 basis 的复数 bases /ˈbeɪsiːz/ 拼写相同、读音不同。固定短语 be based on 与 on the basis of 都表"根据"，前者用 base，后者用 basis，勿混。

idioms.example: His assumptions about her motives were so completely off base that when she finally told him the truth — that she had been helping him all along, not undermining him — the shock rearranged his entire understanding of their relationship. （读后续写·误解澄清·转折）
idioms.usage: 源自棒球，常用于判断、猜测错误的场景

idioms.example: Before making any major decision, she made a point of touching base with her mentor — not because she needed permission, but because wisdom, she had learned, was not a solitary pursuit. （读后续写·谦逊品格/应用文·工作习惯）

collocations.translation: 以……为基础（依据），把……建立在……上【课件】vt.
collocations.example: I based my theory on/upon scientific experiments. 我的理论基于科学实验。/ What are you basing this theory on? 你这套理论是以什么为依据的？（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 以……为基础/根据（常用被动）【课件】
collocations.example: The film is based on a short story by Jane Austin. 这部电影根据简·奥斯汀的一篇短篇小说改编。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 一项基于计算机的工作（-based 构词：以……为基础的）【课件】
collocations.example: He is looking for a computer-based job. 他在找一份以电脑为主的工作。（课件原句词块）

collocations.translation: 用作……的基础/依据/大本营【课件】n. 基地
collocations.example: She used her family's history as a base for her novel. 她以家族历史作为小说的素材基础。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: have a broad base of support
collocations.translation: 得到广泛的支持（base n. 基础）【课件】
collocations.example: These policies have a broad base of support. 这些政策得到广泛支持。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 把总部/大本营设在……（base n. 基地，根据地，总部）【课件】
collocations.example: The company has its base in New York. 这家公司总部设在纽约。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 根据……，在……的基础上（basis n. 根据/理由）【课件】
collocations.example: She was chosen for the job on the basis of her qualifications. 她凭资历获得了这份工作。（课件原句）
We'll hold the meeting on a regular basis. 我们将定期召开会议。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 最基本的设施／基本技能（basic adj. 基础的）【课件】
collocations.example: The campsite provided only basic facilities. 野营地只提供最基本的设施。/ the basic skills of reading and writing 基本的阅读和写作技能。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: goals based on your abilities and skills
collocations.translation: 基于你的能力和技能所定的目标（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Instead, you should set goals based on your abilities and skills. 相反，你应该根据自己的能力和技能来设定目标。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 以……为基础/根据（过去分词短语作定语/状语）
collocations.example: The film is based on a true story. 这部电影根据真实故事改编。

collocations.translation: 把某事建立在……的基础上
collocations.example: You should base your decision on facts, not feelings. 你应该根据事实而非情绪来做决定。
Students are chosen on the basis of their grades. 学生是根据成绩来选拔的。
The soldiers returned to the military base at dusk. 士兵们在黄昏时分返回军事基地。
The novel was based on a true story — the kind of story that, had it not actually happened, would have been dismissed as too improbable for fiction. （读后续写·真实故事改编·元叙事）

collocations.translation: 将某事建立在某物的基础上
collocations.example: She had based her entire identity on being the best student in her year — and when a newcomer arrived who surpassed her with infuriating effortlessness, the foundation of her self-worth cracked in ways she was not prepared to examine. （读后续写·身份危机·成长痛）

The small café had become an unofficial base for the city's young writers — a place where espresso and ambition flowed in equal measure and where the air itself seemed charged with the electricity of half-formed ideas waiting to be captured. （读后续写·创作圣地·氛围描写）

The old man visited his wife's grave on a regular basis — every Sunday at four, rain or shine, carrying a single white rose, as if the forty-seven years of marriage had never ended but had merely changed form. （读后续写·坚守与思念）
The scholarship was awarded not on the basis of grades alone but on the basis of character — a quality far harder to measure and, the committee believed, far more important to cultivate. （应用文·评选/推荐）

synonyms.example: Trust is the foundation of any meaningful relationship. 信任是任何有意义关系的基础。
synonyms.usage: 更抽象、更书面，强调"建立于其上的根基"，常搭配 lay the foundation of/for；base 更中性，可指具体底座或"依据"。

synonyms.example: On the basis of these facts, we drew our conclusion. 根据这些事实，我们得出了结论。
synonyms.usage: 常用于 on the basis of / on a ... basis 结构，指"依据/原则"，不指具体底座；base 既可指具体底部也可作动词。

synonyms.translation: 理由，根据（常用复数 grounds）
synonyms.example: She had no grounds for suspicion — nothing she could point to or articulate — just a feeling that settled in her stomach like a stone dropped into still water, sending ripples she could not ignore. （读后续写·直觉·不安预感）
synonyms.usage: 常用于法律、论证场景(on the grounds that...)，指立论的"理由"；base 更强调结构性的"基础"或动词"以…为据"。

advancedExpressions.expression: 名词 + -based → 形容词'以……为基础的'：computer-based（基于计算机的）/ home-based（在家办公的）/ evidence-based（基于证据的）/ community-based（以社区为依托的）
advancedExpressions.example: 课件 a computer-based job；仿写：an evidence-based decision 基于证据的决定；a home-based job 在家做的工作。构词逻辑：base sth on sth → sth-based（该物是基础/依托）。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·basis（base 的名词兄弟）
advancedExpressions.expression: on the basis of sth（根据……）· on a regular / daily / weekly basis（定期/每天/每周地）· basic adj. 基础的 · basically adv. 主要地、基本上 · basic facilities / basic skills
advancedExpressions.example: On the basis of her qualifications she was hired, and now she trains new staff on a regular basis, teaching them the basic skills the job requires. 她凭资历被录用，如今定期培训新员工，教他们这份工作所需的基本技能。（串起 on the basis of / on a regular basis / basic skills；辨析：be based on 用 base，on the basis of 用 basis，勿混）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·过去分词短语作定语（based on）
advancedExpressions.expression: goals / a plan / a decision + based on sth.（= which is based on sth.）
advancedExpressions.example: 从课文 set goals based on your abilities and skills 长出：based on... 相当于定语从句 which are based on...，过去分词表被动，紧跟被修饰名词。仿写：a conclusion based on solid evidence 基于确凿证据的结论。

advancedExpressions.expression: be based on / base sth. on sth. / on the basis of / on a regular basis / the basic idea / basically
advancedExpressions.example: Basically, the whole plan is based on one basic assumption, and on the basis of that assumption we adjust it on a regular basis. 基本上，整个计划都建立在一个基本假设之上，我们在此基础上定期调整。

advancedExpressions.expression: ... became the base upon which sb. built / rebuilt ...
advancedExpressions.example: That single act of kindness — a bowl of soup offered to a stranger on a winter night — became the base upon which he rebuilt his faith in humanity, brick by fragile brick, until the structure of his hope was strong enough to bear the weight of living. （一小善→人生重建）

advancedExpressions.expression: based on the evidence / data / analysis presented above, I would argue that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Based on the survey results and the feedback gathered from over two hundred students, I would argue that the current homework load is not merely excessive — it is counterproductive, breeding resentment where it should be fostering curiosity. （正式建议信）

advancedExpressions.expression: if ... is the base, then ... is the structure that rises from it
advancedExpressions.example: If knowledge is the base, then character is the structure that rises from it — and a magnificent foundation without walls or a roof is not a building; it is a ruin waiting to happen.

sentenceUpgrade.original: His opinion is based on facts.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: His opinion was not built on the shifting sands of emotion or the borrowed bricks of other people's convictions. It was based on facts — facts he had gathered himself, facts he had tested against the whetstone of doubt, facts that had survived every attempt he made to disprove them. And so when he spoke, the room listened — not because he was loud but because his words had weight, the kind of weight that only truth, patiently earned, can possess. （读后续写·可靠人物·事实的尊严）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 否定递进(not built on shifting sands...borrowed bricks) + 三排比facts he had... + 对比收束(not because loud but because weight)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should base our work on research.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If I may offer one piece of advice to those who wish to produce work of lasting value: base your work on research so thorough that it becomes invisible — like the foundation of a cathedral, no visitor admires the stones beneath the ground, and yet without them, the spires that pierce the sky would be nothing more than a fantasy. Let your research be that foundation: unseen, unthanked, and absolutely indispensable. （应用文·演讲/建议·地基隐喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(like the foundation of a cathedral) + 转折/对比(spires vs stones) + 三短定(unseen, unthanked, absolutely indispensable)层层收束

original_sentence: Instead, you should set goals based on your abilities and skills.

classPractice.type: 语境应用·单句语法填空（课件）
classPractice.question: 1) 我的理论基于科学实验。I based my theory ____ scientific experiments.  2) 这部电影根据简·奥斯汀的一篇短篇小说改编。The film ____ ____ ____ a short story by Jane Austin.  3) 她凭资历获得了这份工作。She was chosen for the job on the ____ ____ her qualifications.
classPractice.answer: 1) on/upon  2) is based on  3) basis of
classPractice.note: 课件原句。base sth on/upon sth（vt.）；be based on（被动，主语是物）；on the basis of（用名词 basis，不用 base）。

classPractice.question: Instead, you should set goals ____ (base) on your abilities and skills.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；base sth. on sth. 的过去分词形式作后置定语，表被动（=which are based on）。

classPractice.question: 这部电影根据一个真实故事改编。The film ____ ____ ____ a true story.
classPractice.note: be based on 以……为基础/根据；主语是物用被动。

classPractice.question: We chose the winner on the ____ (base / basis) of both talent and effort.
classPractice.note: 固定短语 on the basis of 根据……，用名词 basis，不用 base。

definitionEn:
(1) vt. to help somebody remember something, especially something important that they must do
(2) vt. to make somebody think of somebody/something because they are similar

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①提醒（某人别忘记要做的事）：remind sb. to do sth. / remind sb. that ...
uncommonMeanings.example: Remind me to charge my phone tonight. 提醒我今晚给手机充电。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②使想起，使联想到（因相似）：remind sb. of sth./sb.
uncommonMeanings.example: You remind me of your mother when you smile. 你笑起来的样子让我想起你母亲。

readingExamples: This will remind you of what you are working for and keep you focused.

posExamples.sentence: The photograph, yellowed and creased at the corners, reminded her of a summer so distant it felt like a dream she had once overheard — and yet the ache it produced was as fresh as if the goodbye had been spoken only yesterday. （读后续写·旧照片唤起回忆·物是人非）
I am writing to remind all club members that the weekly meeting has been rescheduled to Thursday at 4 p.m. due to a scheduling conflict with the auditorium. （应用文·通知/提醒邮件）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：re-(再、又) + mind(思想) → 使思想再回到→提醒/使想起。区分 remind（"使别人想起"，及物，须带宾语）与 remember（"自己记得"，可及物可不及物）。remind sb. of sth.=使想起；remind sb. to do=提醒去做；两者别混。名词 reminder：a reminder that... 提醒……的东西。

idioms.translation: 那倒提醒了我（对话中自然切换话题）
idioms.example: "That reminds me," she said, reaching into her bag with the air of someone retrieving a secret, "I found this in the attic — and I think it belongs to you, or rather, to someone you used to be." （读后续写·关键物品揭示·对话推进情节）

collocations.translation: 使某人想起某事（因相似而联想）【课件】
collocations.example: The photos reminded me of the excitement at the party. 这些照片让我想起了聚会上的兴奋。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 提醒某人去做某事【课件】
collocations.example: My mother often reminds me to keep a positive attitude towards life. 妈妈经常提醒我要对生活保持积极乐观的态度。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 提醒某人……（that 从句）【课件】
collocations.example: Passengers should be reminded (that) no smoking is allowed on this train. 应该提醒乘客本次列车禁止吸烟。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 提醒某人……（后接 wh- 引导的从句）【课件】
