collocations.example: Can someone remind me what I should do next? 谁能提醒我下一步该做什么？（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: remind you of what you are working for
collocations.translation: 使你想起你为之奋斗的目标（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: This will remind you of what you are working for and keep you focused. 这会使你想起自己为之奋斗的目标，让你保持专注。（课文原句）
This song reminds me of my childhood. 这首歌让我想起我的童年。
Please remind me to post the letter. 请提醒我把信寄出去。
She reminded me that the deadline was Friday. 她提醒我截止日期是周五。
A gentle reminder to all participants: the feedback forms are due by Friday, and your honest opinions — even the critical ones — help us improve in ways that flattery never could. （应用文·通知/邮件）

synonyms.translation: 提醒/警告某人某事（同构短语，介词 of）【课件·辨析】
synonyms.example: Medical experts warn high school students of the potential health risks of lack of exercise. 医学专家警告高中生缺乏运动的潜在健康风险。（课件辨析：warn sb of sth 与 remind sb of sth 同构，均介词 of；课件例句为提醒学生别漏 of）
synonyms.usage: 【课件辨析】remind / warn / inform sb of sth 三者同构：都是'及物动词 + sb + of + sth'。warn 侧重'警告、告诫（有危险）'，remind 侧重'使想起、提醒（别忘）'，inform 侧重'通知（告知信息）'。注意介词都是 of，切勿漏掉。

synonyms.translation: 通知某人某事（同构短语，介词 of）【课件·辨析】
synonyms.example: Please inform all the members of the change of time. 请通知全体成员时间有变。（课件辨析：inform / warn / remind sb of sth 同构，介词均为 of）
synonyms.usage: 【课件辨析】inform sb of sth = 告知/通知；与 remind sb of sth（使想起）、warn sb of sth（警告）结构完全相同，只是语义侧重不同。也可 inform sb that ...。

synonyms.example: I remember locking the door, but she reminded me to lock the window too. 我记得锁了门，但她提醒我也要锁窗户。
synonyms.usage: 核心辨析：remember 是"自己记得/回忆起"（remember doing 记得做过 / remember to do 记得去做）；remind 是"使别人想起"，必须带宾语 remind sb. of/to do/that。位置：主语能否"记得"用 remember，让人"想起"用 remind。

synonyms.example: The smell of rain on dry earth — petrichor, they called it — brought to mind the monsoon afternoons of her childhood, afternoons that existed now only in the fragile architecture of memory. （读后续写·感官触发记忆·气味描写）
synonyms.usage: 侧重自然而然的联想，比remind更有画面感；主语常是物/景，句式 sth. brings sth. to mind。

synonyms.translation: 唤起某人的记忆，提醒某人
synonyms.example: The detective had hoped the photograph would jog the witness's memory, but the woman only stared at it with the hollow expression of someone who had spent years training herself to forget. （读后续写·悬疑·选择性遗忘）
synonyms.usage: 口语化表达，强调用外部刺激激发回忆；常搭配 photo/word/smell jog one's memory。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·remind/warn/inform sb of sth（同构短语群）
advancedExpressions.expression: remind sb of sth（使想起）· warn sb of sth（警告某人某事）· inform sb of sth（通知某人某事）——三者结构相同：v. + sb + of + sth，介词都是 of
advancedExpressions.example: 课件同构辨析：The photos reminded me of the party（使想起）；Experts warn students of the risks（警告）；Please inform members of the change（通知）。三个动词都接 'sb + of + sth'，语义分别是'使想起 / 警告 / 通知'，切勿漏掉介词 of。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（提醒/使想起）
advancedExpressions.expression: remind sb. of sth. / remind sb. to do / remind sb. that ... / bring sth. to mind / jog one's memory / serve as a reminder that ...
advancedExpressions.example: The old badge reminded him of his first job, brought to mind the mentor who trained him, and served as a reminder that everyone starts somewhere. 那枚旧徽章让他想起第一份工作，让他记起当年带他的师傅，也提醒他人人都有起点。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·remind sb. of + wh-从句（从课文长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: remind sb. of what / who / how ...（of 后接名词性从句）
advancedExpressions.example: 课文 remind you of what you are working for：介词 of 后接 what 引导的宾语从句。仿写：This photo reminds me of who I used to be. 这张照片让我想起从前的自己。

advancedExpressions.expression: ... served as a constant reminder that ...
advancedExpressions.example: The scar on his wrist — faded now to a thin white line, barely visible in most lights — served as a constant reminder that he had once been a different person, a person whose choices had nearly cost him everything, and that the distance between who he had been and who he was now was measured not in years but in every conscious decision to be better. （伤疤→人生提醒→成长见证）

advancedExpressions.expression: may I take this opportunity to remind you that ...
advancedExpressions.example: May I take this opportunity to remind all members that the annual election will be held next Monday, and that your participation is not merely a right but a responsibility to the community we have built together. （正式通知/演讲）

advancedExpressions.expression: history reminds us time and again that ...
advancedExpressions.example: History reminds us time and again that the greatest tragedies were not perpetrated by monsters but by ordinary people who had convinced themselves that their small compromises did not matter — until, collectively, they mattered enough to change the world for the worse.

sentenceUpgrade.original: He reminded me of the meeting.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He reminded me of the meeting with a glance — not with words, not with a tap on the shoulder, but with that particular tilt of his head, the one eyebrow raised just so, a gesture so subtle that anyone watching would have missed it. And yet that glance carried the weight of a thousand reminders: of promises made, of trust earned, of the quiet understanding between two people who had been through enough together that words had long since become optional. （读后续写·无声提醒·默契）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 否定递进(not with words, not with a tap) + 特写gesture + 收束排比(of promises, of trust, of understanding) + words had become optional哲理收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Let me remind you of the deadline.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Allow me to offer not a warning but a reminder — spoken in the spirit of someone who wants to see you succeed: the deadline approaches not as a threat but as an invitation. It asks, simply, 'Are you ready to show the world what you have made?' And I, for one, believe that you are. So let this reminder be the nudge that transforms intention into action, because the world does not reward the best ideas; it rewards the best-executed ones. （应用文·鼓励式提醒·正能量收束）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not...but...转折(not warning but reminder) + 拟人(the deadline asks) + 因果关系(world does not reward...it rewards...)

original_sentence: This will remind you of what you are working for and keep you focused.

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 应该提醒乘客本次列车禁止吸烟。Passengers ____ ____ ____ (that) no smoking is allowed on this train.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；remind sb that ... 的被动式 sb should be reminded (that) ...；that 引导宾语从句，可省略。

classPractice.type: 语境应用·翻译（课件·辨析）
classPractice.question: 医学专家警告高中生缺乏运动的潜在健康风险。Medical experts ____ high school students ____ the potential health risks of lack of exercise.
classPractice.note: 课件辨析：warn sb of sth（与 remind/inform sb of sth 同构），介词都是 of，切勿漏掉。

classPractice.question: This will remind you ____ what you are working for and keep you focused.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；remind sb. of sth. 使某人想起，of 后接 what 从句。

classPractice.question: I ____ (remind / remember) locking the door, but could you ____ (remind / remember) Tom to bring the key?
classPractice.note: remember doing 自己记得做过；remind sb. to do 提醒别人去做。remind 必须带宾语。

classPractice.question: 请提醒我明天给她打电话。Please ____ ____ ____ ____ her tomorrow.
classPractice.note: remind sb. to do sth. 提醒某人做某事。

definitionEn:
(1) phr. to continue doing or using something and not change it
(2) phr. to keep to something and not deviate from it

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·stick 多义】把（尖物）扎进/插入……（push a sharp object into sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: A needle stuck into my finger. 一根针扎进了我的手指。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·stick 多义】把……粘/拼在一起（fix sth to sth else）
uncommonMeanings.example: He stuck the broken pieces together. 他把碎片拼粘在了一起。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·stick 多义】被困在……，动弹不得（impossible to move）
uncommonMeanings.example: I was stuck in the traffic jam for two hours this morning. 今早我堵在车流里两个小时动弹不得。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·stick 多义】留在某人脑海里，久久难忘（be remembered for a long time）
uncommonMeanings.example: One of his paintings in particular sticks in my mind. 他的一幅画尤其令我难忘。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①坚持，固守，不改变（stick to a goal/plan/decision）
uncommonMeanings.example: Once she made up her mind, she stuck to it no matter what. 她一旦下定决心，无论如何都会坚持到底。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②粘在……上；紧贴（The stamp stuck to my finger.）
uncommonMeanings.example: The wet leaves stuck to the windshield like desperate hands, and through the blur of green and brown she could barely make out the road ahead — but stopping was not an option, not now, not with the storm gaining on them like a predator that had caught the scent of fear. （读后续写·暴风雨逃亡·紧张氛围）

readingExamples: After you set a goal, it is important to stick to it and work hard towards it.

posExamples.sentence: Stick to the plan, she told herself, even as panic fluttered in her chest like a trapped bird — because the plan was the only thing standing between her and the chaos that waited patiently for her to let go. （读后续写·危机时刻·坚持计划）

I would strongly suggest that we stick to the original budget — not because I lack ambition, but because a project that overreaches before it has learned to walk is a project that will never learn to run. （应用文·会议发言/建议）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：stick 三态不规则：stick - stuck - stuck。区分近形短语：stick to 坚持/遵守；stick out（使）伸出、突出；stick together 团结一致；stick with 继续做/守着；be/get stuck 被卡住、陷入困境。

idioms.example: Everyone advised her to compromise — the teachers, her parents, even her closest friends — but she stuck to her guns, not out of stubbornness but out of a conviction so deep it had become indistinguishable from who she was. （读后续写·原则坚守·勇气）
idioms.usage: 源自军事，指面对炮火坚守阵地，常用于面对压力仍坚持原则

idioms.example: I must ask you to stick to the point, the chairperson interrupted — not unkindly, but with the firmness of someone who had sat through too many meetings where good intentions drowned in a sea of tangents. （应用文·会议场景/读后续写·辩论）

collocations.translation: 坚持、固守（目标/计划/规定），不改变【课件】
collocations.example: It is important to stick to it. 坚持下去很重要。（课件原句，讲 stick to = 坚持）

collocations.translation: 信守诺言，说到做到【课件】
collocations.example: He promised to help us and he stuck to his word. 他答应帮我们，而且说到做到。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 坚持节食/控制饮食【课件】
collocations.example: She finds it impossible to stick to a diet. 她觉得根本没法坚持节食。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 坚持下去（坚持这个目标）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: After you set a goal, it is important to stick to it and work hard towards it. 定下目标之后，坚持下去并为之努力很重要。（课文原句）
Whatever happens, we must stick to the plan. 无论发生什么，我们都必须坚持计划。
He always sticks to his word. 他总是信守诺言。
In my report, I have tried to stick strictly to the facts — leaving interpretation to those whose job it is to interpret, and judgment to those whose authority it is to judge. （应用文·正式报告/客观陈述）

synonyms.example: She adhered to the training regimen with a devotion that bordered on the religious — rising at five, running in rain and shine, denying herself every comfort that might soften the edge of her ambition. （读后续写·运动员/艺术家刻苦训练）
synonyms.usage: 更formal，后接规则、原则、信念、计划(adhere to the rules/principles)；语义等于 stick to，但多用于正式书面语。

synonyms.example: He persisted in his belief that the old house was worth saving — and when they finally tore down the rotting plaster to reveal hand-carved beams beneath, the skeptics fell silent, and vindication tasted sweeter than any victory he had ever known. （读后续写·坚持终被证明·胜利）
synonyms.usage: persist in doing sth. 强调不顾困难或反对仍继续做，常带执着色彩；后接动名词，而 stick to 后接名词/代词。

synonyms.example: Please keep to the schedule so that everyone finishes on time. 请遵守时间表，好让大家都能按时完成。
synonyms.usage: keep to sth. 与 stick to 近义，指不偏离计划/路线/主题(keep to the point/path)；口语常用，语气略轻于 adhere to。

advancedExpressions.expression: stick to sth 坚持/遵守 · stick into sth 把尖物扎进（push a sharp object into）· stick sth together 把……粘拼在一起（fix sth to sth else）· be stuck in sth 被困住、动弹不得（impossible to move）· stick in one's mind 留在脑海、难忘（be remembered）
advancedExpressions.example: 课件同词多义：stick to a diet（坚持）；A needle stuck into my finger（扎进）；He stuck the broken pieces together（粘拼）；I was stuck in the traffic jam（被困）；One of his paintings sticks in my mind（难忘）。同一个 stick，靠后接介词/搭配区分五种义。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·stick 三态（不规则动词，课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: stick - stuck - stuck（过去式、过去分词都是 stuck）
advancedExpressions.example: 课件强调：stick 三态为 stick-stuck-stuck。He stuck to his word（坚持，过去式 stuck）；I was stuck in the jam（被困，过去分词 stuck）。

advancedExpressions.expression: stick to 坚持/遵守 · stick out 突出/伸出 · stick together 团结 · stick with 继续/守着 · be stuck 卡住/陷入 · stick to one's guns 坚持立场
advancedExpressions.example: When things got hard, the team stuck together, stuck to the plan, and even when they got stuck, no one gave up. 困难来临时，团队团结一致、坚持原计划，即使一度陷入困境，也没人放弃。

advancedExpressions.expression: stick - stuck - stuck；stick(v.) → sticky(adj. 黏的/棘手的) → stuck(adj. 卡住的)
advancedExpressions.example: The lock was stuck, my hands were sticky with glue, and I had to stick to the plan anyway. 锁卡住了，我的手被胶水弄得黏黏的，可我还是得坚持原计划。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. had every reason to give up, but ... stuck to ... as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: She had every reason to give up — the funding had dried up, the team had dwindled to three, and the naysayers had grown louder with each passing week — but she stuck to her vision as if it were the only thing keeping her alive, which, in a way that made sense only to those who have loved an impossible dream, it was. （逆境坚守的震撼描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: my advice, for what it is worth, is to stick to ...
advancedExpressions.example: My advice, for what it is worth, is to stick to the original timeline — not because delays are unthinkable but because momentum, once lost, is harder to regain than any resource I can name. （建议信）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ability to stick to a chosen path in the face of distraction is ...
advancedExpressions.example: The ability to stick to a chosen path in the face of distraction is, I would argue, the single most underrated predictor of success — more than talent, more than luck, more even than intelligence, because intelligence without persistence is a car without fuel: impressive to look at but going nowhere.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: They told him the dream was too big for a boy from a town too small. They told him in words both kind and cruel — some meant to protect him, others to cut him down. But he stuck to his dream with the quiet ferocity of a river that has been told it cannot reach the sea: no argument, no resistance, just the steady, patient, implacable forward motion of a force that has made peace with the distance. And eventually — not quickly, not dramatically, but eventually — the sea came into view, and the boy who had been told he was too small stood at the shore of everything he had been told he could never have. （读后续写·梦想坚守·河流隐喻·大器晚成）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 对比(too big/too small) + 明喻(with the quiet ferocity of a river) + 三副递进(no argument, no resistance, just steady motion) + 首尾呼应(boy too small → stood at the shore of everything)

sentenceUpgrade.original: You should stick to your plan.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There will be voices — there are always voices — telling you to pivot, to adjust, to abandon the plan you made in a moment of clarity and replace it with a reaction born in a moment of fear. Ignore them. Stick to your plan — not rigidly, not blindly, but with the intelligent persistence of a captain who holds the course while adjusting the sails. For the plan is not a cage; it is a compass, and without it, even the fastest ship will find itself, in the end, nowhere worth being. （应用文·演讲/鼓励·航海隐喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 反复(There are always voices) + 否定递进(not rigidly, not blindly) + 比喻递进(not a cage; it is a compass) + 对比收束(fastest ship → nowhere vs compass → worth being)

original_sentence: After you set a goal, it is important to stick to it and work hard towards it.

classPractice.type: 语境应用·辨析 stick 多义（课件）
classPractice.question: 用 stick 的适当形式/搭配填空：1) He promised to help us and he ____ ____ his word.（信守诺言）  2) A needle ____ ____ my finger.（扎进）  3) I ____ ____ ____ the traffic jam for two hours this morning.（被困）  4) One of his paintings in particular ____ ____ my mind.（难忘）
classPractice.answer: 1) stuck to  2) stuck into  3) was stuck in  4) sticks in
classPractice.note: 课件同词多义题。stick to 坚持/信守；stick into 扎进（尖物）；be stuck in 被困、动弹不得；stick in one's mind 留在脑海、难忘。注意三态 stick-stuck-stuck。

classPractice.question: 定下目标后，坚持下去并为之努力很重要。After you set a goal, it is important to ____ ____ it and work hard towards it.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；stick to sth. 坚持、固守，后接名词/代词 it。

classPractice.question: The label ____ (stick) to the box so tightly that I couldn't peel it off yesterday.
classPractice.note: stick 表"粘住"，过去式为 stuck（三态 stick-stuck-stuck）。

classPractice.question: Don't ____ (stick to / stick out) your head ____ the window of a moving bus.
classPractice.note: stick out 伸出、突出；stick to 意为"坚持"，此处不通。

definitionEn:
(1) n. a formal suggestion or plan
(2) n. the act of making a suggestion
(3) n. an offer of marriage

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①提议，建议，方案（正式的完整计划：make/submit/approve a proposal）
uncommonMeanings.example: The board is considering a proposal to cut costs. 董事会正在考虑一项削减成本的提案。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②求婚（尤指 a marriage proposal / accept sb.'s proposal）
uncommonMeanings.example: He had planned the proposal for months — the location, the words, even the exact angle of the sunset — but when the moment came, he forgot every rehearsed line and simply said, with a voice that cracked on the second syllable, 'I don't want to do any of this without you.' And somehow, that unplanned sentence was more perfect than anything he could have written. （读后续写·求婚·真情胜过排练）

readingExamples: Write a proposal for the new club.

posExamples.sentence: Her proposal was met with silence — not the silence of disagreement but the silence of people who had never considered the possibility she was presenting, and needed time to rearrange their understanding of what was possible. （读后续写·颠覆性提议·震撼沉默）

I am writing to submit a formal proposal regarding the establishment of a peer tutoring program — a proposal that I believe addresses a genuine need while making efficient use of the resources we already have. （应用文·正式提案/建议书）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：动词 propose + 名词后缀 -al → proposal(提议)。propose 用法三分：propose doing sth.（提议做）/ propose to do sth.（打算做）/ propose that + 主语 + (should) do（虚拟语气，从句谓语用动词原形）。proposal 后接内容同样用虚拟：a proposal that we (should) start。求婚：propose to sb.，名词 a marriage proposal。

collocations.phrase: the proposal for / to build sth.（= the proposal that ... (should) be built）
collocations.translation: 【课件】建造某物的提议（for + 名词/to do；也可改写成 that 从句用虚拟语气 (should) do）
collocations.example: The proposal for/to build a new high-speed railway met with strong opposition. 建造一条新高铁的提议遭到了强烈反对。= The proposal that a new high-speed railway (should) be built met with strong opposition.（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】提议对某事物作出改动
collocations.example: He proposed changes to the old system. 他提议对旧制度作出改动。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】提议……（that 从句用虚拟语气 (should) + 动词原形）
collocations.example: She proposed that the book (should) be banned. 她提议这本书应该被禁。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】有人提议……（主语从句用虚拟语气）
collocations.example: It is proposed that the meeting (should) be put off until next week. 有人提议把会议推迟到下周。（课件句式）

collocations.phrase: write a proposal for the new club
collocations.translation: 为新社团写一份提案（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Write a proposal for the new club. 为这个新社团写一份提案。（课文原句）
She put forward a bold proposal at the meeting. 她在会上提出了一个大胆的方案。

She put forward a proposal so audacious — a complete restructuring of the school timetable — that at first people laughed. But she had done the research, she had the data, and she answered every objection with the patient precision of someone who had anticipated every argument before it was made. （读后续写/应用文·提案成功·准备的力量）

collocations.translation: 做某事的提议（不定式作后置定语）
collocations.example: There is a proposal to build a new library. 有人提议建一座新图书馆。

collocations.translation: ……的提议（that 从句用虚拟语气）
collocations.example: His proposal that we (should) start earlier was accepted. 他提出我们应该早点开始的建议被采纳了。

The committee rejected his proposal with polite, encouraging words that somehow felt worse than outright criticism — for criticism, at least, takes your ideas seriously enough to engage with them, whereas polite dismissal merely pats them on the head and shows them the door. （读后续写·拒绝之痛·委婉的残酷）

His grandmother had received her marriage proposal in a letter — not an email, not a text, not a choreographed flash mob, but a letter written by hand on paper that still, seventy years later, carried the faint scent of the cologne he had worn the day he wrote it. （读后续写·穿越时空的浪漫·书信传承）

At the student council meeting, she proposed replacing the plastic cups in the cafeteria with biodegradable ones — a small change, she admitted, but one that, multiplied by three thousand students over a hundred and eighty school days, would mean something. （应用文·提案倡议）

The head of the committee proposed that every department should set aside one hour each week for what he called 'radical thinking' — not planning, not reporting, not optimizing existing systems, but simply asking the question: 'What if we started from scratch?' （应用文·正式建议/议论文·创新思维）

He proposed to her on a Tuesday — not because Tuesdays are romantic but because he could not wait another day, and the ring was in his pocket, and the question had been building in his chest for months until it felt like holding his breath under water. （读后续写·即兴求婚·真挚动人）

synonyms.example: It was just a suggestion, she said — but the way her voice wavered on the last word told him it was far more than that: it was a hope dressed in the armor of indifference, a wish pretending not to care whether it was granted. （读后续写·言不由衷·情感潜台词）
synonyms.usage: 比 proposal 更轻、更口语，指随口的一个想法；proposal 强调经过准备的完整方案。句法：make a suggestion；suggestion that... 同样接虚拟。

synonyms.translation: 推荐，建议（尤指基于专业知识）
synonyms.example: The committee's recommendation was unanimous — a rare thing in a group known for its endless deliberations — and the weight of that consensus lent the proposal a credibility that no single voice, however eloquent, could have achieved alone. （应用文·正式报告·共识力量）
synonyms.usage: 强调基于专业判断或调查后的正式建议；make/give a recommendation，recommendation that... 也用虚拟；proposal 更侧重"方案"本身。

synonyms.translation: （会议上正式表决的）动议，提案
synonyms.example: The motion was passed by a large majority. 该动议以绝大多数票通过。
synonyms.usage: 特指会议、议会上供表决的正式提案，搭配 put/pass/carry a motion；proposal 使用范围更广，不限于正式表决场合。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·proposal/propose 后的虚拟语气（should+do）
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】proposal / propose + that + 主语 + (should) + 动词原形（表"建议/提议"）
advancedExpressions.example: 课件示例集：The proposal that a new high-speed railway (should) be built ...（提议的内容用虚拟）；She proposed that the book (should) be banned.；It is proposed that ... (should) do。同类需接虚拟的"建议/命令/要求"词还有：suggest, advise, demand, insist, order, request。

advancedExpressions.expression: propose doing sth. 提议做 · propose to do sth. 打算做 · propose that+(should)do 提议（虚拟） · propose changes to sth. 提议改动 · propose to sb. 求婚 · put forward / submit a proposal 提交方案
advancedExpressions.example: He proposed doing it together, proposed to finish by June, proposed changes to the plan, proposed that we start at once, and — to everyone's surprise — later proposed to his co-worker. 他提议一起做，打算六月前完成，提议对方案作出改动，提议我们马上开始，后来还向同事求了婚。

advancedExpressions.expression: the proposal seemed impossible / absurd at first, but ...
advancedExpressions.example: The proposal seemed impossible at first — a school garden built and maintained entirely by students — but impossibility, she had learned, was often just a word people used to describe things they were too tired or too scared to attempt. And so she began, not with a grand announcement but with a single seed, planted in a yogurt cup on a windowsill. （从小到大·行动的力量）

advancedExpressions.expression: in light of the above, I would like to propose that ...
advancedExpressions.example: In light of the above — the survey results, the focus group feedback, and the comparative analysis of similar programs — I would like to propose that we establish a student mentorship initiative, to be piloted in the coming semester and evaluated at its conclusion. （正式建议报告）

advancedExpressions.expression: a proposal, no matter how brilliant, is worthless without ...
advancedExpressions.example: A proposal, no matter how brilliant, is worthless without the courage to present it and the persistence to see it through — for ideas are cheap, and the world is littered with brilliant proposals that never left the drawer they were written in.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·proposal/propose 后的虚拟语气（should+do）
advancedExpressions.expression: propose / a proposal + that + 主语 + (should) + 动词原形
advancedExpressions.example: 同类需接虚拟的"建议/命令/要求"词：suggest, advise, demand, insist, order, request。例：I propose that the meeting (should) be put off. 我提议会议应该推迟。The proposal that he (should) resign shocked everyone. 他应辞职的提议震惊了所有人。

advancedExpressions.expression: propose doing sth. 提议做 · propose to do sth. 打算做 · propose that+(should)do 提议（虚拟） · propose to sb. 求婚 · put forward / submit a proposal 提交方案
advancedExpressions.example: He proposed doing it together, proposed to finish by June, proposed that we start at once, and — to everyone's surprise — later proposed to his co-worker. 他提议一起做，打算六月前完成，提议我们马上开始，后来还向同事求了婚。

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She made her proposal not from the podium but from her seat in the third row, standing only when the chairperson — reluctantly, skeptically — acknowledged her raised hand. In the three minutes she was given, she laid out a vision so complete, so considered, so quietly radical that by the time she sat back down, the room had transformed: the skeptics had become curious, the indifferent had become engaged, and the opposition — those who had come prepared to dismiss — found themselves, to their own surprise, nodding. That is the power not of eloquence but of preparation: when you have done the thinking, the speaking takes care of itself. （读后续写·提案震撼全场·准备的力量）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 空间对比(not from the podium but from her seat) + 限定压力(three minutes) + 三排比(so complete, so considered, so quietly radical) + 状态转变(the skeptics→curious, indifferent→engaged, opposition→nodding) + 哲理收束(power not of eloquence but of preparation)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I rise to support this proposal — not with the passive assent of someone who agrees in principle but with the active conviction of someone who has examined its assumptions, tested its logic, and found it not merely sound but necessary. For the issue this proposal addresses is not a hypothetical; it affects real students in real classrooms every single day, and inaction — let us be clear — is not neutrality; it is a decision with consequences of its own. So I lend my voice to this proposal, and I urge every member of this committee to do the same — not because it is perfect, but because it is a beginning, and a beginning, however imperfect, is infinitely better than the alternative. （应用文·正式支持提案·演讲）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 否定递进(not with passive assent but with active conviction) + 现实论证(not hypothetical; it affects real students) + inaction is not neutrality悖论句 + imperfect beginning vs alternative对比收束

original_sentence: Write a proposal for the new club.

classPractice.question: 把 that 从句改写成不定式作后置定语：The proposal that a new high-speed railway should be built met with strong opposition. → The proposal ____ ____ a new high-speed railway met with strong opposition.
classPractice.note: 课件原句互换：the proposal that a new high-speed railway (should) be built = the proposal to build a new high-speed railway；名词 proposal 后用不定式作后置定语说明其内容。（课件另给出介词式 the proposal for building / for a new high-speed railway，但本题两空只填不定式 to build。）

classPractice.question: She proposed that the book ____ (ban), and it is now proposed that all such titles ____ (review) before publication.
classPractice.note: 课件原句 She proposed that the book (should) be banned. propose / it is proposed that 后接虚拟语气 (should) + 动词原形，此处均为被动 be + 过去分词。

classPractice.question: 为这个新社团写一份提案。____ a ____ for the new club.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；a proposal for sth. 关于某事的提案。

classPractice.question: The committee's proposal that the plan ____ (carry) out at once was accepted.

classPractice.question: On graduation day, he decided to ____ (propose / proposal) to his girlfriend in front of everyone.

translation: n. 目的，目标 | vi.&vt. 力争做到；目的是；针对
definitionEn:
(1) n. the purpose of doing something
(2) n. what somebody is trying to achieve
(3) vi. to try or plan to achieve something
(4) vi. to have something as a purpose

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】aimless 没有方向的，无目的的 / aimlessly 漫无目的地（aim + -less + -ly 派生）
uncommonMeanings.example: He led an aimless sort of life. 他过着一种漫无目的的生活。I wandered aimlessly. 我漫无目的地到处游逛。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①目的，目标（the aim of sth.；achieve/reach one's aim）
uncommonMeanings.example: My main aim in life is to be happy. 我人生的主要目标是幸福。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②力争，旨在（aim to do / aim at doing / aim for sth.）
uncommonMeanings.example: We aim for excellence in everything we do. 我们凡事都力求卓越。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 瞄准，对准
uncommonMeanings.example: He aimed the camera at the horizon — not at the sun itself, which would have burned out the lens, but just to its left, where the light was at its most tender, the moment when day and night negotiate the terms of their exchange. （读后续写·摄影/艺术·精准捕捉瞬间）

readingExamples: Club aim: To improve short story writing skills

posExamples.sentence: Her aim was not fame or fortune — those were merely the shadows that success cast — but something simpler and infinitely harder: to create work that would matter to someone she would never meet, in a time she would never see. （读后续写·艺术家/创作者·超越个人成就的追求）

She aimed for perfection and fell short — as everyone who aims for perfection must — but in the falling she landed somewhere far closer to it than anyone who had aimed for 'good enough' had ever reached. （读后续写·奋斗哲理·虽未达但已远）

I aim to complete the community survey by the end of this month, and I would welcome any volunteers who wish to contribute their time to a project that will, I believe, directly shape the direction of our school's development. （应用文·工作计划/招募通知）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：aim + 后缀 -less(无) → aimless(无目的的) + -ly → aimlessly。用法三分：aim to do sth.（不定式）/ aim at doing sth.（介词+动名词）/ be aimed at (doing) sth.（被动）三者都表"旨在"，别把 to 和 at 后的动词形式弄混：to 后接原形，at 后接动名词。

idioms.translation: 瞄准；将批评的矛头指向
idioms.example: The editorial took aim at the school board's decision with the precision of a surgeon and the passion of a parent — dismantling every argument, exposing every logical gap, and leaving the board with nowhere to hide. （应用文·评论/报道·精准批判）

"Aim high," her father had always said — three words she had dismissed as a cliché until the day she realized that aiming high was not about certainty of success but about the refusal to let fear of failure determine the size of her dreams. （读后续写·父亲的教诲·重新理解）

collocations.phrase: the aim of sth. is to do
collocations.translation: 【课件】某事物的目标是做……（n. sth. you hope to achieve）
collocations.example: The main aim of the course is to improve your writing. 这门课程的主要目标是提高你的写作水平。（课件原句）
Teamwork is required in order to achieve these aims. 为了实现这些目标，需要团队合作。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】心气/目标很高，胸怀大志（v. 力争上游）
collocations.example: He has always aimed high. 他总是心气/目标很高。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】以……为目标，力争（后接名词/动名词）
collocations.example: The government is aiming at/for a 50% reduction in unemployment. 政府正着力将失业人数减少50%。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】力争做到，目的在于（后接不定式）
collocations.example: They are aiming to reduce unemployment by 50%. 他们力争把失业人数减少50%。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: aim (sth.) at sth. 瞄准，对准
collocations.translation: 【课件】v. 瞄准；对准（把武器/镜头等对准目标）
collocations.example: I was aiming at the tree but hit the car by mistake. 我对准树射击，不料误中了汽车。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: club aim: to improve short story writing skills
collocations.translation: 社团宗旨：提高短篇小说写作技能（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Club aim: To improve short story writing skills. 社团宗旨：提高短篇小说写作技能。（课文原句）
The new policy is aimed at reducing the homework burden on students. 新政策旨在减轻学生的作业负担。

She launched the initiative with the aim of creating something the school had never had before: a space where students could fail without judgment, experiment without grades, and create without the pressure of an audience. （应用文·活动介绍/读后续写·创业故事）

It took seven years to achieve his aim — seven years of rejection letters and sleepless nights and moments of doubt so profound they felt like gravity — but when the acceptance finally came, the victory was not elation but a deep, exhausted peace, the peace of a journey that had finally earned the right to end. （读后续写·漫长奋斗·目标的重量）
The campaign aims at raising public awareness. 这场运动旨在提高公众意识。

synonyms.example: His goal had been simple when he arrived at the school four years ago: to remain invisible, to graduate without being noticed, to leave no trace. But life, it turned out, had other plans — and the boy who had aimed for invisibility found himself, against every instinct, becoming the most visible person in the room. （读后续写·反讽·命运的安排）
synonyms.usage: 最常用、最中性，指努力要达到的"具体目标"，可长期(set/reach a goal)；aim 更强调"意图/宗旨"，且能作动词(aim to do)，goal 只作名词。

synonyms.translation: 目标，目的（尤指商业/军事）
synonyms.example: The team had a clear objective: raise enough money to send the entire debate club to nationals — an objective that seemed laughably ambitious until someone pointed out that every great achievement had once seemed laughably ambitious to someone. （应用文·筹款/项目管理）
synonyms.usage: 更formal，强调明确、可衡量的"具体阶段目标"，多用于工作、项目、军事；aim 可大可小、更口语，也可作动词。

synonyms.example: She had lost her sense of purpose somewhere in the grind of daily routine — not dramatically, not all at once, but gradually, the way a room grows dark after sunset: so slowly you don't notice until you realize you can no longer see. （读后续写·人生迷茫·渐变性丧失）
synonyms.usage: 比 aim 更抽象、更深层，强调"存在的意义/根本意图"(a sense of purpose)；aim 侧重具体想达到的目标。

advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】aim（目标/力争）→ aim + -less → aimless（无目的的，形容词）→ + -ly → aimlessly（漫无目的地，副词）
advancedExpressions.example: An aimless mind wanders aimlessly; a mind with an aim moves toward it. 漫无目标的心会漫无目的地游荡；有目标的心则朝目标前进。（对照 aimless/aimlessly）

advancedExpressions.expression: aim to do sth. · aim at/for (doing) sth. · aim high · be aimed at (doing) sth. · with the aim of doing sth. · achieve/reach one's aim · aim (sth.) at 瞄准 · take aim at
advancedExpressions.example: The workshop aims to help beginners, aims high in its ambitions, is aimed at building confidence, and was set up with the aim of giving everyone a stage. 这个工作坊力争帮助新手，志向高远，旨在建立自信，创办目的就是给每个人一个舞台。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（目标/宗旨）
advancedExpressions.expression: aim / goal / objective / purpose / target / the whole point of sth.
advancedExpressions.example: 写作时表"目标"可替换：Our aim / goal / objective / purpose is to... / What we are aiming at is... / The whole point is to...。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. set out with the aim of ..., but what sb. found along the way was ...
advancedExpressions.example: She set out with the aim of winning the competition — nothing more, nothing less — but what she found along the way was something the trophy could never represent: a community of fellow competitors who became, in the crucible of shared ambition, the friends she had spent her whole life searching for. （目标→意外收获→友谊）

advancedExpressions.expression: our primary aim is to ... while also ensuring that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Our primary aim is to raise awareness about mental health among students while also ensuring that those who are struggling know exactly where to turn for support — because awareness without access is an invitation without an address. （活动介绍/倡议书）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ultimate aim of ... is not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: The ultimate aim of education is not the accumulation of knowledge but the cultivation of wisdom — for knowledge tells you what is true; wisdom tells you what to do with that truth.

advancedExpressions.expression: aim to do sth. · aim at doing sth. · be aimed at (doing) sth. · with the aim of doing sth. · achieve/reach one's aim · aim high · take aim at
advancedExpressions.example: The workshop aims to help beginners, is aimed at building confidence, and was set up with the aim of giving everyone a stage — so aim high and join us. 这个工作坊力争帮助新手，旨在建立自信，创办目的就是给每个人一个舞台——所以胸怀大志，加入我们吧。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Her aim is to be a writer.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Her aim was not simply to be a writer — a title anyone could claim with a blog and an opinion — but to write something true. Something that would outlast her, something that a stranger in a country she had never visited would read fifty years after her death and think, 'Yes — this is exactly what it feels like to be alive.' She had no interest in fame, no appetite for applause; she wanted only to leave behind, in the vast library of human experience, a single honest sentence that had not existed before she wrote it. That, and nothing less, was her aim — and if it sounds impossibly lofty, well, aims that are not lofty are not aims; they are errands. （读后续写·创作追求·给世界留下真诚）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 否定定义(not simply to be a writer) + 未来投射(fifty years after her death) + 破折号补充 + 悖论收束(aims that are not lofty are not aims; they are errands)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I am not here to tell you to 'aim high' — you have heard that before, and hearing it again will not make it more true or more useful. Instead, let me tell you what aiming high actually means. It means choosing the harder path when the easier one is available and well-lit. It means being willing to fail publicly, embarrassingly, completely — because the targets worth hitting are always the ones that are hardest to reach. And it means accepting, with humility and grace, that you may never hit the target at all — because aiming high is not a guarantee of success; it is a declaration of the kind of person you have chosen to be. So by all means, aim high. But do not aim high because you want to impress the world. Aim high because the act of aiming, in and of itself, will make you into the kind of person who deserves to hit the mark. （应用文·毕业演讲·重新定义「胸怀大志」）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 否定引入(not here to tell you...) + 三重定义(It means...三次) + 悖论(aiming high is not a guarantee; it is a declaration) + 因果升华(the act of aiming will make you into the kind of person who deserves to hit the mark)

classPractice.note: 课件派生词：aimlessly（副词，修饰 wandered）；aimless（形容词，修饰 life）。aim + -less(+ -ly)。

classPractice.note: be aimed at (doing) sth. 旨在做某事；at 后接动名词 helping。

classPractice.note: 固定短语 with the aim of doing sth. 以……为目的，只用 aim，不用 goal；of 后接动名词。

definitionEn:
(1) n. a particular way of doing something, or of expressing ideas in writing, music, art, etc.
(2) n. a particular design or fashion of clothes, hair, furniture and so on
(3) n. the quality of being elegant, confident and attractive in the way one behaves or dresses
(4) vt. to design, shape or arrange something, especially hair or clothes, in a particular way

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①风格，文体，方式（写作/艺术/做事的特有方式：a writing/learning style）
uncommonMeanings.example: Every writer eventually finds a style of his or her own. 每位作家最终都会形成自己的风格。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②款式，样式；时尚（clothes/hair 的设计；in/out of style）
uncommonMeanings.example: This hairstyle is very much in style this year. 这种发型今年很流行。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（言行举止的）气派，风度；格调（do sth. in style 有气派地）
uncommonMeanings.example: She handled the crisis with real style. 她处理危机时相当有风度。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 称呼;给(某人)冠以称号(常用被动或 style oneself)
uncommonMeanings.example: Though he had retired years before, the villagers still styled him 'Headmaster Wang' — a title he wore with quiet pride whenever he passed the school gate. （读后续写·人物·尊敬）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 设计;为(头发、服装等)做造型
uncommonMeanings.example: The shop window displayed a mannequin styled entirely in recycled materials, and passers-by slowed down, curious about the message behind the unusual design. （应用文·环保活动报道）

readingExamples: Read short stories in different styles;

posExamples.sentence: Grandma's kitchen had a style all its own — mismatched china, hand-embroidered curtains and the lingering smell of ginger — and the moment I stepped in, the tension of exam season melted away. （读后续写·环境描写·温情）

Our English Drama Club welcomes members of every level, and our teaching style — relaxed, interactive and encouraging — ensures that even the shyest beginner will soon feel at home on stage. （应用文·招募启事）

Since every student has a distinctive learning style, a one-size-fits-all approach to teaching, however convenient for schools, inevitably leaves some talented minds unchallenged and others hopelessly behind. （议论文·教育）
Before the graduation ceremony, my elder sister spent a whole hour styling my hair in front of the mirror, insisting that such a milestone deserved nothing less than perfection. （读后续写·亲情·仪式感）

wordForms.adjective: stylish (时髦的) / stylistic (文体的;风格上的)
wordForms.other: 小贴士：style + 后缀 -ish → stylish(时髦的)；style + -ist → stylist(设计师/发型师)；style + -istic → stylistic(文体上的)。合成词：hairstyle(发型)、lifestyle(生活方式)、freestyle(自由式)、hairstylist(发型师)。注意 stylish(时髦的)与 stylistic(文体的)词义不同，勿混。

idioms.example: When our team finally won the championship, we celebrated in style — banners, fireworks and a feast that lasted well into the night. （读后续写·庆祝场面）
Handwritten letters may seem out of style, yet nothing warms the heart quite like a note written by hand. 手写信也许显得过时，但没什么比亲笔写的字条更暖人心。
Tom loved his little brother dearly, yet he could not help feeling that babysitting every single weekend rather cramped his style. （读后续写·家庭·矛盾心理）

collocations.translation: 不同风格的短篇小说（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Read short stories in different styles. 阅读不同风格的短篇小说。（课文原句）
They celebrated their victory in style. 他们气派地庆祝了胜利。
Gadgets go out of style within months, but the joy of sharing a good book with a friend never does. （议论文·对比论证）
Years of keeping a diary helped Lucy develop a distinctive style that her teachers could recognize at first glance. （读后续写·成长积累）
For the school art festival, our class painted a mural in the style of Van Gogh, its swirling stars lighting up the dull corridor. （应用文·活动报道）
The judges praised her plain yet powerful writing style, remarking that true emotion never needs fancy decoration. （读后续写·比赛·点评）
A wise teacher adjusts the pace of the class to accommodate different learning styles instead of forcing everyone down the same track. （议论文·教育）
Rather than copying famous speakers word for word, contestants are encouraged to develop their own style of delivery. （应用文·比赛通知）
Loud parties never suited Grandpa's style; he preferred a quiet evening with tea, chess and an old friend. （读后续写·人物刻画）
Remember that a letter to a professor calls for a formal style, while a note to a classmate can be casual and warm. （应用文·写作建议）

synonyms.example: The doctor explained the treatment in a gentle, unhurried manner, which gradually eased the old man's fears. （读后续写·医患·安抚）
synonyms.usage: 侧重做事的具体方式或言谈举止,常用于 in a ... manner 结构;不指艺术、服饰等'风格'

synonyms.example: School uniforms may never follow the latest fashion, but they quietly teach us that identity runs deeper than clothes. （议论文·校园话题）
synonyms.usage: 强调一段时期内的流行,时效性强;style 更强调个人特色与品位,不一定随大流

synonyms.example: Instead of drilling grammar rules, our teacher adopted a story-based approach to language learning, and the class came alive. （应用文·课程感悟）
synonyms.usage: 指解决问题、处理事情的方法路径,常与 to 连用;style 偏向个人表现出来的特征

advancedExpressions.expression: in style 时髦/气派 · out of style 过时 · in the style of 模仿…风格 · a writing/learning style · develop one's own style · cramp sb's style · hairstyle / lifestyle
advancedExpressions.example: She writes in a style all her own, dresses in style without following fashion, and lives a lifestyle that never goes out of style. 她的文风独具一格，穿着时髦却不盲从潮流，过着一种永不过时的生活方式。

advancedExpressions.expression: style → stylish / stylistic / stylist / stylishly；hairstyle · lifestyle · freestyle · hairstylist
advancedExpressions.example: The stylish stylist styled her hair in a freestyle way that perfectly suited her relaxed lifestyle. 那位时髦的造型师用一种自由随性的方式为她做了头发，完美契合她轻松的生活方式。

advancedExpressions.expression: in a style that was uniquely one's own
advancedExpressions.example: She comforted the crying boy in a style that was uniquely her own — no lectures, no fuss, just a warm biscuit and a seat by the fire. （破折号列举具体动作,以细节代替抽象评价,人物形象立体化）

advancedExpressions.expression: Designed to cater to different styles of ..., ... offers ...
advancedExpressions.example: Designed to cater to different learning styles, the club offers workshops, film nights and story-writing contests alike, so that everyone can find a door into English. （过去分词短语开头点明设计意图,应用文高分开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: It is not the style but the substance of ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is not the style but the substance of an argument that ultimately persuades a critical reader — a truth many flashy speakers choose to ignore. （强调句+style/substance 对比,论证有力）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Quiet as she was, everything she did — from the way she folded paper cranes to the way she calmed a nervous classmate before exams — carried a gentle style that was unmistakably her own. （读后续写·细节描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 让步倒装(Quiet as she was) + from ... to ... 细节列举 + 破折号插入语,用具体行为呈现抽象的'风格'

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our club has many styles of activities.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Ranging from classic drama rehearsals to modern film-dubbing contests, the activities of our club embrace such a rich variety of styles that every member is guaranteed to find a stage of his or her own. （应用文·社团介绍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Ranging from ... to ... 分词短语开头 + such ... that ... 结果状语从句 + 正式措辞(embrace, be guaranteed to)

definitionEn:
(1) n. a particular way of doing something, especially one in which you have to learn special skills
(2) n. the skill with which somebody is able to do something practical

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】①技巧，手法（a special way of doing sth.：做某事的特殊方法/手法）
uncommonMeanings.example: Write short stories using different techniques. 用不同的技巧写短篇小说。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】②技术，技能（a way of doing sth. which needs skill：需要专门技能才能做的方法）
uncommonMeanings.example: problem-solving / communication / writing techniques 解决问题/沟通/写作的技能。（课件原句词块）

readingExamples: Write short stories using different techniques

posExamples.sentence: The old carpenter had a technique for everything — not the kind you could learn from a manual but the kind that had been passed down through three generations, refined by calloused hands and the quiet accumulation of a lifetime's mistakes corrected. （读后续写·匠人精神·技艺传承）

I have found that the most effective study technique is not highlighting or rereading but teaching the material to someone who knows nothing about it — because until you can explain it simply, you haven't truly understood it. （应用文·学习方法分享）

wordForms.noun: technique（技巧，技艺）；technology（技术，科技）；technician（技术员，技师）
wordForms.other: 构词法·后缀：techn-（技艺）+ -ique 名词，源自法语，故读 /tekˈniːk/，重音在后。词族对照：technique 具体方法（可数）/ technology 科技（多不可数）/ technical 技术的（形）/ technician 技术人员（人）。易错：technique 不要拼成 techneque；technical 双写无。

collocations.phrase: write short stories using different techniques
collocations.translation: 【课件】用不同的技巧写短篇小说（课文/课件原句）
collocations.example: Write short stories using different techniques. 用不同的技巧写短篇小说。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】解决问题/沟通/写作的技巧（technique 前接领域构成复合搭配）
collocations.example: This course teaches practical problem-solving and communication techniques. 这门课教授实用的解决问题和沟通技巧。（课件原句词块）

collocations.translation: 【课件】利用网络资源做研究（Integrated skills 语境词块）
collocations.example: You can do research using online resources before you start writing. 动笔前你可以利用网络资源做研究。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】举办/参加研讨会（Integrated skills 语境词块）
collocations.example: The club will hold a workshop where members share writing techniques. 社团将举办研讨会，让成员分享写作技巧。（课件原句词块）
He learned several narrative techniques in the workshop. 他在工作坊里学到了几种叙事技巧。
It took her years to master this technique. 她花了好几年才掌握这门技巧。
It is a tried and tested technique for calming nerves. 这是一种久经检验的镇定方法。

collocations.translation: 运用不同的技巧（课文原句）
collocations.example: Write short stories using different techniques. 运用不同的技巧写短篇小说。

synonyms.translation: 技能，技巧（可习得的能力）
synonyms.example: Writing is a skill that improves with practice. 写作是一种越练越好的技能。
synonyms.usage: 语义更泛，指通过训练获得的能力（可天生或习得）；technique 侧重完成某事的具体方法与步骤。skill 常与 in / at + 名词或 doing 搭配，如 skill in writing。

synonyms.example: Modern technology has changed how we learn. 现代科技改变了我们的学习方式。
synonyms.usage: 指科学知识在生产中的整体应用（宏观、抽象），常不可数；technique 指个人操作层面的具体方法，可数。易混：注意 techniqu-e 拼写。

synonyms.example: His method of teaching history was unusual. 他教历史的方法很不寻常。
synonyms.usage: 强调系统、成体系的做法，比 technique 宏观；method of doing sth。technique 更聚焦具体手法与操作细节。

advancedExpressions.expression: using different techniques｜master a technique｜a tried and tested technique｜apply the technique to sth｜improve one's technique
advancedExpressions.example: By applying the techniques she had learned, she improved her writing dramatically. 通过运用学到的技巧，她的写作大有长进。

advancedExpressions.expression: technique（技巧）→ technology（科技）→ technical（技术的）→ technically（技术上）→ technician（技术员）
advancedExpressions.example: A technician needs solid technical knowledge and mature techniques. 技术员需要扎实的技术知识和成熟的技巧。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. had elevated ... from a mere technique to an art form
advancedExpressions.example: She had elevated bread-making from a mere technique to an art form — every loaf was a meditation. （技艺→艺术）

advancedExpressions.expression: the technique that has served me best is ...
advancedExpressions.example: The technique that has served me best is the 'five-minute rule' — commit to just five minutes and the resistance dissolves. （经验分享）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Her technique was not flashy — there were no unnecessary flourishes, no gestures designed to impress — but every movement was economical and exact, the product of ten thousand hours of practice distilled into a single, perfect motion. Watching her work was like watching water carve a canyon: nothing dramatic, nothing sudden, just the patient accumulation of small, deliberate acts that, over time, achieved what force alone never could. （读后续写·极致技艺·水刻峡谷隐喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 否定描写(not flashy) + 数字夸张(ten thousand hours) + 明喻(like water carve a canyon) + 对比收束(small deliberate acts vs force)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Let me share with you a technique so simple it borders on the obvious — yet so powerful that, if applied consistently, it will transform not just your grades but your relationship with learning itself. The technique is this: after every class, write down one question. Not a summary, not a note — a question. Because a summary is the end of thinking; a question is its beginning. And a mind that has learned to ask good questions is a mind that will never run out of things to discover. （应用文·演讲·提问法）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 对比引导(so simple...yet so powerful) + 核心揭示(not a summary...a question) + 悖论总结(summary is end; question is beginning)

original_sentence: Write short stories using different techniques

classPractice.note: 课件原句 Write short stories using different techniques. using 现在分词短语作方式状语；technique 此处指一个个具体"手法"，可数用复数。

classPractice.question: The course focuses on practical problem-solving and communication ____ (technique) rather than abstract theory. (复数)
classPractice.note: 课件搭配 problem-solving / communication techniques；指多种具体技能/手法，用可数复数。

classPractice.question: Write short stories using different ____ (technique / technology / skill). (每种手法各不相同)

classPractice.question: It took the young pianist ten years to master this difficult ____ (technique / technology).
classPractice.note: "弹奏的具体技法"用 technique（可数）；technology 指整体科技，不指个人操作手法。

classPractice.question: The car was repaired by a skilled ____ (technique) who knew every part of the engine.
classPractice.note: 空处需要"人"，用 technician（技术员）；techn- 词族区分：方法用 technique，人用 technician。

translation: 研讨会，讲习班；车间，作坊
definitionEn:
(1) n. a meeting at which people share ideas and gain practical experience of a subject through discussion and hands-on activities
(2) n. a room or building in which things are made or repaired using tools and machines
(3) vt. to discuss and try out a play, piece of writing, etc. with a group in order to improve it (used especially in theatre and creative writing)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①车间，作坊（制造或修理东西的场所，与"研讨会"义并列）
uncommonMeanings.example: My uncle works in the factory's repair workshop. 我叔叔在工厂的修理车间上班。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（以工作坊形式）集体研讨、打磨（剧本、作品等）
uncommonMeanings.example: The script was workshopped for months before its premiere. 这个剧本首演前被反复集体打磨了好几个月。

readingExamples: Hold workshops to discuss the short stories that club members read and write;

posExamples.sentence: At the carpentry workshop at the end of the lane, Grandpa taught me to sand a rough plank until it shone, saying that patience, like wood, reveals its grain slowly. （读后续写·祖孙情·哲理）
Nervously clutching her first draft, Lily walked into the writing workshop, never suspecting that the strangers in that room would become her fiercest supporters and dearest friends. （读后续写·成长·伏笔）
To sharpen members' writing skills, the club will hold a monthly workshop where short stories are read aloud, discussed in groups and polished under the guidance of our English teachers. （应用文·社团方案）

Compared with traditional lectures, hands-on workshops engage students far more effectively, for knowledge discovered through one's own effort takes deeper root than knowledge merely received. （议论文·教育方式）

wordForms.noun: workshop（研讨会，工作坊；车间，作坊）
wordForms.verb: workshop（vt. 集体研讨打磨作品）
wordForms.other: 构词法·合成词：work（工作）+ shop（店/作坊）→ workshop，本义"干活的作坊"，引申为"边做边学的研讨会/工作坊"。同类合成：bookshop, classroom, blackboard。复数直接加 -s：workshops。重音在前：/ˈwɜːkʃɒp/。

collocations.translation: 举办研讨会/工作坊（做某事）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Hold workshops to discuss the short stories that club members read and write. 举办工作坊，讨论社团成员读写的短篇小说。（课文原句）
The Student Union will hold a workshop on public speaking. 学生会将举办一场演讲研讨会。

collocations.phrase: attend / take part in a workshop
collocations.example: All who attend the workshop will receive a certificate. 所有参加研讨会的人都将获得证书。
A workshop on paper-cutting drew many students. 一场剪纸工作坊吸引了许多学生。
A hands-on workshop lets you make mistakes and learn. 动手工作坊让你在犯错中学习。

collocations.translation: 为期两天的/周末研讨班
collocations.example: The weekend workshop changed how I take photos. 那次周末工作坊改变了我拍照的方式。
The old repair workshop smelled of oil and rubber. 老修理车间满是机油和橡胶味。
At the closing session, workshop participants exchanged contact information, reluctant to let the newly formed friendships fade. （读后续写·聚散）

synonyms.example: The professor's seminar on climate change challenged us to question data rather than simply memorize it. （议论文·学术场景）
synonyms.usage: 更学术化,以专题讨论、发言为主,常见于大学;workshop 强调动手实践与共同产出

synonyms.example: The morning training session left the volunteers exhausted but far more confident about the tasks ahead. （应用文·志愿活动）
synonyms.usage: 泛指一段进行某活动的时间,如 a training session;不像 workshop 那样特指'实践研讨'这种形式

synonyms.example: She signed up for an online course in coding and stuck with it for a whole year, one lesson a night. （读后续写·自律成长）
synonyms.usage: 指系统、连续的系列课程,周期较长;workshop 通常短期、密集、聚焦单一主题

advancedExpressions.expression: hold / run a workshop｜attend a workshop｜a workshop on sth｜a hands-on workshop｜workshop participants
advancedExpressions.example: Hold workshops to discuss the short stories that members write. 举办工作坊讨论成员写的短篇小说。（课文句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: work（工作）+ shop（作坊）= workshop（工作坊/研讨会/车间）；同法：class+room, black+board, book+shop
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a workshop puts hands to work, a hands-on class turns theory into skill. 正如工作坊让人动手，实践课把理论变成技能。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·不定式作目的状语（从课文长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: Hold workshops to discuss ... —— 用 to do 表"举办……以便……"
advancedExpressions.example: We will hold workshops to help members improve their writing. 我们将举办工作坊以帮助成员提高写作。（原句 to discuss 即目的状语）

advancedExpressions.expression: A series of workshops will be organized, covering ...
advancedExpressions.example: A series of interactive workshops will be organized, covering story structure, description and peer editing. （方案类高分句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: It was at that ... workshop that sb. first ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was at that shabby little workshop that I first understood what it meant to create with my own hands. （强调句锁定关键场景）

advancedExpressions.expression: workshops, where theory is put into practice, bridge the gap between ...
advancedExpressions.example: Workshops, where theory is immediately put into practice, bridge the long-lamented gap between knowing and doing — precisely the gap that traditional classrooms so often fail to close. （非限制性定语从句+破折号强调,凸显对比）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We had a workshop and learned a lot.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: By the time the two-hour workshop drew to a close, my notebook was crammed with fresh ideas, my doubts had quietly dissolved, and I found myself already longing for the next session. （读后续写·活动感悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: By the time 时间状语从句 + 三分句排比递进 + 具象细节(notebook crammed with ideas)代替空泛的 learned a lot

sentenceUpgrade.original: The club will hold workshops for students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Tailored to students of different levels, the club's weekly workshops will provide a supportive platform where budding writers can exchange ideas, receive constructive feedback and steadily refine their craft. （应用文·社团介绍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语开头(Tailored to ...) + where 定语从句 + 三动词并列递进(exchange, receive, refine)

translation: adj. 职业的，专业的；有职业的；娴熟的，精通业务的 | n. 专门人员，专业人士
definitionEn:
(1) adj. connected with a job that needs special training or skill
(2) adj. showing that somebody is well trained and extremely skilled
(3) n. a person who does a job that needs special training and a high level of education

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】专家，专业人士（= expert, specialist；受过专门训练、精于某行的人）
uncommonMeanings.example: For a problem this serious, you should consult a professional. 这么严重的问题，你应该请教专家。（professional n. = expert / specialist，课件义项）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①专业人士，专门人员（受过专门训练、从事某职业的人）
uncommonMeanings.example: The professionals were called in after the amateurs had failed. 业余者失败后，专业人士才被请来。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（体育等）职业的（与 amateur"业余的"相对）
uncommonMeanings.example: She became a professional tennis player at eighteen. 她十八岁成为职业网球运动员。

readingExamples: Invite professional writers to give talks on short story writing.

posExamples.sentence: Even in the midst of the crisis — when the client was shouting and the deadline was impossible and every instinct told her to shout back — she remained professional, her voice steady, her logic intact, the calm center of a storm that everyone else was content to be tossed by. （读后续写·职场危机·专业素养）

The professionals were called in only after the amateur efforts had failed — and the speed with which they diagnosed the problem was a humbling reminder that expertise is not a title you give yourself but a standard you reach, often at great and invisible cost. （读后续写·专业vs业余·敬畏）
I have always admired the way you handle feedback with such professional grace — never defensive, always curious about how to improve — and I try to model my own approach after yours. （应用文·赞扬信/致敬）

wordForms.noun: profession（职业，行业）；professional（专业人士）；professor（教授）；professionalism（专业精神，职业素养）
wordForms.other: 构词法·同根 profess-（公开表明）：profession 职业 / professional 专业的·专业人士 / professor 教授 / professionalism 专业素养。形近辨析牢记：profess·or（人·教授）↔ profess·ional（专业的）。前缀 un- 表否定：unprofessional。

collocations.example: He dealt with the problem in a highly professional way. 他处理这个问题非常专业。（课件原句）
The training helped us build solid professional skills. 这次培训帮我们打下了扎实的专业技能。（课件原句词块）
You can't miss this opportunity for professional development. 你一定不能错过这次职业发展的机会。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 专业作家（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Invite professional writers to give talks on short story writing. 邀请专业作家来做短篇小说写作讲座。（课文原句）
He turned professional at seventeen. 他十七岁就转为职业球员。
The school invested heavily in professional training for teachers. 学校在教师专业培训上投入很大。
You'd better seek professional advice first. 你最好先寻求专业建议。
He was a true professional who did the work when no one was watching. 他是个真正的专业人士，无人注视时依然认真做事。

synonyms.translation: 【课件】专家，行家（= professional 作名词义）
synonyms.example: For a problem this serious, you'd better consult an expert. 这么严重的问题，你最好请教专家。
synonyms.usage: 【课件】professional 作名词时义为"专家、专业人士"，可与 expert / specialist 互换。expert 更强调在某领域知识经验深厚（an expert in / on sth.）；professional 更强调"以之为职业、达到专业水准"。

synonyms.translation: 【课件】专家，专门人才（= professional 作名词义）
synonyms.example: The hospital referred him to a specialist in heart disease. 医院把他转诊给了一位心脏病专家。
synonyms.usage: 【课件】professional (n.) = expert = specialist。specialist 强调"专攻某一狭窄领域"的专家（尤指医学、学术）；professional 泛指以此为职业、达专业水准的人。

synonyms.translation: 业余的；业余爱好者（反义/对比词）
synonyms.example: He is only an amateur photographer, not a professional. 他只是业余摄影师，不是专业的。
synonyms.usage: professional 的核心反义词：amateur 指出于爱好、非以此为职、水平未必顶尖；professional 指以此为职业、受过训练、水平高。作形容词时二者常对举：a professional / an amateur player。

synonyms.example: Professor Lin is a professional in linguistics. 林教授是语言学领域的专业人士。
synonyms.usage: 形近易混：professor 是"大学教授"（人、职称）；professional 是"专业的/专业人士"；profession 是"职业"。三词同根 profess-，但含义、词性各不相同，勿张冠李戴。

synonyms.example: She was the most skilled negotiator the firm had ever produced — not because she was aggressive but because she listened with an intensity that made the other side feel, for the first time in any negotiation, genuinely heard. And people, she had discovered, will give you almost anything if you first give them the gift of being understood. （读后续写·谈判高手·倾听的力量）
synonyms.usage: 形容词，侧重实践技能的高水平

advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】profession（职业、专业，名词）+ -al → professional（职业的、专业的，形容词；也作名词"专业人士/专家"）
advancedExpressions.example: The suffix -al turns the noun profession into the adjective professional: a professional does the job of his profession in a professional way. -al 后缀把名词 profession 变成形容词 professional：专业人士以专业的方式做本行的工作。（课件构词点）

advancedExpressions.expression: professional writers｜in a (highly) professional way｜professional skills｜professional development / training｜go / turn professional｜a true professional｜professional (n.) = expert / specialist
advancedExpressions.example: He dealt with the problem in a highly professional way, using the professional skills he had gained through years of professional development. 他凭借多年职业发展积累的专业技能，以非常专业的方式处理了这个问题。（课件词块串联）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（"专业/在行"）
advancedExpressions.expression: be professional｜be an expert (in)｜be skilled / experienced｜know one's stuff｜do sth like a pro（可替换表达枚举，不辨析）
advancedExpressions.example: When it comes to fixing computers, he really knows his stuff. 说到修电脑，他真在行。

advancedExpressions.expression: profession（职业）→ professional（专业的/专业人士）→ professor（教授）→ professionalism（专业精神）
advancedExpressions.example: A professor is not always a professional in business, though highly respected in his profession. 教授在其行业受人尊敬，但未必是商业上的行家。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. was a professional in the truest sense — not because of ... but because ...
advancedExpressions.example: She was a professional in the truest sense — not because of the letters after her name but because she brought the same care to a five-minute call as to a million-dollar contract. （定义专业精神）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. conducts himself/herself with the utmost professionalism
advancedExpressions.example: I have had the pleasure of working with Ms. Chen for three years, and I can say without reservation that she conducts herself with the utmost professionalism — handling pressure with grace, disagreement with respect, and success with the humility of someone who knows that today's achievement is tomorrow's baseline. （推荐信）

advancedExpressions.expression: professional writers｜go / turn professional｜professional development｜professional advice｜a true professional｜with the utmost professionalism
advancedExpressions.example: Invite professional writers to give talks. 邀请专业作家来做讲座。（课文句式）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He was professional in a way that had nothing to do with his title and everything to do with his conduct. When the project collapsed — and it did collapse, spectacularly, in front of the entire board — he did not deflect blame or manufacture excuses. He stood up, acknowledged the failure without flinching, outlined the lessons with the precision of a surgeon, and then — this was the part no one forgot — he thanked his team for their effort, publicly, by name, taking the fall alone while spreading the credit. That, I learned that day, is what professional really means: not the absence of mistakes but the presence of character in their aftermath. （读后续写·项目失败·真正的专业风范）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 否定定义(nothing to do with title, everything to do with conduct) + 场景叙事(collapse, stand up, acknowledge) + 破折号强调(this was the part no one forgot) + 哲理收束(not absence of mistakes but presence of character)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There comes a moment in every ambitious endeavor when enthusiasm is no longer enough — when good intentions collide with hard realities and passion, for all its heat, cannot melt the cold facts of a situation. That is the moment to seek professional help. Not because your own efforts are worthless but because the gap between amateur and professional is not talent — it is time. The professional has made the mistakes you are about to make, has learned the lessons you have yet to encounter, and can save you not from failure but from the kind of failure that teaches nothing. （应用文·演讲/建议·专业的真正价值）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 条件铺垫(There comes a moment...) + 比喻(collide with hard realities, passion cannot melt cold facts) + 核心论点(the gap is not talent — it is time) + 哲理收束(save you from failure that teaches nothing)

classPractice.note: 课件原句：in a (highly) professional way 以（非常）专业的方式；professional development 职业发展。

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·构词）
classPractice.question: Profession（职业）+ -al 构成形容词，修饰名词：He handled everything in a highly ____ (profession) way, using his ____ (profession) skills. (两空填同一形容词)
classPractice.note: 课件构词点 profession + -al → professional；两空均需形容词修饰 way / skills，用 professional。

classPractice.question: Our club plans to invite ____ (profession) writers to give talks on story writing. (专业作家)
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句：修饰 writers 需形容词 professional"专业的"；profession 是名词"职业"，不能作定语。

classPractice.question: Tom is only an ____ (amateur / professional) singer who sings for fun, while his sister has already gone ____ and joined a famous band.
classPractice.note: amateur 业余（出于爱好）↔ professional 职业；go professional = 转为职业。语境"for fun"定 amateur。

classPractice.question: Handling pressure with grace, she always conducts herself with the utmost ____ (professional).
classPractice.note: 介词 with + 名词，表"以极高的专业素养"，用抽象名词 professionalism；勿误填形容词 professional。

translation: n. 材料；素材 | adj. 物质的，实际的；客观存在的
definitionEn:
(1) n. a substance that things can be made from
(2) n. information or ideas used in books, etc.
(3) adj. connected with money and possessions rather than with spiritual or intellectual things
(4) adj. important and needing to be considered

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①布料，衣料（可数/不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: She bought two metres of material to make a dress. 她买了两米布料做裙子。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②素材，题材（写作、创作的内容）
uncommonMeanings.example: The comedian writes her own material. 那位喜剧演员自己写段子（素材）。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③物质的，实际的（与 spiritual"精神的"相对；material world 物质世界）
uncommonMeanings.example: We should not chase only material wealth. 我们不该只追求物质财富。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④重要的，实质性的（正式/法律用语，material to the case 与案件有实质关系）
uncommonMeanings.example: The new evidence was material to the case. 新证据对本案至关重要。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑤合适的人选，可造之才（head teacher material 当班主任的料）
uncommonMeanings.example: The headmaster saw her as head teacher material. 校长看出她是当班主任的料。

readingExamples: I found Maths quite easy and enjoyable because the material was less advanced in the UK than in China.

posExamples.sentence: She gathered her materials with trembling hands — the photographs, the letters tied with a ribbon faded to the color of old ivory, the pressed flower that crumbled to dust at her touch — and placed them in the box that would go to the archive, where private grief would become public history. （读后续写·整理遗物·物与记忆）

He had achieved every material measure of success — the house, the car, the title on the door — and yet he woke every morning with a hunger that none of it could satisfy, a hunger he was too afraid to name because naming it would mean admitting that he had spent thirty years climbing a ladder that was leaning against the wrong wall. （读后续写·物质成功·精神空虚）
I have attached all relevant materials — the survey data, the interview transcripts, and the comparative analysis — for your review before the meeting on Friday. （应用文·正式邮件/汇报）

wordForms.noun: material（材料，素材，布料）；materialism（物质主义，唯物主义）
wordForms.adjective: material（物质的）；immaterial（不重要的；非物质的）
wordForms.other: 构词法·前后缀：mater-（源自"母/本原"）+ -ial 形容词/名词。前缀 im-（否定）→ immaterial 不重要的·非物质的。抽象名词后缀 -ism → materialism；动词后缀 -ize → materialize。物质 material ↔ 精神 spiritual/mental 为常考对举。"素材"义常不可数：write one's own material。

idioms.example: The sculptor saw something in the raw material that no one else could see — not a block of marble but the figure trapped inside it, waiting for someone with enough vision and enough courage to set it free. （读后续写·艺术创作·米开朗基罗式隐喻）

collocations.translation: 教学内容/教材程度较浅（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The material was less advanced in the UK than in China. 英国的（教学）内容比中国的浅。（课文原句，此处 material 指所学课程内容/教材）
The teacher prepared rich teaching materials for the class. 老师为这节课准备了丰富的教学材料。
Cotton is the raw material for these clothes. 棉花是这些衣服的原材料。
They built the shelter from any materials they could find. 他们用能找到的任何材料搭起了棚屋。
He had every material comfort but felt empty. 他物质上一应俱全，内心却空虚。

synonyms.example: The scientist analysed the mysterious substance. 科学家分析了那种神秘物质。
synonyms.usage: 更强调具体的"物质/化学成分"（a chemical substance）；material 更泛，可指材料、素材、布料等。

synonyms.example: The dress was made of soft fabric. 这条裙子是用柔软的织物做的。
synonyms.usage: 指"布料、织物"时与 material 近义；还常喻指社会/关系的"结构"（the fabric of society）。material 语义范围更广。

advancedExpressions.expression: teaching materials｜raw material(s)｜building materials｜material possessions｜material world｜relevant materials
advancedExpressions.example: The material was less advanced in the UK than in China. 英国所学内容比中国的浅。（课文句式）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（"物质 vs 精神"对举）
advancedExpressions.expression: material ↔ spiritual／mental；material wealth ↔ spiritual richness；possessions ↔ inner peace（可替换对举表达，不辨析）
advancedExpressions.example: Material wealth cannot buy spiritual peace. 物质财富买不来内心的安宁。

advancedExpressions.expression: material（材料/物质的）→ immaterial（不重要的）→ materially（实质上）→ materialism（物质主义）→ materialize（实现）
advancedExpressions.example: His dream finally materialized after years of effort. 多年努力后他的梦想终成现实。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. had amassed every material comfort yet found himself/herself ...
advancedExpressions.example: He had amassed every material comfort yet found himself sitting alone in a house full of expensive things. （物质极丰→精神极荒）

advancedExpressions.expression: please find enclosed / attached all materials relevant to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please find attached all materials relevant to the proposal. 随信附上与提案相关的全部资料。

sentenceUpgrade.original: He has a lot of materials.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The materials he had gathered over forty years of research filled an entire room — not neatly, not systematically, but in the organic chaos of a mind that saw connections where others saw only data. There were newspaper clippings yellowed to the color of weak tea, notebooks filled with a handwriting that grew shakier with each passing decade, photographs annotated in three different colors of ink — each color, someone later discovered, corresponding to a different theory he had been testing, theories that had consumed him so completely that his own daughter, when asked what her father did, could only shrug and say, 'He thinks.' And when he died, the materials did not go to a museum; they went to a young researcher who had written him a letter — a single letter, handwritten, asking a question no one else had thought to ask — and in the chaos of that room, she found not just the answer to her question but the seeds of a dozen new ones, planted by a man who had never stopped asking, never stopped gathering, never stopped believing that truth was a mosaic made of fragments, and every fragment mattered. （读后续写·学者一生·材料即生命）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 空间描写(filled an entire room) + 质感细节(yellowed clippings, shaky handwriting, three colors of ink) + 侧面烘托(daughter: 'He thinks') + 传承收束(seeds of a dozen new ones)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I have prepared materials that I hope will do more than inform — they are designed, if I may be so bold, to provoke. Because the purpose of these materials is not to give you answers but to make you uncomfortable with the questions you have not yet asked. I have included, alongside the data, the contradictions in the data. Alongside the conclusions, the assumptions upon which those conclusions rest — assumptions that, if examined too closely, might crumble and take the conclusions with them. Because education, at its best, is not the transfer of material from one mind to another; it is the disturbance of a mind that has grown too comfortable with what it thinks it knows. （应用文·演讲/课程介绍·资料即思辨）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not...but...转折(not inform but provoke) + 对比并置(Alongside the data, the contradictions) + 核心定义(education is not transfer...it is disturbance)

original_sentence: I found Maths quite easy and enjoyable because the material was less advanced in the UK than in China.

classPractice.question: I found Maths quite easy because the ____ (material) was less advanced in the UK than in China.
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句：此处 material 作"所学内容/教材"讲，作主语用单数不可数；勿加 -s。

classPractice.question: True happiness comes from inner peace rather than ____ (material / spiritual) wealth.
classPractice.note: 与 inner peace（精神层面）对举，需"物质的"material；material world / wealth 是常考对比搭配。

classPractice.question: 老师为这节课准备了丰富的教学材料。The teacher prepared rich ____ ____ for the lesson.
