classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件 slide 22 原题③）
classPractice.question: 任何相关人员都没有向媒体发表过言论。____ ____ ____ did anyone involved speak to the press.
classPractice.note: at no time 决不、从不；否定副词短语置于句首，句子部分倒装（did anyone speak）

classPractice.question: 我的语言能力随着时间的推移逐渐提高了。My language skills improved ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；over time 随时间推移、久而久之，作状语

classPractice.question: Please make sure you hand in the report ____ (over time / on time); the deadline is Friday.
classPractice.note: '准时、按期'用 on time；over time 表'渐渐地'，语义不符

classPractice.question: The doctor arrived just ____ (in time / at times) to save the injured child.
classPractice.note: '及时、来得及'用 in time；at times 意为'有时'

translation: 可选择的事物，选择；选修课
definitionEn:
(1) n. something that you can choose to have or do
(2) n. the freedom to choose something
(3) n. a subject that a student can choose to study but that they do not have to do

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】optional 可选择的、选修的（opp. compulsory 必修的）
uncommonMeanings.example: There are many optional courses in my university, as opposed to the compulsory ones everyone must take. 我的大学里有很多选修课，与人人必修的课程相对。（课件 slide 25）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①选修课，选修科目（=optional subject/course）
uncommonMeanings.example: Chinese calligraphy is a popular option among students who love traditional art. 中国书法是热爱传统艺术的学生中很受欢迎的一门选修课。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（商业合同中的）期权，购买权
uncommonMeanings.example: The publisher had an option on her next book — a clause buried in the contract she had signed when she was twenty-three and too eager to read the fine print — and now, at thirty, with a manuscript that was darker and stranger and infinitely better than anything she had written before, she found herself bound to a company that did not understand what she had become. （读后续写·创作者困境·成长的代价）

readingExamples: There were lots of options including bread and butter, chicken pie and puddings, but I still missed my mum's cooking!

posExamples.sentence: She had two options — stay in the town where she had lived her entire life, safe and small and suffocatingly familiar, or take the scholarship to a city she had only seen in photographs, where no one knew her name and every day would be an act of invention. Both options terrified her, but one terror felt like a cage and the other felt like a door. （读后续写·人生抉择·两种恐惧）

I chose photography as my optional subject not because I had any talent — my first roll of film came back with thirty-six variations of blur — but because I wanted to learn to see, really see, the world around me rather than just look at it. （读后续写·选课动机·看见vs看）

After careful consideration, I have decided that the best option is to postpone the event to next month — not because we are not ready but because an event rushed is an event compromised, and I would rather deliver quality late than mediocrity on time. （应用文·决策说明/通知）

wordForms.verb: opt（选择；opt for 选择 / opt to do 选择做 / opt out 退出）
wordForms.adjective: optional（可选的，选修的；反义 compulsory 必修的、强制的）
wordForms.other: 词族：名词 option — 动词 opt — 形容词 optional — 副词 optionally。记忆点：optional（选修的）↔ compulsory/required（必修的）为一对反义；短语 opt for=choose，opt out=退出

idioms.translation: 保留选择余地，不急于决定
idioms.example: She kept her options open until the very last day — not out of indecision but out of the belief that the right choice, when it presented itself, would feel less like a calculation and more like a recognition, as if she were not choosing a path but remembering one she had always been meant to walk. （读后续写·延迟决定·直觉大于算计）

With the bridge washed out and the storm intensifying, they had no option but to take shelter in the abandoned cabin — a decision that felt, at the time, like desperation but would later reveal itself, in the strange logic of fate, as the first link in a chain of events that would save their lives. （读后续写·被迫选择·命运的伪装）

collocations.phrase: have the option of doing / to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】可以做……的选择，有做……的选择权
collocations.example: Students have the option of studying abroad in their second year. (= have the option to study abroad) 学生在第二年可以选择出国留学。（课件 slide 24）

collocations.phrase: have no option but to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】别无选择，只好做某事（= have no choice but to do；= had to do）
collocations.example: I had no option but to ask him to leave. (= I had to ask him to leave.) 我别无选择，只好请他离开。（课件 slide 24；but 后接带 to 不定式）

collocations.phrase: have no choice but to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】别无选择只好做某事（= have no option but to do）
collocations.example: With the last bus gone, they had no choice but to walk home. 末班车已开走，他们别无选择只好走回家。（课件 slide 24；对比 can do nothing but do 有 do 无 to）

collocations.translation: 【课件】走捷径，选择轻松（省事）的做法
collocations.example: He decided to take the easy option and give them what they wanted. 他决定走捷径，满足他们的要求。（课件 slide 25）
There are many optional courses in my university; the opposite are compulsory courses. 我的大学有很多选修课；与之相反的是必修课。（课件 slide 25）

collocations.translation: 许多选择（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: There were lots of options including bread and butter, chicken pie and puddings, but I still missed my mum's cooking! 有很多选择，包括面包配黄油、鸡肉派和布丁，但我还是想念妈妈的手艺！（课文原句）

Online learning was the only viable option during the lockdown — not ideal, not preferred, but viable — and the teachers who had never taught through a screen before became, in the space of a month, filmmakers and editors and digital community-builders, proving that necessity is not just the mother of invention; she is also the mother of reinvention. （应用文·教育报道/读后续写·疫情教学·重塑自我）

Before committing to a university, she spent a year exploring her options — not traveling, as her wealthier classmates did, but working three jobs in three different fields, learning not what she wanted to do but who she wanted to be, which was a far harder and more important question. （读后续写·间隔年·从做什么到成为谁）

When given the choice between the safe, predictable path and the one that led through shadows and uncertain ground, she opted for the shadows — not because she was reckless but because the safe path had been walked by everyone she knew, and not one of them had ever come back with a story worth telling. （读后续写·选择冒险·追寻意义）

Rather than take the bus as she had every morning for three years, she opted to walk that day — a decision that added forty minutes to her journey but also added, entirely by accident, an encounter with an old man feeding pigeons in the park who would turn out to be the retired professor whose recommendation letter would change the direction of her life. （读后续写·偶然相遇·命运的散步）

Three members of the team opted out of the project at the last minute — and while their departure felt like a betrayal at first, the three who stayed discovered, in the urgency of making up for lost manpower, a resourcefulness they had never known they possessed. （读后续写·团队危机·化损为机）

I would like to recommend that the school make the creative writing workshop a permanent optional course — not an afterthought squeezed into lunch breaks but a proper class with its own slot in the timetable, because in an education system that often prioritizes the measurable over the meaningful, a space for imagination is not a luxury; it is a necessity. （应用文·建议信·教育理念）

collocations.translation: 某事是可选的/非强制的
collocations.example: Attendance at the workshop is optional, but I would encourage everyone to come — not because I want to fill seats but because the speaker, a journalist who has reported from seventeen conflict zones, will talk about things that cannot be found in any textbook, and some lessons are too important to be made compulsory. （应用文·通知/邀请·柔性说服）

synonyms.example: You have two options / choices: stay or leave. 你有两个选择：留下或离开。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：二者常可互换，均指'可供挑选的事物'。细分：choice 最常用、最口语，兼指'选择的行为/权利/被选中之物'（have no choice 别无选择）；option 更正式、更中性，强调'一个具体可选项'，常用复数 options 并配 explore/consider/weigh；固定短语区分：have no choice but to do（choice 无 s）≈ have no option but to do（option 无 s），二者可换但不可混拼

synonyms.example: The alternative — staying in a school that was slowly killing her spirit, one standardized test at a time — was, when she finally allowed herself to name it, not an option at all. And so she left, not running away from something but running toward the possibility of an education that felt less like a cage and more like a conversation. （读后续写·逃离教育体制·寻找真正的学习）
synonyms.usage: 强调另一个可替代的选择，常用于对比两个方案

advancedExpressions.expression: have the option of doing / to do 可以做……的选择 / have no option but to do = have no choice but to do 别无选择只好做 / take the easy(soft) option 走捷径 / optional (opp. compulsory) 选修的(必修的) / can do nothing but do sth（有 do 无 to）
advancedExpressions.example: Having no option but to stay, she took the easy option and picked the optional course everyone else had chosen. 别无选择只能留下，她走了捷径，选了别人都选的那门选修课。（一句串起 option 短语群）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·have no option/choice but to do（but 后接带 to 不定式）
advancedExpressions.expression: have no option but to do sth = have no choice but to do sth 别无选择只能做某事；此处 but 意为'除……之外'，后接带 to 的不定式（区别于 can do nothing but do 中的省 to）
advancedExpressions.example: With the bridge washed away, they had no option but to turn back. 桥被冲毁，他们别无选择只能折返。（易错：but to turn，不可写成 but turn；对比 can do nothing but turn back）

advancedExpressions.expression: have no option but to do 别无选择只能 / keep one's options open 保留选择余地 / a viable option 可行的选择 / opt for sth 选择 / opt to do sth 选择做 / opt out of sth 退出 / an optional course 选修课
advancedExpressions.example: She kept her options open, then finally opted for the course that had no option to drop. 她先保留选择余地，最终选了那门无法退选的课。（option 名词与 opt 动词连用）

advancedExpressions.expression: faced with two options — ... or ... — sb. chose neither and instead ...
advancedExpressions.example: Faced with two options — the prestigious university her parents had dreamed of or the local college her budget could afford — she chose neither and instead applied for a scholarship to study abroad, a third option that had seemed, until she made it real, like a fantasy. And that decision — to refuse the binary, to insist that the world contained more than two paths — became the template for how she would live the rest of her life. （拒绝二元选择→创造第三种可能→人生模板）

advancedExpressions.expression: in my opinion, the best option would be to ...
advancedExpressions.example: In my opinion, the best option would be to pilot the program with a small group before rolling it out school-wide — not because I doubt its value but because a pilot allows us to learn from mistakes that, at a smaller scale, are lessons rather than crises. （建议报告/决策分析）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He had no other option — or so he told himself, because it was easier to believe that choice was an illusion than to admit that he had chosen, actively and deliberately, to take the harder path. The army had not drafted him; he had enlisted. The dangerous assignment had not been forced upon him; he had volunteered. And sitting in the darkness now, a long way from home, with the sound of something that might have been thunder or might have been artillery rumbling in the distance, he made peace with the truth: he had always had options. He had simply chosen the one that allowed him to look at himself in the mirror. And if that choice cost him his safety, his comfort, perhaps eventually his life — well, safety and comfort were not the currencies in which he measured a life well-lived. （读后续写·选择vs别无选择·军人的自我认知）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 自我欺骗揭示(or so he told himself) + 对比纠正(army had not drafted him; he had enlisted) + 环境呼应(thunder or artillery) + 价值观声明(safety and comfort were not the currencies in which he measured a life well-lived)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I want to tell you something that no one told me when I was your age, something it took me twenty years to learn: you have options. Always. Even when it feels like you don't — especially when it feels like you don't — there is a door you have not noticed, a path you have not considered, a third answer to a question that has been presented to you as a choice between only two. The world is larger than the choices it offers you, and the most important skill you can develop is not the ability to choose wisely among the options you are given but the courage to look beyond them and ask, 'What option am I not seeing?' （应用文·演讲·选项的想象力）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 延迟揭示(it took me twenty years to learn) + 排比(a door, a path, a third answer) + 核心定义(not choosing wisely among given options but asking what option am I not seeing)

original_sentence: There were lots of options including bread and butter, chicken pie and puddings, but I still missed my mum's cooking!

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件 slide 24）
classPractice.question: 学生在第二年可以选择出国留学。Students ____ ____ ____ ____ studying abroad in their second year.（= have the option to study abroad）
classPractice.note: have the option of doing = have the option to do 可以做……的选择

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件 slide 24）
classPractice.question: 我别无选择，只好请他离开。I had ____ ____ ____ ____ ask him to leave.（= I had to ask him to leave）
classPractice.note: have no option but to do = have no choice but to do 别无选择只好做；but 后接带 to 不定式

classPractice.type: 语境应用·单句语法填空（课件 slide 25）
classPractice.question: There are many ____ (option) courses in my university, as opposed to the compulsory ones.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 courses 需形容词 optional 选修的；反义为 compulsory 必修的

classPractice.question: 有很多选择，包括面包配黄油、鸡肉派和布丁。There were lots of ____ including bread and butter, chicken pie and puddings.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；lots of 后接可数名词复数 options

classPractice.question: 末班车已开走，我们别无选择只能走回家。With the last bus gone, we had no ____ but ____ ____ home.
classPractice.note: have no option but to do 别无选择只能做；but 后接带 to 不定式

classPractice.question: Chinese calligraphy is one of the ____ (option) courses; it is not compulsory.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 courses 需形容词 optional 选修的；由 not compulsory 反证

definitionEn:
(1) n. a soft yellow food made from cream, which people spread on bread or use in cooking
(2) n. a soft paste made by crushing a particular nut or bean (peanut butter 花生酱)
(3) v. to spread butter on bread, toast, etc.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①在……上涂黄油（动词用法，教材只给名词义；butter up sb 奉承讨好）
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandma buttered a thick slice of home-made bread and slid it across the table without a word — her quiet way of saying that everything would be all right. （读后续写·亲情·无声的安慰）

readingExamples: There were lots of options including bread and butter, chicken pie and puddings, but I still missed my mum's cooking!

posExamples.sentence: The kitchen smelled of melted butter and warm flour as Mum flipped pancakes at the stove, and for one golden moment all my worries about the coming exam simply dissolved. （读后续写·家庭温情·嗅觉描写）
For our cooking workshop next Friday, please bring some flour, two eggs and a small box of butter, and our foreign teacher will show us how to bake traditional British scones. （应用文·活动通知）
Nutritionists point out that replacing butter with plant-based oils, though seemingly a trivial change, can make a measurable difference to one's long-term heart health. （议论文·健康饮食）

wordForms.verb: butter (同形动词:涂黄油;butter up 奉承)
wordForms.other: 小贴士：butter 作'黄油'为不可数名词，无复数，计量用 a knob/pat/piece of butter 或 some butter；不可说 a butter / two butters。名词、动词同形

idioms.example: Tom spent the whole morning buttering up his sister — doing the dishes and praising her cooking — in the hope that she would lend him her new camera for the weekend. （读后续写·兄妹日常·幽默）

idioms.translation: 生计,主要收入来源;(喻)最基本、最重要的东西
idioms.example: For most families in the fishing village, the sea has always been their bread and butter, which explains why they fought so fiercely against the polluting factory. （议论文·环保与民生）

idioms.idiom: look as if butter wouldn't melt in one's mouth
idioms.translation: 装得天真无辜、一本正经
idioms.example: Standing before the teacher, Jack looked as if butter wouldn't melt in his mouth, yet the streaks of blue paint on his fingers told quite a different story. （读后续写·孩童恶作剧·反差刻画）

idioms.idiom: know which side one's bread is buttered (on)
idioms.translation: 清楚自己的利益所在,会看风向
idioms.example: The new assistant knew perfectly well which side his bread was buttered, so he greeted every regular customer with the warmest smile in town. （读后续写·人物刻画）

collocations.translation: 面包配黄油；（喻）生计，谋生之本（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: There were lots of options including bread and butter, chicken pie and puddings, but I still missed my mum's cooking! 有很多选择，包括面包配黄油、鸡肉派和布丁，但我还是想念妈妈的手艺！（课文原句）
Humming an old tune, Dad spread butter on the toast so generously that it glistened like morning sunlight, and the whole kitchen seemed warmer for it. （读后续写·清晨餐桌·细节描写）
First melt the butter in a pan over gentle heat, then stir in the flour little by little — that, our cookery teacher insists, is the secret of a smooth sauce. （应用文·食谱/流程说明）

collocations.translation: 一小块黄油（butter 不可数，用量词计量）
collocations.example: The recipe calls for just a knob of butter at the end, yet it is that final touch that gives the dish its rich, comforting flavour. （应用文·食谱介绍）
Nothing cheered up little Amy like a peanut butter sandwich, so Mum always tucked one into her schoolbag on rainy mornings. （读后续写·童年细节）
The recipe recommends unsalted butter, which allows beginners to control the flavour of the biscuits far more precisely. （应用文·食谱说明）

synonyms.example: Some families choose margarine instead of butter for health or budget reasons, though many bakers insist that nothing matches the taste of real butter. （议论文·饮食比较）
synonyms.usage: margarine 是植物油制成的黄油替代品;butter 由奶油制成,口感更醇厚。二者外形相似但原料不同

synonyms.example: She stirred a spoonful of cream into the soup, and its plain taste turned instantly silky and rich. （读后续写·烹饪细节）
synonyms.usage: cream 是牛奶上层的液态奶油,也是制作 butter 的原料;butter 是固体涂抹食品,不能混用

advancedExpressions.expression: sth is the bread and butter of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Patience and daily practice are the bread and butter of language learning — glamorous shortcuts simply do not exist. （借习语 bread and butter 喻"根本",破折号断言收尾,论证干脆有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: look as if butter wouldn't melt in one's mouth
advancedExpressions.example: The little girl folded her hands and looked as if butter wouldn't melt in her mouth, though the empty biscuit tin behind her said otherwise. （习语+反差细节,一句写活"表面乖巧"）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Mum gave me bread and butter for breakfast.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Breakfast was nothing fancy — just thick slices of bread with butter melting into every corner — yet the familiar smell wrapped around me like Mum's own arms, steadying me for the long day ahead. （读后续写·以食物写亲情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 先抑后扬(nothing fancy — yet) + 细节特写(melting into every corner) + 明喻(like Mum's own arms) + 现在分词收尾(steadying me)

original_sentence: There were lots of options including bread and butter, chicken pie and puddings, but I still missed my mum's cooking!

classPractice.question: 有很多选择，包括面包配黄油、鸡肉派和布丁。There were lots of options including ____ and ____, chicken pie and puddings.
classPractice.note: 课文原句搭配 bread and butter 面包配黄油；两词均不可数

classPractice.question: For the fishermen, the sea is their ____ and butter — it is how they earn their living.
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义：bread and butter 喻'生计、谋生之本'

definitionEn:
(1) n. (BrE) the sweet course eaten at the end of a meal; dessert
(2) n. a hot sweet dish made from flour, milk and eggs, often served with a sauce (e.g. Christmas pudding)
(3) n. (BrE) a dish of flour or batter cooked with meat inside or alongside (e.g. steak and kidney pudding, Yorkshire pudding)
(4) n. (AmE) a soft, creamy cold dessert made with milk

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（英式）饭后甜点（这道程序的统称，=dessert；for pudding 作甜点）
uncommonMeanings.example: What's for pudding today? 今天甜点吃什么？

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②(英式)咸味的"布丁"类菜肴,并非甜点 — 如 Yorkshire pudding 约克郡布丁(配烤牛肉的烤面糊)、black pudding 血肠
uncommonMeanings.example: To Lin Hui's astonishment, the Yorkshire pudding on his plate turned out to be no dessert at all, but a golden, hollow puff waiting to soak up the gravy of the roast beef. （读后续写·留学餐桌·文化冲击）

readingExamples: There were lots of options including bread and butter, chicken pie and puddings, but I still missed my mum's cooking!

posExamples.sentence: Staring at the wobbly pudding on his dinner tray, Wang Lei suddenly ached for his mother's steamed buns, and the noisy school dining hall seemed to fall strangely quiet around him. （读后续写·思乡·以物寄情）

Do save room for the Christmas pudding at our International Food Festival next Friday — we have followed an authentic British recipe, and I promise its rich, fruity flavour will not disappoint you. （应用文·邀请信）
Small as it may seem, the pudding that rounds off a traditional British meal shows how deeply everyday food rituals are woven into a nation's cultural identity. （议论文·饮食文化）

idioms.idiom: the proof of the pudding is in the eating
idioms.translation: 实践出真知;好坏一试便知
idioms.example: As for whether the new study plan can really reduce our burden, the proof of the pudding is in the eating — let us try it for a month before we draw any conclusions. （议论文·实践检验）
His apology started off sincere, but by the fifth extravagant compliment he had clearly over-egged the pudding, and Sarah's smile began to cool. （读后续写·人际分寸·幽默）

collocations.translation: 鸡肉派和布丁（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: There were lots of options including bread and butter, chicken pie and puddings, but I still missed my mum's cooking! 有很多选择，包括面包配黄油、鸡肉派和布丁，但我还是想念妈妈的手艺！（课文原句）
Following tradition, Grandma hid a shiny coin inside the Christmas pudding, and the children dug in eagerly, each hoping to be the lucky one. （读后续写·节日习俗·童趣）
The canteen's rice pudding, warm and faintly sweet, was the one dish that reminded the homesick exchange students of their childhood suppers. （读后续写·细节描写）
Before he had even finished his vegetables, little Tom was already asking what was for pudding, making everyone at the table burst out laughing. （读后续写·餐桌对话·童趣）

collocations.translation: 黄油面包布丁(英国传统甜点)
collocations.example: The cookery club's bread and butter pudding, baked from yesterday's leftover loaf, proved that thrift and deliciousness can happily live side by side. （应用文·活动报道·节约主题）

synonyms.example: The restaurant is famous for its desserts, from silky cheesecakes to fruit tarts that look almost too pretty to eat. （应用文·推荐介绍）
synonyms.usage: 通用词,正式菜单和美式英语常用;pudding 是英式日常口语对"饭后甜点"这道程序的统称,也指具体的布丁类点心

synonyms.example: After the roast, the waiter came round to ask whether we would like a sweet to finish off the meal. （记叙·就餐场景）
synonyms.usage: 英式非正式说法,相当于 pudding/dessert;另有"糖果"义。正式程度最低

advancedExpressions.expression: The proof of the pudding is in the eating — ...
advancedExpressions.example: The proof of the pudding is in the eating — however promising a policy sounds on paper, its true worth is revealed only when it is put into practice. （谚语开篇+however 让步,增强说服力与文采）

advancedExpressions.expression: Do save room for ... — I promise ... will not disappoint you.
advancedExpressions.example: Do save room for the home-made pudding at the end of the evening — I promise its warm, gentle sweetness will not disappoint you. （do 强调式祈使+破折号承诺,给邀请信增添热情与人情味）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: One spoonful of the warm pudding, and the sweetness spread slowly across my tongue — rich, comforting, and so much like home that I closed my eyes without meaning to. （读后续写·味觉描写+情感联结）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: One spoonful..., and... 以小动作开启画面 + 三项形容词递进(rich, comforting, like home) + 无意识动作(closed my eyes without meaning to)含蓄传情

original_sentence: There were lots of options including bread and butter, chicken pie and puddings, but I still missed my mum's cooking!

classPractice.question: 有很多选择，包括面包配黄油、鸡肉派和布丁。There were lots of options including bread and butter, chicken pie and ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；此处泛指多种布丁/甜点，用复数 puddings

classPractice.question: In Britain, people often ask 'What's for ____ (pudding / soup)?' meaning the sweet course after the main meal.
classPractice.note: 英式英语中 pudding 泛指'饭后甜点'（=dessert）

translation: 吸引，使喜爱；招引；引起（反应）
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to make somebody/something come somewhere or take part in something
(2) vt. to make somebody feel interested in something or have romantic feelings for somebody
(3) vt. to cause a particular reaction

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（物理）吸引（引力/磁力作用；反义 repel 排斥）
uncommonMeanings.example: A magnet attracts iron and steel. 磁铁吸引铁和钢。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②招引，引起（反应/批评/关注等，attract criticism/attention）
uncommonMeanings.example: His rude remark attracted a storm of criticism online. 他无礼的言论在网上招来一片批评。

readingExamples: The one that attracted me most was the Rugby Club.

posExamples.sentence: What attracted her to the old bookstore was not the books — there were books everywhere — but the silence, a particular quality of silence that felt less like absence and more like presence, as if all the stories on all the shelves were breathing quietly, waiting. （读后续写·被安静吸引·书店氛围）

The event attracted over three hundred students — a number that exceeded our expectations and confirmed, I believe, that there is a genuine hunger in this school for conversations that go beyond the curriculum. （应用文·活动报告·反响热烈）

His unconventional teaching methods attracted criticism from the more traditional members of the faculty — criticism he accepted with the equanimity of someone who had long ago decided that being understood by everyone was a far less worthy goal than being effective for someone. （读后续写·创新引来批评·坚守信念）

wordForms.other: 词族：动词 attract — 名词 attraction（可数=景点 a tourist attraction；不可数=吸引力）— 形容词 attractive — 副词 attractively。派生记忆点：tourist attraction 旅游景点，是 attraction 的高频具体义

idioms.example: They said opposites attract, and perhaps they were right — she was chaos and he was order, she was impulse and he was deliberation, she was the storm and he was the shelter — but what the proverb forgot to mention was that opposites attract and then drive each other mad, and the art of their marriage was learning to be grateful for the madness. （读后续写·性格差异夫妻·相爱容易相处难）

collocations.translation: 【课件】引起某人对……的好感；把某人吸引到……
collocations.example: What attracted me to her was her big eyes. 吸引我（对她产生好感）的是她的大眼睛。（课件 slide 28 原题答案）

collocations.translation: 【课件】被……吸引（被动，介词用 by 强调施动者）
collocations.example: I was attracted by her big eyes. 我被她的大眼睛吸引。（课件 slide 28 原题答案）

collocations.translation: 【课件】adj. 有吸引力的；对……有吸引力
collocations.example: The offer was very attractive to young graduates looking for their first job. 对找第一份工作的年轻毕业生来说，这个职位很有吸引力。（课件 slide 29）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对某人（没什么）吸引力（attraction n. 吸引力）
collocations.example: City life holds little attraction for me. 城市生活对我没什么吸引力。（课件 slide 29）

collocations.translation: 【课件】旅游胜地，旅游景点（attraction 可数具体义）
collocations.example: The ancient town has become one of the country's most popular tourist attractions. 这座古镇已成为全国最热门的旅游景点之一。（课件 slide 29）

collocations.phrase: the one that attracted me most
collocations.translation: 最吸引我的那一个（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The one that attracted me most was the Rugby Club. 最吸引我的是橄榄球俱乐部。（课文原句；先行词 the one 含最高级 most 语境，只能用 that，见语法点）

collocations.translation: 被某人/某物所吸引（被动，介词用 to）
collocations.example: She was strongly attracted to the idea of studying abroad. 出国留学的想法深深吸引了她。

Her painting did not attract attention at first — it was small, and hung in a corner, and the colors were too subtle for a world that preferred its art loud — but the people who noticed it could not look away, and those people told other people, and slowly, the way a secret becomes a story, the painting became the reason people came to the gallery. （读后续写·慢热型成功·宁静的力量）

The article attracted a storm of criticism — some of it fair, much of it not — and in the eye of that storm, she discovered who her real friends were: the ones who disagreed with her and still stood by her, proving that loyalty and agreement are not the same thing. （读后续写·争议中见真情）
Every spring the ancient town attracts thousands of visitors eager to see its blossoming courtyards. 每年春天，这座古镇都吸引成千上万游客前来观赏繁花庭院。

synonyms.example: The idea of a gap year appealed to her — not the Instagram version of gap years, all beaches and selfies, but the idea of a year spent doing something real, something hard, something that would change the shape of her understanding before she committed to four more years of classrooms. （读后续写·间隔年的真正吸引力·成长）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：appeal to sb 强调'投合心意、令人感兴趣'，主语常为物/主意，需带介词 to（区别于 appeal to sb for help 呼吁）；attract 语义更广，可指物理吸引、招引游客、引起反应，宾语后不加介词（attract sb, be attracted to sb）

synonyms.example: The music drew people from their tents — a slow, mournful violin that seemed to have been composed by the desert itself — and by the time the last note faded, a circle of strangers had formed, drawn together by a melody that needed no language, no introduction, no explanation. （读后续写·音乐聚集陌生人·艺术的力量）
synonyms.usage: 更有画面感的「牵引」动作，适合文学描写

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·唯一/全部先行词只用that（课件 slide 26-27）
advancedExpressions.expression: 先行词指物且带'唯一、全部'概念时，定语从句关系词只能用 that，不用 which。触发词：the only / the very(正是的) / the right(恰当的) / the last / the + 序数词 / the + 最高级 / all / every(thing) / any(thing) / nothing / none / no / few / little 等。课文原句 The one that attracted me most was ... 中 the one 受 most 修饰，故只能用 that。
advancedExpressions.example: In China, parents always do everything that they can to support their children; I did nothing that might hurt you; it was the largest map that I ever saw. 在中国，父母总是竭尽全力支持孩子；我没做任何可能伤害你的事；那是我见过的最大的地图。（everything / nothing / 最高级先行词均只用 that）

advancedExpressions.expression: attract sb to sb/sth 引起某人对……的好感 / be attracted by 被……吸引 / attractive、be attractive to 有吸引力的、对……有吸引力 / attraction、hold attraction for sb 吸引力、对某人有吸引力 / tourist attraction 旅游景点
advancedExpressions.example: What attracted me to the town was its charm; it is so attractive to travellers that its tourist attractions hold endless attraction for them. 吸引我喜欢上这座小镇的是它的魅力；它对游客极有吸引力，那些景点对他们有着无穷的吸引力。（一句串起 attract/attractive/attraction）

advancedExpressions.expression: attract sb's attention 引起某人注意 / be attracted to sb/sth 被……吸引 / attract tourists 吸引游客 / a tourist attraction 旅游景点 / an attractive offer 诱人的提议 / hold great attraction for sb 对某人有很大吸引力
advancedExpressions.example: The old town attracts tourists because it is genuinely attractive, not because it advertises its attractions. 这座古镇吸引游客，是因为它本身有魅力，而非靠宣传景点。（一句串起 attract/attractive/attraction）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·被吸引的瞬间
advancedExpressions.expression: sb. was drawn / attracted not by ... but by ...
advancedExpressions.example: She was attracted not by his achievements — impressive though they were — but by the way he spoke about his failures: without shame, without excuse, as if every misstep had been a teacher and he, for all his success, was still and would always be a student. （被对待失败的态度吸引→终身学习者）

advancedExpressions.expression: the goal is to attract participants / attention by ...
advancedExpressions.example: The goal of the campaign is to attract participants not through flashy promises but through genuine testimonials from students whose lives were changed by the program — because the best marketing, I believe, is not persuasion but testimony. （活动策划方案）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She attracted attention — not the kind she had sought as a teenager, the attention that came from being loud and reckless and impossible to ignore, but a quieter kind, the attention that gathered around her like mist around a mountain: slowly, naturally, the inevitable consequence of being someone who did not try to be noticed and was, paradoxically, impossible to overlook. The teachers noticed her not because she raised her hand the most but because when she did, the question was always the one everyone else had been afraid to ask. The students noticed her not because she was popular but because she was present — truly, fully present — in a way that made the person she was talking to feel, for the duration of that conversation, like the only person in the world. And that, she discovered, was the secret of attraction: not the pursuit of attention but the cultivation of a self worth attending to. （读后续写·真正的吸引力·从追逐关注到成为值得关注的人）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 对比(not attention she had sought as teenager but quieter kind) + 明喻(like mist around a mountain) + 具体展开(teachers noticed...because; students noticed...because) + 哲理收束(secret of attraction: not pursuit of attention but cultivation of a self worth attending to)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We need to attract more students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The question I want us to consider today is not 'How do we attract more students?' — a question that leads, inevitably, to gimmicks and giveaways and the kind of short-term thinking that produces long-term mediocrity. The better question is: 'What kind of education would make students feel that staying away is a loss?' When the product is genuinely excellent, attraction is not a strategy; it is a byproduct. So let us focus not on attracting more students but on becoming the kind of institution that students are attracted to — not by our marketing but by our substance, not by our promises but by our results. （应用文·教育演讲·从营销到本质）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 问题转化(not 'how to attract' but 'what kind of education') + 对比(attraction as strategy vs attraction as byproduct) + 排比对照(not by marketing but by substance, not by promises but by results)

definitionEn:
(1) n. a game played by two teams with an oval ball, which players kick, pass backwards or carry, trying to touch it down behind the other team's goal line
(2) n. the sport exists in two forms — Rugby Union (15 players a side) and Rugby League (13 players a side); it takes its name from Rugby School in England, where it was first played in the 1820s
readingExamples: The one that attracted me most was the Rugby Club.

posExamples.sentence: Mud-splattered and gasping, Kevin clutched the rugby ball to his chest and charged towards the try line, the roar of the crowd pounding in his ears like a second heartbeat. （读后续写·赛场冲刺·感官描写）

Our school rugby club, which warmly welcomes beginners of all levels, meets every Friday afternoon on the playground, so come along and experience the teamwork this thrilling sport has to offer. （应用文·社团招新启事）
What rugby teaches its young players — discipline, courage and absolute trust in one's teammates — often proves far more valuable than the final score itself. （议论文·体育育人）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：rugby 是不可数名词，作运动名称，前不加冠词、不加复数（play rugby，非 ❌a rugby / rugbies）；同类球类运动名（football, basketball, tennis）皆如此。词源专有名词：得名于英格兰 Rugby School（拉格比公学），故有些语境首字母大写 Rugby

collocations.translation: 橄榄球俱乐部（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The one that attracted me most was the Rugby Club. 最吸引我的是橄榄球俱乐部。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 打橄榄球（球类运动前不加冠词，rugby 不可数）
collocations.example: Tom had never played rugby before coming to the UK, but by the end of term he could hardly imagine a Friday afternoon without it. （记叙·留学生活）
The whole school turned out to watch the final rugby match, their scarves and banners turning the cold stands into a sea of colour. （读后续写·赛场氛围·环境描写）
Joining the rugby club, I soon discovered, was less about winning than about learning to trust the fourteen people running beside you. （记叙·社团感悟）

collocations.translation: 橄榄球运动员/橄榄球场
collocations.example: Overnight rain had turned the rugby pitch into a field of mud, yet not a single player slowed his pace. （读后续写·环境烘托）

collocations.translation: 联合会式/联盟式橄榄球(两种正式形式)
collocations.example: Most British students will happily explain the difference between rugby union and rugby league to any curious foreign visitor. （说明·文化介绍）

collocations.translation: 橄榄球式飞身擒抱(某人)
collocations.example: Without a second thought, the shop owner rugby-tackled the fleeing thief and pinned him to the pavement until the police arrived. （读后续写·见义勇为·动作描写）

synonyms.example: American football players wear helmets and heavy padding, while rugby players take the field with little more than a mouthguard. （说明·体育文化比较）
synonyms.usage: 中文"橄榄球"涵盖两者:rugby 源于英国,防护装备少、比赛连续进行;American football 源于美国,装备厚重、按回合推进。教材语境(英国中学)指 rugby

advancedExpressions.example: Our rugby club, which welcomes beginners of all levels, meets every Friday afternoon — come along and experience the teamwork this thrilling sport has to offer. （非限定性定语从句+祈使句呼吁,招新启事高分框架）

advancedExpressions.expression: What ... teaches ... often proves far more valuable than ...
advancedExpressions.example: What rugby teaches its players — grit, cooperation and grace in defeat — often proves far more valuable than any trophy. （what 主语从句+破折号三项插入,升华体育的育人价值）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: On the rugby pitch he was a different boy altogether — dodging, sprinting, shrugging off tackles — as if all the words he never said in class had finally found a way out. （读后续写·人物弧光·动作描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: a different boy altogether 前后对比刻画 + 三个现在分词构成连贯动作链 + as if 虚拟语气深入人物内心

definitionEn:
(1) n. the art of producing beautiful handwriting with a brush or a special pen
(2) n. beautiful handwriting itself, especially when displayed or collected as a work of art
readingExamples: Chinese Calligraphy is one of the many optional courses offered to students who are interested in traditional art.

posExamples.sentence: Grandfather's wrist hovered above the rice paper; then, in one unbroken breath, the brush swept down, and the calligraphy that bloomed beneath it seemed to hold all his eighty years of quiet patience. （读后续写·祖孙传承·细节特写）

I am writing to invite you to the calligraphy workshop our school is holding next Sunday, where you can pick up a brush yourself and feel how each stroke carries the rhythm of Chinese culture. （应用文·邀请信）
In an age when keyboards have all but replaced handwriting, calligraphy reminds us that writing can be not merely a tool of communication but an art of self-cultivation. （议论文·传统文化的现代价值）
Her hand trembled as she dipped the brush in ink, but the moment it met the paper, years of calligraphy practice took over and every stroke fell exactly where it belonged. （读后续写·比赛·由紧张到从容）

wordForms.other: 构词法·-graphy（书写、记录、图）家族：calligraphy 书法（calli- 美 + -graphy 书写=“美的书写”）/ geography 地理（geo- 地）/ photography 摄影（photo- 光）/ biography 传记（bio- 生命）/ autobiography 自传。书法家用 -grapher：calligrapher；对应形容词 -graphic：calligraphic。小贴士：calligraphy 作'书法(艺术)'不可数，一幅作品用 a piece/work of calligraphy

collocations.translation: 中国书法（一门选修课）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Chinese Calligraphy is one of the many optional courses offered to students who are interested in traditional art. 中国书法是提供给对传统艺术感兴趣的学生的众多选修课之一。（课文原句）
At the international culture fair, the Chinese calligraphy booth drew the longest queue, with foreign visitors waiting patiently to have their names written in flowing ink. （应用文·活动报道）
Practising calligraphy for half an hour every evening, my grandfather says, does for the mind what jogging does for the body. （夹叙夹议·养心之道）
She held the calligraphy brush upright, just as Master Zhang had taught her, and let her breathing slow before attempting the first stroke. （读后续写·动作细节）

collocations.translation: 一幅书法作品（calligraphy 不可数，用 a piece/work of 计量）
collocations.example: Hanging in the school hall is a piece of calligraphy donated by a retired teacher, its four bold characters reminding us daily to value truth above ease. （应用文·校园介绍）
To our great delight, Li Hua's entry won first prize in the province-wide calligraphy competition, bringing honour to our school. （应用文·喜报）
The calligraphy exhibition to be held in the school gallery next week will display over fifty works by students and teachers alike, and everyone is warmly welcome. （应用文·通知）
The art of calligraphy, far from being a mere skill of writing, trains the eye, steadies the hand and quiets the heart. （议论文·艺术修养）
Signing up for the calligraphy club turned out to be the best decision of my senior year, for it gave my restless mind a place to settle. （记叙·感悟）

synonyms.example: The teacher recognized the neat handwriting at once and knew exactly who had left the unsigned thank-you note. （读后续写·悬念细节）
synonyms.usage: 指日常书写或个人笔迹,不含艺术意味;calligraphy 强调作为艺术的书法

synonyms.example: In my grandmother's day, penmanship was a subject in its own right, and pupils copied out lines until every letter stood straight. （记叙·今昔对比）
synonyms.usage: 较正式、略显旧式,指(硬笔)书写的工整与技巧;calligraphy 则是用毛笔或艺术笔进行的艺术创作

advancedExpressions.expression: -graphy = '书写/记录/图'：calligraphy 书法（calli- 美）/ geography 地理（geo- 地）/ photography 摄影（photo- 光）/ biography 传记（bio- 生命）/ autobiography 自传（auto- 自己）｜对应 -grapher 表'……者'：calligrapher, photographer, geographer
advancedExpressions.example: From calligraphy to photography and geography, the -graphy family all point to different ways of 'recording' the world. 从书法到摄影再到地理，-graphy 家族都指向'记录'世界的不同方式。（一句巩固构词法）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., an art form dating back ... years, embodies ...
advancedExpressions.example: Calligraphy, an art form dating back over two thousand years, embodies the harmony between hand, heart and mind that Chinese culture treasures. （同位语插入+抽象名词升格,文化介绍信的核心句）

advancedExpressions.expression: It was through ... that sb came to understand ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was through those quiet hours of calligraphy at Grandpa's desk that I came to understand what patience truly meant. （强调句+抽象领悟,适合续写结尾段）

advancedExpressions.expression: While some dismiss ... as ..., it is precisely ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: While some dismiss calligraphy as a relic of the past, it is precisely its slowness that offers a cure for our restless, screen-bound age. （让步+强调句双重结构,辩证有力）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What draws me to Chinese calligraphy is not merely the beauty of the strokes, but the rare stillness it demands — for the moment the brush touches paper, the noisy world quietly falls away. （夹叙夹议·兴趣描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What 主语从句聚焦 + not merely...but 递进 + 破折号 for 补充说明,以画面收束

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Tailored for students fascinated by traditional art, the calligraphy course offered by our school provides a precious opportunity to slow down, wield the brush and converse with a tradition of two thousand years. （应用文·课程介绍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语开头(Tailored for...) + 三个动词短语并列递进 + 拟人(converse with a tradition)提升格调
